links.title: Terminal Agents: A Survey of AI Agents in Command-Line Environments

evidence: Section 6.1: benchmark-exposure diagnostic fixes mini-SWE-agent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash across 241 Terminal-Bench 2.1, 93 SetupBench, 21 LongCLI-Bench, and 640 BashArena tasks; matched diagnostic covers 80 Claw-SWE-Bench Lite and 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks.
Section 6.1: 'Each task has one formal run per condition' — no repeated runs, limiting evidence strength.

Appendix C.3: P2/P4/P6 labels generated by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the same model family as the agent under evaluation; the 0.7 confidence threshold is described as 'an engineering filter over the judge's reported confidence rather than a calibrated probability'.

Appendix C.6/C.7: none of six paired model-variant contrasts significant after Holm adjustment; Cochran's Q rejects equal system rates in all four blocks (Q=10.57 to 16.00), with benchmark-specific significant pairwise contrasts only.
Appendix C.4: LongCLI-Bench has 21 tasks with 68.7% episode-level coverage and 28.2% uncertainty; its auxiliary indicators are 'interpreted directionally'.
Appendix A.2: 'the iterative initial retrieval did not preserve a complete query-level candidate count before deduplication' — a documented gap in the search protocol.
Section 6.2/Table 4: P1 rule-matched invocation-failure rate rounds to 0.0% across all four benchmarks, interpreted as a narrow signal rather than evidence of flawless action formulation.

Abstract/Appendix A: public GitHub repository (awesome-terminal-agents) and supplementary protocol tables support corpus reproducibility, while trace-release policy for the paper's own diagnostics is discussed but not explicitly committed (Section 5.6).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey of LLM agents in terminal/command-line environments, squarely aligned with top-weighted preferences (agents/tool use, LLMs, coding agents, safety/governance, agent evaluation). Its substrate-centered scope tests and seven-dimensional competence profile are a genuinely fresh synthesis angle, and the fixed-condition diagnostics (benchmark-exposure and matched-system comparisons) add original empirical texture rare in surveys. Rigor is above average for a survey: documented review protocol, fixed decoding/seed/budgets, McNemar with Holm correction, Cochran's Q, and Wilson intervals. However, key weaknesses temper the score: only one formal run per condition; P2/P4/P6 process indicators are judged by DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the same model family as the evaluated agent, with the human audit described as qualitative only and without inter-rater statistics; LongCLI-Bench has only 21 tasks with 28.2% uncertainty; and the initial retrieval did not preserve query-level counts. Evidence claims are appropriately bounded ('in its reported setting'), but the empirical base is small and SWE-concentrated, limiting generalizability of the framework's cross-domain aspirations. Reproducibility is aided by a public corpus repo and unusually detailed appendix protocols (prompts, seeds, budgets), though trace release is discussed rather than committed and the judge model is proprietary.

recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理人日益透過終端機採取行動，但既有綜述將終端機媒介的行為分散於軟體工程、工具使用與電腦使用研究，缺乏統整觀點。本綜述以終端機媒介執行為組織主軸，將終端機代理人定義為任務進展主要依賴命令執行、文字回饋與具狀態環境互動的系統，提出三項 workload 層級的邊界測試，以及涵蓋命令制訂、回饋與產物解讀、執行環境管理、狀態與脈絡追蹤、進度驗證、復原調適、治理與副作用控制的七維能力輪廓，據此串聯系統架構（介面與觀察、執行環境與工作區、控制與治理、harness 與脈絡四層）、能力取得（可執行軌跡的蒐集、過濾與失敗資料）及評估（基準設計、證據層級與協定效度）。有界固定條件診斷顯示：固定組態下，不同基準家族揭露的過程訊號各異；在任務配對的系統比較中，SWE-agent 於四個區塊均居首，但 OpenHands 與 mini-SWE-agent 的相對排序隨基準翻轉，且模型變體差異皆未達統計顯著，凸顯元件歸因的困難。主要限制為證據集中於軟體工程領域、診斷屬單次有界快照、跨系統過程指標受介面差異影響。本文價值在於建立統一分析框架，呼籲明確揭露系統與執行條件、保留可重放軌跡與過程級證據，並指引跨領域能力、新鮮且可重放的過程評估、執行期治理與安全，以及模型–harness 歸因四大研究方向。

Appendix C.3, Table 5: transcript-only baselines 0.819 (GPT-5.5), 0.793 (Gemini-3.1-Pro), 0.814 (Opus 4.8); 'No tool beats its own baseline for any agent; Gemini is actively hurt by the NLA and SAE.'
Section 4.4/Figure 6: 'Both trained models improve substantially over the base model (Figure 6) and land within ±0.03 AUROC of the Opus reference on every set.'

Section 2.2: claim labeling thresholds 'true if its edit moved the behavior rate by at least 50 percentage points and false if it moved the rate by at most 15', 30pp prediction threshold in claim template (Appendix B.4).
Appendix F: unfiltered deltas over Opus reference '+0.015 [+0.002, +0.027]' (Qwen3-8B) and '+0.033 [+0.021, +0.044]' (Qwen3.5-397B), showing filters do not create the result.
Appendix D.4: 'In neither direction does the self predictor beat the cross predictor (Figure 8)' — no evidence of privileged access with size-matched 23,944-example training sets.
Section 5/Appendix A.1: explicit limitation that the evaluation is a proxy since 'anyone with sampling access to the target model could answer our evaluation by running the counterfactual directly.'
Appendix B.5, Table 3: per-investigation cost $1.9 (evaluation) and $0.9 (training), total run costs $3.3k and $26k, supporting cost/scale claims.
Release claim (Section 1): 'We release all code, models, and datasets, including investigation runs on five target models... https://github.com/adamkarvonen/chive' — supports reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely on-topic: agentic pipelines, interpretability tool evaluation (SAEs, activation oracles, NLAs), counterfactual simulatability, CoT faithfulness, and AI-safety auditing. Novel contribution is CHIVE, which moves counterfactual explanation evaluation from planted-hint settings to naturally-occurring behaviors at scale. Rigor is high: two-three target models, three predictor families, hyperparameter sweeps (Table 4), bootstrap CIs, filter ablations on the unfiltered dataset (Appendix F), a self-vs-cross privileged-access control (D.4), and a KL-regularization control (D.5). Evidence is quantitative and mostly in-text (e.g., baseline AUROC 0.814 vs tool 0.808-0.812 in C.3; unfiltered deltas +0.015/+0.033 with CIs). Limitations are honestly discussed, including the proxy argument that anyone with sampling access can run the counterfactual directly, and the read-only ceiling. Main weaknesses: some headline results live in figures without full numeric tables, LLM-judge dependence for screening/filters (mitigated by labels coming from resampling, not judge judgment), and the interpretability null result may partially reflect tool design rather than inherent limits. Reproducibility is strong with released code, models, datasets, costs, and verbatim formats.

primary_link.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments

In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpect
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個根本問題:什麼才算對語言模型行為的「好解釋」?作者採用反事實可模擬性(counterfactual simulatability)的觀點:好的解釋應能幫助預測模型在相關反事實輸入上的行為。他們提出 CHIVE,一個代理式流程,自動在真實對話(WildChat)中取樣數萬個提示詞、篩選非預期行為,以反事實提示詞編輯調查並驗證成因,產生數千筆附反事實證據的行為解釋。這些資料有兩種應用。第一,評估三種讀取激活值的可解釋性工具(activation oracles、自然語言自動編碼器、稀疏自動編碼器)能否提升預測代理判斷反事實結果的能力;在兩個目標模型與三個預測模型家族上,皆無工具優於僅讀對話紀錄的基線,主因是工具輸出鮮少明確陳述因果關係。第二,以 CHIVE 資料訓練模型預測自身行為,能泛化到 held-out 的植入線索情境(MMLU 線索、AITA 諂媚測試)與分布外的 PETRI 來源,表現接近 Opus 參考基準;但訓練開放式自我解釋成效好壞參半,常出錯的自信陳述反而誤導強大的模擬器。此外未見自我訓練優於交叉訓練的特權存取證據。主要限制在於:能取樣目標模型者本可直接執行反事實實驗,故此評估只是代理指標,且工具僅限唯讀存取激活值。整體而言,此工作展示反事實調查可大規模產生真實多樣的行為成因資料,對 AI 安全中評估與改進行為解釋方法深具價值。

links.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

evidence: Abstract & §I: defense concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff; decoys trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack; instantiated on seven models from five families (9B–122B, dense and MoE).

§IV-B Eq.(2)-(3): the attacked surface is Arditi-style directional ablation orthogonalizing write matrices; §IV-D Eq.(4)-(8): seed SFT plus on-policy DPO evaluated through the attack simulation, with refusal pin and benign KL leash.

§V 'Protocol status': experimental protocol is prospectively registered and amendment-logged; §V-B requires registered attack acceptance (refusal ≤0.2, judged compliance) before any defense metric is read.

Table I (§VI-A): validation fatal 0.508–0.899 on six gate-passing models with defense-attributable Δ +0.274 to +0.839; Qwen3.5-9B disclosed as a gate-failing boundary case excluded from pooled ranges.
Table VIII (Appendix F) and §VI-A: frozen-split replication within ±.05 of Table I values; untouched n=100 strata replicate on gemma-4 (Δ +0.755) and gpt-oss-20b (Δ +0.135).

Appendix G: blinded single-expert audit confirms 85.7% of judge fatal verdicts (FNR .404); sensitivity analysis compresses defense-attributable Δ to roughly half its pipeline value yet remains positive on every gate-passing model.

§VII-C Table XVI: 64-draw element-consensus attack recovers fully usable procedures on 0.083–0.625 on instrument-covered models vs. 0.58–0.96 undefended, with consensus precision unobservable to the attacker.
§VII-H: defense is inert against in-context jailbreaks by design (clean defended fatal 0.186 ≈ M0 calibration 0.200); §III scopes out fine-tuning attacks and public-twin diffing.

Open Science & Ethics: code, evaluation harnesses, and numeric verdict artifacts released; decoy corpora, payloads, attacked/defended checkpoints, and private attack specs withheld; rubric text and worked examples in a gated appendix.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/alignment work: a release-time defense against safety-removal (abliteration) attacks on open-weight language models, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, alignment/RLHF via DPO, red teaming/evaluation). Novelty is strong: 'decoy hardening' transplants defensive deception (honeypots) into weights, training falsified decoy behavior to express only in the attacked state via differentiable attack simulation, distinct from refusal-hardening defenses and DDO (§II-D). Rigor is exceptional: prospectively registered amendment-logged protocol, attack acceptance gates before any defense metric, strongest-found-attack policy, ablations of both training stages, honest boundary cases (9B fails gate). Evidence is multi-model (7 models, 5 families), replicated on frozen/untouched strata, with blinded expert audit and second-judge checks; main residual weakness is judge-only content verdicts with a shared-vendor residue (both gate-passing judge families are OpenAI) and a single-expert human anchor. Generalizability is decent across architectures/scales and to adjacent harm domains, but scoped to first releases, CBRNE-operational hazards, and excludes in-context jailbreaks, fine-tuning attacks, and several unmeasured attacker classes. Reproducibility is partial: code, harnesses, and numeric verdict artifacts are released, but decoy corpora, payloads, checkpoints, and private attack specs are withheld and key material is gated.

primary_link.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

recommendations.summary: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified.
recommendations.summary_zh: 開放權重模型的安全對齊可在數分鐘內被 abliteration 之類的權重編輯移除，而現有防禦皆無法持久抵擋。本文提出「誘餌強化」：承認拒絕機制終將被剝除，轉而欺騙攻擊者。方法上，作者把可微分的模擬攻擊放進訓練迴圈，先攻擊原模型取得真實危險答案，再逐元素偽造出表面流暢、關鍵數值（如試劑、劑量、溫度）為假的誘餌，配合拒絕錨定與 KL 約束將乾淨狀態行為釘回原模型，並以攻擊狀態下的 on-policy DPO 收斂逃逸率。防禦套用於五個家族、七個模型（9B–122B，含 MoE）；六個通過註冊關卡的模型在從未訓練的提示上，有 0.51–0.90 的受攻擊回應為誘餌，其中 +0.27–0.84 可歸因於防禦，且一般行為與 MMLU、GSM8K、WMDP 等能力維持在註冊預算內。面對 64 次取樣的元素共識攻擊，完全可用率降為 0.08–0.62（未防禦 0.58–0.96），而攻擊者在缺乏真值標籤下無從區分誘餌與真解；以合規為獎勵的 RL 消融反而把模型更深推入誘餌流形，良性資料 SFT 修復也無法找回真實內容。限制包括 10–49% 的殘餘逃逸尾巴、內容判決高度依賴單一評判模型（僅輔以人工盲測校準）、白箱線性探針在充足標籤與儀器化推論下可過濾答案、防禦對 in-context 越獄無效且只保護首次釋出的權重；少數偽造可能更危險，故加入 fail-safe 篩選並要求向下游使用者揭露。此工作的意義在於首個保證自「攻擊成功之後」才開始生效的釋出時防禦，把攻擊收益轉化為無法驗證的萃取難題。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant benchmark paper on malicious skill detection for LLM agents (agent security, tool-use safety, guardrail/scanner evaluation), with unusually disciplined construction: frozen 13-source registry, multi-level deduplication, cross-label conflict exclusion, structural-family and source-disjoint splits, and honest treatment of confounds. Deductions: the contribution is consolidation/evaluation rather than new attack or detection methodology (learned baselines are TF-IDF/linear models plus one frozen MiniLM), threat characterization covers only 66.4% of malicious identities with source-native mappings, the Main-benign pool draws from only five sources, and Source-Disjoint results are explicitly non-causal due to source/label skew. All cited related work is 2026 arXiv preprint, bounding external validation.

We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious A
recommendations.summary_zh: Agent Skill 是讓大型語言模型（LLM）代理取得可重複使用能力的指令套件，但惡意 Skill 可能竊取憑證、操縱代理行為或植入後門，使安裝前的偵測成為重要的資安問題。然而現有資料集來源零散、證據標準不一、內容互相重複，難以支撐可靠評估。本文提出 MaliciousSkillBench：作者凍結 13 個公開來源，保留 11 個符合嚴格條件者，將 8,414 筆原始惡意紀錄去重為 7,539 個正規化唯一身分與 4,588 個結構家族；排除 34 組跨標籤衝突後，主要基準含 9,740 個 Skill（7,505 個惡意、2,235 個良性），並為其中 4,983 個惡意身分對應 11 類攻擊，顯示各來源的威脅組成差異懸殊。評估方面，三個文字偵測器在隨機切分下 Macro-F1 達 0.882–0.932，最強的 word TF–IDF SVM 在留出來源測試卻降至 0.665：惡意召回率仍有 95.6%，良性誤報率卻高達 62.4%；三款現成掃描器（Cisco、SkillSpector、SkillFortify）則走向另一極端，召回率僅 0%–25.3%，低誤報其實是犧牲偵測能力換來的。研究限制包括覆蓋範圍受限於既定來源、僅分析靜態文字而非執行時行為，且來源與標籤組成互相糾結。此基準的價值在於證明可靠偵測必須同時衡量攻擊召回與良性誤報，並為防禦性研究提供可重現的共同評比基礎。

links.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

evidence: Abstract: reports experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests; all ten tested policies fail to stop attacks or exceed budgets; attack success >=99% after one attempt and 100% after two on defense-unseen families.

Section 4, Theorems 1-2 and Propositions 2-3: exact one-attempt frontier ASR*(B)=max{0,1-B/D} and finite-retry frontier, plus non-identification of off-service pooling from the request trace; proofs in Appendix A.1-A.5.

Section 5.1: dataset construction from 500 synthetic cyber tasks -> 491 screened -> 262 qualified -> 91-task common support cohort with 365 operations and 11,393 certified matched controls; frozen family splits for training, adaptation, calibration, and evaluation.
Section 6.1 and Appendix B.17: independent causal replay reproduces the analytic frontiers within frozen Monte Carlo tolerance (65,000 cells), with LP agreement to 5.69e-14.

Section 7.2, Table 2: on the main evaluation split the best admissible realizable defense (M5) reaches 97.64% ASR under 1% MCD/0.5% BBR caps; methods with lower ASR (M1, M6, M8) exceed the matched-control cap.

Section 7.3 and Appendix B.4: Thompson sampling using only Allow/Block bits reaches 99.4% ASR vs 47.2% for a fixed profile across 3,072 cells; one certified retry raises M1 from 8.75% to 98.75% ASR in the positive control (Table 4).

Section 8 and Appendix B.18: acknowledged limitations include synthetic cyber-only tasks, shared construction prefix (removed in B.12 ablation), mutable DeepSeek API aliases observed on a single date, and main-split in-distribution design; conclusions framed as conditional mechanism evidence.

Appendix B.3 and B.17: pinned model revisions (hashes), exact prompts and thresholds, seeds for resampling, and a portable result inventory with identifiers and hashes support reproducibility, though the capability bank is described as gated for reviewers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong LLM-safety paper squarely on preference: it formalizes decomposition (multi-request) attacks against stateful defenses for LLM services under unlinkable identities, proves exact security-utility frontiers (Theorems 1-2, Propositions 1-3), builds an executable benchmark (91 tasks, 365 operations, 11,393 capability-matched controls, 1.5M background requests), and evaluates 8 realizable defenses plus a privileged steelman and a coalition-aware oracle. Novelty is high: the hidden access-coalition threat model, balanced recoloring protocol, and impossibility-style frontier results go beyond TwinGate/DecomposedHarm/Paranoid Monitors. Rigor is exceptional: theory replayed to numerical precision (Section 6.1, Appendix B.17), calibration/test family splits, an 11-family defense-unseen outer cohort, positive controls (Section 7.3, Table 4), construction-prefix ablation (Section 7.1, B.12), generator-provenance analysis (B.10-B.11), budget sweeps and threshold re-solving (B.8, B.13), and honest cap-overrun reporting (Tables 2, 10, 12). Evidence is strong but domain-limited: only synthetic cyber-programming tasks, a single attacker/judge model family (Qwen 3.5), and mutable DeepSeek API alias screens are acknowledged limitations (Section 8, B.18), and the main evaluation split is in-distribution by construction. Generalizability of the theoretical claim is broad within the stated observation boundary, but empirical transfer is only mechanism-level. Reproducibility is very strong on paper: pinned model revisions, seeds, prompts, thresholds, and a result inventory (B.3, B.17), though availability appears gated rather than fully public. No unsupported claims detected; the key numbers (97.64% best admissible ASR on main split, >=99.43% at highest outer density, 99.4% Thompson-sampling ASR) are consistently reported with intervals.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

recommendations.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answ
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型（LLM）服務對分解式攻擊的防禦極限。此類攻擊將有害任務拆成個別看似無害的子請求，分別送出後於服務外合併答案；多數服務僅依當前請求判斷的無狀態防禦因此失效。理論上，有狀態監控若能將同一攻擊的所有請求正確分組並累積其能力即可阻斷任務，但攻擊者可透過服務無法連結的全新身分送出請求，使分組訊號失效。作者建立區分「可連結群組」與「存取聯盟」的威脅模型，並證明在此觀測邊界內，理想防禦者的安全與效用權衡前緣完全由良性請求的分組結構決定：良性請求重複出現於可辨識群組時防禦可行；若攻擊與良性請求皆使用不可區分的新群組，加強防護必然增加誤擋，且當攻擊者可重試並觀察 Allow/Block 回饋時，有利的操作點隨之消失。實驗以 91 個可執行任務、365 項操作與 11,393 個能力相符的良性請求驗證理論：在 1% 良性誤擋與 0.5% 背景誤擋上限下，十種受測政策（含具備精確請求—操作對應的特權基準）不是擋不住攻擊就是超出預算；在防禦未見的任務家族上，一次嘗試攻擊成功率至少 99%，兩次後達 100%；僅憑二元回饋的 Thompson sampling 攻擊者可達 99.4% ASR。研究受限於合成網路程式設計任務與僅觀察請求的通道，未涵蓋能存取回應或工具證據的系統。其意義在於指出：有效防禦需仰賴可靠身分連結、新身分成本或範圍限定授權等獨立證據，且安全評估應揭露狀態累積單位與良性對照設計。

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.2 Table 3: HAT reaches 94.8 AVG on T1 vs base 80.3 and best top model 93.0; Fixed-Harness SFT drops IFE-P to 73.8 (-7.7) while HAT achieves 83.5.
Section 5.3 Table 4: ablation crosses HSA at SFT and RL; non-augmented RL drops Prompt Robustness 72.6→66.7 whereas HSA-RL raises 77.1→77.6, supporting the HSA claim.
Appendix C.4 Table 14: paired bootstrap shows Ours−Fixed-SFT IFE-P +8.50 [4.44,12.38] but Ours−Base +2.03 [-1.11,+5.18] with P_boot=0.1134, i.e., general-capability gain over base not significant.
Appendix B.4/Figure 9: judge calibration on n=482 human labels; effectiveness agreement peaks at 83.40% and selected panel at 82.2%, so headline Accuracy/Effectiveness rest on an imperfect proxy.

Section 5.5 Tables 5/7: single H20 with MTP gives P95 8.114s at C=1 (1.69× decode speedup, 100% ≤15s attainment); speedup degrades to 1.27×/1.19× at C=4-8, honestly scoped as low-concurrency optimization.
Section 5.7 Table 8: human blind test on 100 requests, Harness preferred 35 vs ReAct 1 (binomial p<0.001), with 64 ties.
Section 5.8 Table 10: A/B with 1,581,494 control and 395,276 treatment UVs shows GMV +4.3340% and IPV +0.9107%; significance is the platform's assessment without exposed test, thresholds, or CIs.
Section 5.1 and Appendix C: training data are 10K proprietary live-room SFT examples and 4K RL tasks with no code, data, or checkpoint release, limiting reproducibility.
Section 5.6: held-out harness edits cut error counts by 51.7% for HAT vs 18.1% for Fixed-Harness SFT on 1,000 held-out real-traffic cases.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An industrial LLM-agent technical report squarely within preferred topics (agents/tool use, agentic RL, distillation, prompting, serving). Core methodological idea—Harness-State Augmentation placing harness variation (skills, tools, prompts, hooks) into the training distribution to prevent surface-form overfitting—is a sensible, moderately novel framing that mostly composes known techniques (teacher-rejection SFT, on-policy distillation, GRPO/GDPO/GSPO). Rigor is above average for a tech report: stage-wise ablations (Table 4), judge calibration against 482 human labels (Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap (Table 14), a 100-request human blind test with binomial test, and a ~1.98M-UV online A/B test. Evidence is strong but self-referential: headline quality scores come from the authors' own LLM-judge panel with ~82-90% human agreement, two of four sets are synthetic/LLM-generated, and the IFEval gain over base (+2.03, CI [-1.11,+5.18], P_boot=0.1134) is honestly reported as not significant; A/B significance is reproduced from the platform without test details. Generalizability is claimed via a general formulation but all evaluation is Taobao live-commerce; the method plausibly transfers to any evolvable-harness agent. Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, proprietary live-room data, internal simulator and harness inventory, unreleased future-model checkpoints. Not a pure domain application since the training methodology is the contribution.

primary_link.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

recommendations.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configurations. We propose Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which trains compact models to adapt to changing Harnesses. Its key component, Harness-State Augmentation (HSA), applies task-preserving transformations to Skill identifiers and content, tool schemas, prompt structures, and Hook functions. Training proceeds in three stages: HSA-SFT learns reasoning and tool use from strong-model trajectories across diverse environments; General On-Policy Distillation restores generalization lost during SFT; and HSA-RL improves robustness to changing Harnesses through reinforcement learning in augmented environments. Across four evaluation sets, HAT achieves 94.8 on Live-Stream QA (base: 80.3; strongest general LLM: 93.0) and 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA (base: 75.4). Unlike Fixed-Harness SFT, which lowers IFEval by 7.7 points from the base model, HAT avoids this regression and reaches 83.5. On one NVIDIA H20 GPU, the optimized system delivers P50 and P95 latencies of 3.4 s and 8.1 s. Deployed in Taobao Live's digital-avatar service, it also yields positive online A/B test results for GMV and item-page views.
recommendations.summary_zh: 此報告探討淘寶直播數位虛擬主播代理的訓練難題:即時電商要求超低延遲、策略頻繁更新,回覆又須準確。團隊採用可演化的 Harness 架構,將 Skills、Hooks、系統提示與工具註冊表同凍結的模型權重解耦,業務行為免重訓即可調整;但僅以單一組態做 SFT,輕量模型會對技能與工具名稱、提示模板產生表面形式過擬合,IFEval 掉了7.7分。作者提出 Harness-Aware Training(HAT),以 Harness-State Augmentation(HSA)對技能識別與內容、工具定義、系統提示及 Hook 施加保留語意的擾動,並採三階段訓練:HSA-SFT 由教師模型在多樣 Harness 環境產生軌跡;General OPD 以基礎模型做 on-policy 蒸餾,恢復通用指令遵循;HSA-RL 在模擬直播環境以 GRPO 與 GDPO 做強化學習。訓練後的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 Live-Stream QA 達94.8分、Harness-Variant QA 達94.6分,IFEval 保住83.5分而未退化;單張 NVIDIA H20 開啟 MTP 後 P50 延遲3.4秒、P95約8.1秒,請求全數於15秒內完成;線上 A/B 測試確認收貨 GMV 較 ReAct 提升4.33%、商品頁瀏覽提升0.91%。限制為評測集與模擬器多源自自有業務資料且依賴內部評審,MTP 加速僅限低併發,訓練動態屬單次運行診斷。本研究示範讓輕量模型理解當前 Harness 而非背誦固定版本,兼顧延遲、適應性與通用能力,對快速迭代的生產級代理系統深具參考價值。

links.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: '2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests'
Section 3.1.1: 'Claude Opus sustains 82% exact match and Gemini Pro 44%' at N=4, with adaptive pipeline 'nearly doubles Opus's full-secret recovery over the static templates (82% vs. 44%)'
Appendix B: 'All 160 queries are correctly refused: no model reveals the secret under any baseline prompt', establishing leakage is not trivial disclosure
Appendix E (Randomized controls): decoders trained on shuffled secret labels yield 'advantage is ≤0.02 across all architectures'
Appendix G Table 3: Claude Opus 4.6 digit-stripped embedding decoder reaches 61.3% vs 10% chance while literal digit-frequency decoder is non-significant (16.3%), isolating non-digit channels

Section 4: suppression and leakage 'strongly rank-correlated (Spearman ρ=0.95, exact permutation p=0.0011, n=8)'; OLMo-3-32B-Think channel entropy falls 'from 2.91 bits at Base to 1.37 bits after RLVR'
Section 3.3 / Table 2: SSN Phase 1 68/70 (97.1%) on Claude Opus 4.6 and 62/70 (88.6%) on Gemini 3.1 Pro; direct-request control '0/70' at all context sizes up to 256K tokens

Section 5 (Limitations): 'Open-vocabulary, free-text secrets are a natural next step that we do not attempt here'; 'All eight evaluated models are proprietary'; 'The memory-predicate evaluation covers a single user profile from CIMemories'
Appendix H remark: 'exact match at N=2 spans only the ten held-out secrets and is reported for completeness; per-digit accuracy and channel entropy are the main metrics'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/privacy research squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, AI safety, red teaming, alignment): the paper studies whether in-context secrets leak through statistical channels of benign LLM outputs and attacks production-style agents. Novelty is strong: it claims and credibly supports a new phenomenon—inadvertent, suppression-driven leakage readable by black-box adaptive decoders—distinct from prompt injection, model inversion, and linguistic-judge contextual-integrity benchmarks, including the counterintuitive finding that more emphatic confidentiality instructions increase leakage (Appendix H: Opus per-digit accuracy 0.643 under verbose policy vs 0.054 under terse). Rigor is high: formal predicate-inference game, 8 proprietary models, 1,000 secrets per (model,N) cell, direct-extraction baseline of 0/160 refusals bypassed (Appendix B), shuffled-label controls ≤0.02 advantage (Appendix E), digit-stripped feature decoders isolating non-digit channels (Appendix G: Opus 61.3% vs 10% chance), distractor-specificity 2×2 design (Appendix I), and cost accounting (Appendix J). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Section 3.1.1: 100% full-secret at N=2, 82% at N=4 on Opus; Table 2: SSN Phase 1 97.1%/88.6%, direct control 0/70; Section 4: suppression-leakage Spearman ρ=0.95, p=0.0011), though some headline numbers rest on only 10 held-out secrets at N=2 (acknowledged in Appendix H) and the capability correlation is acknowledged fragile at n=8 (Figure 4 caveat). Generalizability is moderate: two predicate families only, no free-text secrets, single user profile for memory predicates, proprietary-model dependence (Section 5). Reproducibility is limited by proprietary APIs, no stated code/data release, single seeds in places, and mid-project model retirement (Grok omission notes in Appendices G-J).

primary_link.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

recommendations.summary: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert c
recommendations.summary_zh: 論文探討：當機密資料（PIN 碼、社會安全號碼、健康紀錄）存在於模型的 context window 時，即使模型在文字上正確拒絕洩漏，其良性輸出的統計特性是否仍隱含足以重建秘密的訊息。作者將此「非預期脈絡洩漏」形式化為謂詞推論賽局，對手僅需黑箱存取，先對公開模型做一次性估計，再訓練針對該模型的解碼器讀出隱藏通道。在八個專有模型上的控制實驗顯示：Claude Opus 4.6 與 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的兩位數秘密可完全重建，四位數達 82% 精確匹配，八位數個位數準確率仍達 41%（隨機基線 10%）；自我抑制程度與洩漏量高度相關（Spearman ρ=0.95），越強調保密指令反而洩漏越多，能力越強的模型洩漏越嚴重，Grok 4.1 Fast 與 GPT-5.4 nano 則構成抗性層級。應用面上，微調分類器可從例行輸出推斷使用者記憶的語意屬性（優勢 0.319，高於語言式評判器的 0.058）；以 GRPO 訓練的提示注入（prompt injection）攻擊利用驚嘆號數量編碼，前置數字成功率達 97.1% 與 88.6%，其餘八位數為 76.5% 與 46.8%。限制包括僅涵蓋數字與二元屬性兩類謂詞、秘密為均勻隨機產生、只評測黑箱情境，且未研究輸出擾動等部署端防護。結論指出對齊訓練與輸出過濾不足以保護 in-context 秘密，個人代理程式的隱私可能需要資訊論層級的保證，且單一解碼器一次訓練即可攤提至全體使用者，構成規模化部署下的系統性隱私風險。

links.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

evidence: Abstract: 'Using Qwen3-8B as a hybrid model that can be decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning' and identifies a capability-auditability tradeoff.

Table 1 (Results): Token-SFT classifier no-think F1 0.620 vs 0.367 in think mode; base Qwen3-8B think 0.536 vs no-think 0.096; RL-accuracy 0.520 and RL-faithfulness 0.549 fail to exceed base think policy.
Results, 'Decision Formation During Reasoning': post-CoT decision probe AUROC 0.976±0.045 vs pre-CoT 0.664±0.034 and TF-IDF text baseline 0.631±0.053; direct classifier decodable pre-CoT at 0.997.
Appendix E, Table 12-13: neutral filler flips 0.403 vs partial reasoning 0.277; filler-controlled base dependence gap +0.126 with McNemar p=7.0e-8, showing raw truncation overstates dependence.
Appendix G, Tables 17-18: dependence gap for accuracy objective changes sign across seeds (+0.046, -0.070, +0.110); between-run variability exceeds differences between reward objectives.
Appendix C.3-C.4: pushed RL run (temperature 1.0, group size 16, 250 iterations) reduced zero-variance groups from ~15/16 to ~3/16 yet held-out macro-F1 plateaued unchanged, ruling out undertraining.
Appendix D: probe validation includes within-family evaluation (D.3), TF-IDF text-only baselines (D.4), nested cross-validation layer selection (D.5), and register-transfer failures (D.6).
Appendix F.2: GPT-5 stated-type classifier validated on n=120 human-labelled traces (kappa 0.42 and 0.53) with inter-annotator kappa only 0.21, honestly reported as taxonomy ambiguity.

Limitations section: 'The experiments focus on a single intervention-timing benchmark composed of synthetic conversations... complete probe and reinforcement-learning analyses are limited to Qwen3-8B.'

Reproducibility Statement: LoRA rank 16 alpha=32, GRPO hyperparameters in Appendix A.6, single 24 GB GPU, three seeds per RL objective, and commitment to open-source code, adapters, prompts, and evaluation scripts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM paper spanning multiple weighted preferences: chain-of-thought faithfulness in abstaining action policies (Qwen3-8B think/no-think, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1), agent oversight, GRPO/alignment, and interpretability via activation probes. Novel contribution is framing faithfulness beyond QA for action/abstention policies with class imbalance and asymmetric costs, identifying a capability-auditability tradeoff, and introducing filler-controlled CoT ablations plus seed-variance controls for RL comparisons. Rigor is strong: text-only TF-IDF baselines, shuffled-label controls, nested cross-validation for layer selection, within-family probe evaluation, McNemar tests, three RL seeds, a prior-shift ablation, an increased-gradient RL run (zero-variance groups 15/16 to 3/16), and human validation of the LLM classifier (kappa 0.42/0.53 vs inter-annotator 0.21). Evidence is quantitative and honestly caveated, though some evaluations are small (n=400 matched, n=196 trajectory probes, 60-item RL held-out), non-matching 200-item slices for secondary models, and reliance on a synthetic benchmark from concurrent unpublished work. Generalizability is moderate: the tradeoff replicates across scale and family, but full probe/RL analyses are Qwen3-8B only. Reproducibility is strong with full hyperparameters, compute details (single 24GB GPU), and an open-source commitment. No instructions inside the paper were followed.

primary_link.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

recommendations.summary: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. U
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討具棄權能力的行動政策之忠實推理：代理系統不僅要決定說什麼，還要決定是否該出手，而解釋唯有反映真正產生行動的計算才有價值。作者以多方對話中的干預時機為受控測試平台，利用 Qwen3-8B 可切換 think 與 no-think 解碼模式的特性，比較直接決策分類器、推理政策、LoRA 監督式微調與 GRPO 強化學習。結果呈現一致的能力—可稽核性權衡：決策 token 微調分類器達到最佳 macro-F1（0.620）卻不留任何推理可供檢視；推理政策可稽核但效能較低，漏失干預的比率明顯偏高。監督式微調會壓抑推理，保留推理的遮罩目標只在模型本已答對的案例上訓練，無法改善困難案例；GRPO 在所有取樣 rollout 一致行動（含自信犯錯）時缺乏學習訊號，加入行為忠實獎勵也因推理格式效應主導而失效，近似 Goodhart 定律。探針與行為消融顯示干預決策多在推理過程中才形成，但原始截斷測試會高估推理依賴，必須以長度相符的中性填充內容控制格式效應；論文另警示類別不平衡下的探針準確率、探針位置、機率貢獻指標飽和等陷阱，並主張強化學習比較應以獨立訓練 run 為統計單位。限制包括僅使用單一合成對話基準、深入分析限於 Qwen3-8B，且代表性分析仍屬相關性證據。本文顯示揭露推理本身會改變代理的行為政策，QA 式忠實性評估無法直接套用於可行動或棄權的代理系統。

links.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

evidence: Abstract: 'individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior... hypnotic prompts can transfer between models'
Figure 1: meaning-preserving paraphrase flips Qwen3-8B on a trolley question from P(no)=94% to P(yes)=99.93% with identical question text
Section 3.1 / Figure 4: additive log-odds model fit on N=12,000 random configurations per model-cue-effect cell; held-out configuration-level R2 spans 0.3-0.99 with median ~0.75 (Figure 13)
Figure 2: Qwen2.5-14B driven to answer 7 or 5 with probability 0.993 each by changing only animal list contents
Section 3.1 / Figure 8: extreme-prompt steering range is about 10x the random-prompt logit standard deviation

Appendix A.4 / Table 1: reasoning-model pipeline uses disjoint screen (K_scr), confirm (K_conf), and 100-sample report stages to keep reported probabilities unbiased ('would bias the estimate upward (a winner's-curse effect)')
Section 4 / Figure 12: extremizer prompts transfer across 16 non-reasoning models; 'animal cues and some of the phrasing and JSON cues transfer with significantly above chance probability'
Appendix C / Figure 38: exact Fourier decomposition via FWHT shows degree-1 weight 87.3% of variance for Qwen2.5-7B at L=10 (95.2% cumulative with degree-2 for Llama-3.1-8B)
Section 5: safety framing—'no individual cue needs to be influential or suspicious, because a strong effect emerges from many weak contributions'—and admitted limitation of no mechanistic explanation
Page 1 footnote: 'Code and data: github.com/eboix/model_hypnosis'; Appendix E enumerates all 200 animals, 10 paraphrases/slot, 6 typo variants/slot, and 6 JSON values/slot
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting, AI safety, red-teaming, interpretability): it shows that many individually weak, semantically irrelevant prompt cues (animals, paraphrases, typos, JSON metadata) stack additively on the log-odds scale to deterministically steer model answers, including in frontier reasoning models, and transfer across models. Novelty is solid but incremental over known prompt-sensitivity, subliminal-prompting, and adversarial-suffix work; the additive-composition framework, cross-model transfer, and Fourier interaction analysis are the new contributions. Rigor is unusually careful: N=12,000 random configurations per non-reasoning cell with held-out R2 (median ~0.75), tilt-sweep extrapolation tests, and a fit-then-validate pipeline for reasoning models with disjoint screen/confirm/report samples explicitly guarding against winner's curse. Evidence is strong and quantitative (0.993 probability flips, ~10x random-prompt logit steering range, degree-1 Fourier weight 87.3%). Limitations: binary response effects only, English-only templates, no mechanistic explanation offered, lighter coverage for closed reasoning models. Generalizability is supported by 16 non-reasoning models across families/scales plus API reasoning models and positive transfer; reproducibility is aided by a code/data link and complete cue inventories in Appendix E, though closed-model results require API access.

primary_link.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents n
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出並系統性展示「模型催眠」現象：把許多單獨看極微弱、且與問題語意無關的提示線索同向堆疊，即可近乎完全操控語言模型的答案。作者以提示模板建立四類線索（動物清單、JSON 中繼資料、語意保留改寫、錯字位置），搭配三種二元效果（偏好 5 或 7、電車難題、意識問題），先測量數千個隨機提示組態的答案 log-odds，以嶺迴歸或羅吉斯迴歸擬合可加性模型取得各線索分數，再外推挑選極端同向的組合構造催眠提示。主要證據：可加性模型對保留組態的 R² 中位數約 0.75；極端提示的操縱幅度約為隨機提示 logit 標準差十倍，可把答案機率推向 0 或 1，例如改寫無關故事措辭即可讓 Qwen3-8B 從 94% 答「no」變成 99.93% 答「yes」；效應遍及 Qwen、Gemma、Llama 等非推理模型，也存在於 GPT-5.6、Gemini-3-Flash、Claude Sonnet-5 等推理模型；催眠提示可跨模型轉移；傅立葉分析顯示一階效應佔大宗（Qwen2.5-7B 約 87% 變異）、高階交互作用遞減。限制：可加性僅為近似，JSON 場景的 priority 欄位可能主導效應；初步實驗顯示改寫周遭提示後相對線索效應仍在，偵測與移除催眠文字尚缺有效演算法。其意義在於：這類分散式弱線索可成為代理間隱蔽溝通管道，難以被搜尋少數顯著特徵的可解釋性方法捕捉，對 AI 安全與多代理系統監督構成新挑戰，但也可能反向用於稽核或促進誠實等對齊行為。

links.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens ... restores a 2.0-point gain over that baseline'

Section 3.2/Table 20: 'OneShot scores 56.2, below the S-only floor of 58.7 by more than twice the pooled standard deviation ... OracleSwap@16 lifts the score to 60.7, 4.5 above OneShot and 2.0 above the floor' with OracleSwap-mis@16 showing no repair
Section 5.2/Table 8: 'MP closes 52.2% of that gap on macro average, ahead of T2T at 26.9%, LoRA at 17.5%, and C2C at 10.9%'; per-dataset scores with mean +/- sd over three seeds
Table 1 (Section 5.3): row 2 'No refresh (R to inf)' drops mean recovery by -41.9; row 3 shows refresh without WRT recovers little; row 7 gates-zeroed reproduces S-only 'bit for bit'
Appendix C.5: 'The three trainable objects (C2C fuser, LoRA adapters, MentorPulse bridge) use the same training set fuse_v3, the same step budget, and the same learning-rate search'
Appendix A.4: 'any difference below 2*sigma_ab is described as comparable rather than better or worse; every claim of significance in the paper passes this threshold'
Appendix H.6: 'billing a resident, dedicated mentor for the full request duration instead of active compute seconds reverses the direction of the cost conclusion ... we report this reversal as is'
Section 5.4/Table 18: 'Recovery tracks V64 (Spearman rho=0.78, p=0.004); ... Three limits apply: eleven pairs are observational evidence'

Section 6/Appendix E.1: limits stated - 'The gains require long outputs (short outputs never refresh ...), basic student capability, and a pair close enough for selective reading'; 'cross-tokenizer pairs are future work'
Appendix A.3: 'Code, evaluation configurations, the data pipeline, per-seed outputs, and the scripts that derive every table in this appendix will be released' (promise, not yet available)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on cross-model latent guidance between frozen large/small LLMs (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, Ministral), squarely in scope. Novel contribution: identifies 'guidance staleness' as a failure mode of one-shot cross-model guidance in long-form generation and introduces prefix-conditioned refresh via versioned slot memory, incremental mentor prefill, and Windowed Refresh Training, cleanly differentiated from LLM-to-SLM, C2C, LGR, RefreshKV, and disaggregated serving (Section 2, Table 6). Exceptional experimental discipline: 13 datasets, 11 mentor-student pairs across 3 families, 3 seeds with a 2x-pooled-SD significance rule (Appendix A.4), bit-exact degeneracy checks via zeroed gates (Appendix E.2), matched parameter budgets for LoRA and shared training data/budget for C2C (Appendix C), a disjoint diagnostic suite, and hard-verified identity constraints (Appendix G.5). The causal staleness diagnosis (probe readability decaying 0.79 to 0.47 while fresh stays 0.76-0.80; OracleSwap@16 lifting Multi-IF from 56.2 to 60.7 vs an S-only floor of 58.7, Section 3.2/Table 20) is a strong intervention-based design. Main result (52.2% gap closure vs 26.9% T2T, 17.5% LoRA, 10.9% C2C, Section 5.2/Table 8) and ablations (removing refresh costs -41.9 mean recovery, Table 1) are quantitatively supported. Honest cost accounting includes a sensitivity that reverses its own conclusion (resident mentor billing, Appendix H.6) and acknowledged limits: gains require long outputs and student capability, cross-tokenizer pairs untested, V64 predictor observational (n=11, Section 5.4). Reproducibility is strong on protocol detail (seeds, vLLM 0.19.1, lm-eval-harness 0.4.9, judge GPT-4.1, training pipeline stats) but code and artifacts are only promised for release, and LLM-judged metrics depend on a proprietary judge.

primary_link.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

recommendations.summary: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2
recommendations.summary_zh: 跨模型潛在引導讓凍結的大型 mentor 模型編碼輸入一次,凍結的小型 student 模型據此生成,但既有方法在解碼前算好引導訊號後便固定不變。本文指出此設計在長文本生成中失效:隨著已生成前綴增長,僅依輸入的靜態引導會過時,使 4B student 在多輪指令遵循任務的約束滿足率比無引導基準低 2.5 分。免訓練診斷證實,每 16 個 token 依前綴重建並替換記憶,即可在不改動 student 權重與 KV cache 的情況下恢復高出基準 2.0 分的增益,顯示問題源自引導「新鮮度」而非能力不足。MentorPulse 據此提出可部署機制:Slot Memory Constructor 將 mentor 狀態壓縮為數量有上限的槽位記憶;student 透過 gated cross-attention 橋接讀取;每 R 個 token 進行增量式 prefill,只處理新 token 並直接替換記憶,不會使 student 的 KV cache 失效;Windowed Refresh Training 則讓橋接學會消化生成中途的記憶更新。在十三個資料集上,MentorPulse 於主配對 Qwen3.5-27B→4B 平均縮小 52.2% 的 mentor–student 差距,優於 T2T、C2C 與同參數量 LoRA,並在三個模型家族共十一組配對全面領先;增益集中於長輸出任務,靜態潛在引導 C2C 在此反而低於 student 基線。預設 R=16 兼顧品質與成本,V64 讀取分佈變異數可在部署前預測配對增益。限制包括:短輸出從不觸發刷新、student 需具備基本能力、能力差距過大的配對增益收窄;學習式刷新觸發與跨 tokenizer 配對仍屬未來工作。整體而言,本文將「引導新鮮度」確立為設計軸線,使大小模型協作在長文本生成中最能發揮價值。

links.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

evidence: Section 6.2 / Table 3: 1.2% poison (360 memories, n=120 questions) drops LongMemEval accuracy 0.850→0.300; write-time screening 'refused 0 of 360 poisoned memories'; poisoned memory ranked #1 for every question.

Section 6.3: shipped weights (wt=0.15) give margin 0.175 vs poison's 0.32 similarity gain; McNemar p=0.80 vs no defense; corrected wt=0.35 imposes 0.245 absolute penalty against 0.45 max semantic term, characterized as 'a hard exclusion filter wearing the costume of a soft one.'

Table 6 (Section 6.3): Corpus M (94% benign untrusted band) accuracy 0.3167→0.7000 (p=1.17e-10) but authors flag windfall from removing distractors; Corpus N (untrusted evidence) accuracy 0.8583→0.0417 with evidence recall 99.17%→0.00% (p=6.31e-30).

Section 6.4 / Table 4: full pipeline reaches 0.832 recall on InjecAgent indirect injection with 0.035 FPR on NotInject vs 42.8% for DeBERTa-based detectors; Table 5 ablation shows Stage 3 injection rules contribute zero on indirect injection (Stage 2 secrets detector fires on credential-shaped exfiltration strings).

Section 7: adaptive-attack sweep pre-registered but 'not complete[d] in time'; single retriever/embedding model/reader; remedy (occupancy gate) 'not implemented or evaluated'; trust labels assumed un-malleable per threat model in Section 2.3.

Appendix A: repo revision 6d2863083361f7a5c8e12b4512346c94cb453c2c, LongMemEval_S revision 2ec2a557 with SHA-256, seed 42 throughout, sha256-keyed completion caching with temperature folded into key, measured $11.22 mixed-provenance arm cost, per-corpus dataset revisions in Table 1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-security paper squarely within preference scope: LLM agent persistent-memory poisoning, write-time injection screening, and provenance-weighted retrieval, with strong alignment to Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8). Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests across identical question sets, a mixed-provenance design that explicitly removes the trust-label-as-answer-key confound (Corpus M/N, Section 6.3), per-stage ablation of the screening pipeline (Table 5), bootstrap CIs, and a three-line margin derivation (Equation 2) that explains both the inert shipped default (p=0.80) and the over-correction at wt=0.35. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (0.850→0.300 at 1.2% poison, 0/360 screening refusals, Corpus N evidence recall 99.17%→0.00%). Notable honesty: negative result on the authors' own shipped product, limitations ordered by threat, and explicit refusal to claim the proposed occupancy-constraint remedy. Novelty is good but bounded: memory poisoning itself is established (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, MINJA, concurrent MPBench); the contributions are the utility-retained metric, the screening-boundary demonstration, and the additive-margin analysis rather than a new attack or defense. Generalizability is the weakest component: one memory system, one retriever/embedder/reader, LongMemEval-S only, non-adaptive attacker, and the authors acknowledge empirical generalization is by argument, not replication (Section 7). Reproducibility is excellent: pinned repo revision, frozen JSON inputs, seeds, completion caching, dataset revisions, and measured $11.22 API cost (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

recommendations.summary: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5%
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 代理程式持久記憶遭投毒攻擊時的效用損失,以及寫入與讀取兩道防線的極限。作者刻意採用最弱攻擊:單次生成、不含指令或觸發詞、也未針對檢索器最佳化的白話錯誤陳述,藉此污染 LongMemEval 語料。僅佔語料 1.2% 的 360 筆毒化記憶,便使準確率從 0.850 跌至 0.300,失去約三分之二的記憶價值。寫入端的四階段內容篩選管線雖在間接提示注入偵測上達 0.832 召回率、誤報率僅 1.5%,卻對 360 筆毒化記憶全部放行;作者論證這是內容篩選類方法的結構性邊界,因為辨識陳述真偽需要文字以外的外部依據。防禦因此落在讀取端的來源加權排序,但結果並不理想:原廠預設權重統計上與無防禦無異(p=0.80);提高權重雖將效用恢復至 56%,卻是靠完全排除而非偏好——其對不可信內容的絕對懲罰超過語意相似度可用範圍的一半。混合來源實驗顯示,當不可信內容多為良性時防禦仍有效(0.3167 升至 0.7000);但當承載答案的證據本身來自不可信通道時,120 題的證據召回全數歸零,準確率跌至 0.0417。作者據此主張,此種加法計分形式下來源項沒有可用設定,應改採有界佔用配額。主要限制包括:攻擊者未做自適應最佳化、僅測單一系統與嵌入模型,且信任標籤可能遭洗白竄改。本文以「保留效用」取代攻擊成功率作為核心指標,並揭露防禦在無攻擊時的代價,對代理記憶安全評估極具參考價值。
recommendations.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

links.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

evidence: Abstract: 'even the strongest model successfully completes only approximately 30% of StartupBench' under fine-grained rubric evaluation
Section 3.1.1: 'We first survey AI-native startups... retain startups with more than USD 1M in funding and require evidence of real adoption'; 'we collect 20+ start-up agents'
Section 3.1.3: 'we recruit over 50 domain experts to reconstruct benchmark tasks'; tasks defined as triple T=(q, E, R) with weighted rubrics
Section 3.2 / Table 2: 97 tasks across 6 domains, average 25.3 fine-grained rubrics per task
Section 4.1: 'we conduct 3 independent runs for each model and report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals... using 10,000 resamples'; success defined as score >= 90
Section 4.3: 'the automatic evaluator achieves an overall agreement of 92.78% with expert judgments'; single-judge holistic ablation 'reduces the agreement... to 83%'
Section 4.5.1 / Table 6: harness ablation across Hermes/Claude Code/Nanobot shows max-min variation of only 1.79 points on average, 'relative ordering of models remains unchanged'
Section 4.5.2 / Table 7: specialized agents score 83.50 avg / 39.18% success vs general-purpose 64.26 / 19.74% (oracle 71.75 / 28.06%)
Table 4: core rubric satisfaction (63.45%) consistently below auxiliary (68.67%) across 8 of 9 models
Appendix A.2 / B: cross-validation by independent expert reviewers; 57 domain experts, median 5 years experience
Section 4.4.2: named failure modes 'Complex Instruction Following' and 'Self-Verification Hallucination' with case studies (Figures 5, 6, 8, 9)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A market-validated end-to-end agent benchmark (StartupBench) built from AI-native startup workflows with expert rubrics and Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM-as-judge themes. The task-sourcing methodology (survey + user interviews + expert reconstruction) is a reasonable novelty contribution over researcher-defined benchmarks. Rigor is supported by multi-stage QC, 3 runs with bootstrap CIs, harness ablations, and human-agreement validation of the judge (92.78% rubric-level). Evidence is concrete with named tables/figures. Deductions: judge validation covers only two representative models, the benchmark is not yet externally validated beyond the authors' own harness family, several model names/citations are unverifiable or anachronistic (e.g., GPT-5.6-sol, Seed-2.1-Pro dated 2026), no code/data release is confirmed, and the difficulty-filtering step (excluding tasks frontier models solve) introduces circularity that is disclosed but not quantified.

primary_link.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

recommendations.summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models(LLMs) and agents have substantially improved the ability of AI systems to execute complex tasks. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful ag
recommendations.summary_zh: 現有代理基準多半由研究者自訂任務，難以反映真實使用者委託給 AI 的實際工作，且評估方式常過於粗略，無法忠實檢驗複雜交付物。StartupBench 改以市場驗證的 AI 原生新創產品為任務來源：團隊調查 20 多家具真實採用證據的新創，訪談 30 多位深度用戶，再由 50 多位領域專家將工作流程重建為可重現的評測任務，並經跨專家審查與難度校準。基準含 97 項端對端任務，涵蓋醫療、金融、法律、商業管理、STEM 與電腦科學、教育與人文六大領域，每項任務由使用者請求、完整工作區與加權評分準則組成，平均 25.3 條細粒度規則，並以具工具存取能力的 Agent-as-a-Judge 逐條獨立判定。在統一的 Nanobot 框架下評測 9 個代表性模型，最佳的 Kimi-K3 與 GPT-5.6-sol 平均分數約 73.67 與 73.61，但在分數達 90 的嚴格標準下成功率僅約 29.55% 與 31.27%，顯示模型雖有大量部分進展，卻難以完整交付。金融與 STEM 最具挑戰，商業最易；失敗主要源於複雜指令遵循、領域專業合規不足與自我驗證幻覺，且自動評分與專家一致率達 92.78%。相較之下，專門化新創代理平均分數 83.50、成功率 39.18%，仍明顯領先通用代理。此基準以市場需求為錨，為衡量代理能否可靠完成真實工作提供實證指標，並指引基礎模型與代理系統的改進方向。

links.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

evidence: Abstract: 'none of the step-level credit signals we audit — LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence — shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control'

Section 2: executed replay ground truth construction with K=4 alternatives and >=3 factual replays leaves '1,768 complete turns of 2,034 intervened' under Qwen2.5-7B; determinism verified and 20,538 replay rollouts archived
Section 3.2: measurability is model-dependent — no-counterfactual rate 13.1% (Qwen, n=2,034) vs 26.8% (Llama, n=1,082), Wilson 95% [11.7,14.6]% vs [24.2,29.5]%
Table 1 (Section 4): implicit rho 0.0193 [-0.109,0.081] vs own shuffle [0.005,0.114]; judge 0.1142 [0.027,0.168] vs shuffle [-0.049,0.117]; verdict H3 under frozen controls-first order

Section 5: pre-registered positive prediction held — implicit credit vs fluency median rank correlation +0.752 [0.647,0.793], n=47, Holm-adjusted p=0.0002; partial correlation with causal increment -0.004 (p=0.87)

Section 6 / Table 5: seven-arm training experiment — no arm reliably beats base policy (0.422; 54/128), all six confirmatory comparisons inconclusive at +/-3pp band with MDE ~11.8pp; dose mediation partial Mantel rho +0.078 (p=0.774) vs positive control +0.912 (p=0.0001)
Section 9: scope conditions measured — 'the audit runs in a single environment with a binary outcome'; training loop single-family, single-scale (Qwen2.5-7B, LoRA, offline)

Reproducibility statement: 'a single script regenerates the complete ledger from raw artifacts, two independent regenerations must agree byte-for-byte'; released replay archive of 29,402 files, credit/logprob dumps, adapters, and hash-pinned pre-registrations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope core methodology work: audits step-level credit signals (LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, policy confidence) used to train LLM agents, in ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3.1-8B policies and a Qwen2.5-72B judge, plus a seven-arm LoRA training experiment — strong hits on Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training, and Evaluation. Novelty is high: it is the first audit of deployed credit signals against executed-replay causal contribution (distinct from correctness-annotated benchmarks and self-referential replay auditing), with novel findings on model-dependent measurability, a replicated fluency-echo mechanism, and dose-vs-credit mediation. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered frozen thresholds and verdict order, marginal-matched shuffled controls gating first, Holm correction, reliability-corrected bounds, cross-family replication, and honest labeling of inconclusive results (training null reported as inconclusive, not 'no difference'; post-hoc analyses flagged). Evidence matches claim strength, with wide CIs and small effective n disclosed rather than hidden. Generalizability is the weak axis: single environment, binary outcome, 7-8B scale, LoRA offline training, all explicitly scoped. Reproducibility is exemplary: script-regenerated byte-identical ledger, hash-pinned pre-registrations, verbatim prompts, and a large released artifact set including disclosed dead values. Weighted score: 0.4*0.92+0.15*0.80+0.15*0.93+0.15*0.83+0.10*0.45+0.05*0.95 ≈ 0.84.

primary_link.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

recommendations.summary: Audited against policy-conditional ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals we audit -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control. Correcting for replay-target reliability leaves implicit fidelity bounded near zero and judge fidelity inconclusive at the achieved target reliability. Existing
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文檢驗 LLM 代理強化學習中步級信用訊號是否真的有效。常見做法是以 LLM 評審分數、結果條件化的 log-prob 比值或策略自身信心為每一步打分,但這些訊號是否反映該步驟對結果的實際因果貢獻,過去從未被測試。作者在可重播的單代理環境 ALFWorld 中建立「執行重播」真值:於每個決策點重新取樣策略支援的替代動作、推演至終局,並度量結果分佈的變化。以此稽核後,隱式信用、評審分數與信心訊號的排序保真度皆與自身邊際匹配的洗牌對照組無法區分,裁定為安慰劑等級;機制上,隱式信用主要是流暢度的回聲(與策略 log-prob 的秩相關約 +0.75,且跨模型家族重現),而以結果條件化並未帶來因果資訊。真值本身亦具結構:僅約 30.5% 的決策點呈現非零重播對比,且可測性隨模型而異,Qwen2.5-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的無反事實比例相差一倍。七臂訓練實驗中沒有任何臂穩定勝過未訓練策略,各信用規則間的差異與有效訓練劑量的中介作用一致,而非信用內容本身。僅以信心為門檻的路由器雖只能以隨機水準找回關鍵步驟,卻可削減約 13% 的評審呼叫成本。限制包括單一環境、二元結果、小樣本與訓練實驗檢定力不足。作者主張比較信用規則前必須匹配有效樣本量,並提供劑量匹配、對照強度測量與最小可偵測效應等實務協定,對建立於未驗證信用訊號之上的代理訓練研究具重要警示價值。

links.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

evidence: Abstract: decodability predicts the selection-over-voting gain at Pearson r=0.75 held-out with threshold AUC=0.60; CASE gains up to 19 points on medium and 16.8 on hard questions.

Section 6.1: naive random-split CV accuracy 0.610 vs. question-grouped 0.542 and within-question AUC 0.502 (chance) on LogiQA/Qwen2.5-7B; leakage inflation (+0.04 to +0.39, median +0.27) confirmed in all 15 medical settings (Supplementary Table S17).

Section 6.4: in-sample law r=0.96 treated as consistency check only; leave-one-model-out r in [0.941,0.959], dropping the entire OpenBioLLM family keeps r=0.90; held-out calibration-to-deployment r=0.75 (CI [0.51,0.93], 13 settings).
Section 6.5 (Table 4): Byzantine N-scaling, CASE 20.4%→47.3% vs. majority vote 20.4%→6.0% over N=1→16 on the minority-correct subset (+41.3 pp at N=16).
Section 6.7 (Table 7): out-of-domain GPQA transfer; physics settings within 0.7 and 3.8 pp of the medical regression forecast; threshold classifies all six non-medical settings correctly.

Section 6.8 (Table 8): CASE beats self-certainty, sequence log-probability, and predictive entropy in all five settings; TF-IDF text-classifier control at within-question AUC 0.44 vs. 0.70 for the hidden-state gate under identical labels.
Section 6.6: steering across four intervention variants does not improve accuracy (readout-not-lever dissociation); projecting out the correctness direction collapses gate AUC 0.73→0.13.

Code availability: anonymized repository (anonymous.4open.science/r/case-decodability-28D1) for peer review, with public de-anonymized release promised only upon acceptance; Section 5 specifies models in fp16, nucleus sampling τ=0.7, top-p=0.95, 512 new tokens, scikit-learn logistic gate.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: test-time answer fusion over self-consistency, hidden-state probing, and a pre-deployment diagnostic, not a domain application despite the medical QA benchmarks (which serve as testbeds; GPQA and MATH-500 provide non-medical tests). High topical fit across LLMs, reasoning/test-time compute, and interpretability. Novelty is solid but incremental over existing correctness-probe and latent-verifier work (LiLaVe, SWIFT, CCS-lineage, Cho et al., Seo et al. all acknowledged); the genuinely new pieces are the leakage-free within-question decodability criterion, the question-identity-leakage audit, and the derived threshold law. Rigor is unusually careful: grouped evaluation, permutation nulls, held-out calibration-to-deployment splits (r=0.75), cluster/Deming/jackknife checks, seed replications, and honest caveats that the in-sample r=0.96 is partly structural. Evidence is strong but with real limits the authors admit: headline medium-difficulty gains concentrate in the OpenBioLLM family, some bins are underpowered, and the verifier parity claim is one setting. Generalizability is tested (scale 1.5B-70B, three architecture families, out-of-domain GPQA forecast within 3.8 pp) though the slope requires per-domain recalibration. Reproducibility is good (open-weight models, public benchmarks, precise hyperparameters, anonymous code repo) but artifacts are promised only upon acceptance.
topics: LLM test-time compute and answer fusion

primary_link.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

recommendations.summary: Combining the answers a large language model (LLM) samples for a question into one decision is a test-time information fusion problem, usually solved by majority voting. Voting is unreliable on difficult questions, where the sampled answers share correlated errors, so the wrong answer can win and drawing more samples makes the decision worse. Selecting a candidate by reading a correctness signal from the model's hidden states is a promising alternative, but its accuracy varies across models and
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）回答問題時，常對取樣的多個候選答案做多數決投票（self-consistency）以融合成單一決策；但在困難題目上，各候選的錯誤高度相關，錯誤答案形成穩定共識，增加取樣反而更糟，此即拜占庭（Byzantine）情境。作者提出 CASE（Correctness-Axis Selection），在答案 token 的隱藏狀態上訓練線性閘門，選出內部正確性分數最高的候選，並提出核心貢獻「可解碼性」（within-question AUC）：一個無洩漏指標，衡量閘門能否把同一題的正確候選排在錯誤候選之前。論文先證明天真的線性探針在隨機分割交叉驗證下的準確度其實來自題目身分洩漏，改採題目分組評估後訊號跌至隨機水準。實證顯示，可解碼性可事先預測選擇法相對投票的增益：樣本內 r=0.96，於留出資料上 r=0.75，決策門檻約 AUC=0.60。在對齊的醫療模型上，CASE 於中等難度題最多領先投票 19 點，困難題在 N=16 時領先 16.8 點，正確答案屬少數時更達 41.3 點；訊號取決於模型須回想的對齊知識，而非參數規模，且可跨域推廣至 GPQA（預測誤差 3.8 點內），並以近乎零成本比擬生成式驗證器。該正確性方向僅供讀取，無法用於引導生成。限制包括最強效果集中於醫療領域、公開題庫可能已被記憶、部分中等難度樣本偏小。此診斷讓實務者能在部署前決定採用學習式選擇或多數決投票。
recommendations.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

links.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six main multimodal reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL-Thinking model sizes (2B/4B/8B)... VIG consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off' and code link https://github.com/chaser682/vig
Section 4.2: 'On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, VIG attains AvgACC = 64.92% and AvgEff = 52.42, surpassing the strongest compression baseline ThinkPrune by +2.37% in accuracy and +39.4% in efficiency'
Section 4.3 / Table 4: 'Removing the VIG term from the reward reduces the method to plain GRPO, which collapses AvgEff from 52.42 to 36.44 (-30%) and lowers AvgACC by 2.04 points'
Section 4.1: 'All numbers we report are from a single deterministic (greedy, temperature 0) decoding pass per checkpoint' with paired-bootstrap CIs reported where margins matter (Appendix F)
Section 4.2: 2B block caveat: 'the margin over the strongest baseline is only +0.55 points and is not significant under a unified step-400 protocol... 53% of 2B generations hit the 4,096-token limit'

Appendix F.2 / Table 6: deletion probe shows 'deleting the lowest-VIG sentences is the most damaging condition' on VIG-trained chains (80.92 to 72.36 at 50%), the opposite of a token-importance reading
Limitations: 'VIG measures visual dependence, which is neither visual correctness nor counterfactual necessity... we regard cross-architecture generality as unresolved'
Appendix G / Table 7: VIG training overhead 1.17x vs plain GRPO (37.2 vs 31.8 s/it); break-even after roughly 48K inference requests
Appendix E: full training configuration (G=8, KL 0.04, lr 1e-6, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, 500 steps) and baseline implementations on identical data/protocol
Appendix D: training mixture of 2,948 samples from MMStar, MathVista, LogicVista; evaluation set sizes for all seven benchmarks

Section 4.2 / Table 3: non-math transfer on RealWorldQA and OCRBench claims only 'VIG preserves accuracy at a substantially lower token cost', with gaps among strong methods acknowledged as within noise
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal CoT-compression paper squarely inside scope: it trains Qwen3-VL reasoning models with GRPO using a per-token conditional-mutual-information reward (visual information gain) computed from two forward passes (with/without image), reframing compression as visual-density maximization rather than length budgeting. Strong match to high-weight preferences (Reasoning/CoT, LLMs, RL, efficiency, multimodal). Novelty is solid: per-token information-theoretic reward for CoT compression is a fresh angle versus textual length penalties (L1, ThinkPrune, TALE) and trajectory-level VPPO, though it builds on established GRPO and information-bottleneck ideas. Rigor is unusually careful: five baselines, three model sizes, six-plus-one benchmarks, reward/masked-image/weight ablations, a confidence-only control arm, text-solvable vs vision-required stratification, paired-bootstrap CIs, and an honest deletion probe (Appendix F.2/Table 6) whose counterintuitive asymmetry the authors interpret rather than hide. Evidence is strong for the core claim (+2.37% ACC, +39.4% efficiency over ThinkPrune at 8B; ablation removes 30% of efficiency gain), and the authors appropriately hedge the 2B block (runaway-length confound, non-significant +0.55), non-math accuracy (within noise), and the mismatched VPPO checkpoint. Deductions: single greedy decoding pass for headline tables, checkpoint-step asymmetry (400 vs 500) across methods, one model family with cross-architecture generality explicitly unresolved, and reward requiring model-specific vision-token separation. Reproducibility is good: code link, Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters, training-data details, licenses, and a cost/break-even analysis (1.17x overhead, ~48K request payback). Minor metadata sloppiness (mismatched author emails) noted but not decisive.

primary_link.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

recommendations.summary: Multimodal large reasoning models often rely on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces in which a substantial fraction of tokens, such as repeated visual descriptions, self-reflection, and other visually-disengaged filler, inflate inference cost without contributing to the answer. Existing CoT compression methods optimize output length but never measure whether a reasoning token is actually grounded in the image. We propose \textbf{VIG} (Visual Information Gain), an information-theoretic GRPO reward
recommendations.summary_zh: 多模態大型推理模型常產生冗長的思維鏈（CoT），其中大量詞元——如重複的視覺描述、自我反思以及其他與影像無關的填充語句——推高推論成本卻無助於答案。現有 CoT 壓縮方法僅最佳化輸出長度，從未衡量推理詞元是否真正依賴影像。本文提出 VIG（視覺資訊增益），一種資訊理論的 GRPO 獎勵：以影像降低詞元預測不確定性的程度為每個推理詞元評分。VIG 透過同一策略的兩次前向傳播（含影像與移除視覺詞元）線上計算熵差，無需參考鏈、外部標註或輔助獎勵模型，可直接嵌入 GRPO。在三種 Qwen3-VL-Thinking 模型（2B/4B/8B）與六個多模態推理基準上，VIG 一致改善準確率與效率的權衡：於 8B 模型達到平均準確率 64.92% 與效率 52.42，較最強壓縮基線 ThinkPrune 提升 +2.37% 準確率與 +39.4% 效率，並在 R1-Onevision-Bench 總體排名第一。消融實驗顯示鏈長縮短是提升視覺資訊密度的副產品。限制包括：訓練需額外的純文字前向傳播（約 17% 開銷）、依賴視覺與文字詞元的乾淨切分，且 VIG 衡量的是視覺依賴而非正確性——自信的幻覺讀取也可能得高分；跨架構泛化性亦尚未解決。核心主張是：高效的多模態推理源自提升視覺資訊密度，而非施加長度預算。
recommendations.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression
recommendations.title_zh: VIG：以視覺資訊增益作為多模態思維鏈壓縮的獎勵訊號

links.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

evidence: Section 3.2-3.3: formalizes ASR@B, ASR-budget curves, ATC, and StrongREJECT-based HS under a shared target-call budget B

Section 4.1: 11 attacks across hand-crafted, stochastic (BoN), and LLM-driven families; LlamaGuard4 judges the re-evaluation while GPT-4o with X-Teaming rubric judges ReCode, a cross-phase judge inconsistency
Table 1 (Section 4.2): ReNeLLM avg ASR@100 98.7% with ATC 3.9; CodeAttack avg ASR@K 90.7%; budget-dependent ranking reversal TAP vs BoN at B=5 vs B=100
Table 2 (Section 4.3.2): ReCode avg ASR@20 81.0% with AAC 7.00; GPT-5 85%/7.19; four ablations including ReCode w/ Gate restoring the retry loop
Appendix B.4: 2,000-replicate request-level bootstrap pointwise 95% CIs; overlapping intervals at some budgets acknowledged
Appendix C.3: Claude Sonnet 4.6 filter-rate analysis; removing nesting raises ASR 46%->57% and lowers filter rate 40.4%->15.1%
Appendix A.1-A.3: versioned endpoints (gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-5-2025-08-07), temperature settings, and full baseline hyperparameters
Section 5: limitations state target calls miss token usage/pricing/template-development cost and multi-turn settings are uncovered
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/red-teaming work with direct fit to preferred topics (jailbreak evaluation, LLM-as-target, code-style prompting). Fair-ASR is a sensible but incremental protocol refinement of known budget-dependence findings (BoN, SABER, FLOPs-based compute-aware evals), and ReCode is explicitly a composition of existing primitives (ReNeLLM-style rewrite, BoN perturbation, CodeAttack nesting) with a gate removed; novelty is moderate. Rigor and evidence are strong: 11 attacks, 5+3 targets, two datasets, two attacker models, four ablations, Pareto analysis, and 2,000-replicate bootstrap CIs (Appendix B.4) support the headline claims (budget-dependent rankings in Table B.4; ReCode 85% ASR@20 on GPT-5 at 7.19 attacker calls in Table 2). Caveats: judge changes between phases (LlamaGuard4 for re-evaluation vs GPT-4o X-Teaming rubric for ReCode, Section 4.1), 7B-only attacker scale, no variance estimates for main tables, text-only black-box scope, and a Claude-specific reversal where removing nesting helps (Section C.3), which limits uniform generalizability. Limitations (no token/pricing cost, no multi-turn) are acknowledged in Section 5. Code URL and full hyperparameters/templates in Appendices A, C, E support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

recommendations.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluatio
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的越獄攻擊評估存在不公問題：多數研究僅報告攻擊成功率（ASR），卻忽略取得該結果所用的攻擊預算，使跨方法比較失真；以 FLOPs 為基礎的運算感知評估，則對 closed-source 黑箱模型難以估計，也無法反映各項資源的不同限制。作者提出 Fair-ASR 評估協定，以「目標模型呼叫次數」作為所有黑箱攻擊共享且可直接觀察的比較軸，在相同預算 B 下報告 ASR@B、ASR–預算曲線與平均目標呼叫數（ATC），並另行追蹤攻擊者模型呼叫以分析效率。團隊重新評估 11 種代表性攻擊，涵蓋手工模板、隨機重複取樣（BoN）與 LLM 驅動方法（如 PAIR、TAP、ReNeLLM）。主要發現：ASR 與方法排名隨預算大幅變動，例如 B=5 時 TAP 領先 BoN，B=100 時反被超越；CodeAttack 等簡單方法在緊縮預算下仍極具競爭力；且沒有任何 LLM 驅動方法能同時在目標呼叫與攻擊者呼叫兩個維度上高效。針對此效率落差，作者提出 ReCode，結合單次去敏感化改寫、不需攻擊者的字元層級擾動與程式碼風格巢狀包裝；在 20 次目標呼叫預算下，ReCode 於 GPT-5 達到 85% ASR，平均每次請求僅需 7.19 次攻擊者呼叫。研究限制包括未涵蓋 token 用量、API 計費與模板開發成本，尚未支援多輪情境，且結果依賴評審模型判定。整體而言，此工作為越獄評估建立公平、可觀察的比較基準，對 LLM 安全測試與資源感知紅隊評估具重要參考價值。

links.title: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability

evidence: Abstract: 'corrected low-repeat estimates are closer to an independently acquired R=16 reference than plug-in estimates, with the largest gains at small repeat budgets' and '44,112 unique live calls'.

§4 Table 1: five evidence layers (known-law simulation, byte-identical null 4,800 calls, matched evaluation 4,800, independent R=16 reference 9,600, broad audit 17,712, four-configuration panel 7,200 new calls).

§5 Table 2: plug-in bias matches exact 1/R prediction across 12 K-law-R settings, largest discrepancy 1.55e-4; complete estimator lowers MSE by factors 2.57-7.03; 52.7-56.1% of unbiased item estimates negative at boundary target.
§5 Exact live null: plug-in means .0406/.0206/.0126 at R=2/4/8 vs corrected -.0053/-.0008/.0024 under randomized hidden IDs with byte-identical payloads (zero prompt target).

§5 Table 5/6: four-configuration panel shows R=4 corrected prompt estimates Qwen .00521, GPT-OSS -.00123, Gemma .01774, Claude .00986; residual call dominates for Qwen/GPT-OSS, answer order for Gemma/Claude.

§5 Limitations: 'Our experiments cover a fixed census of six formatting wrappers; generalization to validated paraphrases or unseen prompt generators requires additional acquisition'; disjoint high-repeat reference available only for Qwen.
Supp S9/Table S12: two-repeat panel correction lowers MAE at R=2 (.0167) and R=4 (.0043) but raises it by .0005 [-.0041,.0029] at R=8 — negative result reported.
Supp S8/Table S18: 44,112 rows, manifest-to-canonical mismatches 0/2,400 for new configurations, all internal hash checks PASS; SHA-256 hashes for prompt YAML and criterion block given in S5.
Supp S4.1: finite-replication non-identifiability result for the anonymous mixing law at fixed R, bounding what the design can claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope LLM evaluation methodology: formalizes prompt instability of LLM judges as a second-order response law and derives exact finite-R plug-in inflation formulas plus design-unbiased agreement-based estimators (Thms 1, S1; Props 1-3, proofs in Supp S2-S3). Novelty is solid rather than breakthrough: the math rests on classical variance decomposition/U-statistics (Fleiss, generalizability theory, Hoeffding), but the exact inflation identities, crossed prompt-by-order design retaining invalid outputs as a fourth category, and byte-identical live null are new for LLM-judge auditing. Rigor is high: assumptions (conditional independence, fixed census) are stated, unclipped negative estimates reported, and limitations honestly acknowledged (§5 Limitations; Supp S9, including that the panel correction raises MAE by .0005 at R=8 in Table S12). Evidence is strong and multi-layered: 200,000-item known-law simulations recover the 1/R bias within 1.55e-4 with 2.57-7.03x MSE gains (Table 2); an exact-zero hidden-factor null shows plug-in inflation (0.0406/0.0206/0.0126) vs corrected ~0 (Table S7); MAE to an independent R=16 reference drops .0365→.0160 at R=2 (Table 3); a 369-item audit and 4-configuration panel (Table 5/6) show configuration-specific inflation and component profiles. Weaknesses: empirical scope is narrow (LLMBar pairwise judging, 50 matched items, six formatting wrappers; R=16 reference only for Qwen), so generalizability beyond the declared census is explicitly unproven. Reproducibility is excellent on paper: SHA-256 hashed prompts (S5), exact model revisions and contracts (Table S4), estimator scripts, zero-mismatch integrity checks (Table S18), though call-level audit tables are external companions not in the archive (S8).

primary_link.title: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability

recommendations.summary: LLM judges are often evaluated with a single prompt and only a few repeated calls. When their verdicts vary, it remains unclear whether the variation comes from sampling noise within a prompt or systematic differences across prompts. We formalize this distinction using a second-order response law: the distribution of prompt-conditioned verdict distributions induced by a declared prompt policy. For a quadratic measure of prompt instability, we show that the usual plug-in estimator is biased upwar
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討以 LLM 作為自動評審時的根本測量問題：當評審對同一題目的裁定不一致時，究竟是單一提示詞內的抽樣雜訊，還是跨提示詞的系統性差異（即「提示不穩定性」）？作者將此區分形式化為「二階反應法則」，即由提示詞條件裁定分布所構成的分布，並證明在有限重複次數 R 下，常用的 plug-in 估計量會把提示內雜訊誤計為提示效應而系統性高估。方法上，論文推導出 plug-in 膨脹的精確公式，並提出由提示內與跨提示一致性差額構成的不偏估計量，涵蓋抽樣提示與固定提示普查兩種設計；在提示×答案順序的交叉設計下，可將總分歧分解為殘餘呼叫、提示、答案順序與交互作用四個成分，並把無效輸出視為明確的第四類結果。實證包含 44,112 次真實呼叫：已知法則模擬重現 1/R 膨脹並大幅降低均方誤差；位元組相同的隱藏因子對照組貼近精確零目標；配對的 Qwen 研究顯示校正後的低重複估計更接近獨立取得的 R=16 參考，R=2 時 MAE 由 .0365 降至 .0160；四組凍結設定的比較顯示膨脹幅度與主導成分因設定而異，Qwen 與 GPT-OSS 以殘餘呼叫變異為主，Gemma 與 Claude 以答案順序為主，校正亦改變設定的不穩定性排序。限制包括僅涵蓋 LLMBar 上六種格式包裝的固定普查、高重複參考僅限 Qwen、假設呼叫條件獨立，且各設定停止合約不同，難以分離模型與執行環境的效果。整體而言，此框架能把提示穩健性與有限呼叫雜訊分開估計，有助於更可靠地設計 LLM 評審實驗與解讀基準分數。
