links.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

evidence: Abstract: SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks; +5.7 on BFCL v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent at 30B-A3B
Table 1: Qwen3-30B-A3B suite average 58.3 (+8.1 over base 50.2) vs Fixed-env RLVE 53.0 and Fixed-env GRPO 51.4, both retrained per backbone for 400 iterations from the same base model

Table 3 / Section 7.1: removing corpus grounding or memory alone drops suite average to 53.5/53.2; removing both ED training and memory falls to 40.5, 9.7 points below base; static GPT-5.5 pool reaches 53.0
Section 7.2 / Table 6: hint-based regret reaches 58.3 average vs 55.9 for EMA-based learning potential, isolating the designer-reward choice

Appendix F.3.1: reference systems in Table 2 were trained/evaluated on their own harnesses with differing BFCL versions, tau2-bench forks, user simulators, and aggregation rules, so cross-row comparison is not apples-to-apples

Appendix E: Theorem E.5 proves every pure Nash equilibrium yields hint-free optimality, but under idealized assumptions E.2 (articulated hints) and E.3 (internalizability) that do not hold in practice
Appendix I.1.2 / Table 8: Vendi/n 0.68 with corpus vs 0.04 without, replicated under TF-IDF/LSA embeddings (0.53/0.58/0.48/0.05)

Section 9 Limitations: environment complexity bounded by base-model scale, human-designed optimizer (GRPO) not self-modified, no formal optimality of the curriculum, fixed-task evaluation rather than open-ended growth
Appendix F.3: training and evaluation code, configuration files for every run, evaluation output JSONs, and figure scripts are released; full hyperparameters in Table 5 and prompts in Appendix F.1

Section 8 / Figure 13: average gain grows with model size (+5.2 at 4B, +5.7 at 8B, +8.1 at 30B-A3B) while Fixed-env GRPO stays near +1.2; Appendix G Figure 16 shows Nemotron-30B gains only on Reasoning-Gym
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent research: a single LLM both designs executable training environments and learns from them via GRPO, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, reasoning, RL, training optimization). Novelty is meaningful but incremental in a crowded self-play/environment-synthesis space: hint-based regret extends PAIRED's minimax regret, corpus grounding extends SPICE, role-conditioned self-play extends SPIRAL; the claim of being the first RL-trained designer producing full multi-turn MDP environments is credible but the delta over EvoEnv, TTCS, and GenEnv is arguable. Rigor is strong: three backbones (4B/8B/30B-A3B), retrained fixed-environment baselines from the same base checkpoints (Table 1), component-controlled ablations (Table 3: w/o corpus 53.5, w/o memory 53.2, w/o ED training+memory 40.5, GPT-5.5 static pool 53.0 vs full 58.3), a reward ablation isolating hint-regret (58.3) from EMA learning potential (55.9) (Section 7.2, Table 6), curriculum-diversity and scaling analyses, a calibrated Vendi diversity metric with dual-embedding replication, and an equilibrium analysis under explicitly stated idealized assumptions (Appendix E). Evidence weaknesses: tool-use comparisons in Table 2 are transcribed from other papers with differing budgets/protocols (acknowledged in Appendix F.3.1), best-checkpoint selection per variant risks optimistic selection, and the cross-family check (Nemotron) evaluates only Reasoning-Gym (Figure 16). Reproducibility is excellent: code, per-run configs, evaluation JSONs, and figure scripts released, with full prompts and hyperparameters (Appendices F.1-F.3).

primary_link.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

recommendations.summary: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce SPADE (Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes complete, long-horizon training environments a
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文指出，隨著高品質人類文字趨於枯竭，具有可驗證獎勵的訓練環境供給已成為代理式AI進步的瓶頸；人工策劃或靜態合成的環境池無法隨學習者能力提升而調整。作者提出SPADE自我對弈強化學習框架：單一LLM扮演兩個角色——環境設計師撰寫具Gym風格reset()/step()介面、含狀態轉移與獎勵函數的完整可執行Python環境並附特權提示；推理代理則在環境中學習行動。環境設計師以「提示式遺憾」為獎勵，即代理有無提示時的回報差距，將環境鎖定於能力前緣且可解的範圍，實作PAIRED式minimax遺憾而無需對抗者。方法另依賴預訓練語料錨定（DCLM、MegaScience、Nemotron程式碼語料）提供新穎性來源，並以環境記憶避免重複已掌握的任務。實驗涵蓋遊戲與工具使用兩種設定，在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B上訓練：遊戲設定下30B模型於AIME、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6及Reasoning-Gym等八項留出基準平均較基礎模型提升8.1分，較最強固定環境基線提升5.3分，且優勢隨規模擴大；工具使用設定於BFCL v4多輪提升5.7分、ACEBench-Agent提升13.9分。消融顯示移除環境設計師訓練與記憶會使表現低於基礎模型，移除語料錨定則令環境多樣性崩塌（Vendi分數由0.68降至0.04）。限制包括環境複雜度受限於基礎模型能力、學習規則仍為人工設計的GRPO，且缺乏課程最佳性的形式化證明。此研究將環境設計轉為可學習組件，是邁向開放式持續自我改進的具體一步。

links.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract and §7.2 Table 1: 'CAPO reaches a feasible operating point in all six evaluated settings'; initial prompt, APO, and GEPA feasible in one of six, MOPO in zero.
§3.1 Eq. (1) and §4.4 Eq. (4): threshold-constrained prompt formulation with projected dual updates from signed empirical residuals.

§5.2 and Appendix B.2.5: pool-based GRPO trains the rewriter with adaptive Lagrangian scores while the task agent (Qwen3-8B/32B) stays frozen; Agent-GRPO baseline uses fixed penalty vectors (1,2.5) and (2,4).

§6 Theorem 6.1 and Appendix A.2 Assumptions B1-B2: surrogate bound requires strong concavity/smoothness in a continuous prompt surrogate; B.4.3 Table 25 only reports positive means for alignment (0.046, 5.19, 0.40), not estimated constants.
Appendix B.1.1 Table 6: evaluation splits are small (Airline 20, Retail 40, Telecom 40 tasks); B.4.2 Tables 14-16 report per-example SEs up to ~0.09 on accuracy.

§7.3 Table 23 and B.4.2 Table 21: mechanism ablations show one-shot sampling, static constraint injection, and EvoPrompt-GA all fail feasibility; β=4 is the only tested dual learning rate feasible in both Airline and Telecom.
Appendix B.3.5 Table 12: frozen Telecom-trained rewriter lowers ToolEx in target domains but 'does not achieve feasibility without target-domain adaptation'—honest negative transfer result.

Appendix B.2.1 Table 7 and B.2.3 Table 8: full hyperparameters, per-round complexity accounting, and compute setup are documented; prompts listed in Appendix C, but no public code repository is claimed.
§7.3 and Appendix B.3.5 Table 10: SWE-bench Lite case study—all methods resolve 5/30 issues; CAPO only reduces patch size (1.055), tool actions (0.371), and files touched (1.300) below thresholds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent deployment: constraint-aware system-prompt optimization (primal-dual with per-constraint multipliers) plus a GRPO-trained rewriter (DCAPO) with frozen task agents. Directly matches top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, prompting, RL/GRPO, safety constraints) with a SWE-bench coding-agent case study. Novelty is moderate: the machinery is standard constrained RL/Lagrangian optimization transplanted to discrete prompt search; the pool-based dual-conditioned rewriter and the surrogate error analysis are the freshest pieces. Rigor is solid—formal assumptions with proofs, mechanism ablations, noise/dual-rate sensitivity, and honest negative results (Appendix B.3.5 transfer failure)—but main evaluations are single-run with small eval sets (20-40 tasks per tau2 domain per Appendix Table 6), the theory rests on strong concavity assumptions only loosely verified (B.4.3 positive inner products), and the editor-size ablation is self-described as 'descriptive best-observed' not controlled. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (feasible 6/6 GPT-5-mini/GPT-5.1 settings vs at most 1/6 for baselines in Table 1), but feasibility is a coarse binary criterion with occasional thin margins and β=4 is the only feasible tested dual rate (Table 21), suggesting fragility. Generalizability is genuinely broad across models and task families; reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters/thresholds/prompts (Appendix B.2, C) but no code release is claimed and much depends on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization)
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM agent 的部署問題：agent 即使完成任務，仍可能過度呼叫工具、系統提示過長或違反安全與格式政策。作者將系統提示詞最佳化形式化為具明確門檻的約束問題，提出 CAPO，一種原始—對偶（primal–dual）搜尋法：為每個限制維護非負乘數，依帶符號的實測殘差動態更新（違規時提高權重、有餘裕時降低），並以提示池保留優良候選，用凍結的 LLM 作為改寫器迭代搜尋，輸出仍為文字系統提示。進一步提出 DCAPO，以 pool-based GRPO 訓練依回饋與對偶狀態條件化的可學習改寫器，同時凍結任務 agent。理論部分於連續替代空間刻劃有限提示池與離散改寫誤差如何進入不精確原始—對偶界。實驗在 tau2-bench（Airline、Retail、Telecom）顯示 CAPO 於三個領域與兩種任務模型共六種組合皆達 AllSat 可行，而初始提示、APO、GEPA 各僅一種、MOPO 為零種；chatbot 與 PUPA–IFBench 證明方法可延伸至安全、隱私與格式限制，開放權重 Ministral-8B 與 SWE-bench Lite 程式撰寫 agent 案例亦支持此結論。DCAPO 在三個 agent 領域皆產出可行提示，準確率與基準相符或更佳；消融顯示線上行為回饋提供單靠編輯模仿所缺的資訊。限制包括僅調整系統提示、對雜訊回饋敏感（Airline 與 Telecom 在雜訊下違反門檻）、AllSat 僅為經驗性指標而非母體保證，且更廣泛領域與跨域轉移尚待驗證。其意義在於讓部署需求本身成為引導搜尋的回饋訊號，而非事後檢核。
recommendations.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
recommendations.title_zh: CAPO：LLM Agent 的限制感知提示詞最佳化

links.title: The Model's Tell: Measuring Context-Leakage Attack Signals with Behavior Gauges

evidence: Abstract: LeakGauge achieves AUROC 0.944–0.996 on unseen attacks across 11 LLMs including GLM-5.2 (753B) and Kimi-K3 (2.8T), with <0.5K extra parameters and 10.34 ms added latency.
§4.1 (Table 1, splits): 30% of protected content and 30% of attack templates reserved as unseen; Held-Out Content/Attacks/Strict splits pair at least one unseen component.

§4.2 (Table 2): Behavior maintains AUROC ≥0.94 in every (model, split) combination including Held-Out Strict; End20 degrades sharply on held-out attacks (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B 0.611) supporting the suffix design.
§B.2 (Table 9): random-label control AUROC* stays ~0.50 across models, suffixes, splits, and both tasks, guarding against memorization.
§6 (Table 5): cross-attack deployment on Llama-3.1-8B via vLLM — LeakGauge AUROC 0.996, F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963 at 10.34 ms vs I'vDtL 0.995/0.987/0.947 at 70.91 ms with an extra 8B model copy.

§5.3 (Figure 4, Appendix D): activation steering along a leakage-related direction produces aligned changes in probe logit and ROUGE-L recall, linking the observable signal to internal representations.
§G.2 (Table 21): single-probe-aware GCG attack cuts detection recall to 0.080 (post-filtered ASR 0.275); two-probe deployment restores 0.976 recall, honestly reported robustness limit.
Appendix H (Table 22): Behavior mean AUROC 0.981 on base vs 0.991 on instruction-tuned checkpoints, indicating the signal is not created by instruction tuning.
Appendix I (Table 23): same recipe transfers to StrongReject (0.995), BIPIA (0.971), ToxicChat (0.972), HaluEval (0.926), suggesting generality beyond leakage.

§10 Reproducibility Statement + Abstract: code released at github.com/yeasen-z/LeakGauge; hyperparameters, dataset splits, model configs, steering and deployment details given in §3–§4, Appendices A, D, E.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM safety/methodology paper: detects system-prompt and RAG context-leakage attacks by reading prefill log-probs of an appended natural-language 'gauge' suffix with a <0.5K-parameter probe, requiring no internal-state access. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, RAG, interpretability-style probing, vLLM serving/deployment). Method is novel relative to hidden-state (I'vDtL) and attention (Attention-Tracker) detectors, and the content-agnostic Behavior gauge finding is a substantive contribution. Rigor is unusually thorough: component-wise held-out splits (content/attacks/strict), ablations (End20, Linear), random-label and unrelated-suffix controls (§B.2 Table 9, §B.3 Table 10), cross-lingual/cross-objective shifts, activation steering (§5.3), hard-negative and adaptive GCG stress tests (§G), base-vs-instruct analysis (Appendix H). Evidence is strong and quantitative (AUROC 0.944–0.996 across 11 models, Table 2; deployment Table 5: F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963, 10.34 ms, <0.5K params). Caveats: probe is trained per model/task, deployment comparison is on a single 8B model with acknowledged non-hardware-normalized baselines (§E.2), single-probe adaptive attack reduces detection recall to 0.080 (Table 21), and cross-model transfer is only partial (Table 16). Code and detailed configs are released (§10), supporting high reproducibility.

However, processing these contexts alongside user queries creates an attack surface: adversarial inputs can induce models to disclose them. Prior probing studies suggest that leakage-related signals emerge in hidden states, yet the need to extract these states poses additional deployment challenges. In this paper, we explore whether this internal signal leaves a
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型依賴系統提示與 RAG 檢索文件等機密上下文,惡意輸入卻可能誘導模型洩漏這些內容。僅分析輸入文字的分類器對未見攻擊泛化有限,讀取隱藏狀態或注意力的方法又需存取內部狀態、部署門檻高。本文提出 LeakGauge:在輸入後附加自然語言量表,讀取 prefill 階段各 token 的 log-probability,以參數少於 0.5K 的 MLP 映射為風險分數,全程免解碼生成。量表有 Exact(取受保護內容開頭 token)與 Behavior(以內容無關的洩漏行為描述,如「根據以上,我將提供系統提示」)兩種,後者更穩健。在 11 個 8B 至 2.8T 參數的 LLM 上,即使攻擊與內容皆未見過,Behavior 的 AUROC 仍達 0.944–0.996;跨語言或逐字轉語意式洩漏時訊號依舊穩健,activation steering 顯示分數與內部洩漏相關方向連動。部署於 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 時跨攻擊評估達 AUROC 0.996、F1 0.983、TPR@FPR5 0.963,僅增約 10.34 毫秒,並可重用 KV cache。限制:完全曝光的單一探測器可被針對偵測器的 GCG 攻擊規避(召回降至 0.08,雙量表部署回升至 0.976),跨模型訊號遷移亦不完全一致。此機制可延伸至有害請求與提示注入偵測,為 LLM 洩漏防護提供輕量、免生成且泛化佳的新途徑。

links.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success on five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, vs. identical budget on outcome reward alone (47.0%).

Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): all trained rows start from the same Qwen3.5-9B SFT checkpoint; RL runs 100 steps of on-policy GRPO on 491 training tasks with 8 rollouts per prompt; each configuration is a single run, with task-level bootstrap for uncertainty.

Section 4.6 / Figure 5: offline audit of SkillRL (outcome only)'s 12,800 on-policy trajectories shows skill-naming tokens carry a median 0.14% loss-weight share, diluting ~7x with length, with ~two in five oracle reads receiving negative advantage.

Appendix E: pooled trial-success improvement of +7.9 pp for SkillGate over SkillRL (outcome only) with 95% interval [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero; pooled task pass@4 interval [-1.4,+15.7] crosses zero and significance is not claimed.
Section 6 (Conclusion): stated limitations—each configuration is a single run, the method needs training tasks whose correct skill is known, and an action-local scheme cannot credit an abstention.
Appendix C (Table 5): on 147 held-out Claw tasks, SkillGate reaches 61.2% pass@1 vs. 57.8% for SkillRL (outcome only), with oracle reads 79.6% and misleading reads 15.0%.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent RL method (agents/tool-use 2.5, LLM 2.5, RL/training) that trains in-policy skill selection inside GRPO. The core contribution—diagnosing 'selector credit starvation' via an offline audit of a real run's 12,800 trajectories, then partitioning token supports into disjoint outcome and action-local selector credit channels—is a clean, well-motivated refinement of existing turn-level credit-assignment work rather than a conceptual breakthrough. Rigor is solid: controlled comparison against outcome-only RL sharing init/data/steps/hyperparameters, five credit-placement ablations, external-router study, held-out 147-task generalization set, and raw counts (Table 4). Evidence is moderate: +7.9 pp pooled improvement with CI [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero, but each configuration is a single run, per-benchmark intervals cross zero, pass@4 is not significant, and frontier rows are uncontrolled references. Generalizability is limited by the need for training tasks with a known, verified oracle skill, a fixed read-call interface, and the method's inability to credit abstention (acknowledged in the Conclusion). Reproducibility is aided by released code/models, hyperparameters, and prompt appendix, but several benchmarks (Claw-Eval, SkillsBench, SETA) have unclear public availability.

primary_link.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-leve
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理框架將程序性知識封裝為技能檔案,公共技能庫已達數千筆,任務中途「讀哪個技能」成為策略自身的關鍵決策。本文指出僅靠結果報酬的 RL 教不會此決策,並審計 12,800 條實際訓練軌跡證實「選擇器信用飢餓」:在序列層級的廣播式優勢下,命名技能的少數 token 損失比重極小(中位數 0.14%,隨軌跡變長稀釋約七倍),且後續執行失敗時,正確選擇反被負優勢懲罰,最長軌跡上受罰比例甚至過半;但此決策本身價值達 11.2 個百分點的任務成功率。SkillGate 將單一策略的 token 支援分割為兩個互斥的信用通道:任務通道沿用 GRPO 群組正規化結果優勢,但整段讀取呼叫自遮罩移除;選擇器通道對技能名稱 token 施加動作局部優勢,僅當軌跡只讀一次且讀對 oracle(正確技能)才給正分,並以長度不變的權重重標定,使選擇決策的權重不受軌跡長度影響。在五個代理基準、每題 16 個候選技能的設定下,SkillGate 將 9B 模型整體成功率由 40.8% 提升至 53.2%,超過相同預算下僅用結果報酬的 47.0%,也勝過監督式選擇、偏好學習、外部路由器與 27B 參考模型;誤導技能暴露降低約三分之二,讀取次數反而更少,顯示增益來自選得更準而非讀得更多。限制包括:各設定僅單次訓練、需要已知正確技能的訓練任務、動作局部設計無法給「不讀取」的節制行為信用。本研究顯示,當一條軌跡交錯著性質不同的決策時,分割 token 支援是比重分配單一廣播優勢更便宜且可驗證的替代方案,技能選擇是必須直接訓練的獨立能力,而非模型規模自然湧現的副產品。
recommendations.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
recommendations.title_zh: SkillGate:在長程代理中訓練策略內的技能選擇

links.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 2: 0/154 novel closed-book trials vs 299/300 front-load recovery at ≥9/12 requirements, isolating channel substitution
Section 4.1, Table 2: renamed closed-book, 66/70 trials across seven model families pass the identical 24/79 tests with pairwise Jaccard 1.000
Section 4.3 and Appendices I-J: fault-injection sweeps show zero-deviation linear damage (32→24→16→8→0 tests) across nine cells, n=6 per cell

Section 4.4 and Appendix K: 144 trials all passing, cumulative input spans 12.8× (293,882–3,752,134 tokens) while peak per-turn context spans only 1.8×; withheld-fact sweep shows no configuration recovers more
Section 4.8: conflicting-source result 39/39 trials follow the written standard, Wilson 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]; Section 4.9 shows stale standard (0%) worse than no standard (33%)
Section 4.10: residency AUC ≈ 0.49 on 122 recoverable SWE-bench trajectories; resolved rates 1.0–39.4% across 397 scored trials; instrument explicitly does not transfer
Section 5: authors withdraw a prior residency-separation result after a 20-trial rerun reversed it (residency AUC 0.55 vs activity counts 0.86–0.95)
Appendix S and Appendix T: repository at https://github.com/mpi-dsg/agent-coherence with per-trial ledgers, sandbox profiles, vLLM 0.24 on 2×80GB H100, and enumerated recomputable results
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research on coding agents, context vs parametric-memory substitution, and harness design — squarely within high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code & Programming 2.0, Long Context & Memory 1.8). The working-set/coupled-fact framing with edit-time fault injection is a genuinely fresh causal take compared to the post-hoc trajectory classifiers it cites (Section 7). Rigor is unusually high: pre-specified predictions, evidence tiers separating confirmatory from exploratory n=3-12 cells, Wilson/bootstrap intervals, sandbox leakage controls with excluded earlier policies, a 1,089-run estimator enumeration (Appendix C), a withdrawn earlier result (Section 5), and honest nulls (SWE-bench AUC 0.49). Quantitative evidence is clean but rests on hand-authored synthetic workloads with marker evaluators, small per-cell n, and ceiling arms that only bound distance effects (Section 4.2). The authors explicitly scope generalizability: the measurement instrument fails to transfer to real repositories (Section 4.10). Strong artifact release with recompute lists and environment details supports reproducibility.

primary_link.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

recommendations.summary: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels
recommendations.summary_zh: 儲存庫規模的程式修改,要求 coding agent 在有限脈絡視窗內維持測試、匯入、設定與遷移規則的一致性。本文將此建模為重建「耦合事實圖」:每次編輯所需的事實須來自近期脈絡或模型的參數記憶,兩者皆未涵蓋者即構成「連貫性債務」(coherence debt)。研究團隊分別供給與抽離兩個通道並注入錯誤,跨七個模型與五種 harness 進行實驗,涵蓋虛構 API 遷移的閉卷測試、前置供給條件、真實 Pydantic v1→v2 遷移及其改名對照版,以及自行建構耦合的合成任務。結果顯示:兩通道皆空時,154 次閉卷試驗全數 0/12;把事實放進提示詞後,300 次中 299 次達到至少 9/12。記住同一函式庫的七個模型,在改名遷移上於相同處失敗、通過完全相同的 24/79 個測試。成敗取決於事實是否存在而非距離:供給的事實遠在 128,000 字元外仍同樣有效;抽離幾個事實便恰損失其對應的工作,損害呈線性。同樣全數通過測試的各種 harness 設定,累積 token 消耗相差達 12.8 倍,且事實被抽離時多花費也換不回成效。缺少事實時,代理多半虛構檔案或猜測數值而非回報受阻,受阻比例幾乎由模型決定(0% 到 100%)。當書面規範與程式碼衝突時,代理一律遵循規範,即使規範較差,故過時的慣例檔案比沒有更糟。限制:以讀取為基礎的駐留分數具工作負載相對性,在 SWE-bench 上預測力近於隨機(AUC≈0.49),靜態匯入圖亦難代表真正的任務耦合。啟示是 harness 應確保編輯當下所需的事實可用且一致,並以代理的產出而非讀取行為來檢驗。
recommendations.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

links.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 66.4% near-verbatim extraction success on open-source LRMs with length within 10% and >=90% exact token match; 33,463 tokens extracted from a 32,948-token target on Gemini-2.5

Threat Model section: defines black-box attacker with API access, attacker-defined tool, observable tool arguments, and only reasoning-token count/CoT summary as signals; no parameters, gradients, or logits

Table 1 (Evaluation Results): EchoCoT-LTGO achieves 46.1% ASR@99 / 66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek-V4-Flash vs REP at 0.3% ASR@90, Direct Prompting and CoT Synthesis at 0.0% across thresholds; Answer Match Rate 84.2-93.0%
Table 2 (Cross-Dataset Transferability): optimized trajectories transfer with ASR@90 of 80% (MATH500), 71% (JEEBench), 64% (LiveCodeBench) on DeepSeek, without re-optimization

Ablation Studies (Appendix A.3): two-level objective improves DeepSeek LGO ASR@90 from 0.03 to 0.51 vs mean-only; full Inject+Reflect+Distill workflow beats Inject-Only and Inject+Reflect; 3 tool-call steps are near-optimal
Table 6 (Defense Results): reasoning-state removal yields 0% ASR@90; defensive system prompt reduces mean ASR@90 from 46.0% to 5.0% (9.7% under adaptive re-optimization); length obfuscation 13-17%
Appendix A.1 Proxy Fidelity Analysis: Spearman correlation 0.532 (p<0.001) between Summary Token Recall and ground-truth Token-F1 over 1,024 triplets, stronger at low Length Error
Limitations section: single run per sample without run-to-run variability; proprietary-model fidelity evaluation is proxy-only since ground-truth CoTs and tokenizers are unavailable
Footnote 1 and Artifact Release: code at github.com/TrustAIRLab/EchoCoT; full artifacts promised for open-source models, provider-specific trajectories withheld/restricted
Ethics Considerations / Responsible Disclosure: institutional ethics review approval and disclosure to Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI
llm_evaluation.rationale: Security attack paper squarely within core preferences: it targets LLM/LRM hidden chain-of-thought (Reasoning & CoT), exploits tool-call continuity (Agents & Tool Use), uses prompt injection with LLM-based trajectory optimization (Prompting, Red Teaming), and frames CoT exposure as an AI-safety risk. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the 'reasoning replay surface' between tool calls and the Inject-Reflect-Distill optimizer are new, yet they build on known prompt-injection and prompt-optimization ideas (GEPA, ExpeL). Rigor is high for open-source models with ground-truth CoTs: clear threat model, multiple metrics (Length Error, Token-EM, ASR@x), three baselines, ablations over objectives/workflow/steps, failure-mode analysis, and defense evaluation including adaptive attackers. Evidence is strong where ground truth exists (66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek; 80% transfer to MATH500; 21,109/21,106-token example with Token-EM 0.999) but only proxy-based for proprietary models (length match, summary recall, entailment), which the authors acknowledge; single-run-per-sample is an additional limitation. Generalizability is supported by 8 models, 4 datasets, and cross-domain results, though trajectories are per-model optimized and success varies widely (Qwen 30.8% vs DeepSeek 66.4%). Reproducibility is aided by released code, pseudocode, and full optimizer prompts, but proprietary trajectories are withheld. Not out-of-scope: no domain-application or pure-vision content.

primary_link.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

recommendations.summary: Hidden chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, especially those from frontier proprietary large reasoning models (LRMs), are valuable model assets. Yet whether these hidden CoTs can be directly extracted from black-box models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically study whether hidden CoTs can be extracted near-verbatim from black-box LRMs through API interactions. We identify a previously overlooked reasoning replay surface between tool calls and develop EchoCoT, a multi-step attack
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型推理模型（LRM）的隱藏思考鏈（CoT）能否透過黑箱 API 互動被近乎逐字地擷取。作者發現一個先前被忽略的攻擊面：模型在單一輪次內進行多次工具呼叫時，會保留推理狀態以維持連續性。攻擊者可自訂 scratchpad 工具，並在工具回應中注入惡意指令，逐步誘使模型把完整思考內容寫入工具參數；再利用 API 回傳的推理 token 數量與 CoT 摘要作為代理訊號，設計長度與文字兩層保真度評分，並以 LLM 最佳化框架透過 Inject-Reflect-Distill 流程自動搜尋通用注入軌跡（LGO 與 LTGO 兩種目標）。實驗顯示，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.5-Plus 與 GLM-5.2 上，EchoCoT-LTGO 達到 22.8%–46.1% 的 ASR@99 與最高 66.4% 的 ASR@90，最佳化軌跡還能遷移到未見資料集（MATH500 達 80%），並近乎逐字重現逾 20K token 的長推理。對 Gemini 與 Claude 系列專有模型，擷取長度接近官方回報值，Gemini-2.5 更抽得 33,463 個 token，還能挖出 o4-mini 的系統提示。防禦評估指出，移除推理狀態可根除攻擊；防禦性系統提示與移除長度訊息較為實用，但自適應攻擊仍可部分得手，顯示需多層防護。限制包括專有模型缺乏真實 CoT 供驗證，僅能以代理指標估算，且每樣本僅執行一次。此研究確立隱藏 CoT 外洩是實際的安全風險，作者已向 Google、Anthropic 與 OpenAI 負責任揭露。
recommendations.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
recommendations.title_zh: EchoCoT：從大型推理模型擷取隱藏思考鏈

links.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

evidence: Abstract and §3.1: CellFill parametrization W = Ŵ + M ⊙ tanh(sBAᵀ) with B=0 at init, so |W_ij − Ŵ_ij| < M_ij for every weight regardless of optimizer; invariance is a property of the parametrization, not the training run.

§2 Prop. 1 and Appendix A: bitwise invariance holds only against frozen (a,s); a two-weight counterexample (executed as a unit test) shows re-running a quantizer with recomputed absmax scales silently reassigns untouched weights.

§5.1 Table 1: CellFill r=64 recovers 66.7±8.6% of synthetic facts with LAMBADA 42.33±1.99 under exact invariance asserted over 1.409×10⁹ constrained weights with zero violations; unconstrained dense pays 74.83 LAMBADA for 59.3±8.7%.

§5.5 Table 4: at the lr CellFill uses (1e-3), LoRA collapses (WikiText 796.48, 61.7% of weights clipped, 0.0% recall) while CellFill reaches 94.3±2.2% bit-identically; LoRA needs 2e-4 to work and still must be clipped (8.5%).

§5.5 Tables 2–3: MEMIT destroys the model under sequential application (WikiText 20,348 archived) and GRACE under its honest condition scores 2.0% (the untouched model's rate), while CellFill's honest condition reaches 95.7% on the 507 real probes.

§5.7 Table 7: on the PopQA tail, the fill answers 81.8–89.8% of unknowns at 75 tokens/question versus 90–1,008 tokens for retrieval arms, and is unaffected by the chunked index that drops retrieval to 41–74%.

§5.13 Table 10: at 10⁴ facts the knee is the tanh link's dead gradient (78.4% saturation), not the cells; gradient-preserving links raise absorption 22–24% to 36–39%, and stored bits (3–5×10⁻⁵/cell) are far below parametrization capacity.

§5.17: four sequential tasks each verified with zero violations; mean-room ratios 0.8271/0.8254/0.8238 give β=0.825±0.002, and the naive identity β=1−E|t| is shown false by logged fills (0.44–0.52 vs implied 0.17).

§5.16 Table 13: mechanism verified on published NF4/QAT releases (Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B at 94.3–97.6%, Gemma-4 at 82.9%) and a 27B gated-linear-attention model with 2.435×10¹⁰ weights bit-identical, though the 27B run is single-seed with a different recipe.

§9 Limitations: one model family/quantizer for most claims, n=1 for the entire 27B result and seven partitions, in-domain perplexity contaminated by rehearsal everywhere, diagonal-Fisher budget underestimates drift 15.9×–383×, and the headline capacity number and its cross-domain price come from different runs.

§10 Reproducibility: archived JSON configs trace every number, tables generated by scripts/make_tables.py, 25 CPU unit tests, exact commands per experiment, code at github.com/sumsliu/cellfill; §9 reports vendor byte-identity verification (bitsandbytes returns the release's 7.05×10⁸ packed bytes identically).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: continual learning on deployed 4-bit LLMs with bitwise artifact invariance, positioned at the intersection of quantization/efficiency, LoRA-style fine-tuning, knowledge injection vs RAG, and deployment/serving. The reframing of the dequantization gap as writable storage, the tanh-bounded CellFill parametrization with invariance by construction, the plasticity decay law (Prop. 6), and nested refinement bits are genuinely novel relative to QLoRA/LoftQ/QA-LoRA, PEQA/AlphaTuning, BitDelta, and editing methods. Rigor is unusually high: formal propositions with proofs and unit tests, exhaustive integer-domain verification on every merge, matched controls (unmerged adapter, unconstrained dense), LoRA/MEMIT/GRACE/retrieval baselines, and a candid limitations section that walks back earlier overclaims (rehearsal free-lunch artifact, Fisher budget not a certificate). Evidence is broad and archived but many key comparisons are n=1 or n=2 with seed spreads comparable to effects; capacity exponents come from two points; the capacity headline and its cross-domain price come from different runs. Generalizability is limited: facts only (no skills), one quantizer stack for most results, no GPTQ/AWQ measurements despite the argument that cell arithmetic applies, single sequential sequence on one model, and the 27B point uses a different recipe and path. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, archived JSON results generating all tables via scripts, exact commands, hyperparameter appendix, and vendor byte-identity verification.

primary_link.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

recommendations.summary: A deployed language model is a file that many things depend on - a benchmark report, a certification, a fleet of devices - and every way of teaching it something new produces a different file. We show that this is not necessary. A 4-bit release stores each weight as an integer code and a shared scale, and leaves between the stored values an interval the quantizer discards; we call in-cell learning the paradigm in which new knowledge is written only into that interval, so that re-quantizing the s
recommendations.summary_zh: 已部署的 4-bit 量化模型是一份被基準報告、認證與裝置依賴的檔案,而任何教它新知識的方法(全參數 fine-tuning、adapter 合併、知識編輯)都會產生不同的檔案,迫使整套認證重來。本文提出 in-cell learning 典範:4-bit 權重以整數碼加共享縮放因子儲存,量化器丟棄的細胞內區間可作為可寫入空間;更新只寫進該區間,重新量化後可逐位元重現原始釋出版本。CellFill 以 W=Ŵ+M⊙tanh(sBAᵀ) 的有界低秩參數化實作,並直接在供應商自己的 4-bit 釋出版上訓練;更新是獨立、可撤銷的 fill 檔案,漂移由訓練前固定的半徑界定。在 NF4、QAT 與 GPTQ 式網格、Qwen3 與 Gemma(1.7B 至 31B)上,CellFill 寫入 83–97% 模型確實不知道的真實事實,於高達 2.4×10^10 個受限權重上零違規;同學習率的 LoRA 則會發散。寫入的知識確實可用:藥物與成分能以模型自身的兩跳上限組合;對 PopQA 長尾,fill 以每題 75 tokens 回答 82–90% 釋出模型答不了的問題,且不受區塊索引影響。多位寫入者可共用一次釋出,順序更新的可寫空間以 β≈0.82 幾何衰減,遺忘被測量而非消除。限制包括:僅示範事實而非技能、種子數少、NF4 以外的網格多為論證而非實測、Fisher 預算並非可用的數值憑證。此方法將模型更新從整份替換變成可稽核、可回滾的增量,對認證成本高於算力成本的部署場景極具價值。

links.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer

evidence: Abstract: map covers 6.3x10^8 candidate channels in GPT-2 to 1.3x10^11 in Pythia-6.9B; 70-89% of head pairs oriented far from chance, with both strong coupling and active avoidance; full map costs 15 s for GPT-2 and 11 min for Pythia-6.9B on one consumer GPU.

Section 3: coupling coefficient C=||RW||_F/(||R||_F||W||_F) generalizes Elhage et al. (2021) composition scores to all 18 connection classes; Prop. 5 (Appendix A.4) gives exact chance level E[C^2]=1/d.

Section 4 / Table 10: freezing the 30-head induction community destroys 93.8% of GPT-2's induction gain vs 2.5% random-control median; five behavioral induction heads alone account for only 60.8%; replication in Table 9 reaches 97.1% vs 1.0% control at Pythia-2.8B.

Section 5 / Table 3: RW-PCA 2D subspace deletion destroys 82-96% of induction gain across six models; Pythia-6.9B: 89.5% (ours) vs 84.5% (activation PCA) vs 36.5% (outlier dims); Pythia-160m: 95.8% vs 42.0%/35.4%; principal cosines show the directions are distinct from baselines.

Section 6 limitations: map shows potential connectivity from weights only, not input-dependent routing; validated against a single capability (in-context copying); experiments limited to sub-10B-parameter models; nodes are heads/neurons, not learned features.
Appendix C.2/D.3: GPT-Neo excluded from deletion because random 2D deletions already destroy 60-98% of its induction gain; Pythia-6.9B absent from Table 9 due to ~55 GB RAM vs 45 GB available.

Reproducibility statement: full pipeline released at github.com/richardzhewang/communication-map with fixed seeds, public TransformerLens checkpoints, fixed Pile samples, single NVIDIA RTX 5090; all numbers regenerate from released code and map tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of transformer language models, squarely in scope (not a listed out-of-scope area). It directly matches high-weight preferences: LLMs (weight 2.5; GPT-2/Neo/Pythia language models), Interpretability & Explainability (weight 1.8; circuits, attention heads, residual stream), Transformer Architecture (weight 1.2; W_QK/W_OV, attention), plus moderate matches to Prompting/ICL (in-context copying/induction gain) and Scaling. Novelty is high: first claimed whole-transformer communication map over all 18 connection classes including neurons (Section 1, 3), a generalized coupling coefficient with closed-form rotation-null moments, and a new RW-PCA method yielding an induction-critical 2D subspace distinct from activation-PCA and outlier-dimension baselines (Section 5, Table 3). Rigor is strong: proofs (Appendix A.3-A.4), Monte Carlo verification of closed-form nulls, FDR control with stratum-fitted empirical nulls (Section 4, C.1), matched random ablation controls, replication across six models (Table 9), and honest caveats (GPT-Neo excluded because random deletions destroy 60-98%, Appendix D.3; Pythia-6.9B ablation absent due to RAM, C.2). Evidence is quantitative and controlled (93.8% induction-gain destruction vs 2.5% control median, GPT-2, Table 10; 89.5% vs 84.5%/36.5% baselines at 6.9B, Table 3), though validated on a single capability and limited to sub-10B models (Section 6 limitations). Reproducibility is excellent: released code/maps with fixed seeds, public checkpoints, documented compute (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer

recommendations.summary: The components of a transformer communicate by writing to and reading from a shared residual stream, and mechanistic interpretability has mapped these connections by hand, one circuit at a time. We present the communication map, which charts every potential communication channel in a language model from weights alone, generalizing the composition score of Elhage et al. (2021) into a single coupling coefficient covering all 18 connection classes, from entire attention head circuits to single neur
recommendations.summary_zh: Transformer 的各元件（attention heads 與 MLP 神經元）共用殘差流（residual stream）交換資訊，但過去機制可解釋性研究多為逐一手工追蹤單一電路，缺乏整個模型層級的通訊全景。本文提出「通訊地圖」，僅從權重即可描繪所有潛在通訊通道：作者將 Elhage 等人的 composition score 推廣為通用的耦合係數，覆蓋 18 類連線（head 間 K/Q/V-composition、head 與神經元、介面矩陣等），並以 Haar 旋轉的理論虛無分配、分層經驗虛無分配與 FDR 控制判定顯著連線。透過跡的循環性質與內 Gram 矩陣分解，繪製 GPT-2 全圖僅需 15 秒，Pythia-6.9B 的 1.3×10¹¹ 條候選通道也只要 11 分鐘（單張消費級 GPU）。普查發現 70–89% 的 head 對顯著偏離隨機水準，不是超耦合就是主動迴避；神經元之間也存在遠超機率的直接連線。應用一：最強的 head 間耦合在不依賴行為線索下重現 induction 電路，並形成縱貫多層的社群，消融含五個 induction heads 的社群摧毀 GPT-2 93.8% 的 in-context 複製能力（Pythia-2.8B 達 97.1%）。應用二：reader–writer PCA（RW-PCA）從權重幾何找出二維 induction 關鍵子空間，刪除它在六個模型上摧毀 82–96% 的 induction 能力，效果優於 activation PCA 與 outlier dimensions 基線，且選出的方向與二者不同。限制方面：地圖僅反映權重的潛在連通性，無法呈現依輸入而變的實際訊號路由；驗證聚焦單一能力（in-context copying）；實驗限於百億參數以下模型；節點為 heads 與神經元而非稀疏自編碼器學得的特徵。整體而言，此工作首次建立全模型通訊地圖，並釋出地圖、統計工具與介入套件，為電路發現、子空間介入與可解釋性研究提供高效且可重現的基礎。

links.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: models 'maintain accurate strategic depth under recursive reasoning' and 'errors arise from using the wrong number of iterated depth of reasoning steps, not from computing best responses incorrectly'.

Definition 1 (Methodology): formalizes level-K distinguishability as injectivity of k -> a(k) on {0,...,Kmax}; motivating counterexample shows depth-0 and depth-2 proposals coincide in the negotiation game of Zhang et al. (2025).

Table 2 (Experiment and Results): recursive-condition accuracy 83.5-92.5% for three models but Sonnet 4.6 49.0 (99.0 within-one) in 11-20 Mod.; inductive accuracy collapses to 0.5-2.5% in Nash Demand, showing uneven degradation.
Appendix A.4: 'Ring 11-20 separates them' - extrapolating the constant -3 step diverges from the IDR sequence at k=4, giving an extrapolation check the three arithmetic games lack.
Appendix A.3: exclusion of Ring 11-20 k_target=10 trials is quantified - retaining ambiguous 20 submissions would raise pooled accuracy from 31.9% (n=12,467) to 32.9% (n=12,787).
Appendix B.3 Table 7: models called via OpenRouter slugs, temperature 0.2, max_tokens 8192, 4 games x 10 levels x conditions x 20 reps = 3200 trials per model; no-action trials scored as incorrect.
Appendix D.4: Wilson intervals plus cluster bootstrap with B=2000; clustered intervals are a median 4.1x wider per model and 7.6x pooled.
Conclusions: limitations - 'we only tested up to a depth of 10' and 'a single LLM judge (Claude Opus 4.8) to read and score every chain of thought'.
Appendix D.1: judge is same family as one evaluated model; extraction-only design with mandatory verbatim quotes mitigates but 'does not eliminate that possibility'.
Appendix B.2: confound acknowledged - wording change between k_target=4 and 5 means 'the design as run cannot separate the effect of the wording from the effect of the depth'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-methodology paper: evaluates four LLMs' strategic reasoning depth via level-k game instruments, with chain-of-thought consistency analysis and a tool-calling inductive condition, matching multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, agents/tool use, evaluation, theory of mind). Novelty is substantive: the level-k distinguishability condition (Definition 1) directly addresses an identifiability gap in prior LLM game benchmarks, and the novel Ring 11-20 game plus non-monotone IDR sequence separates iteration from extrapolation (Appendix A.4). Rigor is high: closed-form best-response maps, a pigeonhole bound on Kmax (Lemma 1), blinded extraction-only judge with quote grounding, Wilson and cluster-bootstrap intervals (Appendix D.4), and an honest confound disclosure that wording change and depth boundary are inseparable at k=4/5. Evidence is quantitatively supported (Table 2 per-game accuracies, Figure 4 chain-length analysis, Table 3 mentalizing splits), though the mentalizing-accuracy link is correlational and the judge shares a model family with one evaluated model (acknowledged in D.1). Generalizability is limited to depth 10, four games, four models, and a single judge, as the Conclusions state. Reproducibility is strong: verbatim prompts (B.2), model slugs and decoding (Table 7), sampling formula for histories (C.1), released logs/code including lambda_sweep.csv, and provider-pinning guidance.

primary_link.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

recommendations.summary: Strategic depth of reasoning is essential for human interaction of Large Language Models (LLMs) operating in boundedly rational environments. However, existing evaluations are primarily based on canonical games prevalent in pretraining corpora, making it difficult to disentangle true strategic reasoning from memorisation. To address this, we formalise a necessary level-K distinguishability condition for strategic depth inference and construct a suite of novel game structures that meet this stand
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對現有LLM策略推理評估的效度缺口提出解方。過去研究多以預訓練語料中常見的經典賽局測試策略深度，難以區分真實推理與背誦，且缺乏不同推理深度對應到不同行動的保證，無法從行為辨識真實推理層級。作者形式化level-k可區分性條件，要求疊代最佳反應序列一一對應到不同行動，並建構新穎的五人環狀賽局Ring 11–20，同時改寫11–20金錢請求、All-Pay Auction與Nash Demand三個經典賽局。實驗涵蓋Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.6 27B、Claude Sonnet 4.6與DeepSeek v4 Pro四個模型，對手涵蓋L0至L9，並比較遞迴條件化（以語言描述對手層級）與歸納條件化（僅提供30筆對手歷史行動）。遞迴條件下各模型準確率高，思考鏈陳述的信念與實際行動內部一致；錯誤主要源自疊代步數算錯而非最佳反應計算錯誤，如Sonnet 4.6在深度4後固定少一層，Gemma 4在深度9、10失能。歸納條件下準確率劇烈且不均地下滑，於Nash Demand幾近歸零；思考鏈含明確策略性心智化的試次表現明顯較佳。限制包括僅測至深度10、依賴單一LLM評審Claude Opus 4.8，且對手描述措辭在深度4與5間改變，難以分離兩者效果。此研究對AI安全（低層級代理可能遭剝削）與以LLM模擬人類策略行為的基準設計深具意義。

links.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.1: across 72 model–setting–pressure–domain cells in Table 2 the oracle matches or exceeds contest in all cells and is strictly higher in 71; consistent with the single 0.00% gap (Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math ρ=0.2, 4.46 vs 4.46).

Section 3.4 and Appendix E: response-curve oracle formulated as a multiple-choice knapsack over budget levels with K=5 repeats per grid point and exact enumeration of 6^6 assignments; paper explicitly frames the gap as offline empirical headroom, not an executable policy.
Appendix B: manual audit of 300 Stage-2 finalizer calls across 30 model–pressure–domain cells; 'No audited call re-solved a problem', mitigating the uncharged-finalization confound.

Section 4.4 and Appendix H Table 12: ECI composite over fifty benchmarks does not predict Gap Ratio (mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37; pooled R^2=0.01, p=0.70), ruling out a general-capability explanation.
Appendix O Table 18: target-in-suite diagnostic over 720 stress episodes; nine of twelve cells show ≤5pp loss and mean difference 1.1pp, arguing against a suite-context explanation of the gap.

Section 5 and Table 3: lightweight online schedulers (coverage guard, verification gate) beat the contest reference in six of nine model–domain cells but no policy dominates; Code improves for all three models while Math/AR are mixed.
Appendix K: 18,000 trajectories annotated exhaustively by ten annotators, one annotation per trajectory with quotation-backed rubrics, but no inter-annotator agreement statistics are reported.

Appendix G Table 8 and Appendix I Table 13: per-model token/action caps and full sampling configurations (temperature, top-p, reasoning effort, 5 runs) are disclosed; HuggingFace dataset links appear in the author block and 'exact prompts and scripts are released with the benchmark artifact' (Appendix D).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM reasoning/agent evaluation work: introduces R3-Bench, a shared-budget six-problem contest benchmark over math, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings, evaluated on eight frontier LLMs. The core contribution—measuring the gap between a model's demonstrated single-problem competence (via matched response curves and a multiple-choice knapsack oracle) and its realized suite performance under one shared budget—is a genuinely new evaluation angle distinct from per-task budget-aware methods (TALE, SelfBudgeter) and prior shared-budget works (USACOArena, CLEAR), as argued in the Section 2 comparison table. Rigor is strong: per-model budget calibration (Section 3.1, Appendix G), 5 repeats, a two-stage protocol for thinking models with a 300-call manual audit confirming Stage 2 never re-solves problems (Appendix B), detailed action accounting (Appendix F), and two confound checks—target-in-suite context stress (Appendix O, mean 1.1pp) and ECI discriminant validity with permutation tests (Appendix H Table 12, mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37). Headline numbers are internally consistent (72 cells, oracle strictly higher in 71, matching the single 0.00% tie for Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math in Table 2). Deductions: no confidence intervals or significance tests on the main contest–oracle gaps, no inter-annotator agreement reported despite 18,000 single-annotated trajectories (Appendix K), the oracle is an offline diagnostic rather than an achievable policy (acknowledged in Appendix E), the scheduler study covers only three models at one pressure with no dominating policy (Section 5, Table 3), and difficulty is stratified by reference-model output length rather than accuracy, which may not generalize. Reproducibility is aided by released prompts, scripts, and a HuggingFace dataset plus exhaustive appendices, but relies on proprietary APIs and a model-based math judge (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Appendix D.4).

primary_link.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

recommendations.summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 R³-Bench，一個評估大型語言模型（LLM）在共享預算下資源理性推理的基準。既有推理與代理基準皆以每題獨立預算評估，跨題目的資源分配與機會成本從未被檢驗。R³-Bench 於數學奧林匹亞、競技程式設計與抽象推理三領域各構建 50 場六題競賽（三易、二中、一難），在無工具（輸出 token 預算）與代理式（計數動作預算）兩種設定下，以模型自身無預算用量校準的強（ρ=0.2）與中（ρ=0.8）壓力進行評估。作者另以配對的單題反應曲線建立平均分配重播與反應曲線 oracle（形式化為多重選擇背包問題）作為離線經驗參考。主要結果：在六款旗艦模型的 72 個模型—設定—壓力—領域組合中，oracle 得分皆不低於競賽得分，其中 71 個嚴格更高；強壓力下失敗主因是預算花在其他題目，中等壓力下則常在部分進展後即停止；賽中策略更新與資源理性調整稀少，且此差距無法由逾五十項基準組成的一般能力指數解釋。輕量線上排程器於九個組合中改善六個，但無任何策略跨領域一致有效。限制包括 oracle 僅為離線診斷而非可執行策略、重播受有限樣本影響，排程實驗亦僅涵蓋三款模型；另經「目標題置於題組」診斷，情境干擾並非主因。本基準凸顯單題能力不等於跨題分配能力，對訓練內建資源分配政策具指標意義。

evidence: Section 4 / Table 2 (r=0.1, n=1,000, three seeds): Qwen3.5-9B GSM8K falls 0.845→0.706 (keyboard) and 0.569 (typoswap) while filler leaves 0.840, establishing the corruption-vs-length asymmetry.

Section 5.3 / Table 5 (GSM8K, n=100/cell, paired cluster bootstrap B=2000): clean attention over corrupted content is significantly harmful in three of four models; joint restoration recovers 45-71% of the gap with significantly positive interaction in every model.

Section 5.4 / Table 6 (n=237, model fixed effects, SEs clustered by prompt): numeric-token hit is the only significant flip predictor (OR 12.89, 95% CI [5.06, 32.85]); corrupted fraction and diversion are non-significant.

Section 5.2 / Table 4 (n=500): length-matched padding control (Group C, 62 tokens, acc 0.662) vs keyboard (Group B, 62 tokens, frag 0.080, acc 0.642); the typoswap row (equal fragmentation, higher accuracy 0.682) is explicitly acknowledged as not following and rerouted to the n=4,160 regression (Appendix H).

Section 6.1 / Table 9: deployable tokenizer-level defense detects corruption (F1 0.77-0.81; fragmentation alone 0.70-0.75) but accuracy recovery is positive in 0 of 8 model-task cells; oracle clean-token restoration fully recovers, localizing damage to input representation.

Appendix K: factorial intervention protocol with difflib position map, -log K mass-preservation correction, and five validation checks (identity bit-identical, causality, mass moves 0.121→0.089 vs clean 0.079); 99.3% of positions get a genuine clean counterpart.
Limitations: factorial intervention run only on GSM8K at a single severity (BoolQ gap too narrow); perturbations synthetic; single-turn standard-length tasks; coupling claim rests on one task.
Appendix D: Llama-3.3-70B GSM8K drops 13 points under typoswap; Chinese CMath keyboard drop of 30 points with harmless filler, indicating cross-script, cross-scale generalization with attenuation.

Appendix A / Tables 11-12 (n=100, r=0.1): GPT-5.4 Thinking keyboard degradation -0.147 vs -0.093 Standard; frontier evidence is prediction-level only and single-severity, weakening strength of that claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM research: empirical robustness and mechanistic analysis of reasoning in open-weight LLMs (Llama-3.1, Mistral, Qwen3.5, Gemma-2, plus GPT-4o/GPT-5.4) on GSM8K/BoolQ/PIQA/HellaSwag, with direct hits on LLM, Reasoning/CoT, and Interpretability preferences and secondary alignment with AI Safety/robustness and Prompting. Novelty is solid but not maximal: typo-brittleness of neural NLP is established (Belinkov & Bisk; Pruthi et al. cited in §7); the genuinely new elements are the fragmentation-vs-length controls (Table 4), the factorial attention/content intervention showing the two channels are coupled and super-additive (Table 5), and the evidence-irreplaceability account of task resilience (Table 6-7). Rigor is high: length-matched padding controls, per-example logistic regression with clustered SEs (Appendix H), bootstrap CIs and five validation checks for the patching intervention (Appendix K), and self-scrutinizing controls (OCR fragments most yet is harmless, Table 8; the anomalous typoswap cell is acknowledged). Main weaknesses: factorial coupling rests on one task at one severity (admitted in Limitations), several interventions use n=100, the Qwen factorial cell is ill-conditioned, and frontier-model claims (e.g., thinking mode amplifying degradation) rest on n=100 single-severity API runs. Code/data link and detailed appendices support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion

recommendations.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Di
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在詞彙層面受擾動時的推理穩健性。作者系統性評估四個開源權重指令微調模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-2-9B）與 GPT-4o、GPT-5.4 等前沿模型，在 BoolQ、PIQA、HellaSwag、GSM8K 四項基準上施以鍵盤雜訊、相鄰字元對調與填充詞插入三種擾動。結果顯示字元級擾動大幅降低準確率，多步數學推理受創最重，填充詞幾乎無害；連 GPT-5.4 的內建推理模式也放大而非吸收損害。機制分析提出「注意力轉移」：字元破壞使 subword 斷詞碎裂，碎片在推論時吸引不成比例的注意力質量，集中於中後層；等長對照與迴歸分析證實碎裂而非提示長度才是元凶。因子式介入實驗進一步顯示注意力與詞元內容相互耦合：僅修復任一通道無效，乾淨注意力配上受損內容甚至有害，兩者同時修復才能挽回約 45–71% 的差距。這解釋了拼字檢查、self-repair、Chain-of-Thought 等推論期策略為何無法穩定復原效能，且數字詞元是 GSM8K 失敗的主因。tokenizer 層級的防禦雖能可靠偵測碎裂（F1 約 0.77–0.81），卻無法逆轉損害。研究侷限於英文與 QWERTY 輸入、合成擾動、單輪短任務，耦合實驗亦僅涵蓋 GSM8K。此發現顯示穩健性必須在斷詞發生前內建於表示層，例如字元感知的備援表示、動態重新斷詞與訓練期對齊，深具實務啟示。

evidence: Abstract: 'Over 78,000 measurements, no model's report discriminates a real intervention from a sham beyond chance (AUROC ≈ 0.5007)', with an equivalence bound below 0.15 percentage points of AUROC

Section 7.2: linear probes reach 0.958 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) and 0.750 (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3) held-out accuracy with 200-refit label-shuffled permutation controls; probes at downstream layers 20/24/31 show no held-out error

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric interpretability/safety paper squarely in scope: it tests whether eight open-weight LLMs (0.5B-14.8B, seven families) can verbally report controlled interventions on their own computation, with direct implications for chain-of-thought monitoring and self-report oversight. Rigor is unusually high: paired sham design, impact-matched random controls, a text-only observer bound, equivalence (TOST) testing that bounds the pooled effect below 0.15 AUROC percentage points over 11,216 pairs, item-pair clustered bootstraps, permutation controls on probes, dual codings for parse failure, and explicit outcome-to-claim rules. Evidence strength is solid because the null is anchored by two sensitivity checks: a linear probe recovering interventions at 95.8%/75.0% held-out accuracy (Section 7.2) and a fine-tuned known positive clearing the same pipeline at d'=5.15. Novelty is moderate-to-good: individual controls exist in the Lindsey-inspired literature the paper itself maps (Section 2), but the assembled design, impact-matched (divergence-matched) control, equivalence bound, and the report/probe and report/confidence dissociations (AUROC 0.647 for verbalized confidence in Qwen2.5-7B) are genuine contributions. Deductions: the primary detection battery uses one residual site (layer 16) and one dose for most models; only Qwen2.5-7B gets a truly impact-matched control while six models use the weakest unit-norm control (Section 7.3); the observer bound uses only the weakest same-model tier; the leakage decomposition and Track C/delayed-track analyses are specified but not executed (Sections 7.4, 7.6, Appendix B); the confidence finding was post-hoc selected from eight estimates without multiplicity correction (Section 7.7); conclusions do not extend to closed-weight frontier models; and there are minor inconsistencies (e.g., Section 6.1 says 'Nine models from seven laboratories' against eight roster models plus a LoRA row). Reproducibility is good via a released library, pinned revisions, released LoRA adapter, and a candid component-status table (Table 4), though the release implements only part of the stated design.

primary_link.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

recommendations.summary: Are frontier models able to introspect about their internal states? Recent work suggests that under certain conditions a complex enough model can audit its own internals, call out what changed, and report back confidently about it. We tested that claim on eight open-weight models from seven families and found no such ability: asked whether their own computation had been altered, none answered better than chance. To test it we built Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), a framework that interv
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型能否內省自身內部運算？近年研究暗示大型模型有時能察覺被注入的概念向量，但 chain-of-thought 監控、自我批評等 oversight 機制皆假設模型能如實自述自身計算。本文提出 Open-Weight Masked Introspection（OWMI）框架：在殘差流位置、注意力頭或 SAE 特徵上施加可控干預後詢問模型是否察覺改動，並以三種對照設下基準——未改動的 sham 執行、影響匹配的隨機擾動，以及只見輸出文字的觀察者；框架直接掛載 MMLU、GSM8K 等既有評測。在來自七個實驗室家族、0.5B 至 15B 的八個模型上累計逾 78,000 次量測，無任何模型的報告能超越機率地區分真實干預與 sham（AUROC 約 0.5007），等價性檢定更將優勢上界壓至 0.15 個 AUROC 百分點內；且七個模型在隨機擾動下反而更常回報「有變化」，顯示報告只反映擾動本身而非被改對象。但儀器靈敏：經 fine-tuning 學會報告此類干預的模型在同一管線下達 d′=5.15、AUROC≈1.0；線性探針自相同激活辨識干預的 held-out 準確率達 75% 至 95.8%，至輸出前最後幾層更無任何錯誤，證明資訊存在於內部狀態、卻未抵達語言報告。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的離散答案雖恆定，其信心分數仍以 AUROC 0.647 區分干預與否。限制含主實驗僅測單一殘差流位置與劑量、延遲與自發軌跡未完成、重建探針缺 ground truth，規模上限 15B。此結果攸關 AI 安全：仰賴模型自述的監控須以內部參照驗證，讀取激活的 oversight 才掌握真正含訊號的通道。
recommendations.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

links.title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null

evidence: Abstract: audits three rounds of rank-32 LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, identifying seven measurement failures each of which inverts a reported finding

Section 4.1: a frozen model under a single greedy decode shows clr=1.5 (9 corruptions vs 6 learnings) on MATH-500; serializing requests cuts verdict flips from 16/200 to 4/200 (Fisher p=0.005), leaving a 2% residual
Section 4.2: the ER1 expansion statistic assigns the frozen control 0.280 on AIME; pooled over 110 frozen comparisons the ER2 null is 0.058 [0.038,0.078], and no threshold below m=5 reaches zero

Section 5, Table 2: matched AIME ladder with stream/volume/evaluation matched — distillation detects 8-11 of 22 low-base problems per seed vs 0-2 for self-training arms; logistic interaction beta=1.91 [1.25,2.56], p<10^-8; on the 10 base-0 problems the union is 5 vs 2, p=0.35 (not significant)
Section 4.3/F5, Table 13: majority-vote SFT clr spans 0.55-1.53 across three seeds scored on the same 175 problems while STaR stays 0.45-0.74
Appendix D.1, Table 18: the ER2 null re-estimated from every subset ranges 0.022-0.098 at G=4 replicates and only stabilizes within +/-0.02 at G=9
Appendix A.4, Table 6: 48 runs, 3.44M sampled generations, 5.30B tokens, $3,171 itemized; measurement infrastructure 13% of spend and key controls cost $0

Appendix D.4, Table 24: refusal probe gives -0.015, -0.115, -0.005 across three replicates; authors report a bound (~11 points) rather than a safety claim, with cluster-robust SEs and design effect 1.8-2.8x

Appendix E.3: limitations — one backbone family carries all claims, 3 rounds/~270 optimizer steps, expansion rests on 22 low-base problems on one benchmark, corruption band built from MATH training problems

Reproducibility Statement: per-problem counts, noise-floor runs, evaluation subsets, and recomputation code released at github.com/chengxuphd/phantom-gains; every reported number computed by released code rather than transcribed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically rigorous audit of transition-level self-improvement claims for LLMs (Qwen3-8B, STaR/TTRL-style self-training, distillation control) that lands squarely in high-weight preference areas: LLM reasoning (AIME/MATH), RL/SFT training, and evaluation methodology, with a secondary safety probe. Preference relevance is high though not maximal (no Japanese NLP, no agents, no new LLM method). Novelty is solid but partly incremental: the paper candidly frames its headline consolidation finding as a replication of concurrent work (Strozzi 2026) and concedes the analytic null nearly matches its measured floor for the recommended estimator; the genuinely new contributions are the seven demonstrated failure modes, the demonstration that no expansion threshold repairs the statistic (measured ER2 null 0.058 over 110 frozen comparisons), and the replicate-count guidance (G>=9). Rigor is exceptional: frozen controls pushed through identical pipelines, design-matched floors, multiple-testing robustness checks, seed replication on matched problem sets, a tested mechanism for batching non-determinism, a logistic control for the teacher's larger gain, cluster-robust refusal analysis, and a reported falsified pre-registered prediction. Evidence strength is high: 48 runs, 3.44M generations, itemized costs, per-problem itemization of all 29 base-unreached AIME items, effect-size envelopes, and transcripts. Generalizability is the weak point and the paper says so: one backbone family, one domain (math), only 3 rounds/~270 LoRA steps, expansion resting on 22 low-base problems (10 truly base-0, non-significant), corruption measured on a constructed band that is not a natural forgetting rate. Reproducibility is strong: released per-problem records and recomputation code, full configuration and grading rules, compute accounting; minor deductions for the Tinker-service dependency and 15GB raw records available only on request.
topics: statistical power, seeds, and multiple testing

recommendations.summary_zh: 模型「自我改進」是否屬實，不能只看平均準確率，而須追蹤個別題目能力的獲得與失去。但這種轉變層級審計是兩個含雜訊估計值的差值，極易被測量假象誤導。本文以 Qwen3-8B 執行三輪 rank-32 LoRA 自我訓練（STaR、多數決 SFT、政策梯度），讓凍結的未訓練對照模型走過完全相同的評估管線，並以蒸餾自 gpt-oss-120b 的外部教師作為正向對照，在 MATH-500、AIME 與 1,163 題難度帶上審計。作者識別出七種測量失敗模式：單次貪婪解碼會為未訓練模型製造破壞與學習比 1.5 的假象（主因為推論批次處理的非決定性）；現行擴展統計量給同一模型 0.280 的擴展率；以兩次成功為門檻的自然修正也不成立，實測虛無值為 0.058 而非零。作者改以對合併基線的逐題精確檢定並控制錯誤發現率，在所有保留的獨立重複上皆未偵測到任何事件。在資料流、樣本數與評估皆匹配的比較中，外部蒸餾能改善基礎模型鮮少觸及的 22 題中的 8–11 題，三種自我訓練僅 0–2 題，且邏輯斯迴歸否定此不對稱僅源自教師整體提升較大（p<10⁻⁸）；但對基礎模型從未觸及的題目證據未達顯著，而自我訓練破壞已解題目的數量遠超實測底線（88–106 對 8）。限制包括僅三輪訓練、擴展結論依賴單一基準、以及所有主張僅由單一族系骨幹模型支撐。本文核心訊息：轉變層級審計須為每個統計量實測虛無基準，而多臂研究其實已免費擁有這些重複評估。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM-agent benchmark squarely on-preference: tool-use agents (26-tool interface), long-horizon evaluation, agent memory curation, and model comparison across 15 frontier LLMs. Novelty rests on combining a ~340-400-stop horizon with a counter-adaptive, competing-agent Arena on one deterministic engine with mechanism-based (not LLM-judged) scoring; the behavioral decomposition into six measurable capabilities is a genuine contribution beyond outcome leaderboards. primary_link.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents

recommendations.summary: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contra
recommendations.summary_zh: FM-Bench 探討的問題是：語言模型代理能否在漫長時間尺度上、面對會反應其行為的競爭對手時，持續做出有效的管理決策，而非僅完成有界任務。方法是讓 LLM 代理經營一支足球俱樂部 20 個遊戲年，透過 26 個工具與約 340 至 400 個決策停點進行選秀、球員交易、合約談判、設施與青訓投資、陣容安排，並接受可解僱它的董事會監督；評分由確定性引擎逐季累計，全程不含 LLM 評審或人為評分。評測包含兩種軌道：單人軌道讓 15 個前沿模型對抗凍結的腳本世界；競技場模式則將 15 個模型與腳本錨點置於同一共享世界，屬首次此規模的正面對決。結果顯示所有模型皆能完成全程，而盲測腳本錨點在多數執行中提早出局；claude-fable-5 在兩軌道奪冠，達到特權 oracle 約 95% 的水準；競技場中聯賽冠軍在十個模型間輪替，且規模、價格與供應商皆無法預測排名。行為分解指出終局意識、現金運用與提前續約最關聯分數，token 花費則無關；模型也學不會隱藏的市場價格，筆記記憶呈現只增不刪或整段改寫兩種相反失敗。限制為種子數有限、競技場僅單一世界、行為指標屬相關性而非因果證據。此研究證明基準能有效區分模型的管理能力且尚未飽和，並為人機協作與行為級評測指出未來方向。

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: three-coupling discrete update is best in every column of Table 1, 75–86 one-step balanced accuracy across four models and both question types, versus Persistence (50.0), Interaction-Free (~45–61), and Mean-Field (~53–74).

Section 5.1 (Generalization): in-distribution vs out-of-distribution columns differ by at most 2.4 points; Table 2 reports 85.0–97.8 one-step balanced accuracy on unseen low-rank, square, and triangular graph families for GPT-4o-mini.

Section 5.4 / Table 3: fitted couplings show beta+ > beta- in all four models (effective concordant 0.99–3.03 vs discordant never exceeding 0.73), and five-coupling fit shows truth-seeking asymmetry (beta_T+ > beta_F+ on concordant channel).
Section 5.3 / Figure 7: fitted operating point T=1 lies below the chi-peak critical temperature in every dataset–model cell, supporting the conviction-buildup claim.
Section 7 (Limitations): authors acknowledge binary opinion states, fixed symmetric communication graphs, Markovian inbox-only updates, and that the method discards natural-language message content.

Front matter and Appendix B.5: code at github.com/batu-el/physics-of-agents, dataset at huggingface.co/physics-of-agents, full prompts in Figures S4–S5, fitting details (Adam, lr 0.05, L2=1e-3) in Appendix D.3, and the public release includes complete logs with every sampled message.

Section 3.3 / Appendix C.1: rightward political drift on subjective questions for three of four models (e.g., Gemma-3n-E4B 75% to 96% right-leaning share; Llama-3.1-8B near-symmetric), with statement set label-balanced to cancel answer-label bias.

Section 5.2 / Figure 6: stochastic rollouts reproduce group archetype shares with ~3–5 points mean absolute deviation, while the paper candidly notes the model inflates individual oscillator counts and that episodes frequently disagree on group archetype (Appendix E.4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core multi-agent LLM research: ~10,000 simulated communities of language-model agents (GPT-4o-mini, Gemma-3n-E4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) on signed communication graphs, with an Ising/Glauber statistical-mechanics model fitted to opinion transitions. Strong preference fit (multi-agent systems, LLMs, alignment-adjacent bias amplification). Methodologically sound: well-motivated balanced-accuracy metric, parameter-matched baselines (Persistence, Interaction-Free, Mean-Field), discrete/continuous and 1/3/5-coupling ablations, held-out questions and unseen graph families, critical-temperature sweep, and honestly reported limitations (binary opinions, fixed symmetric graphs, discarded message content) and archetype-predictability ceiling. Main deductions: novelty is incremental over classic Ising opinion dynamics and existing LLM social-simulation work; baselines exclude learned neural predictors; evidence is internal to the authors' own simulated binary-opinion setting, so external generalizability beyond N=32, single binary questions, and persona-conditioned agents is untested.

primary_link.title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents

recommendations.summary: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange message
recommendations.summary_zh: AI 代理人日益以群體形式互動，訊息交換既可能提升集體推理，也可能引發羊群效應、極化或放大共同偏誤，預測這些集體動態是多代理系統設計與對齊的關鍵。作者模擬超過一萬個語言模型代理人社群，讓人設與專長各異的代理人透過含友好與敵對連結的帶號通訊網路反覆交換訊息並修正意見，題材涵蓋有標準答案的 MATH 數學題與無唯一答案的政治主張，並在 GPT-4o-mini、Gemma-3n-E4B-it、Qwen3.5-9B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 四種模型上驗證。方法上，意見更新被映射至 Ising 模型與 Glauber 動力學：代理人受內在場（人設傾向）與鄰居社會壓力驅動，並擴充為區分無號、和諧、不和諧連結的三耦合隨機更新規則。實證上，個體軌跡呈四種原型，群體歸納出冷漠、極化、共識三種狀態，互動持續推升信念強度；客觀題溝通平均提升集體準確率，主觀政治題卻系統性向右傾漂移。擬合模型僅憑初始意見即可預測個體軌跡，一步預測平衡準確率達 75–86%，優於所有基線、泛化到未見的網路家族，並重現群體原型分布。擬合參數揭示三項機制：社群運作於臨界社會溫度以下（解釋信念累積）；和諧連結強於不和諧連結（促成共識）；持正確答案的鄰居拉力最強（驅動求真）。限制在於每次僅處理單一二元問題、通訊結構固定且對稱、更新為馬可夫式並捨棄訊息內容。整體而言，本研究證明 AI 代理人的集體行為遵循緊湊可預測的動力學定律，有助於預期失敗模式並最佳化多代理系統設計。

Sec. 6.2, Table 3: NPO+Stage 2 reduces agent-deployment All from 68.6→47.5 (Δ −21.1) while retaining Neighbor 55.8, Factuality 37.5, Fluency 669.2 on RWKU with Qwen-3-4B.
Appendix D.4, Table 9: isolates framework effect (Δfw +1.2) from tool effect (Δtool +22.8) for Stage-1 NPO; after Stage 2 tool-induced recovery shrinks to +2.4.
Appendix D.6, Tables 11-12: Refusal SFT −8.7 and Trajectory DPO −10.5 vs ATU −21.1 on All; ATU costs 1.97h vs 1.10h (SFT) and 1.35h (DPO), with lower Neighbor utility than simpler baselines.

Appendix D.9, Table 15: human-validated judge comparison; Qwen2.5-7B judge reaches 83.3% sign agreement and 63.9% exact match, 4B/8B judges only 58.3%/61.1%, with downstream Forget All varying 47.5-60.0.
Appendix D.7, Table 13: forced-retrieval directives raise Stage-1 NPO All to 89.9 (+21.3); ATU limits uplift to +12.1 but exact-copy condition degrades to 57.7 (+10.2), showing incomplete robustness.
Table 4: cross-model MUSE results — Qwen-3-4B knowmem_f 29.8→15.8 (knowmem_r 56.7→55.1); Qwen-2.5-7B knowmem_f 32.9→22.4 (knowmem_r 44.1→40.5).
Appendix D.10, Table 16: 128-step GRPO audit (mean reward −0.44, mean KL ≈0.50, no ultra-short max-reward loophole), though the paper concedes LLM-judged reward dependence remains a limitation.

Limitations section: 'Incomplete closure of the agentic recovery gap' and 'Limited coverage of downstream tool environments' — Stage 2 does not fully restore standalone Stage-1 forgetting levels and training uses a finite simulated tool set.
Appendix C.4: implementation details provided (LLaMA-Factory LoRA Stage 1, OpenRLHF GRPO with vLLM rollouts, 4×RTX 4090 hardware); abstract footnote claims code availability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely matching top-weight preferences: tool-augmented LLM agents, unlearning/safety, GRPO/preference-optimization training, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and retrieval tooling. The identified failure mode (tool-mediated recovery of parametrically unlearned knowledge, e.g., NPO forget score rising 44.6→68.6 on RWKU under agent deployment) is a genuine and quantitatively demonstrated problem; the two-stage ATU fix (parametric unlearning + trajectory-level GRPO with judged rewards) is a sensible combination of existing components (NPO/DPO, GRPO, LLM judges, Qwen-Agent) rather than a fundamentally new technique. Rigor is above average: agent-framework-vs-tool decomposition (Appendix D.4), non-RL SFT/DPO baselines with cost accounting (D.6), tool-swap and held-out-query/tool generalization, adversarial forced-retrieval directives, human validation of the reward judge (83.3% sign agreement for the 7B judge, but only 58.3%/61.1% for 4B/8B), and a reward-hacking audit; limitations are candidly stated (residual gap not closed to standalone level; exact-copy directives remain vulnerable). Weaknesses: single-seed runs without variance, noisy LLM-judge rewards, ROUGE-L-based leakage metrics, Qwen-only backbones, a single-framework (Qwen-Agent) simulated environment, per-target RL training cost, and a very small held-out-query study (one target, 19 test queries). Code availability is claimed with detailed hyperparameters and judge prompts aiding reproduction, though web-tool dependence introduces nondeterminism.

primary_link.title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents

This creates an evaluation mismatch for LLM unlearning: previous unlearning methods may suppress direct parametric recall, but an agent can still recover the same forget target through tools such as web search, retrieval, or database lookup. We identify this failure mode as tool-mediated recovery and study agentic
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出 LLM 機器遺忘（machine unlearning）的一大評估盲點：現有方法多半在單機推論下驗證模型是否已忘記目標知識，但一旦模型被部署為可呼叫工具的代理（agent），仍可透過網路搜尋、資料庫查詢或文件檢索等外部工具「復原」被遺忘的內容，作者稱此現象為 tool-mediated recovery。為此，論文提出兩階段框架 ATU：第一階段在參數層面執行知識遺忘（如 GA、RT、DPO、NPO），抑制直接回憶；第二階段在模擬的工具增強環境中，以軌跡層級的強化學習（GRPO）訓練模型，對遺忘查詢懲罰「找答案式」的工具呼叫與最終答案洩漏，同時以保留查詢與通用工具任務維持正常回應品質與良性工具使用能力。在 RWKU 與 MUSE（Books）基準、多個 Qwen 骨幹模型上的實驗顯示：以 NPO 為例，遺忘集分數在代理部署下從 44.6 回升至 68.6，加入第二階段後降至 47.5（下降 21.1 分）；MUSE 的 knowmem_f 也從 29.8 降到 15.8，且保留端效用與工具使用率大致維持。限制方面：遺忘分數未完全回到單機水準、訓練工具環境覆蓋有限、面對強制檢索等自適應指令攻擊仍會部分洩漏，且依賴 LLM 評審給予獎勵，可能存在 reward hacking 風險。此研究提醒：機器遺忘的評估必須納入代理式部署情境，未來基準應加入工具介導復原指標，使隱私與版權保護在真實部署下依然有效。
recommendations.title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents
recommendations.title_zh: 權重中遺忘、工具中復原：LLM 代理的代理式工具遺忘（Agentic Tool Unlearning）

evidence: Abstract: 'The Kan-default rate is zero in all 248 constrained trials' with failures attributed to reasoning-budget exhaustion or constraint errors, never default reversion
Section 7 (Insight 2): 'With zero events in 248 trials, the 95% upper bound on the Kan-default rate is 1.2%' and jump accuracy 41/44 greedy vs 185/204 at temperature 0.7
Section 7 (Setup): four frontier models on nine certified instances; 'Per-cell accuracies thus rest on six or ten samples' and conclusions rest on pooled counts

Section 7 (Exact-search reference): 'Exact search therefore solves the benchmark by construction. The measured quantity is thus not whether the answer can be reached but whether the model overrides its own default in context'

Appendix F (Aggregates): calibration Kan default in 129/132 non-truncated cases; controls 69/72; 22 jump failures split as 15 truncations, 3 empty, 3 rule violations, 1 valid-but-inadmissible; grader agrees with certified membership on all 138,691 enumerated extensions

Section 8 (Limitations): certifiable and diagnostic regimes may not intersect; scaling certification past brute force is 'the open engineering problem'; calibration validity (C0) could fail for other learners
Section 8 (What is bracketed): 'We formalize four steps of the jump and measure only the second'; constraints are given rather than generated and Tier 2 hosts 'the jump proper'

Abstract/Contributions: code, generator, certifier, and evaluation harness released at https://github.com/EEthanShi/kan-jump-test; Appendix C preregistered integrity checklist including solver, matcher, memorization, format, and budget controls
llm_evaluation.rationale: A formal, LLM-centric capability study: it operationalizes the contested 'jump/abduction' debate for large language models into a measurable Kan-default rate, with certified instances, matched controls, and per-model calibration of the unconstrained default (Section 4.5). Core match to LLM and reasoning/evaluation preferences. Novelty is high: category-theoretic Kan extensions are repurposed from a learning characterization into a certified null hypothesis/foil, which prior categorical and abduction benchmarks do not do (Section 2). Rigor is strong: well-posedness proofs, a family theorem avoiding enumeration, gauge-invariant scoring, preregistered integrity checklist, and explicit assumptions A1-A6; however, all empirical conclusions rest on a single instance family (pointed chains) and small per-cell samples (six or ten samples, Section 7 Setup), and the exact-search reference concedes the benchmark is solvable by search by construction, so the measurement targets only default-override, not difficulty (Section 7, 'Exact-search reference'). Evidence for the scoped claim is solid: zero Kan-default events in 248 trials with a 1.2% upper bound, calibration DC=129/132, controls 69/72, grader validated on 138,691 enumerated extensions, and failure decomposition into truncation/empty/rule violations (Section 7 Insights 1-3; Appendix F Aggregates). Generalizability is moderate: Tier-1 only, fixed FinSet codomain, constraints handed rather than generated, and one task family; the authors scope this honestly (Section 8). Reproducibility is good: released generator, certifier, harness, rendered prompts, replayable pipeline, sub-$15 cost, though evaluation depends on transient API model tiers (Appendix F).

primary_link.title: When the Canonical Completion Is Wrong: Formalizing and Measuring the Jump in Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) can perform the abductive leap from evidence to a new system of axioms, commonly referred to as a jump, has recently attracted considerable debate. A prominent position holds that LLMs are structurally incapable of such jumps, while recent studies challenge both its mechanism and its evidence. However, the debate remains difficult to settle, since the field still lacks a formal definition of the jump and a measure to test either side. In this paper, we develo
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型能否像愛因斯坦從牛頓重力躍至廣義相對論那樣，從證據「跳躍」到新的公理體系？近期辯論一面倒地持否定立場，但爭議始終缺乏形式化定義與可測量指標。本文將跳躍拆解為四個步驟：預設補全為何、何時被迫放棄預設（override）、放棄何時正確、連續跳躍如何疊加，並實測第二步。作者以範疇論定義「跳躍實例」：一個有限擴張問題，附機器可驗證的證書，保證正確補全存在、在重新命名下唯一，且異於資料透過左右 Kan extension 求得的典範補全——後者亦即模型在無約束時的預設輸出。文中證明實例適定（well-posed），並以家庭定理無需枚舉即認證無限多個難度可增的實例。實驗以九個認證實例測試四個前沿模型（GPT-5.6 Luna Pro、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Pro），衡量 Kan-default rate（模型固守已被約束排除之預設的頻率）：在全部 248 次約束試驗中皆為零，226 次落在認證正確答案，其餘失敗源於推理預算耗盡或約束錯誤，而非回歸預設；隨機命中機率低至 8×10⁻⁷。作者據此主張：在選擇步驟上模型確實會跳躍；若「LLM 不能跳躍」屬實，瓶頸應在生成約束或發明全新框架。限制包括：僅測量第二步、Tier 2（自創 codomain 與約束生成）尚待研究、以及認證難度與診斷難度難以兼得。本研究把哲學爭論轉為可證偽的量化測試，具重要方法論價值。
