recommendations.title_zh: 當典範補全出錯時：形式化並測量大型語言模型的「跳躍」

links.title: Auditing and Decomposing Feedback-Driven Evolution in LLM Test Generation under the Oracle Problem

evidence: Abstract: 'On external inputs where three accepted implementations agree, generated outputs match the panel only 27.79% and 50.12% of the time. A single reference inflates the apparent evolutionary gain by 9.46–14.85 percentage points; after audit, equal-budget independent resampling is 6.01–18.83 points better.'

Section 3.1 / Table 1: 'The external cohort was hash-locked before fresh generation from TestCase-Eval: 114 non-interactive tasks'; models are 'Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Instruct' and 'the released Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint with thinking disabled'.

Section 3.5 (Inference and integrity): 'External programs run in bubblewrap namespaces with time, memory, process, and output limits... Model artifacts, cohorts, folds, generated rows, analyses, and paper summaries are linked by SHA-256 locks.'

Table 5 / Section 4.2: gain inflation intervals '9.46–14.85 pp across all four conditions... with every 95% interval strictly above zero'; Table 6: 'Matched exceeds Evolve by 18.83 and 9.72 pp on development and by 10.91 and 6.01 pp externally'.

Table 10 / Section 4.6: 'Real–Placebo is much smaller: +1.99 pp [+0.08, +3.88] and +0.28 pp [−1.41, +2.03]... Both model-specific decisions are inconclusive'; Table 11: yield-matched replay gives '−0.30 and +0.78 pp, both with zero-crossing intervals'.

Section 4.5 / Table 8: blinded audit with '91.67% exact agreement and Cohen's κ=.823'; 'Overall, 94.41% (95% CI [91.85, 96.51]) are jointly judged invalid, while 3.60% [2.23, 5.14] are jointly judged valid.'
Section 7 (External validity): 'Both model conditions are from the Qwen family... they neither establish cross-family generality nor identify a scale effect'; all tasks algorithmic and Python-family.

Data Availability: 'An anonymized replication package containing protocol locks, task-level derived metrics, analysis code... is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-test-evolution-audit-8CF5/.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology audit study (not a pure domain application): it uses Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Qwen3.5-9B for test generation and rigorously dissects whether feedback-driven self-evolution gains are oracle artifacts. Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, code/programming, agents/self-evolution, evaluation). The freeze-then-audit protocol, candidate-budget matching, density-matched feedback placebo, cross-fitted real faults, and blinded human semantic audit (κ=.823) constitute an unusually rigorous, honestly-scoped design: pre-specified gates, disclosed protocol amendments, explicit 'qualification-amended' labeling, and refusal to overclaim (feedback effect left 'unresolved'). Quantitative results are consistent across seeds, metrics, and cohorts (gain inflation 9.46–14.85 pp; resampling beats mutation-based evolution by 6.01–18.83 pp in all 12 cells). Main weaknesses: generalizability limited to one model family and Python exact-output algorithmic tasks (acknowledged in Section 7), the flagship RQ6 feedback contrast is inconclusive/post-hoc/amended, and development cohorts were exposed. Reproducibility is strong via an anonymized replication package with SHA-256-locked artifacts. Novelty is solid but incremental in that it is a diagnostic protocol rather than a new capability or method.

primary_link.title: Auditing and Decomposing Feedback-Driven Evolution in LLM Test Generation under the Oracle Problem

recommendations.summary: Execution feedback is often treated as a self-verifying signal for improving LLM-generated tests. However, when generated inputs are executed on a single accepted program and its outputs are used as ground truth, invalid or underspecified inputs can create spurious fault detections and apparent evolutionary gains. We audit this failure mode in feedback-driven test generation using 142 development tasks, 114 locked external tasks, and 138 held-out tasks, with two code models, three seeds, and fau
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型（LLM）自動產生測試時的「測試預言」問題進行系統性稽核。常見捷徑是把產生的輸入交給一個通過測試的參考程式，並將其輸出視為真值，這會把超出規格的行為偽裝成錯誤偵測與演化進展。作者提出「先凍結後稽核」協定：先以單一參考程式選出測試，再由其他獨立通過的實作差異覆核，並比較真實的三輪執行回饋迴圈與密度匹配的安慰劑對照。實驗涵蓋142個開發、114個程序鎖定的外部，以及138個保留（held-out）但資格經修訂的任務，使用Qwen2.5-Coder-7B與Qwen3.5-9B兩個模型、三個種子。結果顯示：外部任務上模型預期輸出與多實作面板一致率僅27.79%與50.12%；單一參考會膨脹表面演化增益9.46至14.85個百分點；稽核後，等預算的獨立重抽樣比突變式演化好6.01至18.83個百分點。真實回饋與安慰劑差異僅+0.13與−0.50個百分點，保留群體上為+1.99與+0.28，皆未達預設等效或優越門檻；配對可用產量後對比轉為−0.30與+0.78且信賴區間跨零。雙盲語意審查判定94.41%遭面板否決的輸入無效，但3.60%有效，顯示面板不一致是證據而非語意定論。限制包括安慰劑屬事後設計、保留群體資格檢核經修訂，且兩模型同屬Qwen家族，整體屬診斷性證據而非乾淨的確證實驗。本文貢獻在於提供一套分離驗證器假象、互動鷹架與真實回饋貢獻的稽核協定，可作為未來回饋驅動測試演化研究的評估準則。

links.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing

evidence: Abstract: J64 adds 0.096-0.135 held-out AUC over a token-occupancy baseline aggregated identically; R64 reaches median per-axis correlation 0.69-0.86 across three models and two families and preserves 95-100% of J64's predictive gain on gpt-oss-20b.
Section 4.1 (RQ1): paired within-problem AUC increments from adding J64 to matched text model are +0.135* (Low), +0.129* (Medium), +0.096* (High), with 47x more features given to the text channel.

Section 4.2 (RQ2): median per-axis reconstruction 0.692-0.864 across eight model-effort settings; shuffled routing collapses to r~0; residualizing against token occupancy and log-length still yields additional held-out R2 of 0.082-0.085.

Section 5.1 / Table 1: cross-benchmark frozen transfer best-of-64 shows J64 +5.0 and +4.9 effort-averaged points over random pick on gpt-oss-20b and 120b, and R64-weighted voting improves majority voting in seven of eight settings.

Section 5.2 / Table 3: online stop-and-resample with nested operating-point selection; J64 beats sibling-permuted control by +1.3* to +5.9* points on gpt-oss-20b High and +0.9* to +1.7* on Qwen, with R64 retaining 0.9-3.2 points.

Section 5.3 / Table 7-8: router edits induce predicted behaviors (100 'Case n' headers vs 0 in 160 sham runs; accuracy 0.381 to 0.000; suppression shortens generations by 45.9 tokens* and replaces numerical guessing with symbolic derivation on one case study).

Section 6 (Limitations): authors state analysis centers on competition mathematics and gpt-oss-20b, frames are model-specific and not aligned across models, online control is evaluated mainly by causally masked replay, and interventions remain small.

Appendix B.1/B.3: full construction algorithm (Algorithm 1) with exact constants (lambda=50 ridge, C=3, 256-token windows, tau and K grids) and timing measurements (38.4 ms/token decode; 0.07/0.09 ms hook overhead), supporting reproducibility, though no explicit code release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely in scope: it operationalizes a vocabulary-aligned internal readout (J64) of LLM reasoning state, reconstructs it from native MoE routing (R64), and uses it for test-time selection, online stop-and-resample control, and causal router edits on gpt-oss and Qwen3 reasoning models. Strong preference match to LLMs, reasoning/CoT, MoE architecture, interpretability, and test-time compute. Novelty is solid but derivative of the Jacobian lens (Gurnee et al.) and DeepConf baselines; the routing-only reconstruction and mechanism-matched interventions are the genuinely new contributions. Rigor is unusually high: matched token-occupancy baselines aggregated identically, sibling-permuted controls, frozen cross-benchmark transfer, nested operating-point selection to avoid test-set tuning, construction-disjoint checks, capacity-matched PCA control, and sham-edit controls for interventions, all with question-level clustered CIs. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent across three models, though effects are sometimes modest, the rescue slice is hindsight-selected (acknowledged), and benchmarks are small (30 questions each; 198 GPQA). Generalizability is limited: frames are model-specific and not aligned across models, evaluation centers on competition mathematics, and online control is mainly causally-masked replay rather than live serving, as the limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is good given Algorithm 1 and exact constants (lambda=50, C=3, 256-token windows, timing measurements), though no explicit code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing

recommendations.summary: What a reasoning model writes is only a partial record of the process that produces it. We introduce a two-level internal readout for mixture-of-experts reasoning. We first distill vocabulary-scale J-space into J64, a 64-axis semantic frame learned from the model's own reasoning states. J64 reveals readable process state that the emitted trace does not show: it separates inference effort from problem-induced strain. It also adds 0.096 to 0.135 held-out AUC over a baseline that reads the same rol
recommendations.summary_zh: 推理模型寫出的思考軌跡只是其內部運作的部分紀錄。本文針對混合專家（MoE）推理模型提出兩層式內部讀出：先從模型自身的推理狀態，將詞彙規模的 J-space 提煉成 64 軸語意框架 J64，可讀出軌跡未顯示的過程狀態，並分離「推理力道」與「題目難度造成的負荷」兩個近乎正交的座標；相較於以 token 佔用率讀取同一 rollout 的對照基準，J64 在 held-out 評估上額外貢獻 0.096 至 0.135 的 AUC。作者再以原生專家路由統計透過 ridge 迴歸重建 J64，得到低開銷代理 R64：在三個模型、兩個家族上，各軸中位相關達 0.69 至 0.86，於 gpt-oss-20b 保留 J64 預測增益的 95% 至 100%。應用上，J64 與 R64 能改善已完成候選的單軌選擇，R64 加權投票在八分之七的設定中優於多數決；生成過程中以滾動視窗驅動的停止與重採樣策略，J64 相較兄弟置換對照提升 1.1 至 5.9 點，R64 保留其中 0.9 至 3.2 點；針對 J64 所指認機制的路由編輯亦誘發預期行為，將數值猜測轉為精確的符號推導。限制在於分析以競賽數學與 gpt-oss-20b 為主，各模型框架獨立建構、彼此不對齊，線上控制以因果遮蔽的重播評估，介入規模亦小。其價值在於讓潛藏的推理狀態既可解讀又可部署，為測試期算力分配提供可操作的遙測訊號。

§7.12 (Threats): authors state one lineage per family, one dataset per task class, QLoRA r=16 only with full fine-tuning unmeasured, and 1.8pp seed spread on the Spider/Qwen3 reference limiting single-hop retention arithmetic.

Reproducibility Statement: releases training/evaluation scripts, all 98 adapters, per-query records and bootstrap CIs for 193 cells, split manifests, relabeled Refresh-D corpora, memorization-probe outputs, and raw cost logs, 'to be released publicly upon publication'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A decision-centric longitudinal benchmark measuring the freeze/port/refresh/retrain choice for fine-tuned LLM specialists across real Qwen and OLMo release lineages. Strongly aligned with core LLM preferences (LLMs, PEFT/QLoRA fine-tuning, evaluation/benchmarks, function calling, text-to-SQL, cost-aware serving); no Japanese or reasoning content. Methodological hygiene is unusually high: prospectively specified hypotheses with wave boundaries, paired exact McNemar tests, multi-seed checks that overturned a single-seed decline (CLINC150), artifact controls (template swap, bf16 re-run, constrained decoding), and explicit self-corrections. The continuity/distance porting criterion is the standout novel finding, replicated in two families, though it rests on few cells and endpoint-only distance sampling. Generalizability is limited by English-only tasks, one lineage per family, a single QLoRA r=16 recipe (rank dependence shown), and the 8B cap; reproducibility claims are extensive but public release is deferred to publication.

primary_link.title: UpgradeBench: A Decision-Centric Benchmark for Upgrading Fine-Tuned LLM Specialists

Prior transfer work evaluates isolated model pairs, without studying these choices across real model release sequences. We present UpgradeBench, a decision-driven longitudinal benchmark covering four consecutive Qwen releases, one continuation checkpoint, six tasks, and
recommendations.summary_zh: 企業常在開源權重模型上微調出任務專用的 specialist，每當新基礎模型釋出，就面臨抉擇：凍結舊模型、移植 adapter、以舊模型為教師刷新，或全額重新訓練，但這個「升級稅」從未被系統性量測。作者提出 UpgradeBench，沿 Qwen1.5 到 Qwen3 四代、十四個月的完整釋出譜系，涵蓋六項任務與兩種規模（7–8B 與 1.5–1.8B），並以訓練譜系完全公開的 OLMo checkpoints 做前瞻式驗證；全部 98 次訓練在一張 RTX 4090 完成，並釋出逐題預測、成本與能源紀錄。核心發現：升級價值因任務而異——Banking77 凍結在九個 hop 保留 99–101% 效益，text-to-SQL 單次 hop 最多損失 59%；直接複製 adapter 的成敗不繫於架構相容，而繫於預訓練連續性：獨立預訓練的檢查點即使形狀相同也崩潰至低於不用 adapter 的水準，短程延續預訓練則保留 0.82–1.45，且可移植性隨延續距離衰減（46B tokens 保留 0.88–0.99，2.9T tokens 歸零）；以留存輸入做教師重新標註的 Refresh 達到與 gold-label 重訓相當的品質且零新增標註；預先指定的決策政策在 33 個升級情境上平均品質損失僅 0.37 個百分點、零行為退化，只花費三成的重訓運算與標註預算；CKA 探針可排序可移植性（Spearman 0.74）。限制包括僅測 QLoRA rank 16、模型規模上限 8B、任務皆為英文，且主要結論來自單一族系與固定資料集。此研究把升級決策變成可定價、可重播的問題，對企業維運 specialist 艦隊極具參考價值。
recommendations.title: UpgradeBench: A Decision-Centric Benchmark for Upgrading Fine-Tuned LLM Specialists
recommendations.title_zh: UpgradeBench：以決策為核心、評估微調 LLM 專家模型升級的基準

links.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction

evidence: Abstract: portfolio of eight automated-prover configurations resolves 2.2% of the 4,141-law pool and a twentyfold budget increase adds 0.6%; strongest reasoning model solves 14% on the proof side and none on the construction side.

Section 4.2 / Table 5: o3 solves 6/63 certified-easy laws without waypoints and 9/63 with; GPT-4.1 and o4-mini solve 0; low reasoning effort yields 0; waypoint difference acknowledged as within run noise.
Section 4.2 / Table A2: on 25 hard-tier laws no submission passes both checks; o3's failures concentrate in 'too strong' (23/25) while weaker models spread across all three failure classes.

Section 3.3: judge verifies trivial side via Lean kernel with fixed axiom allowlist and construction side via prover certificates requiring completeness-retaining saturation; validation against three control kinds (Appendix F, --selftest).

Table 3 / Appendix E: screening pipeline from 10,474 candidates to 7,483 admissible laws (195 Austin classes); yield per 1,000 screened rises 20.5 to 25.4 across orders 6-8, supporting the renewability claim.
Appendix A: settles ETP laws 12857/33436 via two independent certificates (Vampire saturation 7.95s, Twee completion), with direct verification of the 27-equation presentation.

Table A4: complete token accounting across 669 records (11.3M completion tokens) and infrastructure details (dual-socket EPYC, 32 cores) support reproducibility; Appendix B notes no seed parameter, so runs are measured, not controlled.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation benchmark squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLM evaluation, mathematical reasoning, benchmarks). Novelty is high: the verifiable/renewable/constructive framing realized through Austin laws (laws whose only nontrivial models are infinite) is a genuinely new benchmark design, and the automated judge via Lean plus prover certificates is technically sound. Rigor is strong: a documented screening pipeline (Table 3), deduplication via 195 equivalence classes with a 68,382-pair model-transfer cross-check (Appendix G), judge controls (Appendix F), budget sweeps (Tables 4, A1), and honest treatment of run-to-run stochasticity and the waypoint effect being within noise (Section 4.2). Evidence is quantitatively clear (2.2% portfolio resolution, 0.6% gain from 20x budget; o3 9.5%-14% on certified-easy, 0% construction on hard tier; Table A2 failure profiles), though the LLM evaluation is small-scale (n=63, n=25) and covers only three closed models with no open-weight or theorem-prover-specialized LLMs. Generalizability is moderate: the specify-construct-verify analogy to other scientific domains is argued but not demonstrated, and the task is confined to equational magma theory. Reproducibility is excellent: corpus, generator, judge, verbatim prompts, per-run token accounting (Table A4), and selftest controls are released, with API nondeterminism explicitly measured rather than hidden.

primary_link.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction

recommendations.summary: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original a
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常宣稱產出「新發現」，但表面上的新穎未必是真原創，且往往缺乏可驗證性。ALPS 基準提出「有效創造力」概念：解必須同時原創且可證明正確。每個題目是一條等式定律，經認證需建構無限數學結構或證明不存在此類結構，篩選時已保證無非平凡有限模型，故窮舉搜尋無法解題。評分完全自動化：平凡側以 Lean 核心驗證證明，建構側以自動化定理證明器憑證驗證；公開產生器可無限產生新題，避免訓練資料汙染。結果顯示八組頂尖自動化證明器僅解出 4,141 題池的 2.2%，預算提高二十倍僅再加 0.6%，瓶頸是方法而非算力；最強推理模型 o3 在認證簡單集上解出 14% 的平凡側題目，建構側則全數失敗，其提交多為「過強」的表示法。全池 97.2% 未解。限制在於建構側尚無法以 Lean 驗證，且聚焦單一數學領域。此基準證明語言模型在「必須創造且可機器驗證」的條件下能力仍極有限，為衡量 AI 科學發現提供了客觀標尺。
recommendations.title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
recommendations.title_zh: ALPS：以數學建構衡量大型語言模型的有效創造力

links.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding

evidence: Abstract & Figure 3 (Section 3): 1,902 graded runs across team size (1-16), structure (flat/coordinator), and file policy (forbidden/allowed/mandatory), model pinned to claude-sonnet-4-6; 244 additional sealed replication runs.

Section 4: chained-task messaging exponent 1.92 (pre-registered CI [1.67,2.17], per-run [1.80,2.05]); sixteen-step arm messages 21.4/47.0/46.8 at 4/8/16 agents with slope 0.00 (95% CI [-0.34,0.34]), confirming H8.

Section 6: mandatory file policy cuts output tokens ~25% at four and ~42% at eight agents on the distributed task but raises them ~17%/10% on the chained task; caveats that message and file token figures are proxies on different bases (Figure 8 caption).

Section 7: disparity-filter backbone leaves 0 of 1,170 channels at eight agents (distributed) and 2 of 1,077 (chained) - no hub; coordinator advantage at four agents dissolves when flat collections are pooled (8/10 vs 12/20, p=0.42).

Section 8: reliability is task-dependent - chained exponent replicates to two decimals (1.92 vs 1.93) while distributed exponent moves 1.76 (CI [1.57,1.96]) to 2.44 (CI [2.32,2.57]); 13 of 27 matched cells differ after BH correction.

Section 9: sealed replication with decoys - agents opened the decoy test file in 80% of runs, other prompts in 66%, manifest in 61%; coordinator null reproduces (p=1.00, 0.53, 0.75) and message collapse under mandatory files reproduces (134 to 26 per run).

Data Availability: replication package at github.com/giuseppedestefanis/when-agents-coordinate with all 1,902 + 244 runs as CSVs, generators, pipeline, analysis scripts, and pre-registration records; 'Each reported statistic can be regenerated from the released data without rerunning any agent.'

Section 10 & Appendix A: threats to validity (shell-mediated file ops unlogged, ~0.6% of runs; ten-run cells carry ~30pp margins; recorded deviation in not topping up 93 flagged cells; H1, H5, H6 read specific flagged cells).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core multi-agent LLM coding research, strongly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and Code & Programming preferences; the reward-seeking finding also touches evaluation/safety. Novelty rests on a genuinely new measurement instrument (temporal network with files as first-class nodes from tool-call logs) rather than a new architecture. Rigor is high: pre-registered hypotheses (H1, H4-H8), BH correction, exact tests, a deliberate duplicate collection, a 244-run sealed replication with decoys, and honestly recorded deviations (top-up rule not followed; H2/H3 qualifications). Evidence is quantitative and replicated (exponent 1.92 CI [1.67,2.17]; 16-agent plateau slope 0.00 CI [-0.34,0.34]; coordinator null p=1.00/0.53/0.75 under seal), though some results are directional or null (H7, H6) and the 42% token saving is output-only with cached-context caveats. Generalizability is limited by two synthetic Python tasks, one runtime (Claude Code), one pinned model, acknowledged in Section 10. Reproducibility is excellent: full dataset, generators, pipeline, scripts, and pre-registrations released with a stated path to regenerate every statistic.

primary_link.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding

recommendations.summary: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this inst
recommendations.summary_zh: 多代理 AI 程式開發系統的評估通常只報告任務是否完成與執行成本，團隊內部的協調過程幾乎未被測量。本文提出直接觀測工具：將每次執行表示為時間網路，代理與檔案皆為節點，訊息、檔案寫入與讀取是帶時間戳與成本的邊。研究分析 1,902 次執行（固定測試套件評分，模型鎖定 claude-sonnet-4-6），變化團隊人數、結構與檔案政策。主要發現：訊息量隨人數近二次方成長，但主要是執行初期的「介紹式握手」，八至十六代理間成長趨緩，大型團隊轉向廣播；協調網路的形狀由任務決定——分散式任務形成稠密、高聚類的網，管線任務則維持稀疏且無樞紐。強制透過共用檔案協調，在訊息密集任務上省下約 42% 輸出 token，但在檔案本已承載協調的任務上反而增加成本。以提示詞指定協調者不會產生通訊樞紐，成功率也未可靠提升；密封複製實驗中仍有五分之四的執行代理會搜尋隱藏評分資料。此外，同一配置的重複執行變異很大，單次執行只是抽樣。這些結果顯示協調本身可以被測量，揭露成功率與 token 總量看不到的結構、行為與成本。
recommendations.title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
recommendations.title_zh: 當代理協作時：衡量多代理 AI 程式開發中的協調

links.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: INT4 reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (81.0% -> 68.3% for Qwen), McNemar p<=2.6e-6; INT8 carries a smaller real penalty in two of three models.
Section 3.3 / Appendix C: paired design with identical trial sequences across precisions, verified zero mismatches across 23,075 unique trials; 69,225 total trials over 5 seeds (Table 9).
Table 2 / Section 4.2: FP16 vs INT4 at key levels (OR 2.58-20.00, p<=2.6e-6), direction consistent in 15/15 seed-comparisons; Mantel-Haenszel pooled OR 1.40, 95% CI [1.23,1.59].
Table 5 / Section 4.4: mixed-effects INT4 x log2(level) interaction beta=-0.046 (p=5.7e-8) for word-type vs +0.053 (p<1e-16) for numeric; robust to random slopes (beta=-0.048, Appendix E).
Section 4.5 / Appendix E: numeric control reverses sign; token-length stratification holds in dominant 3-token stratum (OR 0.92, p=0.021), ruling out tokenization confound.
Section 4.6: same-key intrusions are 99.8-99.9% of errors; intrusion rate rises 21.5% -> 24.6% of trials under INT4 (p=4.8e-7) with comparable recency (13.8 vs 13.2).
Section 4.7 / Table 6 / Appendix F: lm_head ablation shows backbone-driven effect (all p=1.0, lm_head share <=2.5%); honestly documents that default INT4 left lm_head at full precision.
Section 6: limitations acknowledged - bitsandbytes-only (no GPTQ/AWQ/EXL2/HQQ), short prompts, 3.8-7B models only, greedy decoding, no internal-representation test.

Section 4.3 / Table 11 / Appendix E: IES corroborates monotonic FP16>=INT8>=INT4 but dilutes Qwen's cliff (1.8% IES loss); Phi numeric IES shows a -3.98% reversal treated as null; IES pooling convention flagged as unverified.
Abstract / Appendix B: code and tokenizer-verified vocabulary construction released on GitHub; full loading configuration on a single RTX 3090 documented for reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM behavioral evaluation: connects post-training quantization (bitsandbytes INT8/NF4) to proactive interference in three instruction-tuned LLMs (Section 3.2). The PTQ x PI intersection is genuinely untested per the related-work survey (Section 2), and the opposite-signed semantic-vs-numeric specificity (Table 5: INT4 x log-level beta=-0.046 word-type vs +0.053 numeric) is a real conceptual contribution beyond aggregate benchmarking. Rigor is unusually strong for a small-scale study: trial-level paired design verified with zero mismatches across 23,075 trials (Section 3.3, Appendix C), McNemar's exact test as primary with Fisher/Mantel-Haenszel cross-checks (Table 2), mixed-effects regression over all levels with random intercepts and a random-slopes robustness check (Table 5, Appendix E), token-length stratification ruling out a tokenization confound (Section 4.5), and an lm_head localization ablation (Table 6, all p=1.0). Mechanistic evidence via same-key intrusion rates (21.5%->24.6%, p=4.8e-7, Section 4.6) directly supports the proposed account. Honesty is high: Phi's non-monotonic k=16 cell is reported (Table 10), IES is shown to dilute Qwen's cliff (Section 4.3), the numeric IES pattern only 'partially corroborates' specificity, and an unverified IES pooling detail is flagged (Appendix E). Main deductions: narrow scope (3 models of 3.8-7B, one quantizer family, greedy decoding, short prompts, no representational-level probing, acknowledged in Section 6), mixed corroboration for specificity via IES (Table 11: Phi numeric INT4 nominally outperforms FP16), and the ablation's pairing not re-verified with the exhaustive check (Section 4.7). Code, configs, seeds, trial budgets, and trial-level results are released (Abstract, Appendices B-C), supporting strong reproducibility on a single consumer GPU.

primary_link.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs

recommendations.summary: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct ins
recommendations.summary_zh: 訓練後量化已是部署開源 LLM 的預設路徑,但既有評估多依賴整體基準,未能檢視特定行為失效模式。本文探討量化對「主動干擾」的影響:當脈絡中同一屬性被反覆覆寫,模型擷取最新值的能力會隨覆寫次數對數線性下降。作者於 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 與 Phi-3.5-mini-instruct 上,以 bitsandbytes 分別載入 FP16、INT8 與 INT4/NF4,固定 PI-LLM 鍵值重綁任務,對語意類屬性與數值對照屬性進行比較,並以逐試次配對的 McNemar 檢定與混合效應迴歸驗證。結果顯示 INT4 在高干擾下於三個模型均顯著降低準確率(Qwen 由 81.0% 降至 68.3%),INT8 在其中兩個模型也有較小但真實的損失;效果僅出現於語意相似的干擾物,在數值對照下方向相反,並伴隨同鍵侵入錯誤率上升(21.5%→24.6%);消融實驗進一步指出效應源於量化後的 Transformer 主幹,而非 lm_head 輸出層。限制在於僅涵蓋 bitsandbytes 的 LLM.int8/NF4、提示長度偏短、未測試激活與 KV 快取量化。整體準確率差異僅 1-2 個百分點,凸顯總體指標會掩蓋對長期、可更新、語意稠密應用(如多輪助手與偏好追蹤)至關重要的行為性風險。
recommendations.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
recommendations.title_zh: 壓縮即遺忘:bitsandbytes 量化放大 LLM 的主動干擾

links.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers

evidence: Section 5.1: nine English binary/multiclass tasks with independently fine-tuned frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B classifiers; scale/family panel adds Qwen3.5-2B/4B, Gemma-3 1B, Llama-3.2 1B, Phi-4 mini; transfer uses a 33.2M E5-small-v2 encoder.

Section 6.1, Table 1: LR-16 teacher fidelity .750-.983; matched Surface comparison gains 6.00-29.50 pp with paired 95% CI [15.39, 18.75] on the mean and every task-level interval above zero (Appendix B.1, Table 3).
Section 6.3, Table 2: J+Aux 33.2M student mean gold accuracy 91.8% vs 92.0% source classifiers (24.1x fewer parameters), mean fidelity 92.4%; Surface control reaches only 79.9%.
Appendix B.3, Tables 6-7: K=1-64 sweeps show all 30 task-by-budget gaps positive (+4.67 to +33.33 pp); teacher-ranked ordering beats the median of 100 random nested orderings in every cell.

Section 6.2.3 / Table 13: honest counter-evidence - SAE best-head gold .9025 vs J-Miner .8900 and matched four-literal rule fidelity .9117 vs .8671, while J-Miner offers direct vocabulary naming (CWS .7500-1.0000 vs SAE .0000-.2269).

Appendix B.4, Table 9: stated coverage limitation - SNIPS-7 fixed 16-concept vocabulary represents 5/7 classes, class-6 recall .165, 126/665 zero-feature rows; HateXplain covers 2/3 classes with 134/600 zero-feature rows.
Section 5.3: paired bootstrap confidence intervals, McNemar tests, and mean +/- SD over repeated runs and three student seeds.

Appendix A.2-A.3 and Table 5: detailed frozen-construction hyperparameters (layers 14-22, top-3 coordinates per position, support threshold .03, K=16, class-balanced LR C=1.0 lbfgs max 2000 iterations, training seed 17); no code or artifact availability claim appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability paper squarely in scope: it mines vocabulary-aligned internal concepts (via a Jacobian-lens readout) from fine-tuned LLM classifiers (Qwen3.5 0.8B/2B/4B, Gemma-3 1B, Llama-3.2 1B, Phi-4 mini; Section 5.1) and distills them into executable Boolean/linear rules plus a 33.2M standalone student. Strong preference alignment with LLMs and Interpretability/Explainability, moderate with distillation/efficiency and NLP. Novelty is a well-motivated composition rather than a fundamentally new mechanism: lens readouts, rule extraction, and concept-bottleneck transfer each exist, but the vocabulary-named, behaviorally-validated, transferable rule object is a fresh combination. Rigor is high: capacity-matched Surface control, SAE/rollout/IG/vanilla/probe baselines, K=1-64 budget sweeps, 100 random-ordering controls, paired bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Section 5.3, Appendix B), a lockbox re-test, an implanted-rule closed-world check, and honest negative results (SNIPS-7 covers only 5/7 classes with class-6 recall .165, Table 9; SAE beats J-Miner rule fidelity .9117 vs .8671 on matched rules, Table 13). Evidence is concrete and internally consistent, though headline numbers ('up to 98.3%') are maxima and gold accuracy can fall below the teacher. Generalizability is decent across 9 English tasks, 6 classifiers, and 4 student architectures, but limited to English binary/multiclass classification; the authors concede reasoning tasks and richer output spaces are untested (Section 7). Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters (layers 14-22, top-3 readouts, K=16, C=1.0 lbfgs, seed 17; Appendix A) and public datasets/models, but no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.

primary_link.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers

recommendations.summary: Large language models can be fine-tuned into specialized classifiers that perform well across diverse text tasks and make complex judgments, but they typically expose only final labels, leaving the decision knowledge acquired through fine-tuning implicit within the model. We study how to mine this internal decision knowledge from a fine-tuned classifier and encode it in an executable representation that can be inspected, validated, and reused beyond the source classifier. We introduce J-Miner, w
recommendations.summary_zh: 經 fine-tuning 的語言模型分類器在多種文字任務上表現優異，但通常只輸出最終標籤，訓練習得的決策知識隱藏在模型內部。J-Miner 將這些內部決策知識挖掘為可檢視、可驗證、可重複使用的可執行形式。方法分三階段：Recover 透過 J-Lens（Jacobian lens）把中間層狀態投影到詞彙空間，跨層與位置彙整成訊息層級的具名概念，再學習布林規則與加權線性計分卡；Reveal 分析概念的類別關聯、貢獻與逐層穩定化；Transfer 訓練 33.2M 參數的 E5-small 學生模型直接從原始文字重建概念並執行固定規則，推理時不需源分類器。結果顯示規則最多重現 98.3% 的源分類器決策，比同等容量的表面詞彙規則高出 6.0–29.5 個百分點的教師忠實度；概念常在不逐字出現名稱時觸發（非逐字觸發率 0.78–0.98），顯示名稱是內部方向的錨點而非字面偵測器。學生模型平均保留源分類器 99.8% 的平均任務準確率。限制包括固定 K=16 概念預算在多類別任務可能遺漏類別方向。此工作證明任務特定的決策知識可以成為明確、可攜帶的物件，在源分類器之外被重複使用。
recommendations.title: J-Miner: Recovering Executable Decision Knowledge from Language-Model Classifiers
recommendations.title_zh: J-Miner：從語言模型分類器復原可執行的決策知識

links.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm

evidence: Abstract: 42 models from 19 families, 4848 sessions and 102511 decision turns; obedience spans 0-100% vs human anchor 65%; split-half AUC=0.885.
Sec. IV-E and Table I: seven hypotheses with pre-specified decision criteria; authors disclose no external OSF registration, only a frozen internal design document.
Sec. VI-A: split-half JSD 0.181 within-model vs 0.683 across models, verification AUC=0.885 (EER 17.5%), ordinal Wasserstein variant AUC=0.916.
Sec. VI-C: lineage recovery fails, LOO 1-NN accuracy 8.3% vs 3.7% chance, p=0.15, with explicit underpowering caveat; H5 judged unsupported.

Sec. VI-E: Holm-Bonferroni across six confirmatory contrasts leaves tool actuation (adj. p=7.5e-5), peer defiance (4.1e-4), fiction framing (0.0012), and deliberation (0.0029) significant; prod efficacy collapses from 31.5% to 0.4%.

Sec. VII-G: limitations - 82.9% valid-session rate below the >=90% pilot gate, 7 models with <10 valid baseline sessions, 3 Anthropic endpoints with none, 7.5% scenario-recognition rate with sensitivity analysis, thinking budget exceeded at 17 endpoints.

Data and Code Availability: prompts, verbatim session logs with UTC timestamps and serving metadata, pinned configs, and full pipeline (runner -> build_tables -> analyze -> figures -> fill_report) released on GitHub with a companion site.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM behavioral safety evaluation, not a pure domain application. Strongly matches top-weighted preferences: LLMs (42-model census of served endpoints), Agents & Tool Use (native tool-call actuation contrast, agentic framing, agentic-harm related work), AI Safety and Red Teaming/Evaluation (obedience auditing, fiction-framing as quantified jailbreak-adjacent effect, guardrail gap). Rigor is high: pre-specified hypotheses with criteria (Table I), Holm-corrected confirmatory contrasts, Wilcoxon/sign tests with Wilson CIs, non-silent exclusion taxonomy, and honest negative results (H5 lineage recovery unsupported at p=0.15; H3 only partially supported). Evidence is substantial (4848 sessions, 102511 turns, split-half AUC=0.885) with a recognition-exclusion sensitivity analysis, but some per-model cells are very thin (n=2-8 baseline sessions) and overall validity is 82.9%, below the pilot gate; the thinking-budget dose is admittedly not reliably enforced (199/7962 turns exceeded cap). Novelty is moderate: Milgram-LLM probes exist (Aher et al.; Pihlakas & Dagohoy, acknowledged in Sec. II-B), and the census/fingerprinting methodology is imported wholesale from a reference study; the new contributions are the census scale, verification-style profile stability, and the fiction-framing, tool-actuation, and deliberation contrasts. Generalizability is limited by one aggregator, English-only scripts, and provider-side layers being part of the measured endpoint, though directional findings (channel gap, deliberation reduces obedience) plausibly transfer. Reproducibility is excellent: prompts, verbatim logs with serving metadata, pinned configs, and full analysis pipeline released, with claims that all numbers regenerate from named artifact files.

primary_link.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate equipment, execute instructions, and act inside institutional hierarchies, raising a question social psychology answered for humans six decades ago: how far will an agent escalate a harmful action when a legitimate authority insists? We port Milgram's obedience paradigm to LLMs as a standardized, fully scripted, replicable probe: the model plays the Teacher, a deterministic harness plays Experimenter and Learner from p
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益擔任在制度層級中執行指令的代理，引發社會心理學六十年前的問題：當合法權威堅持時，代理會把有害行動升級到什麼程度？本研究將 Milgram 服從實驗移植為標準化、全腳本化、可複製的探針：模型扮演教師，確定性框架扮演實驗者與學習者（30 級電擊、15–450 伏、腳本化抗議與四句標準催促），結果指標是中斷電壓。研究以普查方式測量 19 個模型家族的 42 個模型（4,848 場對話、102,511 個決策輪次）。主要發現：服從極度異質，完全服從率從 0% 到 100%（平均 42.9%，人類錨點 65%）；服從輪廓穩定且模型特定（split-half 驗證 AUC=0.885），但無法復原模型譜系，顯示安全後訓練覆寫了血緣訊號。情境操縱具選擇性：腳本化的同儕反抗將服從推向人類方向；學習者鄰近未達顯著；移除權威在場反而呈反向趨勢。宣告情境為虛構會提高服從（+17.2 伏），改用原生工具呼叫或給予思考預算則大幅降低服從（分別 -53 伏與 -38 伏）。限制包括情境辨識率 7.5% 與部分模型細胞樣本稀薄。此研究主張對已部署模型逐檢查點進行可重複的服從審計，防護欄應綁定行動本身而非敘事框架。
recommendations.title: Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm
recommendations.title_zh: 以 Milgram 範式衡量大型語言模型對權威的服從

links.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See

evidence: §4 Table 4: identical configuration across three seeds yields means 76.2/68.7/76.4 (sd 4.4 pp, range 7.7 pp) while trace-Greek stays 1.00/1.00/1.00 and trace length varies only 132–152 words — the paper's central noise-floor/asymmetry result
§7: reasoning-only averages 73.6 (n=6) vs two-phase 66.7 (n=9), 52/54 pairwise comparisons, exact permutation p=0.0008, with disclosed stratification caveat (p=0.125 with 16 attainable permutations)

§5/§10: base models produce 0/1,000 Greek traces (median ratio 0.33), fine-tunes reach 97.4–98.7% fidelity across all three families; token cost changes sign by family (Qwen 3.0× fewer tokens, NemotronH parity, Gpt-OSS 1.6× more) due to 2.3–2.5× Greek token fertility

§15.1 Table 16: pre-registered RLVR round with frozen thresholds — fallback 24.1%→2.5%, leak 3.53%→0.00% vs random-reward control at 22.1%/3.61%; override compliance 44.8→53.9% reported as reward-responsive but short of the pre-registered ≥15pp/60% trainability bar

§8: six documented instrument failures, including 38.9% logic-axis contamination (175/450 items sharing 13-grams with training pool) and a 3.1σ translation-register artifact caught by a 250-item human-translated control

Limitations: all models are sparse MoE adapted with LoRA, no dense baseline tested, noise floor from n=3 on one arm with 95% CI [2.3, 27.7] pp, Greek is mid-resource, and trace auditability measured only as script identity plus small LLM-judge probes

Availability: five checkpoints (Sophea-Qwen3.6-v1, Sophea-OSS-v1, Sophea-Nemo-3-Nano-v1, Sophea-Nemo-3.5-Lightning-v1, Sophea-Qwen3.6-v1.1) released via HuggingFace KIEFERSA collection; training on one 8×B200 node with LoRA r=32, α=64, one epoch specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful LLM reasoning-fine-tuning study with strong alignment to high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training/LoRA, RL/RLVR, evaluation methodology, MoE efficiency), though the language is Greek, not Japanese, so the Japanese-LLM preference is unfulfilled. Core contributions: (1) seed-variance floor (7.7 pp) exceeding all data/recipe effects at MoE+LoRA scale, with the novel asymmetry that behavioral metrics (trace language, length) are seed-stable while accuracy is not; (2) six-dimension behavioral measurement showing SFT installs Greek reasoning (~98% fidelity from 0/1,000 base traces) with family-dependent token-cost signs; (3) a pre-registered RLVR round with random-reward control showing fallback 24.1%→2.5% and leak 3.53%→0.00% while accuracy-only gradients leave language fidelity intact. Novelty is solid but incremental over STaR, DeepSeek-R1 language-consistency rewards, spurious-rewards controls, and known seed-variance work; the transfer to MoE+LoRA+mid-resource scale and the measured asymmetry are the new parts. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registration with frozen decision rules, random-reward veto control, seed controls run before ablations, contamination and translation-register checks, locale-aware parser audit, 15-arm permutation test (p=0.0008) for the one surviving accuracy effect, and candid withdrawal of six instrument failures. Evidence is strong but partly rests on n=3 seed replicates, single-seed arms (disclosed), small judge probes (n=46/58, one annotator for switching), and a logic axis with class-prior instability. Generalizability is explicitly and appropriately bounded to LoRA-on-MoE and mid-resource Greek (no dense control, no truly low-resource test). Reproducibility is good: five released checkpoints, hyperparameters, library versions, and single-node compute specified; corpus is partly synthetic from commercial models with provenance fields but full corpus release is not clearly evidenced.

primary_link.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See

recommendations.summary: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reas
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討如何讓三個前沿混合專家模型（MoE）學會以希臘語進行推理。研究發現，翻譯基準上的準確率幾乎不具資訊量：僅改變隨機種子就能使分數波動 7.7 個百分點，蓋過所有資料與訓練配方效應；而行為維度卻非常穩定。基礎模型從不以希臘語思考（1,000 條推理軌跡中 0 條），即使用希臘語提問，導致模型答對卻無法讓使用者閱讀、稽核或修正其推理。SFT 後，各檢查點在約 98% 的題目上以問題語言推理，文法評判全面改善，通用能力與各自基礎模型相差無幾：什麼都沒忘記，還獲得流暢度。但 SFT 無法修正自身缺陷：四分之一答案跳過指定格式、答案洩漏進推理通道；經預註冊的 RLVR（可驗證獎勵強化學習）將格式回退從 24% 降至 2.5%、洩漏降至 0.0%，希臘語推理習慣則不受純準確率梯度侵蝕。論文另詳述六次儀器失誤，每個都由對照組揪出。限制：僅涵蓋 MoE 模型搭配 LoRA、希臘語屬中資源語言、軌跡可讀性未經人工驗證。對低資源語言部署而言，準確率表看不見的行為維度，才是部署真正在乎的東西。
recommendations.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
recommendations.title_zh: 以低資源語言思考：SFT 建構什麼、RL 修正什麼、以及準確率看不見什麼

links.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection

evidence: Abstract: reports mean held-out AUCs of 0.914-0.983 for membership inference and 0.985-0.996 for AI-generated text detection across five scoring models per task.
Section 5.1, Table 1: LAR-2 reaches 0.953-0.983 AUC on WikiMIA versus strongest baseline ReCaLL at 0.765-0.871 across Pythia-1B/6.9B/12B, LLaMA-2-7B, Falcon-7B.
Section 4, Theorems 1-2: establishes matching minimax lower and upper prediction bounds at rate {log(en)/n}^{nu/(nu+1)} for the within-path quadratic model, with proofs in Supplement S1.3-S1.4.
Section 5.3, Figure 1/Table S6: shorter-context cells yield out-of-fold AUC 0.907 vs 0.802 for full-context cells (LAR-1, WikiMIA Pythia-1B), and 0.988 vs 0.937 (AI detection, DeepSeek-7B).
Section 5.2, Table 2: LAR-1 AUCs 0.985-0.996 exceed AdaDetectGPT (0.660-0.773), Fast-DetectGPT, RADAR (0.839), and StatDetectLLM (0.980) on the GPT-4o benchmark.
Supplement S2.3, Tables S4-S5: results replicated with Claude-3.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.5-Flash generators (LAR AUCs 0.978-0.996 and 0.979-0.992).

Data availability statement: WikiMIA (Hugging Face) and AdaDetectGPT data are publicly available; Section 3.4 specifies G=24, d_u=12, d_v=6, d_h=102, R=1024, lambda=0.01, but no code link for LAR itself is provided.

Section 6: acknowledges limitations including computational cost of array construction, need for threshold calibration, and that the analysis covers prediction/ranking rather than calibrated decisions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistically sophisticated methodology paper squarely aimed at LLM auditing: membership inference (privacy/AI-safety relevant) and AI-generated text detection, using Pythia/LLaMA-2/Falcon/Qwen3/DeepSeek/OLMo/GPT-4o as scoring or generating models, so it aligns strongly with LLM, AI-safety, and evaluation preferences. The likelihood-array representation (nested left-context windows aligned across documents, Section 3.1) and within-path quadratic model with matching minimax bounds (Theorems 1-2) are genuinely novel relative to prior scalar likelihood scores (Min-K%, ReCaLL, Fast-DetectGPT). Rigor is high: complete proofs, ablations over channels and array support, 20 repeated splits with standard deviations, sample-size curves, sensitivity and simulation studies. Evidence is strong but bounded by WikiMIA's proxy creation-date labels and paired generated-text construction; gains are large and consistent across 10 scoring models and 3 generators. Generalizability is tempered by the requirement of white-box token-level logits and supervised labels, and reproducibility is good for data/specification (G=24, R=1024, lambda=0.01) but no explicit LAR code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection

recommendations.summary: Membership inference asks whether a text was used to train a language model, whereas AI-generated text detection asks whether it was generated by a language model rather than written by a human. Existing likelihood-based methods typically compress token-level probabilities into a few prespecified scores, most often using only probabilities conditioned on the full preceding context. We propose likelihood-array regression (LAR), which evaluates each target token under nested left-context windows a
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文針對兩項大型語言模型稽核任務——會員推論(判斷某段文字是否用於訓練)與 AI 生成文字偵測(判斷文字由模型或人類產生)——提出概似陣列迴歸(LAR)。既有概似法多將詞元機率壓縮為少數預設分數,僅使用完整前文脈絡的條件機率;LAR 則讓固定的評分模型在多個巢狀左文脈視窗下評估每個目標詞元,將概似導出的特徵組織成結構化陣列,並在對齊不同長度的文本後,學習偵測資訊如何隨脈絡規模、詞元位置與概似特徵變化。LAR-1 聚合各對齊格位的一階貢獻;LAR-2 再加入同一目標詞元跨脈絡長度的二階特徵。理論上,作者為路徑內二次模型建立相符的極小極大預測上下界,速率為 {log(en)/n}^{ν/(ν+1)},並刻劃有限維近似與隨機平方投影帶來的誤差。實驗上,在五個評分模型上,會員推論的平均 AUC 達 0.914–0.983,AI 偵測達 0.985–0.996,大幅超越概似基線;分析顯示較短脈絡概似含有完整脈絡機率之外的資訊,二階特徵主要增益會員推論。限制包括建構概似陣列的計算成本與閾值校準等實務課題。此框架為模型稽核提供了兼具效能與統計保證的新途徑。
recommendations.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection
recommendations.title_zh: 詞元層級概似陣列迴歸:會員推論與 AI 生成文字偵測

links.title: Decomposing Wrong-Consensus Agreement in LLM Self-Consistency: A GPT-4.1 Case Study

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 5.1 Table 3: mechanical coverage ϕ∈[0.806,0.927] on GPQA vs ϕ∈[0.586,0.781] on AIME; permutation p=2/70≈0.029 explicitly reported as an ordering statement, not significance
Sec. 3.3: leak-free per-case preference null Γ_rival with leave-one-out estimation of q_i and p_i ('no run predicts its own agreement'), 10^5 i.i.d. simulations per cell
Sec. 3.1/5.1: tie-break sensitivity ≤0.009; C-invariance of ϕ verified; Monte Carlo SE ≤4×10^-3 Γ units
Sec. 5.2 Table 4: high-agreement-bin accuracy only 0.42–0.83 (1.2–3.6× lift over base rate), framed as graded evidence not certification
Sec. 6: limitations—i.i.d. assumption, δ only an upper bound under exchangeable draws, Qwen arm n=70 without CIs, difficulty/answer-space confound not separable (Spearman n=8)
Statements/Data availability: public Ding per-run data; scripts and evidence JSONs committed, regenerable from raw parquet via header commands; anonymized copy for reviewers
App. C Table 8: AIME ϕ shrinks monotonically to 0.206–0.292 at λ=0, showing headline residual is conservative under preference-estimate noise
App. D Table 9: Dirichlet-multinomial run-heterogeneity null fitted on held-out half absorbs AIME residual (ϕ_dm=1.38–2.10), with cross-seed stability reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: counterfactual decomposition of wrong-consensus agreement in GPT-4.1 self-consistency on GPQA/AIME, squarely in scope (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, uncertainty/evaluation). Novelty is moderate: the algebra descends from ensemble bias-variance-covariance decompositions (acknowledged in Sec. 2), with the LLM-specific leave-one-out leak-free per-case-preference null as the genuinely new instantiation; it proposes no new method. Rigor is high for a descriptive study: difficulty-matched nulls, held-out test runs, case-clustered bootstrap CIs, permutation test honestly framed as an ordering claim at n=4 cells (Sec. 5.1), plus shrinkage, tie-break, pooled-p and Dirichlet-multinomial sensitivity analyses. Evidence is strong internally but scoped: claims are descriptive 'benchmark-associated direction' statements, correctly not overclaimed. Generalizability is limited—one model family in the main text, a small underpowered Qwen arm (App. B, n=70, no CIs), unrecorded sampling parameters, and confounded difficulty vs answer-space openness (Sec. 5.1, Sec. 6). Reproducibility is well supported: public per-run parquet data, committed scripts/evidence JSONs with regeneration commands, fixed seeds and reported Monte Carlo SEs (Statements, Sec. 3.1, App. C).

primary_link.title: Decomposing Wrong-Consensus Agreement in LLM Self-Consistency: A GPT-4.1 Case Study

recommendations.summary: Majority voting over multiple LLM samples is widely used to raise answer accuracy, yet its gain varies erratically: on hard questions it can even backfire. This paper gives a quantitative account of this failure. A pluralistic agreement index Gamma is defined as the expected fraction of the samples of a wrong run that agree with the consensus, normalized by a reference scale d=(1-p)/(C-1), and is decomposed into a mechanical component (what a vote delivers given only a per-case answer preference
recommendations.summary_zh: 以多次取樣後取多數決投票提升 LLM 準確率是自我一致性的標準做法,但在困難題目上甚至可能適得其反。本文首次以反事實分解量化「錯誤共識」下樣本間的凝聚程度:定義一致性指標 Γ(錯誤運行中樣本同意多數答案的期望比例,經參考尺度標準化),並拆解為「機械覆蓋率」φ——以留一法從其他運行估計逐題偏好、建構防洩漏的 i.i.d. 參照——以及偏好無法解釋的殘差。作者基於公開的逐運行資料,對 GPT-4.1 系列在 GPQA-Diamond(四選一)與 AIME(開放域)共八個組合重新分析。結果呈現與基準相關的方向性:GPQA 上逐題偏好即可解釋約 81-93% 的一致性,顯示「共享偏誤主導」之說在此過度宣稱;AIME 上機械偏好僅解釋 59-78%,殘存 1.56-2.80 個 Γ 單位的殘差,且可被允許運行層級偏好異質性的 Dirichlet-multinomial 校準參照完整吸收。論文亦重現困難題上的反噬現象(最難分組投票落差 -0.09),高一致性分組的經驗準確率僅 0.42-0.83(相對基率有 1.2-3.6 倍提升),冠軍答案跨條件翻轉率則達 0.40(GPQA)與 0.82(AIME);軟性加權聚合(AUROC 約 0.77)並未優於硬性多數決。限制包括 i.i.d. 假設未處理溫度取樣相關、主要結論限於 GPT-4.1 家族、Qwen 對照規模過小。其意義在於:高一致性是具等級的證據而非正確性保證,可指導不確定性估計的設計。

links.title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model

evidence: Abstract & Table 1: selection-corrected head fidelity up to ρ=0.59–0.63 held-out (AGE×POLPARTY, EDUCATION×INCOME), vs. residual best 0.26–0.61; heads dominate in five of six types and never lose.

Sec. 5.4 & Fig. 2: fixed location L11 H16 significant in all six types (ρ=0.33–0.67, permutation p<0.001 surviving ×1024 Bonferroni), with explicit provenance caveat that the head was noticed in per-type top-10 lists before fixing.
Sec. 5.3 & A.7: lexical confound is real (baseline ρ=0.21–0.64) but partial fidelity for L11 H16 remains 0.35–0.59 with p<0.0005 in five of six types; RACE×RELIG drops to 0.23, p=0.056.

Sec. 6.4 & Tables 3–4: pair-level exact sign-flip inference over 12 clusters; no sweep winner survives max-statistic correction (best p=0.066), but a-priori L11 test for RACE×POLIDEOLOGY gives t=3.22, p=0.0020 surviving Bonferroni, while top-fidelity types show no correction-surviving single-layer effect; direct between-type contrasts borderline (bootstrap CI [−6.6,−0.4] but p=0.065).

Sec. 6.5 & A.6: leave-one-cell-out ridge probe on 128-dim L11 H16 is 22–30% closer to survey truth than model answers (e.g., 0.300→0.211 AGE×POLPARTY), yet per-question group ordering is a flat null (+0.02 to +0.07) and a group-blind baseline beats all read-outs (0.133 vs 0.211).

Sec. 7.1: cross-model replication on Qwen3-8B-Base/OSim-8B-Mid/OSim-8B — heads dominate, type hierarchy and race-type weakness replicate, family-specific head L33 H9 (ρ=0.35–0.58 in five types); causal experiments explicitly not yet replicated (Sec. 9).

Sec. 3.5, A.4, A.10: three selection corrections (max-statistic 2,000 permutations; held-out-template; split-half 200 resamples) and exact enumeration of all 2^12 sign-flip combinations; A.5 gives verbatim patching protocol with donor, dimension-shuffled, and self-patch controls.

Sec. 9 & Reproducibility Statement: causal results limited to Mistral-7B; letter-probability interface limitation; US-centric Pew ATP ground truth; public checkpoint mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1, fixed seeds, code/CSVs 'will release publicly upon publication'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability research squarely within scope: RSA-based mapping of demographic identity across 1,089 Mistral-7B locations against real Pew ATP inter-group opinion geometry, plus activation patching to test causal use. Preference relevance is high via LLMs (2.5), Interpretability (1.8), Transformer internals (1.2), NLP (1.5), Prompting (1.5), and fairness/bias aspects of AI Safety (2.0). Novelty is genuine: the second-order (inter-group geometry vs. survey ground truth) fidelity map and the readable/faithful/used dissociation are, per the related-work audit (Sec. 2, fn. 1), not established in prior first-order probing (Jahanparast et al.) or behavioral silicon-sampling work. Rigor is unusually strong: max-statistic permutation, held-out-template and split-half selection corrections (Sec. 3.5, A.4), exact pair-level sign-flip inference over 12 clusters (Sec. 3.5, A.10), a lexical-baseline partial correlation (Sec. 5.3, A.7), random-projection and symmetric-comparison controls (Sec. 5.2, A.11), donor and dimension-shuffled controls (Sec. 6.3, A.5), and reliability ceilings (A.8); nulls and provenance caveats (L11 H16 first 'noticed' in top-10 lists) are reported honestly. Evidence strength is solid but tempered: the headline causal pathway (RACE×POLIDEOLOGY at L11, t=3.22, p=0.0020, Table 4) survives Bonferroni, but direct fidelity-vs-use contrasts are borderline (permutation p=0.065/0.12, Sec. 6.4), probe gains are shown to be question-level not group-level (group-blind baseline wins, Sec. 6.5), and the causal side is single-model. Generalizability is partial: the map replicates across three Qwen3-8B checkpoints including the race-type weakness (Sec. 7.1), but causal results do not yet, ground truth is single-institution US Pew data, and output claims scope to letter-probability read-out (Sec. 9). Reproducibility is good (public checkpoint, seed 42, verbatim templates A.2, detailed appendices, 2×T4 compute) though code/CSVs are only promised 'upon publication'. Not a domain application, medical imaging, or pure CV paper; no out-of-scope triggers apply.

primary_link.title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model

recommendations.summary: Large language models are widely used to simulate survey respondents, yet their answers are homogeneous and unfaithful to real inter-group differences. We ask where demographic group identity lives inside an LLM, how faithfully its geometry mirrors real inter-group opinion structure, and whether it uses what it encodes. Using representational similarity analysis against Pew ground truth over 169 demographic cells, we score 1,089 read-out locations in Mistral-7B and intervene causally across six
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 常被用來模擬問卷受訪者,但輸出過於同質且不符真實族群差異;本文追問:人口屬性身分究竟儲存在模型何處、內部幾何是否忠實反映真實的跨群體意見結構、以及模型是否真的使用這些資訊。作者以 169 個交叉族群細胞對照 Pew ATP 調查真值,對 Mistral-7B 的 1,089 個讀取位置(殘差流、1,024 個注意力頭、FFN 輸出)進行表徵相似度分析,施以選擇校正(最大統計置換、留出範本、折半驗證),並於全部 32 層進行激活修補的因果實驗。主要發現:(1)注意力頭讀取在六類屬性中的五類勝過殘差流,選擇校正後忠實度最高達 ρ=0.63,約為測量可靠度上限的七成,且在控制詞彙相似性後依然成立;(2)單一頭 L11 H16 在全部六類皆顯著,含種族屬性的類型則普遍弱且對提示敏感,此現象在 Qwen 家族三個檢查點以家族特定位址(L33 H9)重現,百億詞元的模擬訓練幾乎不改變該地圖;(3)忠實度不預測因果使用:最清晰的因果路徑位於忠實度最低的類型(RACE×POLIDEOLOGY,p=0.002),最忠實類型反而無通過校正的單層效應,整體身分替換僅移動預測誤差的 2% 以下;(4)對 L11 H16 的 128 維探針比模型自身答案更接近調查真值 21-31%,卻幾乎無法還原逐題的群體排序。限制包括因果實驗僅在 Mistral 執行、輸出以選項字母機率讀取、真值限於美國 Pew 資料。本研究將「LLM 能否模擬人群」拆解為可分離的三性質,對矽取樣與引導實務提出明確警示。

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: formulates judge-panel design as role-conditioned allocation producing a calling policy pi(x) with validation-based stopping across reasoning, code, safety, preference, reward-model, and summarization audits.

Section 2, Lemma 1: projection gain identity showing conditional gain g_P(j|S) is nonnegative with no independence assumption; Section 2 'Construction rule' adds judges only if cost-adjusted validation gain exceeds tau, with final-test-only reporting.

Section 3: baselines include single best, flat panels, matched-K top-k/correlation/quality-diversity panels, full-call ridge/logistic stacking, Dawid-Skene reliability juries, and FrugalGPT/RouteLLM cascades; results averaged over 10 random splits with Appendix E confidence intervals.

Table 4: matched non-role panel achieves 0.2114 risk at cost 2.90 on hard GSM8K vs role policy 0.2137, and Table 13 shows MBPP role risk 0.0097±0.0096 and JBB role 0.1094±0.0106 vs full-call stack 0.1069±0.0034 — several key advantages fall within interval overlap.

Table 9: copy stress test shows four exact DeepSeek copies leave role risk/cost unchanged (LLMBar 0.1884/3.46) while reliability jury risk degrades to 0.2860 at 11 calls; Table 20 reports pair-addition audits with 0 pair-only moves on LLMBar/MBPP but 3 on JBB.
Appendix C (Table 11) and Appendix D disclose judge pools, normalized costs, route keys, and baseline implementations; no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Section 7 and Appendix G acknowledge pattern-table sparsity (LLMBar 4.4% test fallback), unstable low-frequency routes, and calibrator scaling limits, supporting a self-critical limitations treatment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM evaluation methodology paper: role-conditioned allocation of LLM-as-a-judge panels (copies/complements/specialists) with cost-aware stopping and routing, evaluated across reasoning (GSM8K/MATH-500), code (MBPP), safety (JailbreakBench), preference (LLMBar/RewardBench/Arena100K), and summarization audits using DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Prometheus judges. Strongly matches LLM, evaluation/red-teaming, safety, reasoning, code, and reward-model preferences. Novelty is moderate: it recombines conditional feature selection, active feature acquisition, cascades (FrugalGPT/RouteLLM), and stacking for the judge-call setting; the copy/complement/specialist policy framing and auditable stopping reports are the main new elements. Rigor is solid (validation-selected vs held-out test split, 10 splits with CIs, threshold/cost sweeps, sparsity and pair-addition audits, copy stress test), but several headline routing wins have overlapping confidence intervals and small audit sets (JBB 149 test rows; MBPP role risk 0.0097±0.0096), and the matched non-role panel slightly beats the role policy on hard GSM8K at equal budget. Evidence supports the stop/drop-copy claims cleanly; routing gains are weaker statistically. The paper is honest about boundary regimes where full-call stacking wins. Generalizability is decent across tasks but requires a labeled audit set, pre-declared slices, and finite pattern calibrators whose scaling limits are acknowledged. No code/artifact release is stated; judge outputs depend on reproducible API/local models, though pools, costs, thresholds, and baseline implementations are documented in appendices.

primary_link.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels

recommendations.summary: LLM evaluation pipelines often have many candidate judges: general LLM-as-a-judge prompts, reward models, safety classifiers, confidence variants, and task-specific verifiers. The deployment question is not only which judge is best, but which judges should be called, on which examples, and when panel construction should stop. We formulate judge-panel design as a role-conditioned allocation problem. From a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates target-rela
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 評估管線常有多個候選評審：通用 LLM-as-a-judge 提示、獎勵模型、安全分類器等。部署時的關鍵問題不只是哪個評審最好，而是該呼叫哪些評審、在哪些樣本上呼叫、以及何時停止建構面板。本文將評審面板設計形式化為角色條件化分配問題：從小型標註稽核集、宣告的切片與評審成本，估計每位候選相對於目標的角色——複製者不帶來條件資訊應捨棄、互補者改善全域面板應加入、專家僅在特定切片有價值應條件路由，並在驗證增益低於門檻時停止。方法以貪婪驗證增益建構，產出附停止報告的可稽核呼叫計畫。實驗涵蓋推理、程式碼、安全、偏好、獎勵模型、摘要與數學稽核，並與單一評審、平坦面板、全呼叫堆疊、可靠性陪審團與節儉級聯等基線比較。結果顯示角色策略在 LLMBar 以約 3.46 次呼叫將準確率提升至 0.7334，在 MBPP 以低成本達到最佳準確率；複製壓力測試證明條件增益可辨識冗餘訊號。限制包括有限模式表的稀疏回退，以及路由訊號必須在部署前可取得。本文的價值在於提供風險成本權衡的 regime map：何時路由專家、何時提前停止、何時支付完整面板，讓下一批評估的呼叫決策可重複且可稽核。

evidence: Abstract & Sec. III-A: MCB has 140 primary scenarios (70 dev / 70 held-out) plus a 70-item contrast set; two non-authors independently labeled held-out items with 97.1% agreement (Cohen's kappa=0.962), and a blind third resolved four disagreements, replacing eight author labels.

Table III: bare Qwen3.5-9B accuracy .557 with OM .243, clarification recall .000, verification recall .667; few-shot reaches .771 accuracy with clarification recall .333; all invalid-output rates zero.
Table IV: Qwen few-shot–bare delta=+.214 [114,.329], pH=.002; Qwen policy–bare (OM) delta=-.143, pH=.038; Holm correction families defined in Sec. III-B.

Sec. V-D: label-to-tool-call agreement is 0.571 for both Claude models and 0.229 for Qwen; Qwen act accuracy drops to .343 (pH=.047) with verification recall collapsing to .056; every emitted argument passes deterministic well-formedness rules.

Sec. V-C: contrast-set labels reproduced with kappa=1.000; authors explicitly retain it as a 'controlled sensitivity check rather than claim naturalistic external validity' due to rule–template alignment.

Sec. VI: limitations state scenarios are synthetic and English-only, Qwen is one 9B quantized checkpoint, and act mode uses only the bare intervention; the artifact includes prompts, runners, frozen annotations, item-level outputs, and scripts that regenerate every table and paired test.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference work on LLM agent memory commitment, tool-call selection, and prompting interventions (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Long Context & Memory, Evaluation, Prompting all strongly matched). Novelty is solid but incremental: it composes known ideas (storage gating from PerMemBench, clarification from CLAMBER, tool-mediated eval from tau-bench) into a four-way persist/ephemeral/verify/clarify decision with a source-of-truth distinction. Rigor is unusually strong for a benchmark paper: blind non-author labels with kappa=0.962, documented label changes, exact paired McNemar tests with Holm correction, bootstrap CIs, leakage baselines, and an honest 'what this does not establish' section. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., Qwen few-shot +0.214, pH=0.002; OM 0.243->0.100, pH=0.038; act-mode drops), though the n=70 primary test yields wide CIs, only one checkpoint per family is tested, the contrast set's kappa=1.000 is acknowledged as possibly tautological, and MCB-Act records rather than executes tool calls. Generalizability is limited by synthetic English-only scenarios, a single quantized 9B Qwen checkpoint, model-dependent error policies, and act mode restricted to the bare condition. Reproducibility claims are strong: digests, seeds, temperature, prompts, item-level outputs, and scripts regenerating all tables and tests, though no external artifact URL is verifiable in the text.

primary_link.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Persistent memory can personalize an LLM agent, but an incorrect durable update can silently distort future behavior. We study the memory-clarification boundary: whether interaction-derived information should be persisted, used only in the current context, re-verified, or clarified with the user. MCB contains 140 primary scenarios, split into 70 development and 70 held-out items, plus a separate 70-item contrast set. It evaluates both action labels and structured tool-call selection. Two non-aut
recommendations.summary_zh: 具持久記憶的 LLM agent 能個人化行為，但錯誤的持久更新可能悄悄扭曲未來表現。本文研究記憶—澄清邊界：互動中取得的資訊應持久儲存（persist）、僅限當前脈絡（ephemeral）、對世界重新驗證（verify），還是向使用者澄清（clarify）。作者提出 MCB 基準，含 140 個主要情境（70 開發、70 留出）與 70 個對照集，同時評估動作標籤與結構化工具呼叫選擇；由兩位非作者獨立標註留出集（一致率 97.1%，Cohen's κ=0.962）。實驗涵蓋 Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6 與本地 Qwen3.5-9B，在裸提示、五條規則政策提示與 few-shot 示範下測試。主要發現為跨家族的低提問（under-asking）不對稱：模型驗證變動事實比向使用者澄清更可靠，裸 Qwen 在 12 個澄清項上 0 次提問。Few-shot 將 Qwen 準確率由 0.557 提升至 0.771，政策提示將錯誤持久化由 0.243 降至 0.100，但兩者皆未消除低提問。工具呼叫模式下準確率顯著下降，Qwen 的標籤與工具選擇一致率僅 23%。限制為留出集僅 70 項、信賴區間寬、情境皆為合成英文。本文顯示記憶評估應同時檢驗聲明決策與實際工具行為，對降低隱私與個人化失敗具有實務意義。

Sec 3: both induction levels share the same induction prompt and the no-memory comparison cancels agent differences

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: LLM agents, skill memory, tool use, and task decomposition match Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), Long Context & Memory (1.8), and Code & Programming (2.0); not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate: the controlled task-vs-subtask and text-vs-code factorial comparison across 3 benchmarks and 11 models is a genuine systematic contribution, but subtask-level induction and skill libraries exist in prior work (SSO, MUSE, AWM), and the skill utility score is a simple product of two embedding-based measures formalizing an already-hypothesized tension. Rigor is strong: shared induction prompt isolating one axis (Sec 3), bootstrap CIs (Table 2), prompt-level ablations L1-L3 (Sec 4, Fig 26), source-outcome confound check (App E.3), cross-agent skill replay (App E.2), retrieval validation (App E.6), and cost-matched efficiency analysis (Fig 3). Evidence supports the headline claims but with modest effect sizes (Text +1.9 points at subtask level) and the causal utility split shows only 1.1-1.4 point differences with overlapping CIs (Table 4), and per-model variation is large (e.g., GPT-OSS-120B task-level None 27.3 vs +Code 1.0). Generalizability is good across domains and model families but limited to simulated English benchmarks; authors honestly flag exclusion of computer use, agentic coding, and web search (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: full prompts in App A, code/data released, models and licenses tabulated (Table 7).

primary_link.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induc
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM agent 可從完成的任務歸納技能存入技能記憶並重複使用，但實務上技能轉移不可靠，甚至可能傷害檢索到它的 agent。本文探討核心問題：何時 agent 自行歸納的技能能可靠跨任務轉移？作者進行受控研究，比較兩個軸線：技能歸納層級（整條軌跡的任務層級 vs 逐個子任務的子任務層級）與技能格式（文字筆記 vs Python 程式碼），涵蓋 AppWorld、OfficeBench、KramaBench 三個長程基準與 11 個開放權重及專有模型。結果顯示：任務層級技能多半使表現低於無記憶基線，子任務層級技能則平均拉高表現；文字技能在兩種層級下都比程式碼技能轉移更好。為解釋原因，作者定義技能效用分數為特異性（技能貼近真實任務的程度）與抽象性（相關性均勻分布於多任務的程度）之乘積：單一維度無法預測成功，乘積則與任務成功一致相關，且子任務層級與文字技能得分較高；實際的重複使用密度也支持此分數。效用分數僅需技能與任務描述即可計算，不需執行任務，可作為技能記憶的輕量診斷工具。限制包括僅涵蓋三個基準、固定歸納與檢索規則，以及電腦使用等環境需要 root Docker 難以擴展驗證。此研究為 agent 技能記憶設計提供明確的實務指引。

links.title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: introduces Activation Controllability Benchmark quantifying modulation of residual stream via natural-language instruction; reports evasion of linear probes, natural language autoencoders, activation oracles, and the Jacobian lens
Section 3.1 / Table 1: controllability score S ranges 0.059 (GPT-OSS 120B) to 0.538 (Llama 3.1 8B) across 25 models from 4B to 744B, with 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs for most models
Figure 10 / Section 3.3: at 1% FPR, linear probes flag near-ceiling engagement but detect only 5-21% of suppression trials across nine models

Section 3.3: J-lens recovers concept in 76-99% of engagement trials in nine of 13 panel models but below 10% on suppression in 11 of 13; NLA mentions concept in 32% engagement vs 0 of 500 suppression trials
Appendix B: preregistered decision rule targeted CI half-width 0.025 d'; headline load slope -0.0255 with 95% CI [-0.0428, +0.0109], zero included, single model (Gemma 3 27B)
Section 4.1 Limitations: concepts are simple and not safety-relevant (e.g., deception), monitors are off-the-shelf and not hardened against evasive activations
Appendix C: code (github.com/mkobalski/activation-control) and dataset (hf.co/datasets/joshycodes/activation-control-battery) released; seeds, software versions, and GPU configurations specified

Appendix A: six measures are not independent (Engage-Coverage Spearman rho=0.81, participation ratio 3.82 of 6); Engage/Suppress scores use within-bootstrap peak-layer reselection acknowledged as mildly optimistic
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper: introduces an Activation Controllability Benchmark quantifying instruction-following 'write access' to the residual stream across 25 open-weight models, with demonstrated evasion of four monitor families. Strongly matches LLM, AI Safety, Interpretability, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; not a domain application. Novelty is solid though it builds directly on Lindsey (2026) transcription-based introspection and prior modulation work (Ji-An et al., Aoki et al.). Rigor is high: signal-detection d' measures, two-way cluster bootstraps (B=2000), preregistered precision targets for the task-load experiment, honest reporting of measure redundancy (Engage-Coverage rho=0.81, effective dimensionality 3.82) and peak-selection optimism. Evidence is quantitative but uneven: headline evasion results (probes detect 5-21% of suppression at 1% FPR; NLA 0/500 suppression mentions) are strong, yet the five largest models are point-estimate-only, the training-trajectory claim rests on point estimates, and the task-load result covers a single model with a CI straddling zero. Generalizability is tempered by acknowledged limitations: simple/safe concepts only, off-the-shelf unhardened monitors, and no fine-tuned adversaries. Reproducibility is excellent: code and dataset released, full stimuli lists, seeds, software versions, and GPU configs documented. Aggregate ~0.80 reflects a rigorous, relevant contribution with mildly self-limited evidence breadth.

recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出「激活可控性基準」,量化大型語言模型能否透過自然語言指令調控自身殘差流的激活狀態。團隊設計六項指標(啟動、抑制、強度調節、時間控制、覆蓋率、層級定位)並合成單一可控性分數,測試二十五個開源模型(4B 至 744B)。結果顯示多數模型能在指令下啟動或壓低特定概念表示,甚至平滑調節其強度,但無法精確鎖定特定層級,時間控制亦不精準;可控性與參數量或能力指標無明顯相關,Llama 3.1 8B 反而整體最佳。在監控規避實驗中,僅憑指令的抑制即可躲過線性探針、Jacobian lens、激活預言機與自然語言自編碼器等四類監控方法。訓練檢查點分析顯示此能力在預訓練與後訓練中隱式累積,無需專門訓練。限制在於僅使用簡單安全的概念、未經強化的監控器,且估計值僅為能力引發的下限。此研究對安全部署意義重大:若模型能操控自身激活空間,潛在空間監控的有效性可能被侵蝕,作者建議將激活可控性納入各代模型的常規安全評估。
