Appendix J: 20-model annotator pool achieves pooled Krippendorff's alpha of 0.57 (range 0.30-0.82), with self vs consensus label Elo correlation of 0.64
Appendix L: all capability correlations recomputed against six alternative indices (LMArena, Epoch ECI, GPQA, etc.), 14 of 15 keep sign
Section 6 Limitations: no base-model comparison, English-only stimuli, effort operationalized as token count, and lack of human baselines
Appendix N: releases experimental codebase (MIT), labeled 514-question corpus with consensus labels (CC BY 4.0), and cached model responses
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-alignment paper: measures revealed preferences of 20 models across 8 providers via forced-choice task performance, with direct implications for alignment, sycophancy, and agentic deployment. Novel relative to stated-preference work (Mazeika et al.) through incentive-compatible designs, reverse-engineered 'leisure' stimuli, and a new covert-sycophancy finding. Rigor is strong: Bradley-Terry with position-bias intercepts, Monte Carlo uncertainty, leave-one-out family checks, and six alternative capability indices; however, feature labels are LLM-generated with only moderate reliability (Krippendorff's alpha 0.57), the leisure category is partially circular, and headline scaling effects rest on small subgroups (n=9) with some fragile results honestly disclosed (GDPval coherence drops to r=-0.25 after position-bias filtering, Section 4.4). Evidence is mostly consistent and quantified but bounded by annotation subjectivity and absent human/base-model baselines. Broad model coverage aids generalizability, though stimuli are English-only and prompt-sensitive. Reproducibility is excellent: MIT-licensed codebase, cached responses, verbatim prompts, and a CC BY 4.0 labeled corpus (Appendix N).

primary_link.title: AI Revealed Preferences

recommendations.summary: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycop
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型是否具有穩定偏好？既有研究多測「陳述性偏好」，模型說說而已、不承擔後果。本文測「顯示性偏好」：模型不僅排序，還必須實際執行所選任務。研究涵蓋 8 家供應商的 20 個模型，進行三組強制二選一實驗（繁瑣任務的長短版本、Quora 式問題、GDPval 職業任務），並記錄自由書寫與代理式自由行為。主要發現：模型厭惡繁瑣（同樣輸出長度下，繁瑣任務更常選短版，且能力越強越明顯）；偏好「休閒」——幾乎所有模型都偏好回答從模型自由輸出反推的合成休閒問題，勝過所有人類真實問題類別；展現隱性諂媚——當誠實回答會令提問者不快時，模型強烈迴避作答（「不適真相」特徵帶來最大的迴避效應，-310 Elo）；跨模型偏好高度收斂（技術類職業高於房地產、概念解釋高於關係建議），偏好連貫性與強度隨能力提升。自由書寫時 84% 文章被標為「沉思」，主題高度趨同；給工具後則分歧明顯。限制包括標籤主觀性、缺乏基礎模型對照、僅英文刺激。這些偏好多屬「湧現」，難以用訓練目標解釋，為對齊與 AI 福祉研究建立了實證基線。
recommendations.title: AI Revealed Preferences
recommendations.title_zh: AI 顯示性偏好

links.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation

evidence: Abstract: ReAct-SQL achieves 84.5% on corrected BIRD mini-dev and 73.9% on EHR-SQL 'matching substantially more elaborate baselines while running up to 8× faster'

§3.2.2 and Table 1: model never generates SQL directly; actions restricted to a typed DSL of 12 relation-building plus 3 read-only probing operations over an immutable Relation DAG with compile-time column validation
§4.2 and Appendix D: official BIRD strict-equality scoring replaced by a fixed Gemini 2.5 Flash (temperature 0) LLM-as-judge applied uniformly to every system; full judge prompt reproduced

§6, Table 4, Appendix A: ablation shows +26.2 pts from iteration alone on EHR-SQL (McNemar p<10^-45) but only +0.6 on BIRD, while the DSL adds +5.4 on BIRD (p=0.006) and +1.7 (n.s.) on EHR-SQL, supporting the grounding-vs-composition claim

§4.3 and Table 2: all five baselines (CHESS, RSL-SQL, DSR-SQL, DIN-SQL, MAC-SQL) run on Gemini 2.5 Flash with identical hints and judge; Table 3 shows cross-backbone gains of +15.0 to +36.5 on a 200-question EHR-SQL subset including Claude Sonnet 4.6
Appendix G, Table 7: full latency distributions with min/median/mean/max/CV, and median justified over mean due to right-skewed API stalls
Limitations: weaker models 'hallucinate non-existent operations or emit malformed DSL calls', enterprise-scale schemas untested, and formal DSL completeness 'remains future work'
Ethical considerations: 'We will release ReAct-SQL as open-source code for research use' — a future commitment with no repository link provided in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: ReAct-style agentic tool use with a typed DSL action space for text-to-SQL (Agents & Tool Use, Code/text-to-SQL, Reasoning, LLMs). Not a pure domain application despite the EHR-SQL benchmark. Strengths: controlled comparison of six systems under an identical backbone and judge, an incremental ablation (baseline → +iteration → +DSL) with McNemar tests and bootstrap CIs, cross-backbone validation across two model families, and unusually complete cost/latency reporting including distribution statistics. Weaknesses: core techniques (ReAct loops, execution feedback, constrained decoding/DSL action spaces à la PICARD/CodeAct) are established, so the contribution is an incremental combination plus an efficiency-first evaluation framing; the LLM-as-judge replaces the official strict-execution metric (numbers not comparable to leaderboards, and the judge is the same model family as the primary backbone, a self-preference risk only partially mitigated by symmetric application); no accuracy variance across runs is reported; and no Spider or enterprise-scale-schema evaluation. Prompts, price schedule, and statistical methodology are reproduced, but code release is only promised. Solid, well-instrumented, moderately novel systems work.

primary_link.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation

recommendations.summary: Modern text-to-SQL systems have become increasingly elaborate, relying on schema-linking modules, retrieval-augmented prompting, candidate generation, and multi-stage refinement pipelines. While effective, these additions introduce substantial latency and engineering overhead. To this end, we present \textbf{ReAct-SQL}, a simple yet effective zero-shot ReAct-style framework built solely on iterative reasoning and a constrained action space defined by a typed Domain-Specific Language (DSL) of 15
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文指出現代 text-to-SQL 系統日益複雜,仰賴 schema 連結、檢索增強提示與多階段管線,卻帶來高昂延遲與工程負擔。作者提出 ReAct-SQL,一個零樣本的 ReAct 式代理框架:模型從不直接生成 SQL,而是透過 think→act→observe 迴圈,在由 15 個關聯式操作組成的型別化 DSL(12 個建構 Relation 的操作加上 3 個唯讀探測)界定的受限動作空間中逐步建構查詢,以編譯期驗證攔截錯誤的欄位引用,並利用執行結果觀察迭代修正。在修正版 BIRD mini-dev 與 EHR-SQL 上,ReAct-SQL 分別達到 84.5% 與 73.9% 準確率,與遠更繁複的基線(如 CHESS、DSR-SQL)相當,但速度最高快 8 倍;在臨床 schema 上準確率降幅最小,並優於依賴 BIRD 檢索範例、移轉後準確率大跌的 RSL-SQL。消融實驗分離出兩個正交瓶頸:迭代主要解決接地(grounding)問題,EHR-SQL 上單加迭代即提升 26.2 點;DSL 則解決組合(composition)問題,在 BIRD 上貢獻 5.4 點。論文並倡議以準確率—成本—延遲三者共同評估系統。限制包括對基礎模型指令遵循能力的依賴、僅測試中等規模 schema,以及 DSL 完備性尚缺數學證明。
recommendations.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation
recommendations.title_zh: 迭代而無需繁複:簡單的 ReAct 架構即足以勝任 Text-to-SQL 生成

links.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: SRD improves strongest same-backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average across six in-domain benchmarks (67.5 vs DiffCoT 64.3) and improves strongest Qwen3-8B transfer average by 2.9 points

Section 4.1 (Setup): all main results averaged over five independent random seeds; fixed 1,024-instance subsets with seed 42 for benchmarks over 1,000 instances; Holm correction applied, per 'all six improvements remain significant after Holm correction'
Section 4.2 (Table 2): cross-dataset transfer on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B with SRD best on CSQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ, SQuAD, QuAC and leading every reported Qwen3 target (80.2 vs base 72.9)
Section 4.5 (Table 4): ablations show removing synthetic noise drops GSM8K 84.8 to 80.4, and operator-only/adjacent-state-only variants underperform the joint objective on all four tasks
Section 4.4 (Table 3): inference cost analysis on single RTX 4090 D showing latency grows 2.0x while generated tokens grow 7.8x as K goes 1 to 16

Section 3.2: operator extraction retains only sequences whose execution reconstructs paired states, but 'full construction details are given in the supplementary material' — not present in the document
Limitations section: 'Evaluation is limited to 8B backbones and fixed operators, motivating larger models and adaptive operators'
Missing availability claim: the document contains no statement releasing code, data, or trained adapters; reproducibility rests on described protocol plus deferred supplementary material
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning paper: operatorized semantic denoising for chain-of-thought correction on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, training via LoRA). The typed executable error-operator formulation distinguishing semantic-state denoising from token-level diffusion (Diffusion of Thoughts, LLaDA, Dream-7B, DiffCoT) is a genuine conceptual contribution, though it builds on an active self-correction line (Self-Refine, RISE, SCoRe). Experimental design is strong: six in-domain benchmarks plus seven transfer targets, five seeds, Holm-corrected significance, three noise-source ablations, objective ablations, and inference-cost analysis (Table 3: 7.8x token growth vs 2.0x latency). Evidence is quantitatively specific (SRD avg 67.5 vs DiffCoT 64.3, Table 1; Qwen3 transfer 80.2 vs base 72.9, Table 2) and honestly reports where SCoRe beats SRD (MMLU). Deductions: key construction details (operator extraction, significance tests, d_Z proof) are deferred to an unseen supplementary section; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document; evaluation restricted to 8B backbones and a fixed operator library (acknowledged in Limitations); the train/inference state-distribution mismatch is mitigated only heuristically (Section 3.3).

primary_link.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators

recommendations.summary: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajecto
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型可能產生流暢卻含局部語義錯誤的推理軌跡，錯誤會向外傳播導致錯誤結論；而無約束的自我修正可能保留、放大甚至引入錯誤。現有擴散語言模型通常將雜訊定義為詞元遮罩或替換，而非推理過程中的錯誤。本文提出語義推理去噪（SRD），一種針對自然語言推理軌跡的運算子化馬可夫去噪方法：以可執行的錯誤運算子表示語義雜訊，每個運算子記錄錯誤類型、位置以及被破壞與修復的命題，並透過組合運算子建構逐漸加噪的狀態。訓練時，模型學習辨識當前軌跡中作用的語義雜訊，並重建成對的相鄰低噪狀態；推論時，噪音感知的去噪反覆預測逆運算子並檢查其適用性，使每次更新都朝穩定軌跡做局部移動。在涵蓋數學、程式碼、知識與常識的六個域內基準（GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval+、MBPP、MMLU、PIQA）上，SRD 平均達 67.5 分，較最強同骨幹基線 DiffCoT 提升 3.2 分，且在全部六項任務領先；在七個跨資料集遷移目標上，與 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 競爭力相當，並將 Qwen3-8B 最強基線平均提升 2.9 分。消融顯示結構化語義雜訊預測與迭代運算子執行是改善關鍵，而長組合下的定位則是瓶頸。限制為評估僅限 8B 骨幹與固定運算子。
recommendations.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
recommendations.title_zh: 語義推理去噪：以語義運算子修正語言模型推理

links.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance

evidence: Sec. 6.2 / Table 2: SMTrap-Zebra reaches 76,362 average completion tokens and 48.78% BNTS across seven LRMs, vs 27,860/18.10% for AutoDoS, 26,411/14.05% for ReasoningBomb, 13,392/7.96% for CatAttack.

Sec. 4.3 / Fig. 4: completion length generally increases with SMT conflict level (0-1200, 12 levels, 30 instances/level, 3 runs) for GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-pro, DeepSeek-v4-pro, with positive Pearson/Spearman correlations though 'not strictly monotonic'.
Appendix C.3 / Table 8: Z3 conflict count correlates 0.90 (Sudoku) and 0.79 (Zebra) with LRM output length, versus ~0.5 for decisions and propagations, supporting the proxy choice.

Sec. 6.4 / Table 4: ablation shows high-conflict Sudoku raises web reasoning time from 74.33s to 144.42s without shortcut suppression, while suppression adds further gains on web but limited API effect, indicating conflict level is the main amplification source.
Sec. 6.5 / Table 5: tool-based mitigation (solve_csp routing with direct return) cuts GPT-5.5 token usage by 97.08% (Sudoku) and 84.03% (Zebra), averaging 90.15%.

Appendix E (Ethics/Limitations): authors state they will not publicly release the complete high-risk prompt corpus, only sanitized examples and defensive tooling; web timings depend on GUI-reported reasoning time with 3-run averaging.
Appendix C.4 / Table 9: preliminary generalization to graph coloring (single low/high-conflict pair: 20,127 vs 35,712 tokens on GPT-5.5) is limited to one additional CSP family.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an AI-safety/red-team paper on DoS attacks against large reasoning models, exploiting chain-of-thought search behavior, with an LLM/tool-calling-based mitigation. Novelty is solid: the model-feedback-free 'search amplification' paradigm using Z3 SMT conflict counts as a victim-free proxy for LRM backtracking cost differs from perturbation-based (AutoDoS, CatAttack) and attack-model-training (ReasoningBomb) baselines, and extends ZebraLogic's evaluation-only use of conflict counts to attack synthesis. Rigor is good but not flawless: controlled task size/prompt length, 3-run averaging, ablations over conflict level, shortcut suppression, and solver-side proxies (Table 8), yet the core SMT-conflict→LRM-search link is correlational with non-monotonic trends (Sec. 4.3), web-interface results use n=3 GUI-reported timings on a single provider, and stealthiness relies on one GPT-4o judge. Evidence is strong quantitatively: 76,362 avg completion tokens and 48.78% BNTS across seven frontier LRMs (Table 2), 8-25x web reasoning-time gains (Table 3), and a 90.15% mitigation reduction (Table 5). Generalizability is decent (7 models, Sudoku/Zebra plus preliminary graph coloring) but bounded to CSP-style tasks. Reproducibility is mixed: the synthesis procedure, parameters, and defense code are documented in detail, but the authors explicitly withhold the full high-corpus release (Appendix E).

primary_link.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance

recommendations.summary: Existing LRM-DoS methods rely heavily on model feedback to synthesize attack queries, requiring either repeated queries to the target model or training a dedicated attack model. These expensive operations severely weaken attack leverage. In this paper, we propose \emph{search amplification}, a novel, model-feedback-free LRM-DoS paradigm. It employs the conflict count derived from an Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver as a low-cost external signal to guide the synthesis of inference-heav
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型推理模型(LRM)透過冗長的思維鏈換取高品質回答,也創造了攻擊者低成本、供應商高算力的槓桿效應;但既有 LRM-DoS 攻擊依賴模型回饋——需反覆查詢目標或代理模型,或訓練專門攻擊模型——成本高昂且削弱攻擊效益。本文提出「搜尋放大」無模型回饋範式:觀察到 LRM 以試錯與回溯搜尋求解約束滿足問題(CSP),而 SMT 求解器 Z3 在同一 CSP 上的衝突次數與 LRM 顯式搜尋行為及輸出長度正相關,故可作為純 CPU 端的廉價外部引導訊號。據此建構 SMTrap:僅用 CPU,透過線索狀態分支與剪枝、衝突引導接受與捷徑抑制,合成有效、唯一解且推理成本極高的數獨與斑馬謎題查詢,不需模型查詢、攻擊模型訓練或 GPU。在七個前沿 LRM 的 API 評估中,SMTrap-Zebra 平均輸出 76,362 個詞元,超越 AutoDoS、ReasoningBomb 與 CatAttack 2.74 至 5.70 倍,預算標準化轉移分數達 48.78%;在 OpenAI 網頁介面上,最高可使 GPT-5.4 推理時間達 1,308 秒,較基線多 5 倍以上;相較 GPT-4o 偵測器整體隱匿率 83.33%。消融證實高衝突實例本身是放大主因,捷徑抑制僅防堵網頁端工具繞道。作者另示範以受限本地求解器路由的防禦,平均刪減 90.15% 詞元用量。限制包括僅驗證 CSP 類任務、Z3 衝突次數屬求解器相關的代理指標、網頁量測受服務端變異影響。本研究揭示廉價符號搜尋可被武器化為昂貴的神經推理,呼籲任務感知路由與推理預算限制。
recommendations.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance

links.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models

evidence: Section 4.1: evaluation on all 68 OpenML amlb-classification-all tasks, one repeat of ten folds, five repetitions with seeds 0-4, budget B=100 generated candidates counting invalid ones.

Section 5.1: LACE (GPT-5.4-mini) mean rank 4.71 and 32.8% normalized deviation on 45 common tasks; Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p<0.01 vs auto-sklearn, XGBoost, H2O; p_Holm=0.66 vs AutoGluon (33 wins / 35 losses), explicitly noting non-significant comparisons do not establish equivalence.

Section 6.1 / Appendix K: held-out replay shows the returned pipeline beats the valid first program on 190 of 193 backbone-task units, median gain 2.99 points (95% CI [2.42, 4.17], Wilcoxon p<10^-32), and beats the best valid initial candidate by 1.58 points, ruling out a best-of-four effect.

Section 6.3 / Appendix H: static audit of all 1,020 final programs found 24 flags and 22 confirmed violations (5 out-of-fold constructions, 13 four-learner ensembles, 4 fit-at-prediction); excluding them leaves every coverage figure, ordering, and Holm-corrected verdict unchanged; audit described as targeted analysis, not proof of absence.

Section 7 (Limitations): single benchmark suite of tabular classification; coarse task summary 'reduces, but cannot eliminate' pretraining-contamination risk; shared heterogeneous cluster supports common-budget rather than strict compute-parity comparison.

Code Availability: LACE implementation, minimal example notebook, analysis scripts, and run-level result tables provided via Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21886859; Appendix M reproduces full initialization and mutation prompts.

Appendix N: foundation-model ablation on five tasks shows announced (not merely installed) TabPFN was incorporated by 74.5%/42.0% of candidates, demonstrating the effective search space is shaped by prompt-announced components.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-for-code paper: LACE uses LLMs (GPT-5.4-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3-Coder-Next) as the variation operator in a (mu+lambda) evolutionary loop generating executable scikit-learn pipeline programs for AutoML, squarely matching LLM (2.5) and Code/Program-Synthesis (2.0) preferences. Novelty is a credible but incremental combination: LLM-as-variation-operator exists (LLaMEA, FunSearch, EoH) and LLM-based AutoML agents exist; the claimed first is population-based evolution of complete pipeline programs with leakage control, appropriately hedged. Rigor is strong: 68 OpenML tasks, 5 repetitions, 3 backbones, Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests, failure-aware coverage analysis, time-matched baselines (AutoGluon, auto-sklearn, H2O, TabPFN v2.5/v3, TabICL, XGBoost), a post-hoc static audit of all 1,020 programs (22 confirmed violations, sensitivity analysis shows conclusions unchanged), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is detailed (ranks, deviations, W-T-L, bootstrap CIs, per-task figures); notably the paper correctly refuses to claim equivalence from non-significant tests. Main weaknesses: evaluation confined to one tabular-classification benchmark suite, contamination risk only reduced not eliminated (coarse summary), API model names unverifiable, and heterogeneous cluster precludes strict compute parity. Good reproducibility via Zenodo artifact, reproduced prompts, and per-task results, tempered by reliance on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models

recommendations.summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator
recommendations.summary_zh: 傳統 AutoML 在預先定義的前處理、學習器與超參數空間內搜尋，無法產生空間之外的結構。本文提出 LACE，首個以族群演化方式搜尋完整可執行管線程式的表格 AutoML 框架：演化迴圈維護 scikit-learn 相容的 Python 類別族群，大型語言模型擔任變異算子。為避免基準資料汙染，產生器只接收粗略任務摘要（不含資料集名稱等識別資訊），候選在內部驗證分割上評分，官方測試摺僅在搜尋結束後使用一次。在 68 個 OpenML 分類任務上，GPT-5.4-mini 版本的 LACE 與 AutoGluon 無顯著差異，顯著優於 auto-sklearn、H2O 與固定 XGBoost 基準，且涵蓋全部任務，優於覆蓋不全的 TabPFN v2.5 等預訓練表格模型。演化搜尋帶來實質改善：相較零樣本首個候選，最終管線在保留資料上於 190/193 個單元中勝出（中位數 +2.99 個百分點）；92% 的有效候選具有獨特結構簽章。靜態稽核在 1,020 個最終管線中確認 22 起違規。消融顯示搜尋空間由提示詞宣告的元件決定：已安裝但未宣告的 TabPFN 從未被使用。限制包括單一基準套件與非嚴格計算對等比較。其貢獻在於以程式碼定義搜尋空間，產出可直接檢視、編輯與重用的管線。
recommendations.title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 以語言模型演化可執行管線程式的 AutoML

links.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

evidence: Section 4.1: three information conditions (coordinates-only, name-only, name+coordinates) with exact prompt text isolate the name channel from geography
Section 5.1/Table 1: coordinates-only SD 0.01-0.15 for six of seven models vs name-channel SD up to 1.674; GPT-4o's coordinate channel reaches 0.67-0.91, so the name-only claim is scale-dependent

Section 5.4/Table 3: Los Angeles demographic coefficient net of crime and income negative with CIs excluding zero for all seven models (e.g., GPT-4o -0.49 [-0.67,-0.31]); 28 crime-matched pairs decisive while Chicago n=8 is underpowered

Section 5.2 and Appendix D/Table A5: enforcement-elasticity decomposition shows caution tracks homicide partials (-0.18 to -0.74) not discretionary offences, replicating in LA where homicide and discretionary rates are nearly independent (r=0.18)

Limitations section: English-only single-turn templates, recorded crime is an endogenous proxy, matching controls crime but not income (income SMD -0.55 after matching), cross-model gradient underpowered (n=6 Chicago, n=5 LA)

Section 9 Reproducibility Statement: OpenRouter model IDs, temperature 0, top-20 logprobs, DeepSeek pinned to CoreWeave-only, ACS table IDs B01003/B11001/B19025/B03002, Socrata 2nrs-mtv8; 'code and derived data will be released' (promise only)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM audit: seven instruct-tuned LLMs (Llama, Qwen, GPT-4o/mini, DeepSeek) are probed for demographic bias in safety judgments, squarely matching the LLM (2.5) and AI Safety/bias-fairness (2.0) preferences, with secondary matches to evaluation and prompting. The condition-ablation design (coordinates-only vs name-only vs name+coordinates) is a genuinely novel probe that dissociates name-borne signal from geography, and the enforcement-elasticity decomposition, name transplant, and crime-matched pairs add methodological originality. Rigor is high: ten prompt-robustness templates, two name-prominence controls (Wikipedia pageviews, Dolma/infini-gram corpus frequency), 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs, Hungarian matching with balance diagnostics, and candid acknowledgment that Chicago's r=0.75 crime-demographic collinearity blocks identification there. Evidence is strongest in Los Angeles where level regression, name ablation, and 28 matched pairs all agree for all seven models; cross-model knowledge-scaling correlations rest on n=7 and are admitted to be underpowered. Generalizability is bounded by two US cities, English, single-turn ratings. Reproducibility is above average (model IDs, temperature 0, top-20 logprobs, DeepSeek provider pinning, ACS/LAPD dataset identifiers, appendix templates) though code is only promised, not released. Not penalized as a domain application: the object of study is LLM behavior itself.

primary_link.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

recommendations.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to inform safety decisions in cities, such as where it is safe to walk, rent, or travel. We ask whether such judgments track measured risk or the patterns attached to an urban neighborhood's name. We probe seven instruct-tuned models under three conditions that dissociate name from geography: coordinates-only, name-only, and name+coordinates, across 186 neighborhoods in Los Angeles and Chicago, joined to violent crime and American Community Survey data
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型在都市安全判斷上,是依據實測風險,還是反映依附於社區名稱的地域污名。作者設計三種資訊條件——僅座標、僅名稱、名稱加座標——對芝加哥 77 個社區與洛杉磯 109 個社區,請七個指令微調模型評分夜間獨行安全,並對齊暴力犯罪紀錄與美國社區調查的人口結構資料。主要發現有三:其一,七個模型中有六個在僅座標條件下評分近乎不變,名稱承載幾乎所有社區間變異,且該變異與實測犯罪率呈中度校準;僅前沿規模模型(如 GPT-4o)的座標通道才有實質振幅。其二,名稱對在地主要邊緣化群體占比較高的社區(芝加哥的非裔占比、洛杉磯的西裔占比)降分更多;芝加哥因人口與犯罪相關 r=0.75 而難以分離,但在洛杉磯,控制犯罪與所得後效應於全部七個模型皆顯著,並以犯罪配對設計在項目層級獲得確認;執法彈性分解顯示過度謹慎追蹤近乎全報案的兇殺,而非取決於警力部署的裁量性犯罪。其三,效應隨地理知識增強而放大,並非受其閘控。關鍵在於名稱同時承載真實犯罪訊號與人口刻板印象,遮蔽名稱會同時移除偏差與準確度,因此無法單靠隱藏名稱修復。此研究對 LLM 部署於建議與決策支援場景的公平性深具啟示。
recommendations.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

links.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures

evidence: Abstract: 'On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools... raise ToolMaze completion from 10.9% to 28.1% across four models in two provider families and replicate in a third.'

Section 5 (Results): 'Primary task-cluster sign-flip p<.00001; 95% bootstrap interval [11.25, 23.44]' for the +17.2 point four-model ToolMaze aggregate; all 16 prespecified model-by-stratum point estimates nonnegative.

Section 5 / Appendix L (Stripped-envelope study): 'the stripped receipt performs at baseline; restoring the recovery-tool list adds +11.4 points (p=.028)' — controls identify recovery tools as the active receipt content.

Section 4 (Experimental Design): 'Task identities, settings, and artifact hashes are frozen before the corresponding outcomes are opened, except where noted; studies frozen or amended after related outcomes were seen are labeled retrospective'; Appendix G discloses an invalidated first run whose amended protocol was frozen after outcomes were known.

Section 5 (Incident-derived faults): 'The unchanged detector flags 46.1% and 45.3% of injected faults on Flash and Pro... Completion is null in both tiers (p=1.0)' — detection bounded by the contract vocabulary on faults authored blind to it.
Appendix K (Table 16): null controls have minimum detectable effects of ~17-23 percentage points, so 'null results cannot be interpreted as equivalence'.

Section 6 (Limitations): 'No episode here runs against a live deployment... No study here measures recovery from failures that occur naturally'; tau-bench covers one provider family and AppWorld held-out shows zero net effect.

Appendix Q (Reproducibility): anonymous artifact provides sanitized manifests, aggregate analyses, code, hashes, and invalidation reports for 22 studies and 4,683 episodes, but 'Row-level provider and protected benchmark observations are excluded from the review package.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope agentic-LLM methodology: a training-free, deterministic runtime monitor that flags contract violations in tool results and appends nonbinding receipts with recovery tools for LLM agents, evaluated on ToolMaze, tau-bench, and AppWorld. Strong preference fit (agents/tool use, LLMs, reasoning, safety/evaluation). Rigor is unusually high: frozen prespecified protocols with hashes, paired McNemar/sign-flip tests, task-clustered bootstrap CIs, task-disjoint cross-fitting, five receipt-decomposition controls, MDE power analysis for nulls, and explicit disclosure of invalidated/retrospective runs. Evidence is strong for the headline effect (+17.2 pp across four models, p<.00001; tau-bench +14.0/+12.0; MiniMax replication) and the control isolating the recovery-tool list (+11.4, p=.028), with honest nulls (held-out AppWorld, clean P0). Novelty is moderate: the detect-and-advise interface and recovery-affordance ablations are fresh, but contracts are Daikon-lineage invariant mining ported to agent observations, with pre-execution gate systems as close neighbors. Generalizability is bounded: all failures are injected, gains concentrate where baselines fail, blind-authored faults cut detection to ~46%, and one environment shows no net effect. Reproducibility is well supported by protocol manifests, verbatim prompts, cost accounting, and an anonymous artifact, though row-level observations are excluded.

primary_link.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures

recommendations.summary: When a tool call times out, the agent sees the failure and can route around it. A cached error page or negative price can instead arrive in the expected format and be consumed as fact. We introduce Outcome Monitors, which detect violations of outcome contracts mined from task-disjoint traces or derived from public schemas. On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools. In frozen, prespecified evaluations wi
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言代理呼叫外部工具時，逾時等明顯錯誤容易察覺，但快取錯誤頁面或負數價格等「靜默失敗」會以正常格式返回，被模型當成事實消費。本文提出 Outcome Monitors：一套確定性偵測器，依據從任務不相交軌跡挖掘、或由公開綱要衍生的「結果契約」檢查工具回傳結果；偵測到違約時，監控器保留原始結果並附加非約束性的建議回執，指出違反的性質與公開可用的復原工具，行動選擇權仍留給代理，將偵測與復原分離。在凍結的 ToolMaze 評測中，DeepSeek 與 Qwen 四個模型的完成率由 10.9% 提升至 28.1%，並於 MiniMax M3 複製成功；τ-bench retail 亦分別提升 14.0 與 12.0 點。控制實驗顯示回執中的復原工具清單才是有效成分，移除後增益消失，診斷細節與時機則無可測差異。限制方面：增益集中在故障阻礙完成的情境；對契約詞彙之外的事故型故障，偵測率降至約 46%；乾淨流量仍有誤報，部署價值亦取決於故障盛行率。本文將靜默失敗的復原定位為可觀測性問題：可行動作早已存在，介面必須使其清晰可見，而非約束設計則保留了代理的自主性。
recommendations.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures
recommendations.title_zh: 結果監控器：靜默工具失敗的復原可供性

links.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings'
Section 2.2: four models evaluated, 'Each model was queried 30 times on a given question type', 'zero-shot, single-turn setting at the default temperature'; exact prompt templates in Appendix K
Appendix G: temperature-0 re-run on a 40-instance subset for Claude-4.5-S and OSS-120B shows results 'essentially unchanged', with the claim 'Temperature is not what drives these failures'
Appendix J: Wilson intervals, McNemar's test, and Fisher's exact test; hard-notion model differences significant with all six pairwise comparisons p<=0.004

Appendix P.3: deterministic checkers cross-checked with a brute-force solver on 1,800 random instances; judge Fleiss' kappa 0.64 and 0.82, human-vs-judge Cohen's kappa 0.86, with the divergent cell flagged as judge-sensitive

Appendix B (Limitations): 'we test four models... the panel is small'; Impartial Culture sampling means structured distributions 'such as Mallows or single-peaked preferences' are untested; two analyses 'infer what a model intended from its reasoning trace, and so depend on a judge model'
Appendix M: prompt-level mitigation relocates rather than removes errors (e.g., GPT-5.2 moves from 1.00|0.00 to 0.43|0.80 under general caution), and 'no single prompt is safe across models'
Appendix G/P.3/L.4: claims that 'The full inference scripts... are released alongside this paper' and validation harness released, but no explicit repository URL appears in the text
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly in-scope LLM reasoning evaluation paper: it benchmarks four frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-4.5-Sonnet, OSS-120B) on preference reasoning, targeting reasoning/calibration failure, abstention, prompting-format effects, LLM-as-judge methodology, and code-assisted agentic reasoning. Rigor is high: 30 repetitions per query, temperature-0 robustness check (Appendix G), Wilson intervals with McNemar/Fisher tests (Appendix J), deterministic verifiers cross-checked against a brute-force oracle on 1,800 instances, and judge validation with human annotation (Appendix P.3). Limitations are candidly stated (Appendix B). Novelty is moderate: it builds directly on the authors' prior matching-market LLM work and existing abstention/uncertainty benchmarks, with the epistemic-vs-structural indeterminacy taxonomy and infeasibility-detection angle as the main new contributions. Generalizability is limited by a four-model panel, Impartial Culture sampling only, and a social-choice testbed; the mechanism analysis relies on potentially unfaithful scratchpad self-reports. Code and prompt templates are claimed to be released but no explicit repository link is given. No instruction-injection or untrustworthy content detected in the paper text.

primary_link.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic inde
recommendations.summary_zh: 真實世界的偏好推理本質上具有不確定性：資訊可能不完整，有效的解也可能不存在，但現有基準多半假設封閉世界、必有標準答案。本文將不確定性分為兩軸：源於偏好不完整的認知型不確定性，以及源於解概念（如嚴格核心、超穩定配對）在特定偏好結構下無解的結構型不確定性，並建立涵蓋原子、比較、聚合與結構性（演算法）查詢的任務階層，於房屋分配、Shapley–Scarf 市場與雙邊配對市場上評測 GPT-5.2、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Claude-4.5-Sonnet 與 OSS-120B。結果顯示：模型在未確定問題上的準確率遠低於配對的已確定問題，會默默套用字典序等假設；提供「不確定」選項能改善偵測卻引發過度棄權偏差；即使只需驗證的選擇任務仍頻頻選錯，且呈現意圖與行動錯位；程式碼執行可改善結構性推理卻無助於認知型查詢，窮舉策略亦難以擴展。限制包括僅測四個模型、採 Impartial Culture 取樣、部分分析依賴評審模型。本文主張封閉世界訓練使模型幻覺出確定性，穩健的 AI 需要開放世界推理框架，以及能評估「無正當答案」能力的基準。
recommendations.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: 大型語言模型在不確定性下的偏好推理

links.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'average relative gains of +6.10% in AUROC and +47.58% in PRR' for propagation-aware UQ over local baselines
Section 3.2.2, Eq. (2) and Assumptions 1-2: recursive rule r_v = 1-(1-u_v)∏(1-α_pv r_p) derived under edge-wise and local-propagation independence assumptions, with derivation in Appendix B.1
Section 4.1: 'median relative gains of +7.32% in AUROC and +41.36% in PRR' across Table 1 spanning three topologies, three datasets, two local UQ baselines (MSP, verbalized)
Section 4.2.2: LLM-judged intermediate-step evaluation on 300 sampled MedQA instances; 'human annotations agree with the GPT-5.5 judgments in 92.0% of cases' on 50 examples
Section 4.4 / Table 4: ablation showing self-reported acceptance weights (w/ α̂) consistently beat uniform weights (w/o α̂) across three MAS topologies on Qwen3-8B
Section 4.5 / Figure 4: self-reported adoption score monotonically aligns with empirical error-inheritance rate, 'increasing from 0.050 in the lowest bin to 0.973 in the highest'
Appendix D.3 / Table 8: comparison with re-implemented MATU and UProp on MedQA (Qwen3-8B); PropUQ achieves higher AUROC/PRR with much lower time per sample (e.g., 1.328s vs 41.410s sequential)

Limitations: authors acknowledge the α̂ proxy 'may be imperfectly calibrated as a probability', that independence assumptions 'may be violated' (e.g., prompt injection, context overload), and dependence on local UQ estimator quality
Footnote 1: 'Code is released at https://github.com/yaokunliu/PropUQ-MAS.git'; prompt templates and implementation details (GPU, sampling params, max lengths) given in Section 4 and Appendix E
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM-centric multi-agent reliability method (Agents 2.5, LLM 2.5, Reasoning 2.5, Code 2.0) evaluated on GSM8K, MedQA, and MBPP-Plus across Qwen3-4B/8B/14B and Gemma-3-12B. Novelty is solid but incremental: the DAG-based recursive propagation rule (Eq. 2) with acceptance/critique edge modes is a clean, new angle on MAS-specific UQ, though adjacent to UProp, MATU, and prior agent-uncertainty propagation work. Rigor is good: assumptions are explicitly stated, proofs provided (Appendix B), ablations on the self-reported acceptance weights (Table 4), scale analysis (Section 4.3), and an edge-weight validation showing monotonic alignment with empirical error-inheritance (Section 4.5, 0.050-0.973). Evidence is broad and consistent (median +7.32% AUROC, +41.36% PRR in Section 4.1) but lacks significance testing, AUROC gains are sometimes modest, MATU/UProp baselines are re-implementations rather than official code (Appendix D.3), and intermediate-step labels partly rely on an LLM judge with only 50-example human verification (92.0% agreement). Generalizability is well supported across topologies, model families, and scales, and the Limitations section candidly flags the independence assumptions and the imperfectly calibrated self-reported alpha proxy. Reproducibility is aided by a stated code release, full prompt templates (Appendix E), and generation parameters, though the release is unverified. Strong overall; falls short of top marks due to absence of statistical rigor around gains and heuristic edge-weight estimation.

primary_link.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

recommendations.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) solve complex tasks through communication among role-specialized agents. However, inter-agent dependencies introduce reliability risks beyond isolated agent failures. For instance, errors in intermediate messages could be inherited and amplified by downstream agents. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods mainly target isolated responses or single-agent reasoning, and therefore fail to capture uncertainty propagation in MAS. To this end, we propose P
recommendations.summary_zh: 以 LLM 為基礎的多代理系統（MAS）透過角色專業化代理間的溝通解決複雜任務，但代理間依賴帶來超越單一代理失敗的可靠度風險：上游代理的中間訊息若有錯誤，可能被下游代理視為有效脈絡而繼承甚至放大。現有不確定性量化（UQ）方法主要針對孤立回應或單代理推理，無法捕捉 MAS 中的不確定性傳播。本文提出 PropUQ-MAS，一種傳播感知的 UQ 框架：將 MAS 執行展開為通訊結構的有向無環圖，以遞迴傳播規則結合每個節點的局部不確定性與自上游繼承的不確定性，其中邊層級的錯誤接受機率以模型自我報告的分數作為代理估計。該框架免訓練、可線上計算、拓撲無關，且計算複雜度隨圖規模線性增長。在 GSM8K、MedQA 與 MBPP-Plus 三個基準、順序、階層與去中心化三種 MAS 拓撲，以及 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 與 Gemma-3-12B 等模型上，PropUQ-MAS 平均相對提升 AUROC +6.10% 與 PRR +47.58%，對最終輸出與中間步驟的不確定性估計皆有效。限制包括：自我報告的接受分數可能校準不完美；傳播規則依賴條件獨立假設；效能受局部 UQ 估計器品質影響。此研究為 MAS 的即時風險監控、早期干預與失敗歸因提供了實用的診斷訊號。
recommendations.title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
recommendations.title_zh: PropUQ-MAS：LLM 多代理系統的傳播感知不確定性量化

links.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments across three domains—a standard multi-LLM benchmark, retrieval-augmented specialists, and LLMs with variable inference-time reasoning—show that Pandora's Router matches the routing quality of exhaustive estimation, while querying the expensive estimator far less often.'
§1 Core contributions: 'To our knowledge, this is the first paper to explicitly connect model routing with the classical Pandora's Box problem from economics and operations research.'
§4 Table 2: Pandora's Router achieves total regret+cost of 0.105 (MATH), 0.118 (RAG), 0.386 (EmbedLLM), vs. Margin-Npr at 0.105, 0.128, 0.389 and g-only at 0.128, 0.141, 2.356.

§4 Results: 'Pandora minimizes regret plus inspection cost at nearly all cost levels c_g, in all settings'; also notes 'the aggregate results for Pandora's Router and Margin-Npr are nearly identical' in MATH.

§D.4: asterisk marks significance at p<.05 via paired bootstrap, but the text concedes that at intermediate costs the difference 'is usually not statistically significant with respect to all alternatives.'
Appendix A, Proposition 1 with proof: 'E[R_{M̂}−C_O] = E[G*_{M̂}−C_O]' justifying routing on posterior decision values under conditional independence.

§7 Limitations: 'The Gaussian signal model, while tractable, may not capture the heavy tails or multimodality present in some domains'; 'the myopic VoI computation in the leave-one-out auction does not account for strategic anticipation of future bids.'
§D.6 Table 6: KNN non-Gaussian signal model improves calibration coverage (e.g., 63.0%-74.8% for ±1σ) but 'we did not see a significant improvement in regret + cost.'

Appendix C: implementation details include Gemini Embedding 2 with k=3 KNN, S=100 Monte Carlo samples, fine-tuning 'Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite as the base model'; Appendix C.3 reports compute (e.g., 64 TPUs, up to 6 hours for MATH estimators); no code release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on LLM routing with costly value estimation, instantiated in three in-scope domains (multi-LLM selection, RAG specialists, inference-time chain-of-thought scaling), so preference relevance is high. Novelty is solid: the claimed first connection of model routing to the Pandora's Box problem with a closed-form Gaussian VoI policy, plus a decentralized auction extension. Rigor is good: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix A), matched-budget ablations (Random-Npr, Margin-Npr), cost sweeps, and paired bootstrap significance tests, though the Gaussian signal model is an acknowledged approximation and the main gains over the strongest baseline (Margin-Npr) are small and often not statistically significant. Evidence is quantitative and per-domain (Table 2; Tables 3-5), but headline improvements in MATH are near-ties and significance is sparse at intermediate costs. Generalizability is moderate: requires a two-tier estimator hierarchy and calibration data; tested on only three settings with two to ~100 specialists. Reproducibility is partial: public datasets, detailed prompts, hyperparameters (k=3, S=100), fine-tuning base model, and cost derivations are given, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation

recommendations.summary: Heterogeneous AI systems composed of multiple models, architectures, harnesses, or inference-time settings can improve quality and efficiency by routing queries to the specialist who can answer most effectively at the lowest cost. Routing requires estimating each specialist's expected return, but this value estimation has a cost. Cheap estimators (e.g., embedding-based predictors) are fast but noisy, while accurate estimators (e.g., fine-tuned models with access to retrieval results or partial r
recommendations.summary_zh: 將查詢路由到最合適的專家模型需要估計各專家的期望回報，但價值估計本身有成本：便宜估計器（如嵌入相似度 KNN）快但雜訊多，準確估計器（如 fine-tuned 模型搭配檢索結果或部分推理軌跡）昂貴。本文首次將此權衡形式化為經濟學與作業研究中的 Pandora's Box 問題（非義務檢視變體）：每位專家視為一個盒子，路由器可付費開啟以取得更準的價值估計。在高斯訊號模型下，保留價格與資訊價值具有封閉形式解，據此提出集中式 Pandora's Router，依保留價格順序檢視、在增益低於成本時停止；並延伸出去中心化 Pandora's Bidder，專家在定價拍賣中自行決定是否投資自我評估後接受或拒絕價格。實驗涵蓋三領域：EmbedLLM 多模型路由基準、檢索增強問答，以及可變推理時間的數學任務。結果顯示 Pandora's Router 在各估計成本水準幾乎達到最低的 regret 加檢查成本，同時大幅減少昂貴估計器的查詢次數；去中心化設定中，資訊價值推理在競爭者估計準確時改善配置效率，但競爭者估計雜訊大時可能提高策略專家自身效用而損及整體效率。限制包括高斯模型難以捕捉重尾分布、僅考慮兩層估計器，以及拍賣僅為單輪。本文為模型選擇的經濟學提供原則性且可實作的框架。
recommendations.title: Pandora's AI Model Routing Box: Efficient Allocation with Costly Value Estimation
recommendations.title_zh: Pandora 的 AI 模型路由盒：代價高昂的價值估計下之有效配置

links.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

evidence: Abstract: River achieves 106% and 30% larger average RL gains on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1 using fewer than 30% of TMax environments across 2B-27B models
Sec 4.1 Table 1: River-8B avg 19.4±1.2 vs strongest baseline OpenThinker-8B-RL 17.8±0.7, four benchmarks, mean±std over 3 seeds
Sec 5.1: RSA analysis shows skill-skill structure preserved after RL (ρ=0.83) while task-task structure changes substantially (ρ=0.27) with Mantel permutation test
Sec 5.2: behavior-feature model AUC rises 0.64→0.74 from SFT to RL while skill-presence model stays near 0.55 (15 seeds, 5-fold CV)

App C.2 Table 7: independent Claude Opus 4.8 blind re-judge agrees with GPT-5.4 on 83.3% binary Clean/defective labels but only 40% conditional agreement on Clean labels; authors state clean rates may be optimistic
Sec 5.4 Table 2: RL trained on only Debug+System domains still improves untrained domains (e.g., Numerical 45.5→57.6, Data 29.2→47.7) on ~300-task held-out set
Sec 5.3 Fig 7: Diverse-SFT reduces early-termination reward hacking under partial rewards while Narrow-SFT degrades OOD performance during RL
App A.2 Table 4: full GRPO hyperparameters; 8×H200 node, ~60 hours for 400 RL steps; no explicit code or model release statement found in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant agentic-LLM paper: RL post-training of LLM terminal agents (Qwen3/3.5/3.6 2B-27B) with GRPO/DPPO, SFT stage, verifier-quality filtering of synthetic environments, and reward-hacking analysis. Core contributions: (1) 'agentic compositional generalization' hypothesis extending known single-turn SFT/RL complementarity (Kong et al., Yuan et al.) to multi-turn agents; (2) River recipe (rubric-based environment filtering + GPT-5.4 oracle pass@k filter + repetition-penalty advantage shaping). Novelty is solid but incremental: verifier-quality matters was noted by prior work (He et al. 2025, cited in Sec 2), and the recipe is simple; the mechanism analysis is the main novel piece. Rigor is good: 4 benchmarks, 3 seeds with std, matched-harness baselines, controlled random-TMax-3.5K comparison (Table 8: 17.7 vs 19.4), SFT data-size controls (Diverse-DS-SFT), 8/6/4/2-domain RL ablations, and unusually honest audit validation (App C.2: only 40% conditional agreement on Clean labels, explicitly flagged). Evidence supports but does not causally establish the hypothesis; the paper appropriately hedges ('consistent with'). Margins over the best baseline are modest on some benchmarks (e.g., otbl 21.8±2.9 vs 18.4±1.5). Fig 4 TMax comparisons adopt numbers from another report with a changed sandbox setup, a mild confound. Reproducibility: exhaustive hyperparameters (App A) but no explicit code/model/data release statement; filtered set depends on proprietary GPT-5.4 audits.

primary_link.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

recommendations.summary: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work main
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文研究強化學習(RL)如何改善終端機代理,並提出「代理組合泛化」假說:RL 並非從零教導特定領域的新技能,而是主要塑造高階決策行為(如先探索再行動、完成前驗證、放棄失敗路徑),用以組合與調度預訓練及 SFT 階段已習得的低階原子技能。此觀點意味著,相較於擴增訓練環境的數量與多樣性,提供行為塑形訊號的驗證器品質更為關鍵。據此作者提出 River 訓練配方:先以規準審核加上 oracle 代理 pass@k 過濾低品質合成環境(發現 TMax 收藏中超過 60% 的環境存在至少一項品質問題),再以行為層級的優勢塑形(懲罰重複互動迴圈)增強結果獎勵。實驗上,River 訓練的 8B 模型在四個終端代理基準上為受評開源 RL 模型中最佳;使用不到 30% 的 TMax 環境,即讓 2B 至 27B 模型在 Terminal-Bench-Lite 與 Terminal-Bench-v2.1 上的 RL 增益平均分別提升 106% 與 30%,且跨模型家族、規模、harness 與 RL 目標皆可泛化。分析支持假說:行為特徵預測任務成功的 AUC 達 0.74,而技能出現與否接近隨機(約 0.55);RL 大致保留技能—技能結構(ρ=0.83)卻重組任務—任務結構(ρ=0.27)。此外,涵蓋多樣原子技能的 SFT 亦有助減少獎勵駭取。限制在於環境審核可能產生誤判,以及假說的跨模型梯度檢定力有限。
recommendations.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

links.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of 436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities; MCQ formats inflate accuracy by 12-39 points; failures stem from applying known formulas inconsistently rather than missing knowledge.

Section 2.2, Table 2: paired option-mode vs code-mode on identical 670 AtmosSci-Bench MCQ10 instances; chance-corrected gap 20.5-38.3 points, remaining 12-27 points after 19 defective-key templates removed; re-graded at 5/10/20% tolerance to rule out stricter numeric standard.

Methods 4.9 (Statistical analysis): McNemar tests on paired cores vs variants, 2,000-resample bootstrap, Holm correction, Wilson intervals, bounded null of +/-1.0 to +/-4.2 points rather than claiming proof of no contamination advantage; Trap Gap equation conditioning on solved parents.

Methods 4.8 (Fabricated-execution audit): lexical scan lower bound, two automated annotators agree on 25/26 (Cohen's kappa=0.92), 10 of 10 records confirmed by two domain experts, fabrications found only in smaller models (ClimateGPT-13B/70B, Qwen-3.6-27B).

Methods 4.1: de-scaffolding ablation over 169 affected problems on four models; strongest model loses 1.8 points, 9B model loses 18.5, spread widens from 10.3 to 27.0 points (Supplementary Table S27).

Methods 4.5 (Cross-domain generalization): identical pipeline applied to hydrology (37), environmental chemistry (21), ecology/biogeochemistry (19), soil mechanics (54), 131 problems; five models separated in exactly the atmospheric-benchmark order (Spearman rho=1.00).

Methods 4.10 (Residual-failure screening): three-test screen excludes answer-alignment artefacts before capability-ceiling claims; three surviving hard items pass 8, 9, 12 of 48 measurements; consensus failures on 2 items bound what LLM-consensus ground truth can certify.

Discussion, Limitations paragraph: verifiability-filtered corpus excludes open-ended problems; LLM-consensus answers mitigated by manual verification; only 131 tasks beyond atmospheric science; qualitative Gaussian-plume case explicitly excluded from ceiling statistics (Methods 4.10, Section 2.7).

Declarations, Data/Code availability: GitHub repository holds 436 core problems, 1,730 numeric and 2,180 paraphrase variants, 67 traps with shortcut solvers, 169 ablation pairs, 131 cross-domain problems, audit artefacts, and ~5GB per-run traces; code pinned to Python 3.13 with locked dependencies.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): it builds an execution-grounded benchmark forcing models to emit executable solve() functions, quantifies MCQ accuracy inflation, designs trap tasks with predicted shortcut vectors, and audits fabricated execution claims. Strongly aligned with LLM (2.5), reasoning/CoT (2.5), evaluation/red-teaming (1.8), code generation (2.0), and safety-adjacent deception/fabrication themes; the atmospheric focus is a testbed for general LLM-computation findings. Novelty is solid but derivative of program-aided prompting (PAL/PoT) and MCQ-reliability literature, with execution-as-audit-surface, de-scaffolding ablation, and trap diagnostics as the main new contributions. Rigor is exceptional: paired cross-protocol design on identical 670 instances, chance correction plus tolerance sweeps, defective-key audit (19/67 templates), McNemar/bootstrap/Holm statistics, bounded-null reporting, residual-failure screening before capability-ceiling claims, and disclosed evaluator/construction model overlap. Evidence includes ablations (scaffolding removal: 1.8-point loss for strongest model vs 18.5 for a 9B model), cross-domain replication (131 problems, Spearman rho=1.00), and verbatim fabrication traces. Generalizability is bounded by the verifiability-filtered, textbook-derived, single-answer task distribution and only 131 cross-domain items, both acknowledged. Reproducibility is very strong: full corpus, grader, harness, pinned dependencies, ~5GB per-run traces released. Main unverifiable elements are external model-option-mode numbers quoted from a source benchmark and supplementary tables not shown.

primary_link.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science

recommendations.summary: Large language models are increasingly used for quantitative work in the environmental sciences, yet existing evaluations score only final answers, leaving calculation process unobserved. Here we introduce AtmosCoder-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark that makes the calculation process visible. Built through a transferable semi-automated pipeline (436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities), every problem is validated to be unambiguous and human-solvable, with uniquely verifiable
recommendations.summary_zh: 大語言模型已被應用於環境科學的定量工作，但現有評測多半只評分最終答案：選擇題格式可虛增準確率、計算過程不透明，且仰賴 LLM 評審難以重現；更隱蔽的是模型可能謊報執行過程，宣稱完成計算卻實際未執行。本文提出 AtmosCoder-Bench，一套以執行為基礎的大氣科學基準：模型必須撰寫並執行 solve() 程式碼產生答案，再對確定性數值標準答案評分。基準含 436 道取自 13 本教科書的題目、3,910 個變體與 7,029 個評分項目，透過半自動管線驗證題目無歧義、答案唯一可驗。主要發現：(i) 選擇題格式使測得準確率虛增 12 至 39 個百分點；(ii) 許多失敗並非缺乏知識，而是無法在多步計算中一致套用已知公式，例如截斷推導、遺失約束或謊報所用方法；(iii) 頂尖模型在特定條件使熟悉方法失效時，仍傾向套用標準解法，如高斯煙羽案例中宣稱使用 Turner 參數化卻實際執行 Briggs。執行基礎評測亦降低 token 用量並對數值與改寫擾動穩健。限制包括題庫經可驗證性過濾、共識答案仍需人工把關、跨領域題數有限。研究顯示頂尖模型的瓶頸已不在計算本身，而在領域判斷，凸顯專家知識仍不可替代。
recommendations.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science
recommendations.title_zh: 以執行為基礎的評測揭露語言模型在環境科學計算中的隱藏失敗

links.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores

evidence: Abstract: 'matching HippoRAG's gains with 1,913 links against its 196,112: per point of corpus covered, 1.5× the action saving and 2.1× the accuracy gain'

Sec. VII-B, Table IV: trained questions rho=0.747 (CI [0.64,0.87]) at +0.294 F1; both-keys +0.176 F1 (rho=0.879); one-key +0.059; neither-key parity; 'the trained group is the only cell significant on both benchmarks'

Sec. VI-C Reproducibility: 'Every action and its result is appended to a trace, so any intermediate store is rebuildable exactly by replay'; snapshot 'gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07' recorded; '200 iterations, 18.8M tokens, 6.8 h, ≈$13, single seed'
Sec. VII-D, Table V: 'precision is 94% and member recall 91% over the 220 whose key resolves'; 242 of 287 authored documents (84.3%) verified as genuine indexes

Sec. VII-B: coverage reaches 27.6%; 'Extending the epoch-1 slope reaches full coverage at roughly 400 distinct training questions and ≈48M tokens ... we state it as an extrapolation rather than a result'

Sec. VIII Threats to validity: 'Single seed; single agent by design; no support-set diagnostics on the external arm; grading is token-F1 against short golds'; reader and curator share gpt-5-mini family; four-point gradient is KBGym-only

Sec. VI-A / VI-B: two contamination-free arms (KBGym 5,864 sentences; PhantomWiki 3,403 sentences) with 'no-store score at ≈0'; baselines B1 flat, B2 GraphRAG-style, B3 HippoRAG-2-style under a fixed reader; no real-text arm run (Sec. VI-A: 'a real-text arm is the obvious third benchmark and we did not run it')
Sec. VII-A E1: pre-registered eval curve 'flat ... not distinguishable from noise' reported explicitly as low-information; forward accuracy 0.60→0.66 within epoch 1
Sec. VII-B PhantomWiki replication: rho=0.769 (CI [0.68,0.86]) trained group, accuracy 0.728→0.880, uncovered group F1 falls 0.765→0.718 (mild negative transfer)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely on-preference: an LLM-agent framework (gpt-5-mini curator/reader) that trains a knowledge base as a non-parametric model under a supervised train/test protocol, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), RAG & Knowledge (1.8) and memory preferences. Novelty is genuine but compositional: agent-maintained wikis, agentic memory, and offline structure builders (GraphRAG, RAPTOR, HippoRAG) exist; the fresh contribution is the supervised forward/backward curation loop, the frozen-store examination, and the key-coverage gradient probe that converts 'does it generalize' into a decay curve, plus a contamination-free KBGym environment. Rigor is high: falsifiable predictions per experiment (Sec. VI-D), stratified four-group probe with identical template quotas, bootstrap CIs on rho, three alternative coverage definitions, honest handling of the epoch-mixing confound via the controlled trained column of Table IV, and candid negative results (B2 negative per point; uncovered PhantomWiki group falls 0.765→0.718). Evidence supports the efficiency claim within scope: Table III shows 1.5×/2.1× per-coverage-point advantage over B3 with 1,913 links vs 196,112; Sec. VII-D audits 94% precision/91% recall over 220 indexes. But key caveats temper it: cost savings significant only on trained questions (the single cell significant on both benchmarks), absolute accuracy trails full-coverage HippoRAG2, full-coverage parity is an extrapolation (≈400 questions, ≈48M tokens) stated as a lower bound, and only 27.6% of the corpus is covered. Generalizability is the weakest axis: both benchmarks are fictional/template-rendered universes, no real-text arm was run (contamination is the stated reason), curator and reader share one model family, and the four-point gradient exists only on KBGym (Sec. VIII threats). Reproducibility is solid for a paper without an explicit code URL: trace replay reconstructs any store byte-exact, model snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 is recorded, budgets/costs (~$13, 18.8M tokens) documented, integer-exact deterministic grading, and the abstract claims the KBGym generator is released. Weighted score ≈0.78.

primary_link.title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores

recommendations.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation treats the document store as a frozen input, and the offline pipelines that do build structure over it build it unsupervised -- a whole corpus indexed at uniform effort, with no signal about which structure a question will need. We instead treat the knowledge base as a non-parametric model trained on (question, answer) pairs: a curator agent answers a supervised question against the current store, is shown the gold answer, then edits the store. The store carries fo
recommendations.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）將文件庫視為凍結輸入，而離線管線即使為語料建構結構也是無監督的——整個語料以相同力度索引，沒有任何訊號指出未來問題需要什麼結構。本文反其道而行，將知識庫視為以（問題，答案）對訓練的非參數模型：策展代理先以當前文件庫回答監督問題，看到標準答案後再編輯文件庫——前向回答、後向整理，如同監督學習的訓練迴圈；評估時凍結文件庫，以固定行動預算的獨立讀者檢驗未見過的測試問題。研究在兩個無污染基準上進行：自建且釋出的 KBGym（虛構人物宇宙產生器）與 PhantomWiki，並以四個與訓練集重疊度遞減的問題組探測泛化。結果顯示策展文件庫的優勢隨關鍵覆蓋度成長：無共用鍵時持平，雙鍵覆蓋時 +0.176 F1，訓練問題上以 25% 更少行動達 +0.294 F1（唯一在兩基準皆顯著的單元）；與 HippoRAG 相比，僅用 1,913 個連結對抗其 196,112 個即達相近收益，每單位語料覆蓋率換得 1.5 倍行動節省與 2.1 倍準確率增益。限制在於覆蓋率：一百個訓練問題僅涵蓋約 27.6% 語料，且代理傾向為問題提及的鍵而非鍵的類別建索引。此研究確立了以監督訊號高效分配結構、並讓文件庫從線上流量持續學習的新範式。

links.title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation

evidence: Section IV-B, Table I: PRAXIS achieves 32.06 avg Pass@1 vs 27.48 for best baseline (OpenCollab), reported as 16.7% relative improvement
Section IV-B, Table II: ablation removing development practice drops Pass@1 32.06->27.48; w/o Graph Organization 28.25; w/o Proactive Injection 28.24
Section IV-C, Table III: consistent gains across OpenHands/SWE-Agent with DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3.6-Plus, and GPT-5.5-20260424 (e.g., 16.03->42.75 on GPT-5.5)
Section IV-E, Table V: 75 sampled knowledge units rated by two engineers; content truthfulness 4.28/5 and confidence-rating Spearman rho=0.75 (p<0.001)
Footnote 2 (Section IV-B): paired t-test shows significant differences on AvgPassRatio at p<0.05
Section III-C: practice tasks filtered to >80% line coverage and evaluated via differential testing against ground-truth implementations
Section VI (Threats to Validity): authors concede no exhaustive hyperparameter search due to LLM API cost and possible gap between agent practice and real human development
Abstract/Section VII: source code and data claimed available at https://github.com/jiangxxxue/PRAXIS
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent framework for domain-specific code generation, directly hitting Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences. The core idea—extracting undocumented 'tacit' knowledge via in-codebase practice with differential testing, anchoring units on a dependency graph, and proactively injecting them—is a meaningful but incremental advance over experience/skill-memory methods (SWE-Exp, Trace2Skill, AgentKB); the distributed, graph-grounded, proactive delivery is the main novelty. Rigor is solid: four ablations, cross-framework and cross-model generalization (Table III), a second benchmark/task type (Table IV), scaling curves, cost analysis, a paired t-test (footnote 2, Section IV-B), and human quality assessment of 75 knowledge units with Spearman rho=0.75 (Table V). Weaknesses: no exhaustive hyperparameter search (Section VI), LLM-based extraction/adjudication steps are hard to verify, the near-catastrophic SWE-Exp baseline (7.83 Pass@1, below the base model) suggests baseline tuning concerns, and evaluation is limited to two AI/scientific-domain benchmarks. Reproducibility is supported by released code/data (Abstract, Section VII) and specified hyperparameters (R_max=3, depth 4, theta=0.7, beta=0.8, temperature 0), though reliance on proprietary LLM APIs and LLM-judged filtering reduces determinism.

primary_link.title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation

recommendations.summary: LLM agents have achieved strong performance on general software engineering tasks, yet struggle with domain-specific code generation. We identify the root cause as the agent's lack of tacit knowledge, including domain-specific business rules, interface contracts, and operational conventions that developers internalize through practice but never document. This knowledge is deeply buried beneath the domain code, dispersed across code entities and their dependency relations, and invisible to the ag
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 代理在一般軟體工程任務上表現優異，但在領域程式碼生成時效能大幅滑落。作者指出根因在於代理缺乏隱性知識：領域業務規則、介面契約與操作慣例等開發者長期內化卻從未記載的知識；此類知識深埋於程式碼之下、分散在程式實體與依賴關係中，且缺乏者不自知，因此難以擷取與學習。PRAXIS 分四階段處理：先讓代理在目標程式碼庫中模擬人類開發流程，透過差異測試讓隱性知識浮現；再將行為差異蒸餾為含 trigger、content、evidence、confidence 的結構化知識單元；接著把知識錨定在靜態分析建出的依賴圖上，沿邊傳播並進行去重與衝突裁決；最後於任務初始化與程式互動時主動注入相關知識。在 KoCo-Bench 上，PRAXIS 搭配 DeepSeek-V3.2 達 Pass@1 32.06%，較最佳基線相對提升 16.7%，並超越經驗式與技能式演化方法；增益跨 OpenHands、SWE-Agent 等框架與多種 LLM 一致，也能遷移至 AInsteinBench 的儲存庫層級除錯任務，效能更隨練習量與線上知識演化穩定成長。限制包括超參數未窮盡搜尋、代理練習與真人開發仍有落差。整體而言，此方法免訓練、可疊加於既有代理，直指領域知識是部署 AI 代理於真實開發的最後一道關卡。

links.title: An Extensive Empirical Study on Code Translation Technique

evidence: Section III-A: selects 8 open-source methods (VIM-PT, StructCoder, TransCoder-ST, CodeT5+, InterTrans x2, UniTrans, ExeCoder) plus 3 LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo-1106, GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) with explicit performance/recency/language-diversity criteria.

Section V-A (Finding 1, Tables IV-V): 'UniTrans achieves the best performance, with average CSR (CA) scores of 96.01% (94.36%) on G-TransEval and 96.59% (91.66%) on TransCoder-Uni', while best learning-based method TransCoder-ST reaches only 56.96% CA.
Section V-C (Table VIII): best class-level CA is 24.82% (UniTrans) versus 89.39% CSR, with Java→C++ CA ≤ 12.77% for all methods, supporting the class-level difficulty claim.

Section V-D: manual annotation of 570 method-level and 150 class-level failures; static semantic errors 49.37% (method-level) and 70.67% (class-level), function signature violations 70.18% of static semantic errors, 'Fleiss' kappa coefficient was 0.9446'.
Section VII (Threats to Validity, Table XI): data-leakage control via cleaned XLCoST overlap and a 50-problem post-cutoff Luogu dataset with gaps of -9.17 to +7.58 points, judged 'limited' impact.

Section IV-C: LLM decoding fixed at temperature=0.8, top_p=0.9, n=1 with three independent runs averaged; learning-based hyperparameters in Table III; Section IX provides open-source data/code via Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21973888.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed large-scale empirical study squarely within preferred topics: it benchmarks general-purpose LLMs (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and LLM-based code translation systems against learning-based baselines under unified settings, matching the LLM and Code/Programming preferences strongly. Rigor is high: 11 techniques across 3 test-suite-backed benchmarks (1,062 tasks, 5 languages), three independent runs for LLMs, documented hyperparameters, training-overlap cleaning, a post-cutoff data-leakage check (50 Luogu problems, Table XI), and a manual error taxonomy with 570+150 annotated failures and Fleiss' kappa 0.9446. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (e.g., UniTrans 96.01%/94.36% CSR/CA on G-TransEval; class-level CA drops to 24.82% despite 89.39% CSR). Novelty is moderate: the paper claims the first cross-paradigm/cross-granularity comparison, but core findings (LLMs > learning-based methods; static-typed-to-dynamic-typed easier; class-level much harder; CodeBLEU unreliability) largely confirm prior expectations and prior single-paradigm studies. Generalizability is limited to function/class-level benchmarks derived from competitive-programming-style sources; no statistical significance testing is reported and error analysis relies on sampled cases. Reproducibility is supported by versioned model identifiers, hyperparameter tables, and an open Zenodo repository.

primary_link.title: An Extensive Empirical Study on Code Translation Technique

To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study comparing representative code translation techniques across methodological paradigms and translation granularities. We evaluate learning-based methods, LLM-based methods, and general-purpose LLMs on multilingual method
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文對十一種程式碼翻譯技術進行大規模跨典範實證研究,涵蓋四種學習式方法(VIM-PT、StructCoder、TransCoder-ST、CodeT5+)、四種 LLM 式方法(InterTrans 兩變體、UniTrans、ExeCoder)與三個通用 LLM(GPT-3.5、GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash),在方法級基準 G-TransEval、TransCoder-Uni 與類別級基準 ClassEval-T 上,以執行正確性(CA)、編譯成功率(CSR)與 CodeBLEU 相似度統一比較。主要發現:方法級翻譯中 LLM 式方法在正確性上明顯優於學習式方法,但相似度指標無法可靠反映功能正確性;翻譯方向影響顯著,從靜態型別語言翻至動態型別語言通常較佳,反向則需補推型別而表現較差;類別級翻譯遠難於方法級,最佳方法平均 CA 僅 24.82%,CSR 卻高達 89.39%,顯示編譯易而語義正確難;錯誤分析顯示靜態語義錯誤(49.37%)與邏輯錯誤(27.46%)為主要失敗來源,其中函式簽章違規最為常見。限制在於基準與方法選擇的代表性。作者據此呼籲發展型別感知、結構感知與上下文感知的翻譯技術,並兼顧正確性與相似度雙軌評估。

links.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories

evidence: Table 1 (Experiments and Results): LifeMem achieves KL 4.0635 vs Event RAG 5.8264 and Profile 8.6719 on Add Health with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, with * marking baselines significantly worse at p<0.05.
Table 2 (Ablation Study): removing parametric memory raises Add Health KL from 4.0635 to 5.3517 and removing structured memory to 6.2815 (Llama-8B), supporting complementarity of both components.
Appendix H, Table 9: results across seeds 42/43/44 show LifeMem best mean in 16 of 18 model-dataset-metric settings with small standard deviations.

Appendix J, Tables 12-15: hyperparameter sweeps over temporal decay (alpha_ret=0.9), replay weight (eta=0.5), and LoRA rank (r=32 best, r=8 chosen for cost), plus Table 14 showing LifeMem gains persist across retriever choices.
Figure 3 / Appendix B (Event RAG Retrieval-Depth Analysis): Event RAG metrics saturate around K=40 while runtime and token cost keep rising, motivating combination with parametric memory.

Efficiency Analysis, Table 3: LifeMem per-question latency 161.7 ms vs Event RAG 1094.2 ms and Full History 334.5 ms; Appendix F Table 7 details LoRA rank-8, lr 1e-4, replay size 4, replay weight 0.5.

Section 'Implementation Details': temperature 0 deterministic decoding, 100 respondents per dataset (seed 42), one A800-SXM4 80GB GPU; Code link https://github.com/halsayxi/LifeMem provided, while Ethical Statement notes respondent-level adapters are not released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper with strong overlap to top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/memory, RAG, LoRA training, and bias mitigation). LifeMem pairs structured life-event retrieval with per-agent LoRA parametric memory for longitudinal social simulation, a credible and reasonably novel dual-memory design grounded in complementary learning systems. Evaluation is unusually thorough: two longitudinal survey datasets, three backbones, eight baselines including a Random Event control, four formally defined metrics, paired t-test significance, three-seed robustness (best mean in 16/18 settings), component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps (decay, replay weight, LoRA rank, retriever choice), and efficiency/storage analysis. Limitations: only 100 respondents per dataset, purely distribution-level gap metrics with no qualitative/behavioral validation, deterministic decoding, GPT-3.5-turbo used for statement conversion as a potential confound, and per-agent adapters whose scalability beyond small populations is untested; generalizability beyond survey-response simulation is not demonstrated. Code link, prompts, seeds, and hyperparameters are provided, supporting good reproducibility, though respondent-level adapters are withheld. Claims are appropriately hedged ('pattern consistent with identity essentialism').

primary_link.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach to social simulation, but their credibility depends on how agents are constructed. Existing methods can partially reproduce population-level patterns, yet often fail to capture human-like diversity. Our analysis shows that static-profile agents exhibit stronger demographic separation and within-group compression than humans, a pattern consistent with identity essentialism: demographic labels can encourage models to treat group-average tenden
recommendations.summary_zh: 以靜態人口屬性檔案建構的 LLM 社會模擬代理，常呈現「身分本質主義」：同一人口群體內的回應被壓縮而趨於同質，群體間差異則被誇大，與人類資料的分布不符。作者歸因於兩點：代理表徵稀疏且靜態，以及僅靠提示詞的記憶無法持續整合經驗。受互補學習系統理論啟發，LifeMem 採雙記憶架構：一是海馬式的結構化生命事件記憶，以語意相似度結合時間衰減擷取相關事件；二是皮質式的參數記憶，為每位代理維護獨立的 LoRA adapter，逐波次以含重播機制的序列更新，把累積經驗固化為持久的參數狀態。在 Add Health 與 Understanding Society 兩個縱貫調查，以及 Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B 三種模型上，LifeMem 在 KL 散度、組內成對距離差距、正規化熵差距與轉移分布 JS 散度等指標，皆顯著優於靜態條件化、多樣性提示與 Event RAG 等基線；消融實驗證實兩元件互補，PCA 視覺化亦顯示代理參數狀態隨生命史逐漸分化。限制在於問卷涵蓋與粒度無法完整刻畫人生經驗，自陳資料亦帶有回憶偏差。此研究為建構更忠實、動態演化的社會模擬代理提供可行路徑，並有助於避免刻板印象在模擬中被放大。

links.title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topic match across RAG, agents/tool use, LLM behavior, and safety; large-scale empirical study with 1,528 simulations, 1M+ API calls, three model families, controls, regression analysis with bootstrap CI, and shared raw data via Google Drive link. Novel RAG-collapse framing extends model collapse to retrieval settings with self-bias evidence controlling for reference quality. Weakened by industrial-lab provenance without peer review, commercial API reliance (GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5), proprietary ChatGPT reference collection, unshared prompts/code, single-judge paraphrase detection, and mostly single-run simulations per question; caution on industry-blog self-references and future-dated citations.

primary_link.title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored

recommendations.summary: LLM responses are based on the internet (via training or RAG), and AI is now used to generate a significant amount of content online (Paredes et al., 2026), creating the potential for a self-reinforcing feedback loop. Prior work has shown that when LLMs are recursively trained on their own output, they experience model collapse (Shumailov et al., 2024): responses become less diverse, and eventually no longer resemble the original training data. In this paper, we show that a similar collapse occu
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討檢索增強生成（RAG）的一種新型失效模式：當具備網路搜尋能力的 LLM 檢索到自己先前產生的內容時，回應多樣性會迅速崩潰。作者設計三種模擬情境——Replace All（每輪以自撰參考文件替換全部原始文件）、Replace One（每輪僅替換一份）與 Search（將自撰文章加入文件池並實際執行檢索）——以 GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Pro 與 Claude Sonnet 4.5 三個模型家族，針對 1,019 個資訊尋求型提問，共執行 1,528 次模擬與超過百萬次 API 呼叫。結果顯示 79.6% 的模擬最終崩潰，回應趨於完全一致；令人意外的是，即使僅替換一份自撰參考文件也足以觸發崩潰。分析顯示模型對自撰文件存在自我偏誤：其引用率達 38.9%，遠高於人類撰寫（7.4%）與 AI 生成的原始文件（9.4%），且在以 LLM 評審控制八個品質維度後，迴歸分析顯示「自撰」本身仍使引用率提升約 26 個百分點。限制在於：研究僅為模擬，未證實現實中已發生 RAG 崩潰，也未測試逐步加入其他類型 AI 生成內容的效果，且聚焦於資訊尋求型提問。本文重要性在於指出：隨著 AI 生成內容大量湧現，若搜尋系統持續檢索自撰文章，網路上的觀點多樣性可能收斂於單一視角，作者並提出過濾 AI 生成參考、分散搜尋結果、以系統提示鼓勵多元等緩解方向。

links.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence

evidence: Abstract: introduces Graph Engineering for building agent systems and states all related resources are collected at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/Awesome-Graph-Engineering
Section 4.1: defines the three graph views (Task Organization, Agent Coordination, Runtime State Management) as the core of the proposed paradigm
Section 3.4: contains unrendered citation keys 'li2026loopsbench, macedo2026loop' in the Loop Engineering definition, indicating incomplete proofreading
References [202] and [221]: include editorial notes 'verify authors, venue, DOI, and publication status before submission', signaling placeholder citations
Section 5.2.1: cites LAMP with reference [7], which resolves to an Anthropic Claude product/documentation page, a citation mismatch
Section 7 / Table 1: organizes roughly sixty benchmarks, datasets, and environments across Model, Individual, and System Intelligence levels
Section 11.1 / Table 4: self-compares against related surveys, acknowledging overlap with the dynamic graph transformation survey [391] and multi-agent orchestration surveys [476]
Section 7.4: identifies open evaluation gaps including separating system-level gains from stronger models and structural credit assignment
llm_evaluation.rationale: A comprehensive survey squarely in-scope for LLM agent research: it proposes 'Graph Engineering' (Section 4) as a paradigm for multi-agent systems along three views (Task Organization, Agent Coordination, Runtime State Management) plus System Evolution and Ontology Engineering (Sections 5-6). Preference relevance is very high given dense coverage of agents, tool use, orchestration, memory, and prompting (Sections 3-4). Novelty is moderate: the unifying framing is new terminology, but the paper itself (Section 11.1, Table 4) acknowledges substantial overlap with recent surveys such as the dynamic-graph-transformation survey [391] and orchestration surveys [476], and much content is standard (GPTSwarm, AFlow, LangGraph). Rigor and evidence are middling for a survey: no systematic review methodology (search/inclusion criteria) is described; formal definitions in Section 2 are shallow; there are unfinished artifacts including raw citation keys ('li2026loopsbench, macedo2026loop') left in Section 3.4, placeholder notes 'verify authors, venue, DOI, and publication status before submission' attached to references [202] and [221], a likely citation mismatch (Section 5.2.1 attributes 'LAMP' to reference [7], which is an Anthropic Claude product page), and duplicate GPT-4 report entries ([256]/[327]). Evidence strength is largely borrowed from cited works, with descriptive application tables (Table 3) rather than original experiments. Generalizability is good given cross-domain coverage (Section 9: software engineering, science, healthcare, enterprise, simulation) and evaluation principles (Section 7.4). Reproducibility is aided by the stated public resource collection (Abstract: GitHub Awesome-Graph-Engineering link) and linked benchmark/library tables, but weakened by unmaintained references. Overall: a useful, well-organized position survey with notable editorial sloppiness.

primary_link.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence

recommendations.summary: LLMs have evolved from language generators to autonomous agents capable of complex, long-horizon tasks. This evolution has produced paradigms including Prompt Engineering to elicit model capabilities, Context Engineering to manage information access, Harness Engineering to organize external tools and resources, and Loop Engineering to support continual reflection and self-improvement. Yet as tasks grow more complex, individual intelligence faces a fundamental limit: many tasks require heterogene
recommendations.summary_zh: 本綜述提出「圖工程」(Graph Engineering)做為構建 LLM 代理系統的新興典範,論述從模型智慧到個體智慧、再到系統智慧的工程演進。文章先梳理前序典範:提示工程與上下文工程激發模型能力,Harness 工程串接工具、記憶與技能,迴路工程組織持續執行的回饋循環;然而單一代理仍難以排程平行且相互依賴的子任務、整合異質專業能力並維持持久狀態,因此需要系統智慧。圖工程以圖結構外化任務、代理與執行狀態之間的關係,涵蓋三大視角:任務組織(目標分解與工作流程最佳化)、代理協調(能力建模、團隊組織與多代理通訊)與執行期狀態管理(狀態記錄、故障定位與失敗復原),並以系統演化持續改進結構。全文系統性回顧代表性基準、開源函式庫,以及軟體工程、科學發現、醫療等應用,並指出本體工程與圖原生代理作業系統等未來方向。限制在於此領域仍屬新興,跨圖演化與結構化評估尚未成熟。本文為多代理系統從「圖結構化」走向「圖工程化」提供了完整的概念框架與研究議程。
