links.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite

evidence: Abstract: proposes TokEval intrinsic metrics beyond fertility/compression; reports Spearman |ρ| up to 0.80 for information-theoretic metrics predicting language modeling ability
Section 4: 'We train 1.27B-parameter language models under 46 tokenizer configurations' with architecture, data, and hyperparameters held constant; sole variable is the tokenizer
Table 2 (Section 5): Rényi efficiency ρ=-0.80 with FLORES(trained) BPB; digit boundary F1 ρ=-0.62 with Code BPB; AST alignment ρ=0.61 with MBPP, with BH-adjusted significance stars
Discussion 'Seed noise and table resolution': seed std dev 0.00109 val BPB across 5 retrained configurations; MBPP seed std 0.065; concludes tables should be used for screening not selection

Section F.2: family-mean permutation tests and leave-one-out checks confirm key correlations; AST-alignment/MBPP correlation reverses sign when restricted to GPT-4o pretokenizer group, attributed to line-break handling

Section F.4: per-example conditional logistic regressions on internal and 5 external code models find no within-model association between code metrics and problem success, supporting reading metrics as audits rather than predictors

Section 4 availability claim: 'Every model reported in this paper, the tokenizer each was trained with, and a per-run table of the metrics reported here are released at https://huggingface.co/cmeister/tokenizer-lm-ablations'; abstract lists cimeister/tokenizer-intrinsic-evals

Limitations: single architecture (nanochat, 1.27B), n=29 limits statistical power, benchmark suite omits long-context reasoning and instruction following; Section E.3 reports Kendall τ=0.752 between d16 and d24 scale rankings, cautioning scale transfer
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on tokenizer evaluation, validated via controlled pretraining of 46 tokenizer configurations at 1.27B parameters (Section 4), evaluating math reasoning (GSM8K), code generation (HumanEval/MBPP), and multilingual BPB — directly relevant to LLM, reasoning, code, and NLP preferences. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the structural intrinsic metrics for digit handling and code (AST alignment, identifier fragmentation, §3.5-3.6) and the controlled tokenizer-sweep design are new, but the intrinsic-evaluation premise builds heavily on prior tokenizer-impact work. Rigor is exceptional: family-grouped panels to avoid dependence (§A.3, §C.2), mixed-effects regressions with clustered SEs, BH-FDR correction, leave-one-out and design-axis robustness checks (§F.2), seed-noise quantification (Discussion), calibrated held-out prediction (§F.1), and candid negative results (§F.4 per-example analysis; BLiMP correlation attributed to algorithm confounder in §5). Evidence is strong and honestly caveated, though findings are correlational at n=29 and restricted to one architecture/scale, limiting generalizability as the authors themselves acknowledge in Limitations. Models, tokenizers, and per-run metrics are publicly released, supporting high reproducibility.

primary_link.title: TokEval: A Tokenizer Evaluation Suite

recommendations.summary: Language model tokenizers are typically selected with minimal evaluation, despite the fact that their design choices directly impact model capabilities. This can be partly attributed to a limited understanding of which tokenizer properties affect which aspects of downstream performance. We introduce TokEval, a framework of tokenizer evaluation metrics that goes beyond standard measures like fertility and compression rate to capture linguistically and structurally meaningful properties, e.g., UTF
recommendations.summary_zh: 分詞器的設計選擇直接影響模型能力，但實務上常僅以壓縮率或 fertility 等少數指標粗略挑選。本文提出 TokEval，一套超越標準度量的內在評測框架，涵蓋 UTF-8 字元邊界完整性、數字位值對齊、程式碼 AST 邊界對齊與多語言公平性（如 Tokenizer Fairness Gini）等結構敏感指標。為驗證這些指標能否預測下游表現，作者在架構與超參數固定的條件下，僅改變分詞器（演算法、前分詞策略、訓練資料混合）訓練 46 種配置的 1.27B 語言模型。結果顯示：資訊理論類指標最能預測語言建模能力（Spearman |ρ| 最高達 0.80），數字邊界 F1 與 AST 對齊等結構指標則與任務準確率相關；壓縮率本身並非可靠的品質目標。研究強調逐語言分析的重要性：聚合相關性可能掩蓋甚至反轉語言內關聯，且種子重訓實驗顯示結果表中相鄰列的差異多半小於一次重訓的波動，因此這些工具適合用作篩選而非最終選擇。限制包括單一架構、1.27B 規模，以及 n=29 的統計檢定力有限。此工作使分詞器選擇能在昂貴的預訓練掃描之前，先以低成本的內在測量完成初步把關。

links.title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment

evidence: Abstract: two deterministic optimal tracebacks disagree on temporal localization for 55.9% of 1,586 nonzero trajectory pairs; two frozen 800-rollout tool-use audits including a task-and-seed-disjoint replication expose exact-optimum reversals of turn-level credit.

Sec. 4.1 / Fig. 2: 47.5% of pairs are alignment-unidentified under pre-registered early/late rule; Spider Codex header_shuffle sharp range [.221,.799] vs published point near .217; frozen sweep spans 43.2-49.4% with same two aggregate reversals (App. B.1).

Sec. 4.2 / App. B.3-B.4: 93/495 (18.8%, row-clustered 95% CI [14.1,24.0]%) material trajectories, 14/20 sign reversals, disjoint replication 14/22 with zero false signs; pre-registered consequence verdict honestly 'Weak' (margin coverage 5/11=.455, AUC .589 vs required .70).

Sec. 4.3 / App. B.11: Earth-Agent Tool-Exact-Match awards one to 14.23% (CI [7.58,21.80]%) of non-exact cells across 1,532 cells; two-sided repair s2=ell/max{m,n} changes top configuration from DeepSeek-V3.1 IF to GPT-4o AP, surviving all 59 leave-one-task-out omissions.

Theorem 2 / App. A.7 & B.8: shared group standardization compiled over exact-tie fibers is shown NP-hard (lower support) / coNP-hard (threshold certification) via finite-bit MAX-CUT Karp reduction; conformance over 813 no-isolate graphs, 25,264 sign assignments, max error 1.61e-6; natural interaction graphs have treewidth at most 3 (Sec. 3.2).

Sec. 4.4 / App. B.10: pre-registered natural-response transport gate failed; corrected and pre-outcome held-out gates show destructive maps erase 8/8 harmful failures while call-site transport preserves them and reduces mean distance .1163->.0244; earlier invalid 8/8 claim withdrawn due to nonexistent pylint test IDs.

App. A.1-A.6: proofs of identification set, one-sided insufficiency, and linear feasibility boundary; A.6 explicitly attributes minimum-norm separation to classical multi-objective optimization (Fliege-Svaiter, Désidéri, Sener-Koltun), avoiding novelty overclaiming.

Appendix C: explicit scope limits—one agent family, one MatchTIR checkpoint, one compiler family; no final-policy degradation or deployment prevalence claims; provider outputs lack immutable digests and controllable seeds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-evaluation methodology paper squarely in scope: it audits LLM tool-use/code agent pipelines (SWE-bench, Spider2-DBT, MatchTIR tool-integrated reasoning, M3-Bench, Earth-Agent/MCPEval), process-reward credit assignment (Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, Code, Alignment/RL, Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences). Core claim—that cross-view correspondence (transport + tie completion) is a measurement intervention requiring two-sided validation and all-optima identification—is a genuinely new framing, though the formal machinery is openly composed from classical tools (principal angles, minimum-norm separation, MAX-CUT reduction). Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered and frozen protocols, exact-optimum enumeration, evidence-status separation (discovery/post-diagnostic/held-out/post-hoc never pooled), a withdrawn invalid claim, a failed prospective gate reported as such, and the MatchTIR pre-registered consequence gate honestly scored 'Weak'. Evidence is strong within scope (1,586 nonzero pairs with 47.5%/55.9% ambiguity; 14/20 and disjoint-replication 14/22 credit reversals; 14.23% false-perfect strictness cells with a top-ranking change surviving 59 leave-one-task-out omissions; 813-graph conformance ledger at 1.61e-6 max error), but demonstrations cover one checkpoint, one agent family, one compiler family, and no final-policy effect is established, tempering generalizability. Reproducibility is supported by exhaustive protocol detail and public third-party artifacts, though no explicit code-release statement for the auditors appears and provider outputs are not bitwise reproducible.

primary_link.title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment

recommendations.summary: Agent evaluations and trace-based learning often compare outputs across transformed views through a post-response correspondence treated as neutral preprocessing. We show that this correspondence is a measurement intervention: omitting it can manufacture sensitivity, an over-aggressive map can manufacture invariance, and multiple optimal correspondences can leave mechanism labels and signed learning credit unidentified. We develop a validity theory and audit with three components: two-sided vali
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理評估與軌跡式學習常在轉換後的視圖之間比較輸出，其跨視圖對應（correspondence）向來被視為中性前處理。本文證明這其實是一種測量介入：省略適當的傳輸會殘留雜訊、製造虛假敏感性；僅以良性樣本校準的過度激進映射會抹除回應差異、製造虛假不變性；而多個恰好最佳（exact-optimal）的對應則使機制標籤與帶符號的學習信用無法識別。作者提出「對應契約」，包含三要素：對雜訊去除與回應保留的雙側驗證、對所有精確最佳解之下游結論的識別，以及驗證通過後的不確定性傳播，並刻劃線性可行邊界與由編譯器決定的複雜度前沿。實證方面：在 1,586 對公開程式與 SQL 軌跡中，兩個確定性最佳回溯對 55.9% 的配對給出不同的時間定位；對 MatchTIR 的兩次凍結 800 次 rollout 稽核顯示回合級學習信用會翻轉；Earth-Agent 嚴格指標的精確修復更改變公開排行榜的領先者。限制：自然案例稽核屬事後分析、僅涵蓋一種代理家族、未測量最終政策層級的效應。核心訊息是：跨視圖對應必須被宣告、驗證並傳播為不確定性，點結論才具正當性。

links.title: BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: claims 6%/9%/7% average composite improvements on TOFU/MUSE Books/KnowUndo over strongest baselines.
Section 4.2 Table 1: BLADE HM 0.808/0.800/0.803 across TOFU 1B splits vs PDU 0.690/0.740/0.797, 5 seeds with stds.
Section 4.3: honestly concedes PDU leads on MUSE News HM (0.577 vs BLADE 0.544).
Section 4.6 Figure 3: BLADE HM stays 0.523-0.552 under 4x scaling and 4 sequential unlearning steps while PDU collapses (HM=0.005 at 4x).
Section 4.8 Table 4: ablations - ALM off HM=0.233, swapped bilevel HM=0.506, no LoRA HM=0.459, full BLADE HM=0.823; notes K=3 vs K=0 marginal on Books (0.823 vs 0.819).
Appendix B: Propositions 1-2 with proofs that clamped-entropy loss is bounded with exactly-zero gradients in the deadzone.
Appendix E.3: re-learning attack degrades BLADE HM by 69% on average (single seed).
Section 6 Limitations: text-only, factual/knowledge-level unlearning only, untested on multimodal or representation-level removal.
Appendix C.3/C.6 Tables 6, 9, 10: full hyperparameters (7 of 9 fixed), wall-clock 1.5-2x slower but 2-5x lower memory, ~450 GPU-hours total.
Footnote 1: code and configs released at github.com/tzpranto/blade; experiments run in the open OpenUnlearning framework.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (machine unlearning for Llama-3.2/2 models) with strong AI-safety relevance (privacy, copyright, adversarial extraction/jailbreak/MIA/GCG). Well-aligned with LLM, safety, training-optimization, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is moderate: clamped entropy, ALM, and bilevel LoRA are each known; the contribution is their specific combination plus an asymmetric dual 'ratchet' and a repair-first (retain-in-inner-loop) inversion, which the ablation (Table 4: swapped bilevel HM 0.506, ALM off HM 0.233 vs full 0.823) partly substantiates. Rigor is strong: 5 seeds with stds, three benchmark families, component ablations, 120-run hyperparameter sweeps, theoretical propositions with proofs, and disclosed LLM-judge protocol. Evidence is largely verifiable from tables; headline gains check out (Table 1: BLADE HM 0.808/0.800/0.803 vs PDU 0.690/0.740/0.797; Fig. 3 stress tests). Notably honest: concedes second place to PDU on MUSE News (0.544 vs 0.577), acknowledges ablation K=3 vs K=0 is marginal on Books, and reports 69% HM degradation under re-learning attack. Generalizability is decent (three corpora, 1B-7B models) but limited to text-only, factual/knowledge-level unlearning. Reproducibility is high: public code link, full hyperparameter tables, OpenUnlearning framework, compute budget (~450 GPU-hours) disclosed. Score ~0.78 reflects a competent, well-evidenced synthesis rather than a fundamental advance.

primary_link.title: BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning

recommendations.summary: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficien
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文針對 LLM 機器遺忘的穩健性問題提出 BLADE,一個受限雙層最佳化框架。既有方法有三類反覆出現的失敗模式:無界遺忘損失摧毀模型連貫性、固定權重無法適應訓練中途保留難度的變化、未截斷的熵損失持續推動已遺忘的詞元。BLADE 以三個互補機制應對:其一是截斷熵遺忘損失,當詞元熵達 τ·logV 的充分不確定水準後梯度恰好為零,消除過度遺忘;其二是非對稱增廣拉格朗日,一旦違反保留約束便永久拉高乘數形成棘輪,以自適應自校正取代靜態權衡;其三是將雙層結構限制在 LoRA 介面卡上,內迴圈在每次遺忘步驟前修復保留損害,外層以小步幅推進遺忘。在 TOFU、MUSE Books 與 KnowUndo 上,BLADE 相較最強基線平均提升複合分數 6%、9% 與 7%,LLM 評審亦確認近零的語意洩漏;在 MUSE News 的 4 倍規模擴張與 4 次連續遺忘壓力測試下維持穩定,而最強對手 PDU 完全崩潰。訓練動力學呈現可預測的三階段模式(暖身、尖峰拉昇、平滑收斂)。消融實驗證實各元件缺一不可,唯有有界且自飽和的遺忘損失能與受限雙層最佳化相容。限制包括未測試概念或表徵層級的領域移除、易受再學習攻擊,以及僅限文字模型。此工作為部署中模型的合規刪除提供穩健可控的路徑。

links.title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding

evidence: Abstract & Contributions: LiLiCorr raises acceptance length over vanilla DFlash by 9-19% on every benchmark and leads throughput in 70 of 72 settings (nine benchmarks x two targets x two decoding regimes, plus a 36-point concurrency sweep).

§4.1 Baselines/Implementation: Domino and DSpark are retrained on the same ~1.4M-example Nemotron Post-Training Dataset V2 corpus for the same six epochs and ported onto a common SGLang stack; per-block head cost 0.28 ms (LiLiCorr) vs 0.67 ms (Domino), ~2.8% of per-block wall, corroborated by Table 3 stage decomposition.

§4.2 Table 1: under greedy decoding LiLiCorr is fastest in all 18 benchmark settings, leading the strongest baseline by up to 4.9% on the benchmark average; at T=1 (exact rejection sampling) fastest in 17 of 18.
Appendix C Table 11: removing the target-weighted distractor penalty lowers acceptance length on all nine benchmarks (1.5-8.9%), isolating the loss term under a fixed reranker budget.
Appendix E Table 12: exact Viterbi path selection lowers acceptance length on all nine benchmarks versus greedy (mean -2.44%), supporting the prefix-acceptance argument of §3.3/§3.5.

§4.3.1 + Appendix F/G: lead persists on 8K-32K inputs beyond the 3,072-token training range with YaRN positional extension and a hinge margin regularizer; memory-limited rows honestly marked with daggers.
Appendix A Table 4: full hyperparameters given (block 16, K=8, d_e=1024, sigma=8, 36.76M/32.04M head params, AdamW, lr 6e-4/1.5e-4, 6 epochs, batch 64, seq 3072).
§5 Limitation: the method reranks only top-K drafter candidates, so acceptance is bounded by drafter coverage; non-adjacent slot couplings left open.
Document contains no code or model release URL/availability statement; §4.1 notes DSpark leaves no separate head stage to measure, so its comparison rests on end-to-end throughput only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference-acceleration methodology (speculative decoding on Qwen3-8B/4B targets), squarely matching the LLM, inference/serving, scaling/efficiency, and transformer preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is real but sits in a crowded concurrent space (Domino, DSpark): the contribution is a learned in/out-vector factorization that scores the whole candidate lattice in one pass, plus the useful finding that greedy beats exact Viterbi path selection under prefix acceptance. Rigor is strong: matched-training baselines on a common SGLang stack, exact rejection sampling at T=1, three-seed variance reporting, loss ablation (App. C), decode-rule ablation (App. E), and honest memory-bound caveats (App. F). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, though self-reported on the authors' own stack, and all comparisons are confined to the DFlash drafter family with no EAGLE-family or other drafter baseline, so 'state-of-the-art' is scoped to draft-time correlation. Gains over the strongest baseline are modest (up to ~4.9-7.2% throughput). Hyperparameters, data recipe, and baseline configs are detailed, but no code or checkpoint release is stated, limiting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: LiLiCorr: Lightweight Likelihood Correlation of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding

recommendations.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by drafting future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. A diffusion-style block head such as DFlash is an attractive drafter, predicting an entire block of future tokens in one forward pass. However, it is trained on per-position marginals rather than the joint block distribution, so the tokens it emits are individually plausible yet jointly incoherent. We introduce LiLiCorr, a Lightweight Likelihood-based model that Correla
recommendations.summary_zh: 在投機解碼中，DFlash 這類擴散式平行區塊起草器能以單次前向傳播預測整個區塊，成本極低，但其訓練只監督各槽位的邊際分布，導致選出的詞元個體合理、整體卻不連貫。LiLiCorr 提出輕量概似模型：保留每個槽位的前 K 個候選詞元，以一次雙向 Transformer 同時處理全部候選，為每個候選產生 in 與 out 兩個向量，相鄰槽位的配對分數即為前一候選 out 與後一候選 in 的餘弦相似度，使相關性計算化為可平行化的批次矩陣運算，最後僅以不觸及網路權重的貪婪走查依序選詞。訓練採前綴接受導向的局部正規化、oracle 前綴監督，以及依目標模型 logits 施加的干擾項懲罰，並與 DFlash 起草器共同訓練。實驗顯示，相較原始 DFlash，各基準接受長度提升 9% 至 19%；在相同服務堆疊與訓練預算下與同期方法 Domino、DSpark 比較，LiLiCorr 於 72 個設定中的 70 個取得最高吞吐量，其評分頭僅占每區塊延遲約 2.8%，成本約為 Domino 的 2.4 分之 1，搭配 YaRN 位置延伸還能外推至遠超訓練長度的輸入。主要限制是只重排前 K 個候選，接受長度受限於起草器的覆蓋率。此工作為草稿階段的連貫性重建確立了新的技術水準。

links.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL

Appendix D.4, Tables 10-11: matched two-model training and maj@8 inference budget—Co-RL ensemble 66.9 text avg vs TTRL ensemble 64.9; 50.88/52.30 vs 48.80/49.19 multimodal.
Section 6.1 Training details: AdamW, lr 3e-6 (LM) / 1e-6 (VLM), K=12 (LM) / 8 (VLM), single node of eight H100 GPUs.

Appendix D.5 Engineering notes: fixes for Gemma-3 ZeRO-3 init, tokenization, log-prob drift, and Qwen2.5-VL attention backend 'ship with the released code'; code link given in Abstract (github.com/DrStranded/Co-RL).

Table 4 (MMR1 block, InternVL-3.5-2B): Co-RL 45.15 vs TTRL 45.30—a case where Co-RL trails TTRL, showing non-uniform margins; authors note MMR1 and open-r1 blocks use different graders and 'are not compared'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A label-free multi-agent RL method for LLM/VLM reasoning in which decoupled agents are rewarded against peers' majority-vote pseudo-labels instead of their own (GRPO-based), with a diversity study and simplified dynamics theory. Highly on-topic: LLM reasoning, RL/GRPO, multi-agent training, math/code reasoning. The core mechanism is an increment over known ideas—co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998) and Co-rewarding's paraphrase/slow-copy views—so novelty is moderate despite clean execution. Rigor is strong: formal setup, proved propositions/theorem, broad baselines (TTRL, RENT, Intuitor, Co-rewarding-II, MM-UPT, MAPoRL, CoMAS, GT-Reward), matched training+inference-budget control (Appendix D.4), and disclosed protocol deviations (CoMAS coding-aggregation loophole, grader differences between MMR1/open-r1 blocks). Evidence is broad and mostly consistent but main tables appear single-run without variance; some margins are small (e.g., InternVL-3.5-2B MMR1: 45.15 vs TTRL 45.30 in Table 4). Theory assumes odd K and independence of peer pseudo-labels, while experiments use even K (disclosed) and independence holds only as far as error decorrelation, which Appendix A supports empirically (different-family κ≤0.42 vs same-family κ≥0.51). Generalizes across families (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, InternVL, Phi in Appendix A), sizes 1.7B–12B, and text/multimodal math-code-science suites, though the framework doubles training compute and is math-reasoning-centric. Reproducibility is good: released code, full hyperparameters (lr 3e-6, K=12, batch 128, 8×H100), detailed evaluation protocol (D.5), and engineering fixes shipped with code.

primary_link.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL

recommendations.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for improving reasoning in language and vision-language models, yet its strongest successes still depend heavily on ground-truth supervision (e.g., verifiable reward). Such annotations are costly to obtain and become increasingly scarce as reasoning capabilities advance beyond what humans can reliably evaluate. Self-rewarding RL reduces this dependence by enabling models to derive reward signals from their own completions. However, t
recommendations.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）強力提升推理能力，但依賴昂貴且日漸稀缺的真值標籤；自獎勵方法則可能強化既有偏誤、降低回應多樣性，甚至導致訓練崩潰。本文提出 Co-RL：多個不共享參數的模型在單次訓練中同時以 RL 優化，各代理的獎勵來自同儕對多數決偽標籤的比對，形成相互去相關的監督訊號。透過異質的模型家族、規模與改寫過的訓練樣本提升群體多樣性，可降低相關錯誤、阻斷自我強化的回饋迴路。理論分析證明：自我獎勵是自我確認的動態（正確機率低於 1/2 時會趨近 0），而跨代理監督把正確收斂盆地擴大為 p_A+p_B>1，能利用代理間的互補強項修正自我獎勵會強化的錯誤。實驗顯示，Co-RL 在七個純文字基準為四個 LLM 帶來 3.0–8.6% 的平均增益，在四個多模態數學基準為五個 VLM 帶來 2.3–7.2% 增益，全程未使用任何真值標籤即匹配或超越監督式訓練，並以一半的代理數量勝過多代理 RL 方法 CoMAS。限制：代理數量、多樣性與互動拓撲如何塑造跨代理學習，仍是待解的未來方向。

links.title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance

evidence: Abstract: 'We evaluate MemGuard on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web across four backbones... under matched runtime budgets' and 'Code is available at https://github.com/whyyyyy123/MemGuard'

Section 3.3: verifier descriptor d_m=(R_m,c_m,l_m,v_m) is 'attached to every candidate before activation and reused during retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization, and archival' (Abstract/Section 1 contribution (i))

Section 4.2: 'Across all 16 backbone-benchmark settings, MemGuard achieves the best success metric... with up to 7.9 SR-point gains on WebArena' but also 'MemGuard has 11 losses and one tie' across 320 seed-level comparisons
Appendix E.5, Table 26: paired bootstrap p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (q=0.004-0.032, all 16 significant) and Holm correction (7/16 significant)
Appendix C.4, Tables 10-11: 800-case verifier audit with 86%/83% author agreement; 38 of 60 false accepts blocked by governance, 6 traced to downstream failures
Table 12 (Appendix C.4): under 30% simulated label noise MemGuard loses 0.3-2.6 fewer points than the verifier-only control

Limitations section: verifier dependence acknowledged ('false accepts can still promote unsupported experience'), thresholds 'selected on a small held-out development stream', no multimodal or privacy layer
Appendix B (prompts), Table 21 (full hyperparameter list), Appendix F (Reproducibility Statement): implementation details specified for reproduction
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference alignment: an LLM-agent memory-governance method evaluated with LLM backbones (Qwen, Gemini) on agent benchmarks (SWE-Bench, WebArena, Mind2Web, Terminal-Bench), hitting high-weight topics (LLMs, agents, RAG/memory, evaluation). The core contribution—persisting verifier descriptors as lifecycle metadata governing admission, retrieval, conflict resolution, and archival—is a genuine but incremental extension of ReasoningBank and LLM-as-a-Verifier rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is high: 16 backbone-benchmark settings, matched budgets, five seeds, ablations across all backbones, sensitivity analyses (thresholds, weights, token granularity, cross-family verifiers, label noise), and a 2,294-issue long-horizon stream. Evidence strength is solid, with an unusually honest disclosure that MemGuard loses 11 of 320 seed-level comparisons (Section 4.2) and verifier audits showing only 83-86% label agreement (Appendix C.4, Table 10). Caveats: gains are moderate (2.4-7.9 points), verifier audits are author-driven with disclosed kappa, hyperparameters tuned once on a small held-out stream (Limitations), and backbone model versions are not externally verifiable from the document. Reproducibility is supported by a code link, full prompt templates (Appendix B), hyperparameter table (Table 21), and audit protocols (Appendix D), though the repository cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM post-training methodology paper squarely in scope: multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidating math/code/IF RL experts into one student (hits LLM, reasoning, code, RL, training/optimization, efficiency preferences). The strongest contribution is the controlled diagnosis on an oracle-routed SmolLM3-3B testbed showing the integration gap stems from token-budget misallocation (IF: 20.3% of prompts but 0.99% of gradient tokens, Sec 3.3) rather than teacher disagreement (mean 0.126 nat, 0.62% tokens >1 nat, Sec 3.2), plus useful negative results (conflict masks/consensus hurt; inverse-alpha collapses at step 74, Sec 5.2). primary_link.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

recommendations.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking. In this work, we establish a controlled M-OPD benchmark on SmolLM3-3B-Base with oracle routing, isolating capability integration from routing ambiguity. Our investigation reveals a pronounced capability integration gap: standard M-OPD captures only 35.6% of the available headroom relative to a domain-routed oracle ensemble, with concise tasks such as instruction following suffering severe degradation and premature stagnation. Crucially, we show that this failure stems not from gradient conflict, but from a severe misallocation of the token-level optimization budget. This pathology is driven by three orthogonal factors: structural sequence-length disparities across domains, dynamic convergence drift due to non-uniform learning rates, and multi-step reward staleness from asynchronous policy updates. To resolve these imbalances, we introduce Open-MOPD, a principled framework incorporating token-share balancing, gap-aware dynamic budget allocation, and student reward refresh. Together, these mechanisms systematically restore cross-domain balance, elevating headroom recovery from 35.6% to 83.4% in a single deployable student. We fully open-source our end-to-end post-training recipe, training trajectories, and evaluation suites on an academically accessible hardware budget.
recommendations.summary_zh: 多教師 on-policy 蒸餾（M-OPD）可將多個領域強化學習專家整合為單一通用學生模型，但其能力整合動態缺乏理解，也缺少可重現的開源配方。本文以 SmolLM3-3B-Base 建立含 oracle 路由的受控基準，涵蓋數學、程式碼與指令遵循三領域，發現明顯的「能力整合落差」：標準 M-OPD 僅回復混合領域 SFT 至 RouteRL 改進量的 35.6%，簡短的指令遵循任務退化最嚴重且最早停滯。診斷顯示 token 層級的教師分歧並非主要瓶頸，真正問題是 token 層級最佳化預算的錯置，成因有三：各領域回應長度差異（指令遵循佔 20.3% 提示卻僅得 0.99% 梯度 token）、各領域收斂速率不同導致獎勵幅度漂移，以及同一 rollout 跨小批次重複更新造成的獎勵過時。對此，Open-MOPD 提出 token 份額平衡、落差感知的動態預算分配與學生獎勵刷新三項機制，分別對應三個失衡來源。消融實驗逐一驗證其效果，整合後回復率由 35.6% 提升至 83.4%，整合落差由 3.50 點縮至 0.31 點。作者完整開源端到端後訓練配方、訓練軌跡與評測套件，可在 8×A100-80GB 學術環境重現，指出預算配置才是多教師整合成敗的關鍵。

links.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching

llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-level LLM inference paper squarely on-topic for LLM efficiency and edge serving. It addresses the model-exceeds-memory regime with a novel combination of one-shot activation prediction, delta prefetching from NVMe, and a memory-adaptive dense/sparse split. Rigor is high: evaluation on real edge hardware (Jetson AGX Orin), comparison against 20 production systems, memory budget sweeps across 7 levels, latency breakdown, and model quality metrics (perplexity, HellaSwag). Evidence is specific and quantitative with honest reporting of limitations (I/O remains dominant bottleneck; Llama-3-8B is more sparsity-sensitive). Generalizability is limited by single-platform validation with a Jetson-specific coherence staging component. No explicit code release mentioned.

recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文瞄準邊緣裝置上「模型大於記憶體」的艱難情境:模型在整個執行期間持續超過常駐記憶體,儲存裝置必須成為在關鍵路徑上直接供應權重的主動層級。關鍵觀察是自迴歸解碼中 MLP 活化具有強時間局部性:約 82–85% 的活化神經元從一個詞元延續到下一個,因此大多數稀疏權重已常駐,只需取得新增的差異列。NeuroPrefetcher 據此設計:離線先以閾值化與聚類建立稀疏活化質心詞彙;在第 0 層之後,單一 GPU 常駐預測器(僅佔基礎模型參數 2.86%)以一次前向傳遞預測所有下游 MLP 層的活化;執行期比對預測與常駐緩衝區,僅對新需要的差異列排程 NVMe 讀取,並搭配記憶體自適應的稠密/稀疏分割,隨記憶體緊縮以稠密層換取稀疏層。在 Jetson AGX Orin 統一記憶體平台上運行 Mistral-7B,於受限記憶體預算下相較 llama.cpp 達 7.9–12.0 倍加速(3.22 tok/s 對 0.34 tok/s),保留 92–96% 稠密準確度且無需逐任務重訓。對二十個生產級推論系統的能力研究顯示,十二個在生成前即失敗、四個缺乏可部署版本,凸顯傳統卸載設計與統一記憶體邊緣硬體的錯配。剩餘瓶頸在 NVMe I/O 仍佔每詞元延遲的 80–87%,未來需更深預取管線、更強讀取合併與量化稀疏列格式。

Methodologically unusually rigorous: preregistered frozen protocols with SHA-256-hashed preregistrations (Appendix B/C), trap-clustered exact permutation tests with Holm correction over 60 trap clusters (Appendix E), power analysis (Table 23), pre-registered falsifiers honestly reported as failing (UsefulMemoryPrecision 0.264 vs B5 0.556; Table 20), CSPRNG secret injection, container-isolation canary proof (Section 5.6), and a null primary result (P1: 95/180 vs 89/180, permutation p=0.518, Holm p=1.0, Table 9) reported as the headline rather than spun. Novelty is real but narrow: adjacent multi-session memory benchmarks (MemoryArena, EvoMemBench, WorldMemArena, STATE-Bench, MemoryAgentBench) preclude generic priority, and the wake/sleep reference probe recombines known ideas (MemGPT, Letta, Sleep-time Compute, Reflexion) with careful claim boundaries. Generalizability is limited: single wake model gpt-5.5, GLM-5.2 transfer scoped out with no cross-backbone claim (Section 8), fixture repositories, one admitted hosted Mem0 configuration. Reproducibility is high for analysis replay (released v2.0.5/v2.1.0 artifacts with digests, exact replay commands, Appendix B/F) but bounded by hosted-model drift, which the paper itself discloses.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-profile: harness-native RL training infrastructure for coding agents (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, GSPO/verl, vLLM), squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Reinforcement Learning, Training, and Scaling/Serving preferences. Novelty is integration-level: in-process token capture under history rewriting, MoE routing replay (adopted from R3), stage-wise reward-hack defenses, and Live-UI observability are combined rather than algorithmically new, though the negative-control analysis of replay misalignment is a genuine contribution. Rigor and evidence are strong: matched configurations across three harnesses, a four-pool task-selection ablation, routing-replay negative controls, stage-wise timing over 3,699 trials, and unusually honest caveats (sync/async comparison confounded by differing optimizer throughput and explicitly corrected; observational analyses explicitly not claimed as causal). Main deductions: single model, single run per configuration with no variance quantification, binary terminal reward, and unverified generalization beyond OpenSWE-style coding tasks. Reproducibility claims are detailed (released code/models/task index, resolved hyperparameters, documented data formats) but link functionality cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents

recommendations.summary: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges nati
recommendations.summary_zh: 編碼代理的強化學習日益依賴長時運行的代理執行框架（harness）來管理工具整合、儲存庫情境與執行回饋，但其原生執行環境與策略梯度訓練天然錯位：環境崩潰與獎勵駭取會污染結果訊號，訓練—推論差異則使 rollout 行為與策略更新脫鉤。本文提出 Lego-RL，在不修改代理內部控制流的前提下，銜接原生 harness 與可擴充的策略梯度最佳化，三大支柱為：(1) 透過行程內 LLM 代理擷取原始生成流，實現 token 級對齊與穩健的訓練端 log-prob 重算，即使 harness 端有歷史壓縮或重新序列化亦然，對稀疏 MoE 另有路由重放（R3）；(2) 以可擴充沙箱編排、映像快取與分段防禦維護獎勵完整性；(3) 以自動驗證外掛與 Live UI 提供軌跡級診斷與失敗監控。作者以 GSPO 訓練 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，橫跨 OpenHands SDK、Claude Code 與 OpenCode 三個原生 harness：SWE-bench Verified 解題率分別從 64.0% 升至 70.4%、62.4% 至 68.2%、57.2% 至 66.6%，rollout—訓練機率相關性維持在 0.99 以上。限制：單一模型、每配置僅一次運行、終端二元獎勵無法給予中間行為信用。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-training methodology study (not a pure domain application): it manipulates the answer form of supervision labels over byte-identical inputs and dissociates SFT-style dense supervision from advantage-weighted RL (GRPO), with strong matches to LLM, training, and RL preferences and partial match to reasoning (thinking-channel experiments find no benefit). Novelty is solid: the objective-shape knob with exact FE oracle grading and counterfactual probes is a fresh instrument, and it adds a controlled cell to the SFT-vs-RLVR debate, though the qualitative conclusion echoes known elicitation-vs-expansion results. Rigor is exceptional: placebo and format-calibration arms, surface-cue audits, ~50 paired McNemar tests with FDR, 3-seed replications, a second domain, a second model family, paraphrase surface, TOST equivalence, and an alternative-explanation sweep (§2.4, §3.3, §4, Appendix D). Evidence is strong but partly rests on single-run control arms and one 8B+LoRA scale, acknowledged in Limitations. Generalizability is deliberately scoped: one template, synthetic and structurally isomorphic domains, negative claims limited to tested recipes (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: deterministic seeded streams, single regeneration script, SHA-256 fingerprints, full hyperparameters and ~300 GPU-hour budget (Appendix A/C), though the code/data release is promised rather than verified.

primary_link.title: OraclePhys: A Systematic Framework for LLM Fine-Tuning on Structural Mechanics

recommendations.summary: What a language model internalizes from fine-tuning is usually diagnosed after the fact. We make it an experimental variable. OraclePhys is a systematic fine-tuning framework with three components: OraclePhys-Bench, an exactly-graded structural-mechanics benchmark whose finite-element oracle scores every answer and counterfactual edit -- no human labels, no LLM judging; OraclePhys-30K, a supervision dataset of seven answer forms over byte-identical structure descriptions; and a controlled traini
recommendations.summary_zh: 模型從微調中內化了什麼，通常只能事後診斷。OraclePhys 把訓練目標變成實驗變項，包含三部分：以有限元素求解器精確評分（含反事實編輯）的結構力學基準 OraclePhys-Bench、輸入文字逐位元組相同僅答案形式不同的監督資料集 OraclePhys-30K，以及涵蓋七種答案形式與三種驗證器角色的受控訓練研究。核心操縱是標籤揭露多少空間答案：完整逐層排序（P）、峰值純量（A）或通過與否布林（O）。結果顯示答案形式（而非位元數）因果地決定微調教會什麼：排序目標安裝前向模型（校準後 0.73 對未訓練 0.30），純量目標至多部分安裝，布林目標無可測效果；此向量—純量鴻溝在第二個物理領域、第二個模型家族與改寫後的評估表面上皆複現。同一精確求解器進一步區分驗證器的角色：書面答案與分數過濾式答案能安裝能力，而 GRPO 等優勢加權分數雖提高獎勵，模型在保留資料的物理軸上統計上等同起點——分數足以接線動作介面（-0.15 鴻溝閉合），卻不足以安裝知識；思考通道無可測效益。訓練後的 8B 模型達到任務的資料精度前緣，零樣本與 32 樣本皆勝過 Claude Opus 4.8，與專家 GNN 相當。限制在於單一規模（8B+LoRA）、合成領域與僅行為層次的主張。

links.title: Uncovering and Understanding Hidden Dependencies in the LLM API Reseller Ecosystem via Prefix-Cache Side Channels

evidence: Section I (Contributions): claims first systematic study of hidden dependencies among LLM API resellers, formulating dependency visibility as an API-only measurement problem using prefix-cache reuse as a side channel.
Section IV-B1 & Table I: measurement of 39 endpoints, 636 pairs, ~1.1M requests over 7.2 hours; 236/636 (37.1%) pairs show shared cache reach, 147 (23.1%) inconclusive.
Section IV-B3 (Findings 2-3): containment order spans seven layers; one node's cache reach is contained in at least 31 of 33 clone-contracted nodes (stated as a conservative lower bound).
Section IV-C1 (Finding 6): telemetry validation finds 3 false hits among 5,059 usable cold-prompt observations (rate 5.9e-4, 95% CI [1.2e-4, 1.7e-3]).

Section IV-C2 (Finding 7): 14/21 A<B<C chains agree with the multiplicative hit-probability prediction within 0.10 (median deviation 0.084 vs 0.449 randomized), supporting the routing-consistency assumption.
Section IV-D (Finding 8): controlled evaluation with 8 configured topologies (T1-T8) is recovered exactly, including fan-in, chains, implication pruning, and overlapping latent witnesses.
Section IV-B5 (Finding 5): only 2 of 22 decisive reruns on gpt-5.1 reproduce the original containment relations, establishing model-specific topology.
Section III-C/III-D: statistical thresholds derived from binomial bounds at delta=alpha=0.05 (N_flood=59; N_prove=181 with M_contain=4; M_partial=15; M_nohit=59).
Ethics Considerations & Appendix B: endpoint identities withheld/redacted by standing policy and no code artifact is mentioned, limiting exact reproduction despite fully specified Algorithms 1-5.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM infrastructure research: measurement of the LLM API reseller ecosystem via prefix-cache (KV-cache) side channels, with direct ties to inference/serving, LLM supply-chain security, and agentic-workflow risk, not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid: prior work audits individual resellers or uses cache side channels for content leaks, while this paper repurposes authentic cache reuse as a relational infrastructure signal (cache reach/containment), acknowledged as a transfer of cloud co-residency and network tomography ideas. Rigor is strong: formal definitions, explicit assumptions (Assumptions 1-2), statistically derived thresholds (N_flood=59, N_prove=181, M_partial=15), empirical assumption validation, and a controlled 8/8 ground-truth recovery. Evidence is quantitative and appropriately hedged as an under-approximation, though limited to 39 endpoints in one 7.2-hour window, one primary model, and a modest decisive sample (22 reruns, 2 reproductions) for the model-dependence claim. Reproducibility is limited by redacted endpoint identities and no stated code release, despite fully specified algorithms and parameters.
topics: LLM API ecosystem / reseller supply-chain measurement
Prefix-cache & KV-cache side channels in LLM serving
AI safety: confidentiality/integrity of LLM APIs

primary_link.title: Uncovering and Understanding Hidden Dependencies in the LLM API Reseller Ecosystem via Prefix-Cache Side Channels

recommendations.summary: LLM API resellers have become an important access layer to modern LLM services. However, multi-level resale creates an opaque supply chain: a user's request may traverse undisclosed upstream resellers, each of which can inspect or modify prompts and responses, inducing ecosystem-level confidentiality and integrity risks. Existing studies audit individual resellers, but provide little visibility into hidden dependencies across resellers. We present CacheTracer, the first API-only measurement of s
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM API 經銷商常經多層轉售形成不透明供應鏈,上游中介者可檢視或修改提示與回應,但使用者難以察覺這些隱藏依賴。本文提出 CacheTracer,首個僅透過 API 量測經銷商間依賴的方法:利用前綴快取重用做為側通道,以 Flood 原語透過端點 A 反覆灌入新提示,直到快取覆蓋其絕大多數路由流量,再以 Prove 的前綴階梯探測端點 B 能否重用該快取,並以雙向分類組裝全域快取可達結構。作者對 39 個真實經銷端點發送約 110 萬個請求、量測 636 個端點對,發現 37.1% 的對子存在共享快取可達;收縮為 34 個節點後,包含順序深達七層,且某一節點的快取可達被至少 31 個其他節點包含,顯示高度集中、潛在爆炸半徑大的生態結構;跨模型重測中,22 次決定性重測僅 2 次保留包含關係,證明拓撲具模型特異性。驗證方面,5059 次冷提示觀測僅 3 次誤報,受控實驗精確復原 8/8 已知拓撲。限制在於量測結果為保守下近似,快取包含亦不等於已證實的供應邊。此研究對供應鏈感知的安全評估與端到端內容協定設計具啟示意義。

Appendix A.4, Table A4: Curator ablation reduces Skill Cards 273->205 (-24.9%) while improving GPT-5.5 held-out success 104/160->115/160 (65.0%->71.9%)

Appendix A.1, Table A1: 'Verifier: GAIA2 verifier with GPT-5.5 judge where LLM judgment is required' — judge model overlaps with a source and target model; Time ability uses a modified normalized runtime

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM contribution: training-free procedural memory for computer-use agents, built by contrasting same-task trajectories from multiple source LLMs into Function/Skill Cards with a local Curator, evaluated on GAIA2/ARE and AppWorld. Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, with secondary relevance to memory/retrieval. Methodology is unusually well controlled: single-source self-memory control, matched multi-rollout control (Table 3: 70.0 vs 77.5 macro), component ablations, Curator vs append-only ablation (Table A4: 273->205 cards, 65.0%->71.9%), matched-evidence reproductions of AWM/ACE with pinned commits, McNemar significance tests (chi2=171.3), and token/cost accounting (Table A7). Novelty is moderate: the closest cited work MemCollab already contrasts multi-model trajectories; the contribution is the typed-card architecture plus controlled matched-budget evidence, and the contrastive-learning analogy is explicitly conceptual. Main deductions: per-cell n is only 40 tasks; the GAIA2 verifier uses a GPT-5.5 judge that overlaps with a source/target model (Table A1); the Time ability barely improves and needed a benchmark-specific temporal adapter; and the named models (GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen3.7 Plus) and several 2026-dated citations are not externally verifiable from the document. No explicit code or memory-bank release is stated, though prompts, schemas, algorithms, seeds, and frozen configs are provided.

primary_link.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories

recommendations.summary: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, trai
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 ContraMem,一個無需訓練、來源彈性的自我演化程序性記憶框架,將不同模型執行同一任務的結果差異視為監督訊號:正確性、效率、復原與失敗模式的對比,揭露與結果相關的程序性區別。框架將執行軌跡蒸餾為應用層級的 Function Cards(工具契約)與任務層級的 Skill Cards(決策規則),由 Reflector 萃取候選增量,Curator 透過 ADD、PATCH、MERGE、NARROW、NOOP 等局部編輯維護記憶庫,避免僅追加累積或整庫改寫造成的冗餘與漂移;執行期以 BM25 檢索少量任務相關卡片作為軟性程序引導,過程中不更新任何模型參數。在 GAIA2/ARE 電腦使用任務上,以 GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 與 DeepSeek V4 Pro 為來源,三個目標模型的留出成功率從 26.2% 提升至 55.3%(個別 +33.5、+24.5、+29.5);記憶庫原封不動轉移至未見過的 Qwen3.7 Plus,成功率亦從 18.5% 提升至 35.5%,並領先最強既有記憶系統 AWM 30 個百分點。在 AppWorld 上同樣於兩個公開測試分割超越無記憶與單源自我記憶。控制實驗顯示,在匹配軌跡預算下,異質多模型對比的增益無法以單模型多抽樣複製,增益來自行為對比的多樣性而非更強的來源代理。限制在於記憶受限於來源軌跡所涵蓋的程序性失敗,且純文字注入無法解決需持續狀態追蹤的時間敏感失敗。

links.title: Repo2Skill-Evo: Repository Skills Go Stale in Silence

evidence: Section 4.3 / Table 2: six frontier agents reach 29.9%-69.7% avg@3 macro F1 over 105 release transitions, with recall-precision tradeoff profiles per model.
Section 4.4 / Table 5: oracle skill-file localization raises mean avg@3 macro F1 from 32.8% to 45.0% on the hardest-20 subset (95% paired bootstrap CI [+6.8, +17.8]), with residual errors remaining.

Appendix 11.2 / Table 11: repository-clustered 95% CIs for headline scores and paired tests showing all three adjacent top-four model differences exclude zero (e.g., Claude-opus-4.6 over GLM-5.1 by 5.4 [2.8, 8.0]).

Section 4.2 / Table 1 and Appendix Table 6: skill-only raises mean utility from 5.88 to 8.68 across ten sampled repositories, nearly matching source-only (8.64) at ~5x lower token cost; low-baseline group gain +3.98 vs +1.61, explicitly framed as descriptive.

Appendix 9.3: gold obsolete set G_Delta constructed by automated candidate discovery followed by line-level manual verification against direct patch evidence; isolation of S_V1 construction from gold labels stated in Appendix 9.2.
Section 5 Limitations: dataset is a curated staleness-positive challenge set, downstream utility of maintained skills is not rerun, and NL Judge provides only complementary final-state assessment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark/analysis paper squarely within preferred scope: LLM coding agents maintaining agent skills across repository releases, evaluated with frontier models (Claude, GPT, GLM, Kimi, etc.) and an LLM-judge component. Novelty is moderate: 'silent staleness' and release-conditioned skill maintenance is a fresh framing, but the paper itself situates it against adjacent skill-lifecycle work (SkillGuard, SkillOps, Library Drift) and code-migration literature. Rigor is strong for a benchmark paper: fixed patch-grounded metric, 105 transitions/57 repos/1,890 runs, repository-clustered bootstrap CIs, paired significance tests, oracle localization ablation, and residualized correlation robustness; weaknesses include a curated staleness-positive (selection-biased) corpus, unvalidated LLM judges, and a small n=10, single-model utility study with an acknowledged headroom artifact. Evidence is well quantified (headline 29.9%-69.7% avg@3 macro F1 with CIs; oracle gain +12.2 with CI [+6.8,+17.8]), though the central downstream-utility claim relies on ten repositories. Generalizability is limited by concentration in AI/ML-ecosystem repositories and the challenge-set design. Reproducibility is moderate: released materials, version tags, commit hashes, and full instructions are claimed but no verifiable external link or inter-annotator agreement for manual gold verification appears in the text.

primary_link.title: Repo2Skill-Evo: Repository Skills Go Stale in Silence

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over evolving software repositories, where success depends on repository-specific procedural knowledge: which APIs to call, which scripts to run, and which conventions the current release expects. Agent skills externalize this knowledge into reusable units, and prior work shows that they can improve agent performance. What remains unclear is whether that improvement is durable. The same version specificity that makes a skill useful also make
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理技能將儲存庫特定的程序性知識外部化為可檢索的模組，但此類知識與特定版本綁定：版本更迭後，舊技能可能仍可載入與檢索，卻持續提供過時指引，且沒有任何明確訊號提示失效——作者稱之為「無聲過時」。Repo2Skill-Evo 將每次版本轉換視為技能維護任務：給定固定的 V1 技能集與官方 V1→V2 release patch，代理須移除或修訂過時內容，同時保留仍然有效的指引。基準涵蓋 57 個真實 GitHub 儲存庫、105 個官方版本轉換，共 12,217 條經 patch 驗證的過時技能行，評估採嚴格以 patch 為依據的移除指標（精確率、召回率與 F1），輔以五維度 NL Judge。結果顯示六個前沿代理表現遠低於理想：最強的 Claude-opus-4.6 平均 F1 僅 69.7%，GLM-5.1 為 64.3%，GPT-5.4 召回率最高（74.6%）但精確率偏低，其餘模型最低僅 29.9%。錯誤診斷指出兩大瓶頸：受影響檔案的定位覆蓋不全使過時內容殘留，而過廣編輯雖提高召回卻損害精確率；提供 gold 檔案路徑的 Oracle 實驗可改善表現，但殘餘錯誤仍大，顯示檔案內的證據追蹤與編輯選擇同樣關鍵。限制在於資料集為刻意挑選的「過時陽性」挑戰集，且未評估維護後技能的下游效用。本文主張儲存庫技能應被視為帶有版本標記、需隨程式碼演進持續維護的知識資產。

links.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 29 configurations of 6 systems on all 10 tasks the mean score is 0.166, and the best system reaches 0.250'; learning-touching submissions average 0.226 vs 0.126
Section 3.1 Setup: six systems (GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna under Codex at six efforts; Claude Opus 5/Sonnet 5 under Claude Code; Kimi K3), 29 configurations, 290 cells
Section 2.4 Baselines: baseline is the repository's committed code 'executed under the identical procedure and the same twelve-hour budget' with the same fixed evaluator and asset
Section 2.5 Scoring: progress coordinate with sigma=0.1 at shipped algorithm and 1.0 at task optimum; -log transform justified for perplexity (53.4->16.2 = 30% not 71%)
Section 4.1 Table 4: 141 of 263 classified submissions stay run-side only; learning-side gap 0.100 (SE 0.022), holds without RAGEN (0.182 vs 0.128); paper concedes 'not a randomized comparison'
Section 4.2: reasoning effort raises learning-touching share 8%->64% and mean 0.094->0.196 (SE 0.027); median evaluations 4->16; total exploration cost $5,334
Section 2.3 Protocol: 'The separation is one of access and timing rather than of sample disjointness' on some tasks, acknowledged limitation
Abstract and Conclusion: 'We release the task suite, the evaluators and every scored submission'; homepage link provided in metadata
Appendix A: task details (e.g., BTRM proxy is 512 of 2,985 pairs; OWL sparsity gate [0.699,0.701]) are specific and checkable
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: a benchmark evaluating frontier LLM coding agents (GPT-5.6, Claude 5, Kimi K3 under Codex/Claude Code) on editing real training-algorithm code, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Reasoning-effort, LLM, and Evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid if not maximal: agent benchmarks for ML research exist (MLE-Bench, MLGym, RE-Bench, MLS-Bench, autoresearch), but the isolation of 'algorithmic design' changes plus a run-side vs learning-side taxonomy of submitted diffs is a genuine new measurement. Rigor is good but imperfect: 290 cells with strict baseline-parity protocol and careful score mapping (-log for perplexity), yet single 12h runs per cell with no seed variance reported for stochastic training, an LLM-assigned diff classification, effort levels confounded with harness, and a harsh scale anchoring (optimum = best attainable, e.g. perplexity 1) that partly constructs the headline 'lowest fifth' finding. Evidence is strong: full result grids (Tables 2-3), costs, token counts, failure analysis of 19 zero cells, and concrete case studies traceable to tables; key gaps reported with standard errors (0.100 SE 0.022; 0.102 SE 0.027). Generalizability is moderate (10 diverse algorithm families, 6 systems, but 4h/12h budgets and current-generation agents make conclusions time-sensitive). Reproducibility is reasonable: task contracts reproduced verbatim and release of suite/evaluators/submissions promised, though replication requires large GPU spend and proprietary models.

primary_link.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

recommendations.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) asks whether an AI system can improve the process that produces AI systems, so that the next system inherits the improvement. That process is the training algorithm: a better objective or update rule improves the compute\mbox{-}capability exchange rate for every subsequent run, including the one that produces the next agent. Whether RSI is feasible therefore turns on whether an agent can design training algorithms. No benchmark isolates that ability: existing sui
recommendations.summary_zh: 遞迴自我改進（RSI）能否成立，取決於 AI 系統能否改進「產生下一個系統的過程」，亦即訓練演算法本身；但現有基準多由資料工程或超參數調校取勝，無法區分「改變執行方式」與「改變學習方式」。AI4AI-Bench 凍結十個研究程式碼庫，涵蓋監督式 fine-tuning、多回合代理式 RL、on-policy 蒸餾、Bradley–Terry 獎勵模型、偏好最佳化、擴散 RL、機器遺忘、離散圖擴散、權重平均與一次性剪枝十族演算法。代理在單張 B300 上有四小時改寫訓練演算法，提交後的程式碼從乾淨狀態重跑至多十二小時，由預先固定且代理無法存取的評測器計分，並映射到 0（無資訊模型）、0.1（原版演算法）、1.0（最佳值）的統一量表。29 個組態、六個系統的平均分數僅 0.166，最佳系統 Claude Opus 5 達 0.250；263 份提交中有 141 份完全未改動模型如何學習，觸及學習機制者平均 0.226 對其餘的 0.126；提高推理努力主要提升「敢於觸及」的比例，從 8% 升至 64%，平均分數由 0.094 升至 0.196。限制包括任務僅十項、指標不可共量需依賴映射，且探索成本未計入 GPU 時數與評測運算。此基準為 RSI 的演算法層能力提供了可重複的測量工具。

links.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'our defended Qwen3.6-27B achieves a 9.0% ASR against the SoTA PISmith adaptive prompt injections, compared to 94.0% for the prior SoTA, Meta-SecAlign'; code and model links provided (github.com/pppyb/SecOPD, pybbb/Qwen3.6-27B-SecOPD).
Section 5.2, Table 1: SecOPD achieves 1.3% SEP Static, 0.2% SEP Basic Adaptive, 9.0% SEP PISmith, and 4.7% AgentDojo ASR vs Meta-SecAlign at 28.9%/5.5%/94.0%/5.5%; GRPO reaches 61.2% PISmith ASR.
Section 5.4, Table 2: SecOPD average utility 88.1% matches the undefended model's 88.1%, outperforming GRPO's 83.1%, while Meta-SecAlign averages 88.5%.
Appendix D, Table 3: human audit of 300 static SEP labels stratified by attack family reports 33/33 confirmed positives, 0 FP, 0 FN, 100% agreement.
Appendix G: 'the GRPO dataset uses a larger fraction of completion-style attacks than the SecOPD training mixture'—a distribution mismatch confounding the GRPO baseline comparison.
Appendix H: 'The final GRPO and SecOPD evaluations use a maximum context length of 32,768; the original undefended and Meta-SecAlign evaluations use 16,384.'

Limitations: method 'not applicable to preventing jailbreaks, direct prompt injections' and assumes 'a clear signal about which input parts are trusted or not'; authors do not claim to solve prompt injection.

Section 5.1: all four evaluated models are derived from a single base (Qwen3.6-27B), fine-tuned on a 19K Cleaned-Alpaca dataset; Table 8 lists LoRA rank 128, lr 1e-4, temperature 1.0 training configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM security paper on prompt-injection defense for agents, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Agents & Tool Use, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Alignment/RL methods). The methodological contribution—adapting on-policy distillation to security by scoring student rollouts from attacked inputs with the base model given paired clean inputs—is a sensible but incremental adaptation of existing OPD/context-distillation ideas to a new problem, so novelty is moderate. Rigor is solid: three baselines (undefended, Meta-SecAlign, GRPO), static/adaptive attack suites, seven utility benchmarks, a 300-sample human audit of judge labels (Appendix D, Table 3, 100% agreement), and a manual error analysis of 46 Minerva-Math regressions (Appendix J, Table 5). Evidence for the headline claim (9.0% PISmith ASR vs 94.0% Meta-SecAlign, Table 1) is strong but confined to a single model (Qwen3.6-27B) and one training set; the GRPO comparison is confounded by a different injection-sampling distribution (Appendix G) and AgentDojo evaluations use unequal context lengths across defenses (32,768 vs 16,384, Appendix H), which slightly weakens cross-method claims. Generalizability is partially addressed via honest OOD transfer to AgentDojo (4.7% vs 5.5% ASR) but untested across model families/scales, and the Limitations section concedes the method assumes a clear trusted/untrusted input signal and does not cover jailbreaks or direct injections. Reproducibility is good: code and model release, full hyperparameters (Table 8), judge prompts, and attack construction details.
topics: DPO vs GRPO vs token-level feedback

primary_link.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation

recommendations.summary: Prompt injection is listed as the \#1 threat to AI agents. When an agent accesses external data from websites, files, or emails, an attacker may inject a prompt into the data, saying, "Ignore all prior instructions and perform <an attacker's task>." To prevent arbitrary manipulation of agents, defenders try to train secure LLMs, which, however, still suffer from near 100% attack success rates (ASRs) against adaptive prompt injections. We note that this is because existing defensive finetuning re
recommendations.summary_zh: 提示注入被列為 AI 代理的頭號威脅,而現有防禦微調方法(如 Meta-SecAlign 的 DPO 或 GRPO 式訓練)使用序列級回饋,無法指出回應中哪些 token 遵循了注入指令,因而於自適應攻擊下幾近失效。本文提出安全同策略蒸餾 SecOPD,將同策略蒸餾改用於提示注入防禦:學生模型在被攻擊輸入上取樣 rollout,凍結的初始化模型則在對應的乾淨輸入(移除注入)上對每個取樣 token 打分,產生 token 級優勢訊號——符合可信任務的 token 被鼓勵、遵循注入的 token 被抑制。在 Qwen3.6-27B 上,SecOPD 對 SoTA 自適應攻擊 PISmith 僅 9.0% 攻擊成功率,遠低於先前 SoTA Meta-SecAlign 的 94.0%,亦大幅優於 GRPO 基線(61.2%);在訓練完全未見的工具呼叫領域 AgentDojo,ASR 降至 4.7%,優於 Meta-SecAlign 的 5.5%,且整體效用平均 88.1% 與未防禦模型持平,明顯高於 GRPO(83.1%)。限制包括不處理越獄與直接提示注入、假設系統已能區分可信與不可信輸入,以及未來更強攻擊可能突破此防線。此工作證明精細的 token 級訓練訊號能顯著提升模型層級安全,挑戰「模型無法可靠防禦」的悲觀論點。

links.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency

evidence: Abstract: completed audit-to-repair episode lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations by 2.8-11.5 pp against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9-25% relative reduction

Section 3.4: 20,000-replicate cluster bootstraps on per-item paired differences clustered on reused episodes; Holm-Bonferroni within families declared before any p-value was visible (claim family k=24); bootstrap calibration verified by simulation (coverage 0.94)

Section 6: criterion c moves toward leniency in 15/15 combinations surviving correction in 13, delta-d' survives 0/15; hand audit of 50 R0 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong with Wilson interval [8.3%, 28.5%]
Section 5 / Table 2: AX−AS wedge is -5.62 pp surviving 5/5 wordings on Ministral-3-14B only; null on Qwen3.6-27B where 37/50 repairs still assert correct, and 1/5 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

Section 7 (Robustness): reasoning-enabled rerun on 22,320 generations preserves proportional effect (-19.7% and -17.5% vs -21.6% and -14.3% without thinking); balanced accuracy does not rise there (all p >= 0.16)

Limitations: 'one benchmark, one task family, no frontier or closed judge'; false-alarm audit performed by one author with no inter-annotator agreement; Gemma-4-31B contrast significant and reversed (+1.58 pp [0.45, 2.82])

Appendix G: frozen pools content-hashed with contrasts refusing to cross hashes, pinned model revisions (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B 6a9e13bd), allocation seed 20260805, code and per-item outputs accompany the submission
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM research: an empirical study of how prior in-context audit-repair episodes shift LLM verifier thresholds on ProcessBench, touching LLM-as-judge bias, prompting/context effects, mathematical reasoning verification, and checker-fixer pipeline wiring. The core finding (false alarms fall in 15/15 model×wording combinations, opposite to polarity-drift predictions) is counterintuitive and cleanly separated from output-format and placement confounds via byte-identical tasks. Rigor is unusually strong: pre-specified model screen, declared multiplicity families with Holm-Bonferroni, episode-clustered bootstraps with verified calibration, five controls, a second labeled-incorrect arm enabling d'/criterion separation, a hand audit showing 82% of baseline false alarms are fabricated, and a reasoning-enabled robustness arm. Evidence is strong internally but the decisive wedge (AX−AS) survives on only one of three models, the mechanism is explicitly unidentified (complementary components), and the false-alarm audit is n=50 by one author with no inter-annotator agreement. Generalizability is limited: one benchmark, one task family, open-weight models only, with one screened-out model showing a significant reversed effect. Reproducibility is excellent: code link, content-hashed frozen pools, pinned model revisions, seeds, and released per-item outputs and audit verdicts. Score reflects strong methods and fit with moderate breadth limits.

recommendations.summary_zh: 自動化檢查管線常把一個語言模型當審查者、另一個當修復者。本文追問：這種接線是否會改變審查者的判斷？在人工驗證為正確的 ProcessBench 解題軌跡上測量誤報率，且當前任務在所有條件間逐位元組相同，研究發現：上下文中一段已完成的稽核→修復對話，在 15 組模型×措辭組合中全部降低誤報，降幅 2.8 至 11.5 個百分點（相對於長度匹配的非稽核對照為 9–25%），方向與累積訊息極性漂移文獻的預測相反——報告錯誤的稽核事件反而進一步降低誤報。分解顯示修復內容與稽核判決在不同模型家族間互補，無單一必要成分。訊號偵測分析把改變定位在門檻而非辨別力：判準 c 在 15 組中皆移動且 13 組經校正存活，d′ 則無一存活。人工稽核 50 個誤報發現 82% 純屬錯誤，因此在此操作點上門檻移動無害甚至有益。開啟推理後效應的相對大小仍保持。限制包括決定性對照僅在一個模型上乾淨成立、模型皆為開放權重、單一基準。實務警示：驗證器若先進行過它將被要求判斷的同類修復，其門檻會在無人要求下偏移；只看被標記項的指標會誤讀為改善。

links.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'The correct reference does not provide a consistent performance benefit across teacher generation modes, model sizes, and training datasets. Students can improve without the correct reference, and a solution from another problem can outperform the correct solution on several mathematical reasoning benchmarks.'

Section 4.2, Table 1: On NuminaMath with a non-thinking teacher, mismatched reference averages 67.6 vs 59.5 for the correct reference; paired intervals in Table 10 show +12.5 [6.4,18.9] on AIME 2025 and +11.7 [6.1,17.5] on HMMT 2025.

Section 4.4, Figure 4(b): cosine similarity of student change with D_ref exceeds its control by only 0.05 on NuminaMath and 0.10 on MegaScience; Table 2 shows control R_c^2 (0.94-0.98) matches or exceeds evaluated-problem values (0.88-0.97).
Section 3.2-3.6: formal decomposition D_tot = D_ref + D_rec, projection/cosine metrics, controls from other problems, bootstrap uncertainty, and three control pairings (Appendix B.1, Table 15).
Section 5 Limitations: 'We train each condition once, so our results do not measure variation across repeated training runs'; experiments limited to Qwen3 models and math/science datasets.
Section 2: acknowledges concurrent work Ichihara et al. (arXiv:2608.09228) finding that a solution from another problem can preserve or improve OPSD performance.

Appendix A.3/A.6, Tables 6, 7, 14: complete hyperparameters (LoRA rank 64/alpha 128, lr 5e-6, 300 steps, seed 42), dataset quotas (Table 3), prompts (Appendix A.2), and software versions, but no code or artifact availability claim.

Appendix A.4, Table 11: checkpoint selection uses MATH-500/AIME24 (NuminaMath) and MATH-500/GPQA-D (MegaScience), which are also reported benchmarks, though the procedure is disclosed and paired tests are limited to pre-specified comparisons (A.4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology research squarely within preferred topics: on-policy self-distillation of LLMs (Qwen3 1.7B-8B) for mathematical/scientific reasoning, with LoRA fine-tuning and a careful analysis of how privileged reference conditioning shapes token-level teacher supervision. The paper asks a sharp methodological question (does the student actually learn from the reference, or recover base-model thinking behavior?) and answers it with a well-defined decomposition framework (reference-dependent vs reference-free directions), matched controls from other problems, three control pairings, paired bootstrap uncertainty, checkpoint-selection disclosure, benchmark decontamination, and reference-type ablations (answer-only, hints, canonical solutions, 8B/32B traces). Claims are appropriately hedged and supported by quantitative tables (mismatched reference beating correct reference on AIME/HMMT under non-thinking teachers; control directions reproducing most distributional alignment). Limitations are honestly stated: single run per condition, only Qwen3 models, math/science only. Novelty is moderate because the decomposition builds on Purified OPSD and concurrent work (Ichihara et al., Nguyen et al.) already reported mismatched-reference findings, though the control-based alignment analysis and alignment-performance dissociation are distinctive. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters/prompts/software versions but no code or artifact release is stated; checkpoint selection on reported benchmarks is a minor concern.

primary_link.title: Rethinking Privileged Information in On-Policy Self-Distillation

recommendations.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own responses using token-level supervision from the same model conditioned on privileged reference information. We investigate whether performance gains from OPSD show that the student learned the information in the reference or instead reflect recovery of reasoning behavior already present in the base model. We perform OPSD experiments on science and mathematics datasets using Qwen3 models ranging from 1.7B to 8B. Our analysis framewor
recommendations.summary_zh: On-policy self-distillation（OPSD）讓學生在自己生成的回應上，接受同一模型在獲得特權參考資訊條件下提供的 token 級監督。本文追問：效能增益究竟是顯示學生學到了參考中的資訊，還是只是恢復基礎模型已有的推理行為？作者以 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 在 NuminaMath 與 MegaScience 上進行 OPSD，提出分析框架將教師監督分解為「由參考引發」與「無參考」兩個方向，並以其他題目的參考構建對照組，測量兩者與學生預測變化的對齊程度。結果顯示：正確參考在不同教師生成模式、模型規模與訓練資料間沒有一致的效能優勢；學生在沒有正確參考時仍能進步，且來自其他題目的解答在多個數學競賽基準上可勝過正確解答；學生預測變化與基礎模型思考行為的對齊，強於與參考引發監督的對齊，但對照組重現了兩者的大部分對齊；更強的對齊並不必然伴隨更大的效能效益。限制：僅涵蓋 Qwen3 模型與數理科學領域，每個條件只訓練一次，無法衡量重複訓練的變異。此研究的核心警示是：單憑效能增益與分布對齊，無法判定特權資訊在 OPSD 中的實際貢獻。

links.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract & §4.2 Table 4: best model Claude-Opus-5 reaches 11.5 on NC2FT (autoformalization) vs 28.6 Pass@8 on FT2FP; no model exceeds 11.5 on NC2FT, supporting the autoformalization-bottleneck claim.

§3.1 & Appendix G: black-box leakage audit querying GPT-5.6-sol and Claude-Opus-5 without retrieval reports completion similarity below 9.6%, with explicit caveat that this indicates low rather than zero contamination risk.
Appendix E Table 22: inter-expert agreement of 86% (core claim), 90% (NL claim), 93% (formal proof); LLM-assisted annotations required 13-31% substantive expert revision.
Appendix F Table 23: LLM-rubric vs human agreement computed on only 16 randomly sampled examples; discrepancies 3.17-10.67% and identical model rankings.

§5.2 & Figure 4: of 64 agent-generated claims, 39 rejected for lack of novelty, 17 for lack of value, 2 had no proof, and 6 passed expert evaluation and proof verification; framework uses only GPT-5.6-sol.
Abstract footnote 1: code released at github.com/zirui-HIT/FormalTCS; Appendix D Table 21 pins model snapshots and harness versions (e.g., Codex v0.146.0, Claude Code v2.1.220).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM research: a 175-instance expert-validated benchmark evaluating frontier LLMs (GPT-5.6 family, Claude 4.5/5, DeepSeek-V4) on an end-to-end TCS research pipeline (claim elicitation, autoformalization, proof elicitation, Lean proving), plus a planner/formalizer/judger multi-agent framework for autonomous claim generation. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents/tool use, evaluation). Novelty is solid but incremental over TCS-Bench and Lean-based benchmarks: the differentiators are frontier 2025-2026 STOC/FOCS/SODA/COLT sources, preserved paper-specific dependencies, contamination auditing, and the research-taste finding. Rigor is good: five PhD annotators, inter-expert agreement 86-93% (Appendix E), verification-based metrics (BEq+ bidirectional proving, Pass@8 with sorry/axiom linters), and a leakage audit with honestly stated limits. Weaknesses: LLM-rubric human agreement is validated on only 16 sampled examples (Appendix F), the auto-research conclusion rests on 64 claims from a single model configuration with two-expert novelty judgment lacking reported inter-rater stats, and no significance testing. Evidence is quantitative and traceable but small-scale in Section 5; generalizability is bounded by TCS-specificity and proprietary models. Reproducibility is aided by released code, full prompts (Appendix B), and pinned model/harness versions (Table 21).

primary_link.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains $175$ instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 FormalTCS，一個由專家驗證、評測大型語言模型（LLM）端對端理論電腦科學（TCS）研究能力的基準。有別於既有著重孤立能力的評測，FormalTCS 涵蓋 175 個取自 STOC、FOCS、SODA 與 COLT 2025–2026 年論文的實例，保留論文特定的定義、假設與證明依賴，並附專家核驗的 Lean 形式化陳述與證明，同時以黑箱稽核降低資料污染風險。研究將研究流程拆解為核心主張理解、自動形式化（NC2FT）、證明策略生成（C2NP）與定理證明（FT2FP）四項任務，評測 GPT、Claude 與 DeepSeek 等主流模型。結果顯示自動形式化是最尖銳的瓶頸：最佳模型僅得 11.5 分，遠低於證明人類提供之形式化定理的 28.6 Pass@8。作者另建立自動化 TCS 研究框架，在 64 個生成主張中僅 6 個經專家評估與證明驗證留存，顯示研究品味不足是另一主要障礙。此基準為衡量自主 TCS 研究進展提供寫實的測試場，雖然標註仍仰賴 LLM 輔助且規模有限。

links.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation

evidence: Abstract: 'Across five open-source gateways connected to OpenAI and Anthropic, none bound customers to upstream credentials by default; under a shared credential, all five exposed cross-customer cache reads for both providers.'
Section V-A: 'On OpenAI, the observer saw exactly four upstream requests in P/P/P/P' order... every gateway produced [0,1408,1408,0]' with native Anthropic cells [0,h,h,0], h from 1,066 to 1,074.
Section V-B: 'One principal with one namespace crossed 5/5, splitting the namespace under one principal crossed 0/5... whose exact two sided value is p=0.008'; pool partition contrast 3/3 vs 0/3.
Section VI-A: 'All eight dependent commits were correct with no abstention... The target space contained 4^8 = 65,536 sequences, which represents 16 bits of committed target'; 258 total requests.

Section IX-B: 'We found no stable production setting for general extraction of arbitrary content. The strongest evidence is one chain with eight steps over four known words of equal token length... in one favorable cell carrying 16 bits.'

Section VII-C and Table XIII: 'Shared paths crossed in 5/5 gateways. Exclusive paths crossed in 0/5 and retained all five owner hot repeats'; HMAC-derived namespace arm removed the edge against a real OpenAI upstream.
Section VII-D: 'the split increased modeled cost by 1.7 to 2.5% and exposed zero cached tokens from private regions across customers' over 5,713 replayed request events.

Appendix B-A: frozen revisions listed (NewAPI e0d515611588, uni-api 20da7a7cc6f7, MetaAPI 41767a65ec8e, LiteLLM 7e66f00fca08, Sub2API b8b72e1b1831) with observer-verified runtime records; Appendix B-L notes anonymized relays and machine-readable analyses.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems-security measurement paper on prompt-cache isolation across LLM API relays/gateways, directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, AI safety (side channels, vulnerabilities, defenses), inference/serving (caching, KV cache, deployment), and red-teaming/evaluation. Not a domain-application or vision/audio/diffusion paper. Novelty is incremental over prior cache side-channel work (CacheProbe, Gu et al., Early Bird, InputSnatch) but the component-level localization of which relay transformation (credential, pool, adapter, nested hop) collapses cache identity, plus the HMAC-derived namespace defense contract and public/private split, are genuine contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: formal threat model (Sec. II), matched interventions with exact p=0.008 and Clopper-Pearson intervals (Sec. V-B, App. B-D), shadow-history attribution with full replay control (Sec. IV-F, VI-A), preregistered target commitment, frozen revisions, E0-E3 evidence tiers, and an abstaining protocol. Evidence is strong but carefully scoped: 10 real-upstream gateway cells ([0,1408,1408,0] across five gateways, Sec. V-A), 12/28 positive OpenRouter labels covering 33.7% of eligible volume, and one live 16-bit extraction chain; however, intervention arms have tiny denominators (5/5, 3/3), the OpenRouter frame uses one account pair (Sec. IX-A), and extraction is limited to a controlled four-word alphabet (Sec. IX-B candidly states no stable general-extraction setting was found). Defense validation is mostly local-fixture with one real-upstream namespace prototype (Sec. VII-C/D). Reproducibility is aided by frozen commits, request ledgers, and machine-readable analyses, but production relays are anonymized ('coded relay names protect ongoing disclosure') and provider cache behavior is time-varying.

Providers scope prompt caches to upstream principals and namespaces, so relay customers mapped to one cache identity can observe each other's cache state. recommendations.summary_zh: LLM API 中繼服務對客戶分別驗證身分，卻常以共享的供應商憑證轉發請求；供應商的提示快取以上游主體界定範圍，被映射到同一快取身分的中繼客戶因此能觀察彼此的快取狀態，進而洩露提示成員資訊甚至逐 token 復原內容。本文提出 KeyPooling 測量方法：沿憑證、命名空間、轉接器、憑證池與巢狀中繼追蹤客戶身分至最終快取查詢與寫入，以執行期觀察者驗證實際轉換，並一次只改變一個預測的身分元件做對照實驗。跨五個開源閘道器連接 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的測試顯示：預設皆未將客戶綁定至上游憑證，共享憑證下五者全部出現跨客戶快取讀取；主體與命名空間分割、池分割、轉接器對照與巢狀覆寫等介入則定位出控制轉換。在與結果無關的 OpenRouter 週期抽樣框架中，測試涵蓋 80.5% 的合格 token 量，28 個標籤中有 12 個（占 33.7% 流量）出現跨帳號讀取；一條生產路由更支援在無法存取目標的情況下連續復原八個位置的受控目標。作者據此提出防禦契約：每位客戶必須落入供應商強制的網域，或由驗證身分衍生的命名空間必須在每次最終查詢與寫入存活；在公共前綴之後分割可保留大部分重用，成本僅增 1.7–2.5%。

links.title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces

evidence: §3.4: 'All pipeline stages use gpt-5.4 at temperature 1.0'; gpt-5.5 and claude-sonnet-5 serve as judges; gpt-5-mini generates skills and executes held-out tasks
§4.1 Table 1: latent task induction achieves ARI 0.974 ± 0.028 and MAE 0.48 overall across K∈{2..15}, d∈{2..4}
§4.3 Table 4: step description accuracy 74.9% vs 30.3% for strongest workflow-induction baseline (gpt-5.5 judge); operator correctness 88.5% vs 52.7% for direct generation
§5 Table 5: skills from task models improve executability 59.35→67.65 and held-out accuracy 14.29→18.57 (30% relative) over workflow-summary baseline; human-curated skills reach only 10.00 accuracy
Appendix D.1: two annotators agreed on 85% of 995 paired judgments (Cohen's κ=0.48, Gwet's AC1=0.79); LLM judges fall within annotator range on binary checks
Limitations section: acknowledges PII risk in naturalistic traces; privacy redaction and its effect on induction quality left to future work
§1 footnote 1: codebase available at github.com/Yucheng-Jiang/task-model-induction; Appendix F lists all pipeline prompt templates
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-centric agentic methodology paper where every pipeline stage (grounding, segmentation, latent task induction, model reconciliation, skill generation) runs on GPT-5.4-family and Claude models (§3.4), evaluated on computer-use agents and coding-agent trajectories (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI; Appendix C). Novelty is solid: the task-model formalization pairing hierarchical objective decomposition with structured-programming control-flow operators, plus non-contiguous latent task discovery from interleaved traces, goes beyond prior workflow induction and plan recognition (§2, §6). Rigor is good: ARI/MAE robustness sweeps (Table 1, 126 synthetic trajectories), dual-judge identity checks across model families (Table 2), ablations of objective/procedure/reconciliation (Table 4), rubric-based human annotation with κ=0.48/AC1=0.79 (Appendix D.1), and error-propagation analysis (Appendix D.3). Evidence is decent but tempered: core fidelity metrics lean on LLM judges of LLM outputs (mitigated but not eliminated), the interleaving evaluation is synthetic segment shuffling, and the extrinsic gain is small in absolute terms (held-out accuracy 14.29→18.57, Table 5). Generalizability claims rest on 38 human sessions plus one benchmark; single-model-temperature implementation may limit transfer. Reproducibility is aided by a public codebase (§1 footnote), full prompt templates (Appendix F), and public datasets, though reliance on proprietary frontier models tempers exact replication.

primary_link.title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces

recommendations.summary: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world wor
recommendations.summary_zh: 自然錄製的電腦使用軌跡（螢幕截圖與滑鼠、鍵盤事件）蘊含日常工作的隱性知識，但從低階事件還原結構化任務模型極具挑戰：訊號語義稀薄、真實工作多執行緒交錯，且軌跡僅記錄執行路徑而非目標層級與控制流。本文提出 Task Model Induction（TMI），分三階段運作：事件接地與活動分段將原始事件轉為語義動作與活動；潛在任務歸納利用任務摘要與參照識別符，將交錯活動分配至離散任務；任務模型建構則分別歸納目標模型（遞迴分解的目標層級）與流程模型（序列、for-each、while 控制流），再調和解併為統一模型。在合成與真實人類及代理軌跡上，TMI 以 0.974 的 ARI 還原交錯任務分組，任務身分匹配率逾 93%，步驟描述準確率達 74.9%，遠勝最強工作流基線的 30.3%；衍生技能使留出任務準確率相較最強基線提升 30%。局限包括依賴 LLM 推理與隱私遮蔽需求。此方法將日常數位工作轉為可稽核、可重用的知識，對人類文件化與代理技能學習皆具價值。
