links.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints

evidence: Abstract: claims a small open-weight LM 'reaches the highest reported subgoal success rate, exceeding GPT-4's' on WAH-NL under LoTa-Bench, with real tabletop deployment where 'every generated plan satisfies its preconditions and goals by construction'

Section 4.2, Table 2: Llama 3.1 8B raw SR 0.000/Exec 0.010 vs Meta-Ctrl SR 0.470/SSR 0.705/Exec 1.000; footnote 3 acknowledges prior WAH-NL evaluations use different inputs/simulators and SSR-to-SSR is 'the comparable axis'

Section 4.3, Table 3: Meta-Ctrl lifts Llama-3-8B VH AS task SR 21.3→90.4 and execution 23.6→97.7, above leaderboard GPT-4o (71.5), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (76.1), o1-preview (65.2); BEHAVIOR gains smaller (10→34 AS task SR)

Section 4.3, Table 5: ablation with same constraints — masking 81.7/87.5, uniform lookahead 90.7/97.7, trained 90.4/97.7 on VH AS; no-LM search 83.8/93.1; classical planner 47.2/84.6 VH AS and 13/37 BEH AS
Section 3.3/Table 1: exact factorization yields additive (57K) vs multiplicative (350M) states, ~1,900× faster and ~67,000× less memory; meta-token HMM per-action NLL 2.01 vs token HMM 33.54
Table 4: porting to Qwen3-8B and Gemma-3-12B-it in ~40/~35 changed lines with no training, both reaching 90.7/97.7 and 89.4/96.1 task/exec SR on VH AS

Limitations + Appendix G: constraints must be DFA-expressible; BEHAVIOR affordance prior from public BDDL taxonomy rejects 17% of gold plans; guarantee is relative to believed symbolic state on the real robot

Appendix D: HMM training on up to 1,000,000 generations per (benchmark, module) pair, temperature 0.1, seed 42, with held-out NLL scaling analysis; Appendix J/project website provides rollout videos but no code release is stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-methodology paper (constrained decoding for LLMs) applied to embodied planning, not pure robotics, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply; it matches the high-weight LLM, reasoning/planning, and agents/task-planning preferences. Core contribution is a genuinely new exact two-level factorization of token-level syntax and action-level semantics via meta-tokens on top of Ctrl-G, with a clean bijectivity argument and large tractability gains (Table 1: 350M states/1e7 TB monolithic vs 57K states/1.6 GB factored). Rigor and evidence are strong: multi-benchmark evaluation (EAI, WAH-NL, real XArm7), component ablations (Table 5 separating masking/uniform/trained lookahead and a no-LM search baseline), honest negative results (uniform lookahead matches or beats the trained HMM on some modules; BEHAVIOR prior rejects 17% of gold plans; syntax-only masking collapses task SR to 1.4), per-module error accounting (Appendix H), and six-seed evaluation variance handling (Appendix K). Weakened by cross-protocol external comparisons (Table 2 footnotes admit different LM/executor), a small real-robot evaluation (3 tasks), and limited generalization beyond DFA-expressible constraints with published specifications. Detailed appendices support reproduction, but no code release is stated, only a project website with videos.

primary_link.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints

recommendations.summary: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduce
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Meta-Ctrl,一個受限解碼框架,在保留基礎語言模型計畫品質的同時,對機器人規劃的語法與語意約束提供形式保證。核心概念是元詞元——由接地動作構成的緊湊詞彙,使語法(合法動作名稱、參數結構、JSON 格式)在詞元層級強制執行,語意(前置條件、目標、時序)在動作層級強制執行。方法建立在 Ctrl-G 的機率前瞻重加權之上,此精確因式分解讓聯合約束解耦為兩個獨立子問題,將受限解碼的記憶體需求從超過 10^7 TB 壓至 2 GB 以內,運算量約減 1,900 倍、記憶體約減 67,000 倍。實驗上,Llama 3 8B 經 Meta-Ctrl 強化後,在 VirtualHome 動作排序上任務成功率從 21.3% 升至 90.4%,超越 EAI 排行榜所有模型(含 Llama 3 70B、GPT-4o、o1-preview);在 WAH-NL 的 LoTa-Bench 協議下達到最高回報的子目標成功率 0.705,超過 GPT-4;在真實 XArm7 桌上型機器人上,每個生成計畫依建構即滿足前置條件與目標,達到 100% 計畫有效性。消融顯示機率前瞻(相較僅遮蔽的可行性檢查)是品質增益的主要來源。限制包括約束須可由 DFA 表達、依賴結構化規格(BEHAVIOR 上固定的 affordance 先驗會拒絕 17% 黃金計畫),以及保證僅相對於機器人感知估計的狀態。此工作展示小型開放權重模型可在保證下媲美前沿模型。

links.title: TraceGrant: A Contract-Governed Security Framework for the Task-Effect Lifecycle of Networked LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'TraceGrant recorded no attack successes while retaining utility under attack rates of 77.32% and 83.00%, respectively' across 949 AgentDojo and 400 ASB attack cases.
Table 1: TraceGrant ASR 0.00% for all four task-executing models on both AgentDojo and ASB, vs. NoDefense 9.64%/85.00% and Task Shield 2.24%/9.25%.

Section 'White-Box Defense-Aware Attack Analysis', Table 4: 2 of 100 targeted cases succeeded (2.0%), with success path 1 (bill payment) showing 'provenance and evidence admissibility can establish that an argument came from the designated object, but not that the fields inside that object are semantically authentic.'
Table 2 (stage ablations): removing runtime enforcement raises ASR to 0.76% and SVR to 64.75%; removing receipt-backed completion raises FCR to 16.28% and lowers TSR to 68.42%.

Section 'Pre-Execution Contract Compilation and Static-Analysis Quality': 97/97 generated Contracts accepted, 86 with no material deviation from reference Contracts, '0/97=0%' unsafe expansion rate, references independently annotated by two annotators.
Table 5 (Runtime Overhead Analysis): AgentDojo mean latency 22.852s to 30.151s (1.32x) and tokens 40,692 to 55,845 (1.37x); ASB mean latency 24.982s to 35.104s (1.41x).

Section 'Baselines and Model Configurations': Progent, CaMeL, FIDES, AgentSpec, IsolateGPT reproduced from official codebases; Task Shield reimplemented; FIDES excluded from ASB because ASB 'does not expose the corresponding provenance and label-propagation interfaces assumed by FIDES.'
Data availability: benchmarks public, but artifacts 'available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' rather than openly released.

Section 'Limitations and Future Work': acknowledges evaluation restricted to 'office, communication, travel, and financial environments with relatively structured task dependencies', excluding long-running, cross-session, and multi-agent settings.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope paper: security framework for LLM agents against indirect prompt injection, governed by a deterministic Permission-Obligation-Evidence-Completion Contract with one-shot Effect Certificates, receipts, and a Final-Answer Gate. Strongly matches top-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLMs, Red Teaming/Evaluation). Novelty is a solid but incremental synthesis: it extends Progent-style policy enforcement and CaMeL-style isolation with persistent task state, evidence provenance for authority-bearing arguments, and completion gating. Rigor is above average: full AgentDojo (949 attack cases) and ASB (400), six baselines, stage ablations (Table 2), runtime/completion stress tests (123 and 126 constructed cases), a white-box defense-aware attack analysis, and overhead measurements (Table 5, 1.32-1.41x latency). The headline 0% ASR is credible given deterministic PDP/PEP mediation outside the model, and the paper honestly discloses 2/100 white-box successes (evidence-object semantic poisoning, unbound optional authority-bearing argument), which delimits the guarantee. Evidence strength is tempered by: exactly-0% claims resting on a single undocumented implementation, no variance/significance reporting across the 3 runs, a self-reimplemented Task Shield baseline, FIDES excluded from ASB, and task-executing model names (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Qwen3.7-Plus, GLM-5.2) that cannot be externally verified. Generalizability is moderate: requires structured tool schemas, BIND-expressible arguments, and observable postconditions; authors acknowledge limits to long-running, multi-agent, and asynchronous settings (Limitations section). Reproducibility is middling: public benchmarks and detailed configuration, but code/artifacts only 'available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' (Data availability).

primary_link.title: TraceGrant: A Contract-Governed Security Framework for the Task-Effect Lifecycle of Networked LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Networked large language model (LLM) agents retrieve information from email, cloud storage, calendars, transaction platforms, and Web services to complete multistep tasks that produce persistent external effects. The same content needed for legitimate execution may also contain indirect prompt injections that redirect tool use, alter sensitive arguments, or disrupt task completion. Existing defenses mainly constrain untrusted content or individual tool calls, leaving user intent, runtime evidenc
recommendations.summary_zh: 網路化 LLM 代理透過工具完成多步驟任務並產生持久的持久外部效應,而執行所需的執行期內容可能夾帶間接提示注入,改寫收件者、金額或擴大資源範圍。既有防禦多只約束不可信內容或單一工具呼叫,未能連貫使用者意圖、執行期證據、實際效應與任務完成。本文提出 TraceGrant,以明確契約治理任務效應生命週期:執行前由語意契約編譯器從可信請求推導 POEC(權限、義務、證據、完成)契約,並經確定性靜態驗證;執行中透過義務分類帳、證據准入、型別化引數證明、呼叫預算與一次性效應憑證,限定執行期資料只能具現化既有權限而不能創造新權限;執行後以效應收據綁定原生執行結果,最終答覆閘門須待所有硬性義務驗證完成方接受任務完成聲明。在固定基準設定下,949 個 AgentDojo 與 400 個 ASB 攻擊案例皆無攻擊成功,受攻擊效用分別為 77.32% 與 83.00%;白盒防禦感知攻擊僅 2/100 成功,暴露證據欄位語意真實性與選填引數綁定覆蓋等邊界。消融與壓力測試釐清三階段各自貢獻,執行期開銷約 1.3 至 1.4 倍延遲。此框架將提示注入防禦從訊息層提升至任務效應治理層,對安全部署網路化代理具實務價值。

links.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees

evidence: Abstract: 'BPS outperforms all the baselines, reaching 0.73 measured task success versus 0.20–0.52 for released skill routers, text retrievers, and the executor's own selection, on 28% fewer tokens than the strongest released router.'
§4.2, Theorem 1: BPS output satisfies bicriteria guarantee F-hat(S_BPS) >= (1-1/e)G-hat(T) - kappa-hat*ell(T) for all feasible T; tightness argued via Feige (1998) NP-hardness.

§5.1: contamination-controlled testbed forks BigCodeBench with 16 private modules over d=5 capability families, L=31 skill documents, '63,596 executions ... against real test suites'; task admission requires private-module solution to pass and one-capability hybrids to fail.
§5.3: 'BPS attains the exact optimum of (10) on all 80 instances'; singleton-scoring rules reach optimum on under a tenth of instances, set-scoring heuristics on 45%/44%.
§3.3, Proposition 1: selection regret bounded by 2*epsilon + delta under Assumption 1 (uniform fitting error); fitted supplies recover hidden coverage matrix with AUC 0.996 (Fig. 2).

§5.4: neural capability encoder (frozen text-embedding-v4, 64 dims) reaches 0.68 measured success on 716 tokens, '0.05 below the lookup-table instantiation' — indicating a generalization gap for deployment beyond the benchmark.
§6 Conclusion: acknowledges 'degradation models beyond a linear per-token charge' as future work; no code or data release statement anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core Agents & Tool Use / LLM paper: formalizes skill selection under a hard token budget as regularized submodular maximization and gives the first claimed bicriteria (1-1/e,1) guarantee (Theorem 1, §4.2), proved in full in Appendix A with a new budget-aligned interpolation step. Theory is genuinely new as a combination (regularized objective + heterogeneous knapsack + integral output + zero additive loss) but assembles known machinery (Sviridenko 2004, Kulik et al. 2021, ParetoGreedy prefix recording, distorted greedy), so novelty is good rather than exceptional. Rigor is strong: explicit assumptions, error-transfer proposition, ablations (linear-response model), value-model and deployed-selector baselines, exhaustive-search ground truth. Evidence is solid within a self-built, contamination-controlled fork of BigCodeBench (63,596 executions, §5.1), but single executor (Qwen3-32B), 31-skill library, and tasks gated to require injected skills limit external validity; the deployable neural-encoder variant drops to 0.68 from 0.73 (§5.4). No stated code/data release. Preference relevance to LLM agents, context budgeting, and tool/skill orchestration is very high.

primary_link.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees

recommendations.summary: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window is now the primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. As a result, redundant or poorly chosen skills waste scarce context to
recommendations.summary_zh: 技能文件已成為 LLM 代理取得任務能力的主要途徑，但既有技能選擇多以語義相關性逐一評分，再以 top-k 或貪婪裝箱組合，忽略能力互補、冗餘與上下文成本，可能浪費稀缺的 token 預算甚至損害表現。本文首度將技能選擇形式化為正規化次模最大化問題：在硬性 token 預算下，最大化單調次模的能力效益並扣除線性上下文懲罰。由於目標可能為負、無法進行常數倍近似，作者提出 Best Prefix Selection（BPS）——種子規模為二的部分枚舉密度貪婪演算法，記錄每條鏈的所有前綴並回傳最佳者，並以新穎的預算對齊插值論證證得雙準則 (1−1/e, 1) 近似保證，其效益係數在多項式時間內最優。在污染受控的 BigCodeBench 變體上，僅由執行成功與否的記錄擬合的結構化目標可準確預測未見技能組合，BPS 於全部 80 個選擇實例達到精確最佳值，量測任務成功率 0.73，勝過已發布的技能路由器、檢索器與執行者自選（0.20–0.52），且 token 用量較最強路由器少 28%。此工作為技能選擇提供首個理論保證與實證基準。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely on high-weight preferences (LLM evaluation, AI safety, red teaming, alignment, code security). It unifies 46 mostly pre-existing tests across 9 services and evaluates 121 models, with the main novel contributions being cross-dimensional trade-off analysis (safety tax, privacy orthogonality) and a characterization of distillation-induced robustness collapse. Rigor is solid: standardized inference, multi-judge ensembles with cross-judge validation (Pearson 0.985), confidence intervals on correlations, stakeholder/Dirichlet ranking-robustness checks, and internally consistent tables (Table 1 matches Table 7). However, headline claims rest on observational correlations rather than interventions, each prompt is run once (temperature=0, Appendix 0.B), the representational diagnostic uses only 50 prompts, and generation comparisons carry uncontrolled confounds. Generalizability is bounded by English-only tests and black-box access (Section 6). Reproducibility is strong: public portal, released scripts/datasets, recorded proprietary model identifiers and evaluation dates. primary_link.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

recommendations.summary: The critical failure modes in deployed large language models (LLMs) are cross-dimensional: a model can score 99.3 in safety alignment while refusing one in three benign queries, or improve across every capability metric while losing 21 points in privacy. Existing evaluation frameworks that assess safety, security, and privacy independently cannot detect these patterns. We introduce aiXamine, a unified black-box platform that evaluates LLM trustworthiness across safety, security, and privacy as i
recommendations.summary_zh: 部署後的 LLM 失效模式常為跨維度的，但既有評測框架將安全、資安與隱私各自獨立衡量，無法偵測其交互作用。本文提出 aiXamine，一個統一黑箱評測平台，整合 9 項服務、46 項測試與自動化紅隊管線，在相同條件下評測逾 120 個專有與開放權重模型，產出階層式風險輪廓並支援利害關係人加權。逾 5,000 次測試揭示單軸評測無法察覺的三大現象：其一，安全執法帶來可量測的安全稅——對齊越強則過度拒絕越嚴重（與越獄魯棒性相關係數 −0.39）；其二，隱私與其他可信度維度近乎正交（平均 |r|=0.13），不受標準對齊影響，且七個模型世代中有五個出現隱私退步，如 GPT-4o 至 GPT-5 整體提升 3.84 分但隱私下滑 21.73 分；其三，作者正式刻劃蒸餾誘發的魯棒性崩潰：缺乏 on-policy 修正的離線策略蒸餾造成熵崩潰，使同架構模型的對抗魯棒性由 56.9 跌至 2.6。安全行為亦呈類別依賴性，越獄魯棒性組內差距達 47 分。這些發現顯示可信度本質上是多維度的，推動未來走向模組化、維度感知的安全架構。
recommendations.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multi-agent LLM safety paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Alignment, LLM): populations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct agents are infiltrated by committed misaligned minorities, and population-level capture is forecast from benign-operation logs via a mean-field response function. The prospective forecasting angle extends rather than merely replicates prior LLM-population work (De Marzo et al., Ashery et al.), and the rationale-visibility defense and recovery results are new in a local, bounded-memory setting. Rigor is strong: sealed preregistered forecasts at held-out doses (§5.3, Table 1, MAE 0.0058), baseline comparisons (Supplement Table 6), exact sign-flip permutation tests (§5.4, p=0.0078), KM capture-time analysis, and honest disclosure that neighboring doses informed model development and that the response curve is observational, not causal. Evidence is convincing internally but rests on one model, one task family, 3-8 seeds per cell, and a capture criterion whose delay effect is not invariant to the action threshold (Supplement §16.2). Generalizability is explicitly narrow and acknowledged. Reproducibility is high: verbatim prompts and scenario texts, complete configuration table, seeded runs, and an accompanying anonymized code-and-data archive. No instruction-in-content issues found; out-of-scope exclusions do not apply.

primary_link.title: Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations

recommendations.summary: The unit of AI safety evaluation is still the individual model, yet language-model agents are increasingly deployed in interacting populations that read and write one another's decisions. This raises a question no single-agent audit can answer: an agent that is well-calibrated on its own may still be pulled toward a different decision by the agents around it. We study this on a security-triage task, where populations of language-model monitors decide whether to escalate or dismiss alerts, and in
recommendations.summary_zh: AI 安全評估長期以單一模型為單位，但 LLM 代理日益以互動群體部署，個別代理校準良好不保證群體安全。本文在安全分類任務上建立 12 個代理的完全圖群體：先讓全誠實群體運作 15 輪穩固期，再注入 k 個永遠主張駁回警報的承諾少數派。作者從無敵手的良性運作日誌校準回應函數 g(d)，結合平均場混合項，預測受攻擊後誠實代理的穩定駁回率 m*。在三個留出攻擊劑量（k=2、4、5）上，預測與實測的平均絕對誤差低於 0.008，遠優於以受攻擊劑量擬合的三種基線；而單一代理審計在邊界情境高估集體行為達 0.18，顯示個體對齊不等於群體對齊。讓誠實代理看見彼此理由可完全中和溫和攻擊，卻只把高劑量的捕獲時間延後約一倍；移除攻擊者後群體回歸原狀，證明俘虜是暫時狀態而非永久陷阱。限制包括僅驗證單一模型、單一任務與小群體，且封閉式忽略論證內容與時間相關性。此研究的意義在於群體在攻擊下的行為可於事前由良性運作讀出，為前瞻性群體安全稽核與協定級防禦奠定基礎。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A sandbox (Thinkingbox) and 507-task benchmark (Thinkingbox-bench) for LLM agents in stateful, policy-conditioned business workflows with MCP tools, terminal-state/side-effect checks, and repeated-trial reliability metrics. Preference relevance is very high: it directly targets the Agents & Tool Use and LLM evaluation clusters (tool calling, MCP, business workflows, leaderboard across frontier and open-weight LLMs). Novelty is moderate: the core ideas (on-policy user simulator, terminal database-state grading, pass@k vs pass^k reliability, collateral-effect detection) are inherited from tau-bench, tau2-bench, ToolSandbox, and AppWorld; the contribution is their consolidation into one reusable runtime plus two new enterprise domains (neobank internal IT, consulting IT/HR). Rigor is solid: 10,140 trials per model across 12-14 models, task-cluster bootstrap CIs, a deterministic failure-signature taxonomy (Table 5), a retrospective evaluator ablation on 79,853 failed trials (Table 12), and an unusually candid limitations section. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged constraints: tasks are synthetic reconstructions from a non-public source collection, a single golden terminal state excludes multi-resolution workflows, one fixed GPT-5.4-mini simulator/judge shared with the strongest agent's family, and 477/507 verdicts ignore the final response. primary_link.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows

recommendations.summary: Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox,
recommendations.summary_zh: 現有代理評測多聚焦程式修復、工具呼叫正確性或網頁導航，難以檢驗有狀態、多輪且承擔後果的商務工作。本文提出 Thinkingbox，一個工具—代理—使用者互動的沙盒，提供隔離的 MCP 相容工具工作階段、完整執行軌跡與以終端後端狀態為準的結果評測；並在其上建構 Thinkingbox-bench，涵蓋零售、旅宿、汽車保險、新創銀行內部 IT 與顧問 IT/HR 支援共 507 個政策制約工作流。每項任務由任務特定可執行檢查評分，接受有效軌跡的同時拒絕錯誤、遺漏或額外的持久效應，其中 30 項另檢查最終回覆的必要屬性。評測 12 個專有與開放權重模型、每任務 20 次嘗試後，最強的 GPT-5.4 達 65.36% pass@1 與 91.12% pass@20，但僅 25.25% 的任務在全部 20 次皆成功，呈現巨大的探索—可靠度落差。軌跡分析顯示 77.5% 的失敗源自工具使用錯誤且未能修復；回顧性消融更指出 67.2% 的失敗在弱觀測評測下看似完成，證明回覆或工具呼叫層級訊號並非端對端完成的可靠代理。局限包括模擬使用者行為受限與部分任務僅檢查後端狀態。

recommendations.summary_zh: 瀏覽器代理在短而乾淨的示範上表現良好，但真實部署要求代理在動態網站上維持數十個決策、從錯誤中復原並應對複雜 UI。本文指出三個相互交織的結構性挑戰：訓練資料由成功軌跡主導、缺乏復原與複雜 UI 的監督；長軌跡中少數關鍵分支步驟的學習訊號被均勻稀釋；現有基準低估雙語長時程真實網站任務。對應方案為統一管線：結構化瀏覽器 harness 提供穩定的執行原語與決策導向的情境管理；RUIC-SFT 以反思豐富的復原軌跡與 UI 專門資料進行三階段課程式微調；DAO-GRPO 透過基於勢函數的獎勵塑形、分歧感知的步驟信用加權與回應級最佳化，改善長時程信用分配。另建構 BrowserBench：350 個中英雙語真實網站任務，平均 37.9 步、橫跨 254 個網站。Wuying-Browser-Agent-27B 在 WebVoyager 達 80.6%、Online-Mind2Web 達 66.7%、BrowserBench 達 65.1%，刷新開源瀏覽器代理的最好成績，並在 Tau2-Bench、Claw-Eval 與 BFCL-v4 達平均 73.8，展現通用代理能力。消融實驗確認各元件貢獻：RL 增益隨任務難度與軌跡長度遞增，符合長時程設計動機。

Methods, 'Statistics': exact binomial McNemar, Newcombe paired-proportion CIs, cluster bootstrap (10,000 replicates) on continuous endpoints; all 156 model-supervised, 78 ablation, and 117 non-model episodes reported, none excluded.

Results, reasoning-effort case (Fig. 3): low vs high effort differ on one S4 episode (stiction misdiagnosis trip vs composition-imbalance stabilization), one discordant pair, McNemar p=1.0, explicitly reported as a single case without effect size.

Discussion, limitations: evaluation in simulation only, single process, nominal forward simulator cannot predict disturbance-induced trips (Fig. 5 failure), no human-operator comparison, no formal safety guarantee; safety-gap class solvable by rule table, so reasoning contribution is confined to diagnosis.

Data and code availability: harness, benchmark definition, prompts (Parts A/B), validator bounds and analysis at github.com/khalidlabs/safetep-core; TEP kernel at github.com/khalidlabs/tep-studio; scenarios and prompts frozen by content hash.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/LRM agent paper with language methodology at its core, not a pure domain application: zero-shot prompting of large reasoning models (Claude Sonnet-5 high/low effort, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) as a closed-loop decision layer with a bounded tool/action interface, a what-if simulator tool, propose-validate-execute verification, and inference-time compute (reasoning effort) as the key variable. This maps strongly onto the LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Agents & Tool Use, and Prompting preferences. Rigor is high: paired (scenario, seed) design with n=39 per configuration, exact McNemar and Newcombe paired-proportion CIs, cluster bootstrap, pre-calibrated and hash-frozen scenarios, a verification ablation (no-shadow and no-validator both 39/39) quantifying model-vs-check contribution, a scripted rule-table comparator isolating diagnosis (15/15 vs 2/15), and honest failure taxonomy. Evidence is solid but bounded: all simulation on a single process (Tennessee Eastman), diagnosis scored best-of-n, single sample per episode with 'independent re-sampling not performed', saturating primary endpoint that cannot separate configurations, and the headline reasoning-effort effect rests on one discordant pair (McNemar p=1.0), which the authors correctly decline to size. Novelty is moderate: components (LLM agent, validator, simulator tool) are known; the contribution is the integration, quantified delegation of authority, and a reusable benchmark. Generalizability is limited by single-process evaluation and acknowledged untested sim-to-real gap. Reproducibility is supported by cached byte-replayable transcripts, hash-frozen prompts/benchmark, released harness repos, and listed API parameters, but supplementary material and repo contents are unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Large reasoning models for abnormal situation management in safety-critical industrial processes

recommendations.summary: Automation operates safety-critical processes inside their design envelope and leaves abnormal situations to human operators. Mismanagement of these situations is a leading contributor to process-safety incidents and a hindrance to achieving autonomy. Here we show that a general-purpose large reasoning model, with no task-specific training and only the information available to an operator, manages abnormal situations at run time through a bounded, programmatically verified action interface. Acro
recommendations.summary_zh: 異常狀況管理（ASM）長期仰賴控制室操作員，誤處置是製程安全事故的主因之一，也是邁向自主工廠的關鍵障礙。本文探問大型推理模型（LRM）能否在執行期對整廠製程執行 ASM。作者在 Tennessee Eastman 製程上，將 Claude Sonnet-5 等推理模型置於基礎調節控制層之上，限制於有界且經程式化驗證的動作介面：模型僅能調整經驗證範圍內的設定點、啟用預工程保護元件、執行預審程序、不採取行動或下令有序停機，每項提案皆經靜態檢查與標稱模型影子模擬審查。模型僅接收操作員可得之資訊，零樣本提示且無任務特定訓練。在 39 個異常與操作點變更情境中，高推理力配置於全部 39 集保持所有硬約束，而基準調節控制有 15 集跳機；在全部 15 個安全差距情境正確診斷根因；跨 30 倍成本的三款模型結論一致，消融亦顯示成果並非仰賴驗證層。局限在於僅於模擬環境評測，且標稱模擬器無法涵蓋真實擾動。此工作量化了語言模型於安全關鍵控制中可安全委授的權限條件。

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps; consistent with Table 2 ALFWorld OOD +9.0 and Table 3 SWE-verified steps 55.01 to 49.61 (9.8% vs Original Envs).

Section 4.1: EnvRigger and policy share the same model backbone per benchmark (Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite for ALFWorld/WebArena, Gemini-3.5-Flash elsewhere) to rule out distillation from a stronger model; baselines share seed instances, environment count, extraction pipeline, and policy model.

Table 2: ALFWorld OOD 70.4 vs 61.4 (Original Envs), WebArena avg 41.6 vs 38.5, reported as means over three independent runs with standard deviations; WebArena GitLab gain (+2.3) is within reported std devs.
Section 5 / Table 4: GRPO on Qwen3-8B-base; ALFWorld In-Dist 87.9 vs 81.4 but OOD 88.8 vs 89.6, with the slight regression explicitly disclosed; WebShop 79.2 vs 75.6 score.

Table 9 (Appendix F.4): cross-model gains over Original Envs of 2.7-3.7 absolute points across Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Qwen3.6 27B, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, spanning open-weight and proprietary backbones.

Appendix H (Limitations): admits design-loop compute cost, the resettable reset/step interface requirement excluding live services and robots, and sequential-only Chain composition without semantic composition.

Appendix A and Table 8: full EnvRigger designer system prompt and hyperparameters (K=5 rollouts, revision budget 5) are provided; Appendix C details the ActionableEnv bridge/decorator protocol; code release claimed at github.com/google-research/envharness.

Appendix G Table 11: token accounting shows EnvHarness matches the real-execution baseline VeriEnv (137.3M vs 137.8M total tokens) while GenEnv is 3.5x cheaper but uses LLM-simulated rollouts, contextualizing the cost of grounding.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper (agent environment customization, RL with GRPO, SWE/web/office agents) that squarely matches the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code 2.0, RL 1.5); it is in-scope language-methodology work, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: interface-level wrapping (Stage/Contract/Chain) that preserves human-built verifiers is a clean reframing against domain-specific environment generation (GenEnv, VeriEnv, SWE-smith), though curriculum/UED and env-generation prior work makes the conceptual distance incremental. Rigor is solid: five benchmarks in four domains, three-run means with standard deviations (Table 2), shared seed/model/budget controls (Section 4.1, Appendix E.2), ablations (Table 5), scaling curves (Figure 5), four-model cross-backbone study (Table 9), token-cost analysis (Table 11), and an explicit limitations appendix. Deductions: several gains are small relative to variance (OfficeQA EM +1.80 with overlapping std devs; ALFWorld RL OOD regresses 88.8 vs 89.6), no statistical significance testing, single evaluation attempt per instance, and headline results depend on proprietary Gemini/Claude models, which limits exact reproduction despite released code, full designer prompt (Appendix A), hyperparameters (Table 8), and RL training details (Appendix F.1).

primary_link.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning

recommendations.summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 代理透過與環境互動學習，但既有環境多為人工建置且靜態：無法針對代理弱點提供訊號，代理進步後亦失去教學價值；自動環境生成則受限於特定領域管線與昂貴或不可靠的驗證器。本文提出 EnvHarness，一層可程式化的外掛元件，在不改動底層環境邏輯的前提下，透過標準 reset/step 介面重塑靜態環境：Stage 修改初始狀態、Contract 重寫動作、轉移與觀察空間、Chain 串接多個環境以延長任務時程，且每個重塑環境皆保留原有人工建置的驗證器。為自動化客製化，作者提出 EnvRigger，將目標策略視為黑箱，觀測成功與失敗軌跡以診斷缺陷，合成候選元件並以全新 rollout 迭代驗證與修訂。橫跨四領域五基準（ALFWorld、WebArena、SWE-bench Verified、OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench），以 EnvHarness 環境萃取的技能在留出任務最高提升 9.0 分、執行步驟減少 9.8%，勝過特定領域生成管線；在強化學習設定下亦提升政策效能至多 6.5 分，且效能隨環境規模持續成長，促成策略與環境共演化。

links.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: o3 falls from 96% on atomic queries to 82% on the most compositional while the 4B program-synthesis model holds at 93%, 'matching or exceeding the frontier on the hardest tasks at a fraction of the token cost'.
Section 2.5: 'we additionally cross-check every released instance against a second, independently written Python+NetworkX implementation of each category' — programmatically verified ground truth.

Table 6 / Section 4.5: within-model comparison on Qwen3-4B — answer SFT reaches 59.2% held-out with a 19.3pp seen/held-out gap, while Ein SFT reaches 94.3% held-out with a 3.7pp gap; 61 of 74 remaining errors are graph-parsing (edge misreading), only 8 incorrect program logic.
Section 3.3 and Table 10: strict and lenient scoring reported for every configuration; method ordering preserved, program-synthesis gap 0.0-0.3pp vs 4.5-6.3pp for direct small models.
Section 4.4: error taxonomy over the 89 L3 errors of GPT-4.1 CoT — direction confusion 24%, depth truncation 26%, accumulation drift 19% — with worked examples in Appendix L.

Table 7 / Section 4.6: compositional penalty survives JSON edge-list and adjacency-matrix encodings; encoding preference is capacity-dependent (adjacency matrix worst for open models, best for Gemini 2.5 Flash).

Limitations (Section 5): program-synthesis result uses one 4B base model and two targets; no 30B+ open models tested; memorisation probe is a single model/configuration diagnostic that does not address pretraining contamination.

Appendix G: repository releases the 1,300-instance split, raw JSONL responses with reasoning traces, generator producing fresh instances 'in under one minute', and training scripts with adapter weights promised on Hugging Face.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-evaluation paper squarely within scope: it benchmarks frontier (o3, GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5) and open-weight Qwen models on compositional graph reasoning, contrasts direct vs chain-of-thought prompting, and fine-tunes via LoRA to emit verified programs. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, evaluation benchmarks, prompting, program synthesis) though not Japanese-NLP related. Novelty is moderate: constructive/procedural benchmarks (DyVal, LiveBench) and program-synthesis-for-graph-reasoning (Zhu et al. 2025, Guo et al. 2025) already exist; the contributions are the primitive-decomposed taxonomy with three independent difficulty axes, dual-implementation verified ground truth, and a seen-vs-held-out memorisation probe. Rigor is strong: temperature-0 decoding, pinned model commits, strict-vs-lenient scoring reported side-by-side (Table 10), format-error decomposition (Table 11), encoding ablation (Table 7), 3-seed memorisation probe, and an honest limitations section. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (e.g., 1,226/1,300 held-out correct, 74-error taxonomy), though key SFT results rest on a single base model and essentially single runs; the headline 'matches or exceeds frontier' claim is appropriately hedged by the authors themselves. Generalizability is limited by small graphs (n=4-20), purely synthetic tasks, and one 4B SFT model, as acknowledged. Reproducibility is excellent: generator, harness, raw responses, seeds, hyperparameters, datasheet, and licensing all released.

primary_link.title: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning

recommendations.summary: We introduce ClosureBench, a constructive benchmark for compositional graph-relational reasoning with programmatically verified ground truth. Unlike fixed-test-set benchmarks vulnerable to data contamination, ClosureBench generates instances on demand: each task's reference answer is computed by executing a program in the Ein tensor-logic language, ensuring machine-verified correctness. The benchmark spans 26 task categories at three compositional levels (L1-L3), with difficulty controlled along
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在多步驟組合式推理上常被認為表現不佳，但既有圖形推理基準多為固定題組，容易受資料污染，且只能沿單一粗略軸變化難度。本文提出 ClosureBench，一個建構式基準：每個任務由明確的邏輯基元（可達性、度數、集合運算、強連通元件、聚合）組合而成，參考答案透過執行 Ein 張量邏輯程式（並以 Python+NetworkX 交叉驗證）計算，可程式化驗證且能無限產生新實例。基準涵蓋 26 個類別、三個組合層級，並提供圖形大小、邊密度與查詢深度三個獨立難度軸。實驗顯示，從 1.5B 開源模型到 o3、GPT-4.1、Gemini 2.5、Claude Sonnet 4 等前沿模型，準確率隨圖形變大與查詢變深而下降；失敗不在表面形式（改以 JSON 邊列表或鄰接矩陣呈現仍持續）或規則本身，而在跨多步驟於圖上執行計算。一個微調為輸出已驗證程式的 4B 模型在各層級間幾乎持平（整體 94.3%），而 o3 從原子查詢的 96% 掉到最組合查詢的 82%；程式合成每個正確答案約 212 tokens，遠低於前沿 CoT。記憶化探針顯示以答案監督微調會產生 19.3 個百分點的已見/留存集落差。限制包括僅涵蓋圖論任務、程式合成只在單一 4B 模型上驗證。此基準對防堵資料污染、精確定位推理失敗點，以及展示低成本的程式合成路線具重要意義。
